events.title: NEW YEARS 2026 - 26 HOUR SILVESTER at DAS and Pumpehuset (PRESALE  SOLD OUT, FEW DOOR TICKET)
events.description:
NEW YEARS 2026 - 26 HOUR SILVESTER @ Den Anden Side & Pumpehuset

Wednesday, December 31 - Thursday, January 1 │ Soft Selection │ Techno, House

————

2025 is soon yesteryear, and it wouldn’t feel right if we didn’t say goodbye to the old year and hello to the new one with a massively long Silvester party. True to tradition, we are joining forces with our sister venue Pumpehuset for a 26-hour marathon celebration featuring 19 DJs on 4 floors across 2 venues.

We open the doors of DAS at 23:00 on New Year’s Eve for 12 hours of steamy, bouncy house grooves on the main floor, delivered by some of the finest local superstars — and our friend Bella Sarris from Stockholm, who joins Lucky Lube for a unique back-to-back experience. Meanwhile, Den Anden Ende will be vibrating with rolling techno beats from some of the most promising newcomers on the Copenhagen scene.

When DAS closes casually late at 11:00, we gear up for another 14 hours of extravaganza in all three rooms of Pumpehuset. The main floor, Kransalen, will once again feature our iconic 360-degree DJ setup, powered by a 4-point quadraphonic sound system enhanced with extra subs, plus a spectacular light show specially designed for the event. The room will be filled with thundering techno kicks as we proudly present two international headliners: ANNĒ from Greece and Swedish-born, Berlin-based Philippa Pacho. They are backed by a handful of equally skilled Copenhagen techno connoisseurs.

The beloved Smokers Floor will once again be sprawling with cute vibes, colorful house, prog, and playful percussion from a selection of notable local artists.

When taking breaks from the dance floor, you can chill out and relax in Sort Sal, which we are transforming into a huge hangout and lounge area with comfortable couches and beds, relaxing visuals, and a delicious darkroom.

Come and dance into 2026 with us!

————

events.title: MIAW with Majdolen
events.description:
MIAW @ Den Anden Side

Saturday, January 03 │ Soft Selection │ Trance, House
————

MIAW was born as a sweaty, sexy, Sunday queer party — a place where kittens could purr, play, and dance through the daylight.

But after a year and a half of sunlit hedonism, it’s time to let the cats come out after dark.

So brace yourselves, babes: we’re launching our first-ever night club edition of MIAW — and we’re doing it with a bang on Saturday, January 3rd, 2026. The very first Saturday of the new year. The claws are coming out.

As always, music is our love language — and this lineup? It’s purring with intention.

Majdolen made the beach stage at 2025-Whole Festival erupt in a blissful queerquake. Now she’s bringing her explosive energy to the booth at Den Anden Side. Expect drama. Expect desire. Expect to sweat.

We’re beyond proud to introduce Bonnie X to Copenhagen for the very first time. His blend of hypertechno and pop bangers is giving everything — and then some.

And of course, it wouldn’t be MIAW without our two founding cats: Alegrando and DJ John Key, back behind the decks to make you howl.

To close the night with a fierce bang: Britney Speed returns to the MIAW lineup — ready to shred your serotonin levels with pure club euphoria.

At MIAW, we make space for sweat, sound, and self-expression. And this night is no exception.

Come early, stay late, dress how you feel — and remember: no one parties like a nocturnal kitten. MIAW.


𝗟𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘂𝗽
Majdolen
Britney Speed
Bonnie X
Alegrando
DJ John Key


Majdolen
Majdolen is a Syrian-born DJ, producer, and curator based in Berlin, known for her emotionally driven sets that move fluidly between techno, trance, house, and disco. A resident of Power Dance club and a standout voice in the city’s queer underground, she played leading parties like Herrensauna, Cocktail D’amore and WHOLE Festival. Her 2024 debut EP Spirals (Umay Works) deepened her reputation as a narrative-focused artist across dancefloors and beyond.

Britney Speed
Britney Speed is resident at both Mainstream and Bedside — and a trusted architect of full-body momentum. Her sets move from high-impact trance to unexpected rhythm shifts and percussive pulses that keep you alert, aching and on your toes. Nothing lands quite where you think it will — but everything hits exactly how it should. She’s closing Miaw Night Edition, and you won’t want to miss where she takes us.

Bonnie X
Bonnie X is a Copenhagen-based queer artist ready to give you the full X-perience. Blending fast, bouncy techno with shameless pop edits and nostalgic bangers, his sets are playful, sexy, and finely tuned for maximum release. With bold taste and fearless curation, he turns the booth into a pressure cooker of pleasure. This night marks his Copenhagen debut — and he’s not here to blend in.

Alegrando
One of the founding felines behind Copenhagen’s sweatiest Sunday parties, Miaw, Alegrando (aka Alexander) is a groove-obsessed selector with a flair for euphoria. Expect a cocktail of 90s trance, old-school rave nostalgia, and proggy house. His sets purr with playful intensity — built for dance floors that don’t want the night to end.

DJ John Key 
As co-founder and resident of MIAW, John Key sets the tone — and the tempo. Known for his high-energy selections and unapologetic love of 90s eurodance, trance and techno, he’s the kind of DJ who doesn’t wait for the party to start — he starts it. With a sharp ear for momentum and a taste for the dramatic, he’ll open the floor with just the right amount of tension.

events.title: Some Traces Of House at Jolene
events.description:
Some Traces Of House represents an artistic platform focused on underground house music where different sound perceptions are highlighted according to each artist. This concept was founded by Ivan Dallmann in 2020. STOH allows international artists to express themselves in music podcasts and it also works as an independent record label and musical events promoter, aiming to diversify channels and boost up different ways of expression.  

In this opportunity we are hosting Guido Sartoris one of the most influential vinyl DJs in Argentina at Jolene in the mythical meat packing district of Copenhagen. He will take care of the decks and be responsible of setting up the finest sound atmosphere, spinning his best selection of records alongside Ivan Dallmann who's in charge of warming of the venue with the deepest house tunes.

Our guest is considered to be on of the most prominent artists, DJs, producers, and communicators of today, born in Buenos Aires, Argentina. He is a member of the duo E110101 alongside Juan Ignacio Chiri, co-founder of Detroit Classic Gallery, a comprehensive artistic project focused on the electronic music industry.

DCG operates as an event production company, audiovisual producer, academy, and record label, and became the largest electroni music YouTube channel in Latin America, surpassing 150k subscribers.

So far, Guido has shared the booth with major figures of the scene and performed at some of the world's most important clubs and events such as Lollapalooza, Tresor, Rex Club, RSO, Rottesone, Cocoliche, Crobar, Creamfields, Artlab, Desco, HÖR, Spook, among others.

It will be a warm vibes winter evening with quality music, good drinks and that special argentine crowd atmosphere you don’t wanna miss at the most iconic club in Denmarks capital.

Event Info.

* Jolene Bar - Flæsketorvet 81, Copenhagen 
* Free Entrance 
* 20+

See you on the dance floor ;)

events.title: Konkylie x Arken Later ?
events.description:
Start 2026 med at gøre mørket lidt sjovere og lunere på ARKEN d.08.01.26 med Den Sorte Skole, lær at strikke, spændende talk og en jungle af strikkede plastikskulpturer i Kenneth Rasmussens udstilling For helvede mand.
Program:
17:00 Guided tour i Kenneth Rasmussens For helvede mand. 18:00 Langbordsmiddag
19:00 Talk med kulturforsker Maria Strynø og forfatter og aktivist Caspar Eric modereret af Luka Holmegaard
19:00 Drop-in strikkeworkshop med @mikkelisaksen @krejacob og @mandestrik
20:00 Deb Foam (live)
21:00 Den Sorte Skole (live)
22:00 Afskum (DJ)
23:00 Tak for i aften
Langbordsmiddag med vegetarisk curry med hvedekerner, grøn salat, focaccia og pisket smør.
Billetter til fællesspisning og bus til de hurtige finder du via link i eventet.
I anledning af Kenneth Rasmussens udstilling For helvede mand inviterer ARKEN Later? til en talk om, hvordan vi forholder os - i kunsten, i litteraturen, i samfundet - til, at vi som mennesker har forskellige kroppe, kapaciteter og behov. Hvad vil det sige at skabe ligeværd for mennesker med handikap? I mødet med rigide systemer, bureaukrati og digitalisering kan man nemt få brug for at sige "for helvede" - i talken skal de udforske både vrede og sårbarhed som kunstneriske strategier. Hvordan kan man bruge bevidstheden om kropslig forskellighed som drivkraft og materiale i kunst og litteratur? Og kan kunsten bidrage til strukturel og politisk forandring?
Forfatter Luka Holmegaard modererer talken. Deltagerne er aktivist og forfatter Caspar Eric, som debuterede i 2014 med 7/11 og siden har udgivet en række digtsamlinger, senest Crip (2025) på Gyldendal. Han har modtaget Munch-Christensens debutantpris og den norske Bjørnsonpris for sig arbejde, og er en aktiv stemme i den danske debat om mennesker med handicaps vilkår. Og kulturforsker Maria Strynø, som forsker ved Syddansk Universitet i fremstillinger af kroppe med funktionsvariationer i kunsten, og i crip som politisk og kunstnerisk projekt. Hun er PhD fra Roskilde Universitet og har udgivet adskillige artikler i Danmark og internationalt.
Strik for helvede mand!
Må man bande på en sweater? Selvfølgelig.
Til ARKEN Later? lader vi os inspirere af Kenneth Rasmussens vilde strik og no-bullshit-univers—og inviterer dig til at lære at strikke helt fra bunden.
De dygtige strikkeværter @mikkelisaksen @krejacob og @mandestrik guider dig, uanset om du aldrig har rørt en strikkepind før, eller bare vil prøve kræfter med et motiv fra udstillingen. Måske ender du med at brodere et frækt “For helvede mand” på dit næste projekt.
Kom og strik løs til ARKEN Later? Alle kan være med.
Hop med på en helt anderledes omvisning, når KUNSTVOGN ruller ind i For helvede mand. Her dykker vi sammen ned i Kenneth Rasmussens vilde univers – guidet af en af vores skarpe formidlere.
Mellem kæmpestrik og gule indkøbsposer bygger vi skulpturer, mixer materialer og giver megafon-lyd til Rasmussens meterlange grafiske værker.
Vi deler tanker, idéer og indfald undervejs. Hvor samtalen ender, ved ingen – men én ting er sikkert: vi finder masser af svar og nul rigtige facit.
Alt sammen kun for en almindelig entrébillet til ARKEN – få studierabat mod fremvisning af gyldigt studiekort.
Vi ses til en vinteraften fyldt med lune vibes, fællesskab, talk, kunst og musik – og med mulighed for at gøre mørket lidt sjovere.

ARKEN Later? Er et samarbejde med Konkylie.

De dygtige strikkeværter @mikkelisaksen @krejacob og @mandestrik guider dig, uanset om du aldrig har rørt en strikkepind før, eller bare vil prøve kræfter med et motiv fra udstillingen. Måske ender du med at brodere et frækt “For helvede mand” på dit næste projekt.
Kom og strik løs til ARKEN Later? Alle kan være med.
Hop med på en helt anderledes omvisning, når KUNSTVOGN ruller ind i For helvede mand. Her dykker vi sammen ned i Kenneth Rasmussens vilde univers – guidet af en af vores skarpe formidlere.
Mellem kæmpestrik og gule indkøbsposer bygger vi skulpturer, mixer materialer og giver megafon-lyd til Rasmussens meterlange grafiske værker.
Vi deler tanker, idéer og indfald undervejs. Hvor samtalen ender, ved ingen – men én ting er sikkert: vi finder masser af svar og nul rigtige facit.
Alt sammen kun for en almindelig entrébillet til ARKEN – få studierabat mod fremvisning af gyldigt studiekort.
Vi ses til en vinteraften fyldt med lune vibes, fællesskab, talk, kunst og musik – og med mulighed for at gøre mørket lidt sjovere.

ARKEN Later? Er et samarbejde med Konkylie.

events.title: The Disco Express at SIGURD CPH
events.description:
On Saturday, January 10th, The Disco Express rolls back into Klubben, and this time, the train is running full steam. After a long line of unforgettable nights at Sigurd CPH, the London-born collective returns with a renewed spark, ready to turn the dance floor into a glowing engine of disco, house, and unfiltered groove.

Since emerging from an intimate loft party in 2017, The Disco Express has grown into one of Europe’s most beloved disco movements — a record label, a touring party series, and a global community all in one. Their events have lifted floors in New York, Berlin, Paris, and beyond, driven by a mission to bring warmth, soul, and a sense of togetherness back to the nightlife culture. With over 70 releases across their catalogue and co-signs from heavyweights like Groove Armada, Basement Jaxx, and The Blessed Madonna, The Disco Express continues to push a modern, vibrant vision of disco into the future.

For this edition at Sigurd CPH, they’re bringing two artists who embody the deepest corners of their sound:

Third Attempt
The Norwegian producer has been carving out a world entirely his own — lush, aquatic, and brimming with musicality. Known for releases on Beatservice, Det Gode Selskab, Paper Recordings, and most recently The Disco Express, Third Attempt drifts effortlessly between disco, house, jazz, trip-hop, ambient textures, and dreamy electronica. His new EP We’re All Connected has been turning heads, and his sets strike that rare balance between meditative depth and pure dancefloor joy. Expect a sonic journey crafted with intention, detail, and emotion.

Crystal Touch
Hailing from West London and now based in Amsterdam, Crystal Touch brings a soulful sheen to the night. His edits and remixes — out on Midnight Riot, The Disco Express, and more — have earned support from tastemakers like Giles Peterson, Nightmares On Wax, and Yam Who?. Behind the decks, his sets glide between groove-forward rhythms and uplifting disco textures, always with an ear for the warmest, most human side of the dance floor.

We invite everyone to lean into the disco spirit, connect with the crowd, and let the music steer the night. And as always at Sigurd CPH: keep song requests to yourself and trust the journey. No requests, OK?!

Saturday, January 10th:
Prog Realm pres. Trancesetters of Westphalia, Crisco

Raised by the iconic Salon des Amateurs club in Düsseldorf and influenced by late 90's Ambient, Trance and Techno crates, Trancesetters of Westphalia are mostly known for their unique live-set journeys and vinyl only sets. With their Debut EP "Pulse Of The Trees EP" on Junction Forest run by south-korean based artist S.O.N.S they entered the zone and grew a bigger reputation around the Forest Trance and Psychedelic Techno Circle. Deep mystic grooves and tribalistic rhythms define their psychedelic signature style within their experimental and unconventional approach to electronic dance music. As Residents of Salon des Ameteurs they planted another seed with their on-going event series „Symbiotic“ taking place at various venues, aiming to explore a bigger spectrum of experimental and transcending electronic music.

DJ Algorythm
(Vinnie Gotfredsen, she/her) københavnsk nightlife-aktivist og medlem af det normbrydende pornokollektiv Bedside Productions — som både åbner og afslutter natten.

events.title: Vinterbyhaven 2026: dark0wa + Spawner + lucca + Ponny
events.description:
Den 16. januar 2026 vækker vi Byhaven for én aften og hiver alt det dejlige ved Byhaven indenfor i Pumpehuset. Vi snakker kulørte lamper, borde og bænke, rigtig mange Brooklyn-øl, koncerter, naturvin, bingo og selvfølgelig det efterhånden legendariske late night karaoke.
Glæd dig til at opleve lucca, Spawner, Ponny og dark0wa. Derudover holder My Little Party dansegulvet kogende efter koncerterne, mens Karaokaydokay sørger for magisk karaoke på rygeterrassen.
dark0wa
dark0wa gentænker klubmusikken og filtrerer den gennem sin egen blanding af æteriske melodier og tunge beats. Hendes forener pumpende kicks, svævende synths og drømmende vokaler og skaber i mødet et nostalgisk-futuristisk rum, der rummer de tidligere 00’ere og fremtidens electronica. Med rødder i ravekulturen og en frygtløs tilgang til grænser skaber dark0wa musik, der resonerer med internettets kultur og inviterer på en intens og følelsesladet rejse ind i et unikt, alternativt univers.
Spawner
Spawner er Johan Danø Hoffmann, Jonas Engell og Ella Moreno Risell, der laver sange om at føle sig afkoblet fra omverdenen, i en tåget hverdag hvor man står op med en grundfølelse af altid at befinde sig i en feberdrøm. Projektet er en undersøgelse i hvordan tre forskellige stemmer kan skabe en fælles fjerde – og det lykkedes Spawner med i et lydunivers bestående af tætte vokalharmonier, der klinger af folk og country og blander sig med tunge riffs og tempoer fra punk-rock og grunge, dog uden at være bange for poppens melodier og struktur.
lucca
Den danske sanger og sangskriver lucca bevæger sig i krydsfeltet mellem varm poprock, intime vokaler og skæve harmonier. Hendes musik bærer en rå ærlighed og en lyrisk følsomhed, hvor det nære og det skrøbelige får plads. Med en nordisk melankoli og en umiskendelig varme skaber lucca sange, der føles som små øjebliksbilleder af livets stille pauser – ærlige, uperfekte og dybt menneskelige.
Ponny
Ponny træder ind på den danske musikscene med eksplosiv, catchy punk/rock og musikalsk frihed. Trioen blander Riot grrrl, teenage pop og anti-folk med humor og alvor. Teksterne handler om idioter, dårlig sex og vildskab, leveret med hylende guitar, hurtig bas og trommer. Ponny er ukontrolleret energi og alsidige vokaler. Laura, Anna og Asta hylder det umiddelbare og larmende, uden at undskylde for sig selv, og de har meget på hjerte, men trods den nuttede overflade er de trætte af pis!
Billetter er i salg nu via Billetto

FEAR OF MISSING OUT? GOOD. 
Because FOMO is not just a feeling — it’s Den Anden Side's new 2026 club concept. 

Welcome to FOMO, a bounce and hardgroove party focusing on the lighter sounds of the current electronic spectrum, frequently featuring pop edits and with high-energy sets without too many rules and seriousness.

rowdia and Dr. Dextro, will side with you in the final boss fight of a closing set. They’ll take you through time and space with a mix of unstoppable bounce, groovy techno, and unmatched energy!

events.title: THE REMIX x La Vida de Jaime
events.description:
On Saturday, January 17, The Remix returns to Sigurd CPH. A club concept built around celebrating the art and culture of remixing, The Remix looks beyond genres and into the creative act itself. Remixing isn’t just about reworking tracks, it’s about keeping music alive, relevant, and constantly evolving. At Sigurd CPH, we celebrate the remix as a cultural force that continues to push club music forward.

This edition brings together selectors who treat the booth as a space for exploration, connection, and movement.

La Vida De Jaime
Hailing from Málaga, Spain, La Vida De Jaime delivers sets that move freely across time and geography. His sound blends disco, house, funk, and a strong hip hop backbone, jumping effortlessly from Kendrick Lamar to Donna Summer, from 70s afrobeat to Chicago house and 2000s hip hop classics. Influenced by artists like Kaytranada, Folamour, The Neptunes, and Kanye West, his sets are playful, groove-driven, and always centered on the dance floor. With appearances at major festivals, fashion events, and clubs across Europe and the US, La Vida De Jaime brings a global club perspective rooted in rhythm and joy.

SELMA
SELMA is a Copenhagen-based DJ and artist with a deep love for rhythm, movement, and musical fusion. Her sets draw from afrobeat, soul, hip hop, house, and RnB, always tailored to the energy of the room. Known for her original edits and unexpected selections, she brings a vibrant and dynamic presence behind the decks. Whether in the club or the studio, SELMA’s focus is clear: music that makes people move and connect.

DJ Ary
Known to many as a long-standing tour DJ within Danish hip hop, DJ Ary also explores a deeper, more personal side through his house-driven project. Blending dubby house and dance rhythms with Persian musical influences, his sets bridge past and present, club culture and personal history. With years of experience on major stages and a sharp ear for groove, DJ Ary brings both weight and intimacy to the floor.

Let the DJs remix, reinterpret, and build the night as it unfolds. Trust the process, stay present, and dance along to what’s being created. This means: No requests, OK?!

events.title: 4am Kru // Pumpehuset
events.description:
Den britiske jungle-duo 4am Kru lægger vejen forbi København, når de torsdag den 22. januar 2026 indtager Pumpehuset med deres kompromisløse, energiske liveshow.
• Billetpris/gebyr: 210 (35). Dertil lægges et ordregebyr på 10 kr. per transaktion.
• Dørene åbner kl. 20.00
4am Kru består af Howie og Stu, to livslange “music dudes”, der gennem årene har raffineret deres lyd, indtil de fandt frem til det, der nu er blevet deres signatur: en eksplosiv, kompromisløs blanding af tidlig 90’er-rave og jungle, leveret i et intenst liveformat.
Siden de første lockdown-udgivelser har duoen skabt sig et ry som et af de mest autentiske og kompromisløse acts på den elektroniske scene. Med et konstant flow af tracks, et sveddryppende liveshow og opvarmningsjobs for bl.a. Chase & Status er de blevet et navn, der får publikum til at gå amok, uanset om det er på klubgulvet eller foran arena-scener.
Deres koncerter beskrives som en oplevelse i rå energi, hvor Howies live-drumming og Stus beats smelter sammen til et lydinferno, der sender tankerne direkte tilbage til ravekulturens vilde begyndelse, men med en nutidig kant, som har givet dem et dedikeret internationalt publikum.
Glæd dig til en aften hvor intensiteten og den ufiltrerede energi rammer Pumpehuset.

* Free Entrance

events.title: ATW x INSIDE presents: Interplanetary Criminal & Main Phase + more
events.description:
The hyped UK record label ATW is teaming up with the Copenhagen-based power promoters Inside to put together one of the biggest UK garage raves in Copenhagen in recent memory.

Interplanetary Criminal and Main Phase created ATW in 2019, out of a collective passion for underground dance music. With UKG as the main focus, their record label has become the place to be for both upcoming and established artists, that help shape the scene.

Inside consists of two Copenhagen-based promoters who, over the past 15 years, have thrown some of the wildest parties all across Denmark! With their extensive event experience and strong network, both at home and abroad, they’re ready to throw an unforgettable party!

events.title: Jolene Invites: Pangaea (UK), A. Dixen, Vincent's Older Sister
events.description:
On 23 January, Jolene welcomes Pangaea.

A core figure in UK club music and co-founder of Hessle Audio, Pangaea’s sets move fluidly between dubstep lineage, techno, garage and modern bass music. Always sharp, physical and forward-facing, with a deep understanding of the dancefloor.

A rare chance to catch one of UK club music’s key figures in an intimate room.

Support comes from A.dixen, delivering deep, fluid club selections rooted in the local scene, and Vincent’s Older Sister, bringing a more textural, off-axis approach to the floor.

Starting the year with quality!

events.title: Tunghør: The Last Dance
events.description:
Tunghør: The Last Dance

In the steamy hot summer of 2018, a new crew appeared on the Copenhagen techno scene. We have had a mighty run for the past 8 years that we are extremely proud of:
25 events, working with 8 different clubs / venues, booking 20 different international artists (17 of these for their DK debut) and 35 different local artists.
The time has now come to have our last dance as Tunghør; and while that may sound sad – let’s make this a celebration of all the great moments and memories we have created together with all of you.
We hope to see as many of our friends / family / guests as possible - let’s show this city one last time what Tunghør is all about.

With Love

The Tunghør crew

events.title: 100%WET - SOLD OUT
events.description:
VEGA x Soundvenue LIVE præsenterer: 100%WET
___________________________________________________________________
Døre: 19.00
Koncertstart: 20.00
Billetpris: 180 kr. inkl. gebyr
___________________________________________________________________
Duoen 100%WET består af de to producere og guitarister Jakob Birch (The Lost Weekend, Lovespeed) og Casper Munns (Himmelrum, Drop, Splitscreen), som udfolder deres mægtige shoegaze-univers, der henter inspiration i 90’ernes breakbeats, drum’n’bass og vaporwave.
For nyligt har 100%WET samlet al deres kærlighed til alverdens genrer og udgivet EP’en Leave it (2025), som tematisk leger med kontrasterne mellem at leve i nuet og nostalgi.
Birch og Munns studerede begge på Rytmisk Musikkonservatorium i København og dannede deres musikalske bånd i 2022 gennem en fælles fascination af at kombinere elementer fra breakbeat, drum'n'bass og acid house med deres grunge- og shoegaze-sangskrivning.
I januar var 100%WET en del af VEGAs Udvalgte 2025, hvor Soundvenue roste deres eksperimenterende toner:
“Duoens to medlemmer koncentrerede sig i bedste shoegaze-ånd om deres instrumenter og deres mange effektpedaler, der skabte en tætpakket, støjende lyd. Vi fik både breakbeat, hård techno, janglepop og endda en kort Merzbow-klingende noise-intro fra dj’en. Det var en tour de force af vilde musikalske indtryk.”
Duoen optræder med forskellige vokalister bl.a. Eir og Hockeysmith, der tilføjer smukke æteriske melodilinjer til det tempofyldte og guitarprægede lydunivers. Især kunstneren Polly (Amalie Petri) supplerer med æteriske, bløde lag til den ellers tætte og energiske lyd, som 100%WET består af.

events.title: Vinyl's All Night
events.description:
On Saturday, January 24, we invite you to Vinyl’s All Night at Sigurd CPH. A night dedicated to records, selectors, and the physical act of DJing, where the music is carried by crates, not playlists. Expect a slower burn, deeper listening, and a dance floor shaped by intention, warmth, and the crackle of wax.

With the booth surrounded by sound and visuals, the focus stays on selection, flow, and the stories hidden in the grooves.

· Mary Carry
Copenhagen-based selector Mary Carry approaches DJing as a form of storytelling. A lifelong record collector, she plays vinyl with patience and purpose, letting tracks breathe and unfold fully before moving on. Her selections reflect a deep respect for music history, culture, and expression, guided by the simple goal of sharing what she truly loves.

· Manuca
Originally from Portugal and now based in Copenhagen, Manuca brings a warm, globe-spanning sound to the turntables. His roots in reggae are blended with R&B, hip hop, Brazilian music, African and Latin rhythms, and deep house. Driven by flow and positive energy, his vinyl sets are sun-soaked, soulful, and built to bring people together.

· John Vincent
A former b-boy turned turntablist and producer, John Vincent moves confidently between hip hop and genre-crossing club sounds. With years of experience touring and playing stages around the world, his approach behind the decks is precise, playful, and deeply musical. Whether digging into classics or unexpected cuts, his vinyl selections always carry intention and momentum.

· Ras Money
Ras Money is a seasoned selector with decades of experience and an immense record collection. Best known for his deep roots in reggae, his sets travel far beyond one genre, guided by curiosity and storytelling. He never follows charts, instead sending the dance floor on journeys through rare finds, global sounds, and timeless rhythms.

A friendly reminder before you hit the floor: this night is vinyl only. The DJs packed their crates long before the doors opened, so trust the selections, enjoy the surprises, and let the records do the talking.
No requests, OK?!

events.title: 20_14 presents Dorothy Carlos (US) & Rune Kielsgaard
events.description:
20_14 is a Copenhagen-based experimental music platform, label, and event series curated by drummer/producer Rune Kielsgaard, known for organizing unique double-bill concerts featuring diverse artists at venues like the Copenhagen Distillery. It's also the name for associated compilations and releases showcasing Danish and international avant-garde, electronic, and improvised music.
This concert will take place at Beboerhusets intimate cinema, called Biffen. Ask the staff if in doubt when you arrive.
Dorothy Carlos is an experimental cellist and electronic musician known for improvised performances and multi-channel sound installations, blending classical cello with randomized electronics to explore themes of fragility and the imagination, with a background in both music and anthropology, working out of NYC and Chicago. She utilizes extended techniques and effect pedals, performing internationally and collaborating with artists like Brian Oakes, and has been featured in publications such as The Wire and The New York Times.
Rune Kielsgaard is a prominent Danish drummer, producer, and curator known for his versatile work across experimental, avant-garde, pop, and electronic music, often blurring genres with improvisational drumming, post-production, and founding the influential music platform and label 20_14 in Copenhagen. He's recognized for creating intricate sonic textures, building pulsating patterns, and playing with deep sensitivity to sound, having collaborated with diverse artists and bands.

events.title: 2-step Cartel
events.description:
Copenhagen’s 2-Step Cartel is here to remind you why the ’90s rave scene will never die. The local DJ collective is inviting their friend Kip Analog to join them for a night dripping in nostalgia and sweat. Expect high-voltage energy and deep nods to the golden days of Dutch electronic music — when trance, hardhouse, hardgroove, disco, and funk ruled the floor and everyone danced like the sun would never rise. Each DJ adds their own twist to that vintage pulse, bending it into something fresh, raw, and entirely their own. Think warehouse heat, festival euphoria, and the feeling that you’ve stumbled into a time warp where the rave never stopped.

Adrian Salcedo (01-03)

Fresh off his Thailand tour, with standout sets in Bangkok and a NYE blowout at the iconic Full Moon Beach Party on Koh Phangan, Adrian fuses massive ’90s anthems with UKG, soul, and dance. Drawing inspiration from the Dutch scene (ADE, Dekmantel), he will also introduce fresh, original mixes crafted alongside multi-platinum award-winning producer Daniel Mirza
As always he will be taking you to church only this time adding groves inspired by his Thailand tour and Circoloco Phuket.

Kip Analog (03-05)

Kipanga, also known as Kip Analog, is a vinyl collector, devoted music lover, and sonic storyteller who has spent the past seven years bringing people together on the dance floor. Known for his electric selections and infectious groove, he blends soulful energy with warm, dreamy, and welcoming vibes—always choosing tracks that connect people through movement and emotion.
Drawing from his carefully curated record collection, Kipanga crafts playful and uplifting soundscapes that turn every set into a shared, feel-good journey. 

Ankjær B2B svan solo (23-01)

Ankjær & svan solo come together for a set filled with funky grooves, energetic house music, and powerful vocals. The two Copenhagen based DJ’s both take inspiration in their sets from Netherlands and UK, to select a sound that takes any listener to a bouncy and euphoforic journey.
As part of the collective 2-step cartel, they promise a set that brings fun back to the dance floor, as they will be back to back to Baggen.

events.title: Arsenal Mikebe (UG) - SOLD OUT
events.description:
Kroppe og instrument smelter sammen til én, når Arsenal Mikebe går på scenen. Den ugandiske percussiontrio spiller nemlig på ét og samme, hjemmebyggede trommesæt. Kom med, og tag del i en rytmisk ceremoni, når de indtager ALICEs scene under Vinterjazz 2026!
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
Døre kl 20:00 / Show kl 21:00
Køb billet i forsalg: 200 dkk eksl. gebyr / ungebillet: 160 ung dkk eksl. gebyr
Køb billet: https://alicecph.com/event/arsenal-mikebe-ug/
Lyt: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nhH27aQ1Kzg
NB: Koncerten er stående
SCROLL DOWN FOR ENGLISH
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
Den ugandiske percussiontrio Arsenal Mikebe danser på grænsen mellem elektronisk og akustisk musik. De forener nemlig løbende polyrytmer med svimlende udråb og spøgelsesagtige, syntetiske droner. Trioen består af tre fænomenale trommeslagere: Ssentongo Moses, Dratele Epiphany og Luyambi Vicent de Pau, der som en del af det ugandiske kollektiv Nyege Nyege er vokset ud af Østafrikas eksperimentelle scene. Med front mod hinanden, og iført jakkesæt, spiller de på deres hjemmebyggede trommesæt til tre. Med det imellem sig skaber musikerne Arsenal Mikebe en lyd, der både er hektisk og rituel. Det er en slags analog tekno – med en overhængende fare for at falde i trance.
En koncert med Arsenal Mikebe er … som at stå foran en vild, uregerlig og aldeles levende trommeskulptur. Sidste år udsendte trioen deres debutalbum, der meget passende har titlen ‘Drum Machine’. Albummet er produceret af portugisiske Jonathan Uliel Saldanha. På pladen spiller trioen sammen med et lydsystem, der er bygget af Henry Segamwenge og inspireret af trommemaskinen Roland TR-808. Arsenal Mikebe forvandler traditionelle rytmer til metalliske labyrinter. En intens, håndspillet tekno, som de blandt andet har gæstet CTM festival, Roskilde festival og Boiler Room Festival med. Kom med, og tag del i en rytmisk ceremoni, når Arsenal Mikebe kommer til ALICEs scene!
Koncerten er en del af Vinterjazz 2026. Vinterjazz er en landsdækkende musikfestival, som strækker sig over tre uger og rummer omkring 600 koncerter fordelt på flere end 150 spillesteder og arrangører fra Skagen til Svaneke. Vinterjazz 2026 finder sted fra 30. januar til 28. februar. Se mere på www.jazz.dk
Sagt om Arsenal Mikebe:
“Arsenal Mikebe’s “Omuzimu” is an absolute adrenaline rush of polyrhythmic percussion that borders a little on anxiety-inducing. A multi-layered mix of bass kicks, cymbal clicks, and rim shots, the track leaves little room for anything other than the crests of a burbly synth that arrive in perfectly timed waves from what’s apparently a custom-built, reverse-engineered 808” – The Fader
“The one phrase that kept coming to mind the more I listened to DRUM MACHINE was the immortal hook from Aphex Twin’s similarly rhythmic “Come to Daddy”: “I want your soul.” With music this exhilarating, you’d be stupid to refuse”. – Bandcamp Daily
“It’s an absolute belter of a record (...) Nothing outstays its welcome, everything is nominally simple and then shows a rhythmic depth with more listens. It’s rhythm-heavy but it’s not lacking in melodic elements.” – FREQ
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
ENGLISH:
Bodies and instruments merge into one when Arsenal Mikebe take the stage. The Ugandan percussion trio performs on a single, home-built drum kit, played together as one. Join them and become part of a frantic, rhythmic ceremony when they take over ALICE’s stage during Vinterjazz 2026!
The Ugandan trio Arsenal Mikebe dance along the edge between electronic and acoustic music. They seamlessly fuse intricate polyrhythms with dizzying shouts and ghostly, synthetic drones. The trio consists of three phenomenal drummers – Ssentongo Moses, Dratele Epiphany, and Luyambi Vicent de Pau – who, as part of the Ugandan collective Nyege Nyege, have grown out of East Africa’s experimental scene. Facing each other in suits, they perform on their jointly built drum kit. With the instrument placed between them, the members of Arsenal Mikebe create a sound that is both frenetic and ritualistic – a kind of analog techno, teetering on the edge of trance.
A concert with Arsenal Mikebe feels like standing before a wild, ungovernable and utterly alive drum sculpture. Last year, the trio released their debut album, fittingly titled ‘Drum Machine’, produced by Portuguese artist Jonathan Uliel Saldanha. On the record, they perform alongside a sound system built by Henry Segamwenge, inspired by the Roland TR-808 drum machine. Arsenal Mikebe transform traditional rhythms into metallic labyrinths. Their intense, hand-played form of techno that has taken them to CTM Festival, Roskilde Festival, and Boiler Room Festival, among others. Join the rhythmic ceremony when Arsenal Mikebe come to ALICE during Vinterjazz 2026!
The concert is part of Vinterjazz 2026. Vinterjazz is a nationwide music festival spanning three weeks, presenting around 600 concerts across more than 150 venues and organizers from Skagen to Svaneke. Vinterjazz 2026 takes place from January 30 to February 28. Learn more at www.jazz.dk.

events.title: Signal Swap x Sauna Radio with Abstraxion , Softrex, Sean Fender, Renlo
events.description:
Signal Swap x Sauna Radio lands at Jolene for the first edition of Radio Panini’s new international exchange format: one day-to-night handover where community radio heads from different cities end up sharing the same booth, the same room, and (ideally) the same dancefloor.

For this chapter, Sauna Radio—Stockholm’s community web radio born around a sauna setting—comes to Copenhagen with the crew, the energy and a full-spectrum programme: talk, listening, hanging out and broadcasting before we flip the switch into club mode. Sauna Radio broadcasts weekly and has quickly become a local hub for sets, performances and conversations across scenes.

The day starts with an introduction to the people behind Sauna Radio, then rolls into an afternoon/evening broadcast featuring Stockholm and Copenhagen selectors side by side. After that, we push into the afterparty and run it late.

On the night shift:

Abstraxion (Sauna founder / Biologic Records) brings his recognisable blend of Italo-tinged pressure, early trance and rave psychedelia—plus the deep label DNA of releases on imprints like Other People, Hivern Discs and Cocktail d’Amore.

Renlo (SystemError) threads dark disco, Italo and house, with that 80s/90s synth shimmer that keeps the room hot without losing its edge.

Sean Fender (he/she/they) joins as part of the Stockholm orbit—DJ/producer energy with a playful streak, also appearing on Sauna Radio’s own compilation sphere.

Softrex, a Stockholm-based queer DJ with a deliberately wide palette, keeps it moving with genre-blending sets built for momentum and togetherness.


Tune in online via Radio Panini / Sauna Radio, or come catch the whole exchange IRL—radio faces, club faces, and the nice blurry bit in between.

Batukizer DJs

Bringing Brazilian dance music to the World. In the last decade, the duo has shared Brazilian vinyl sets and forgotten genres worldwide 
Having played in clubs and festivals on several continents from Oslo Jazz Festival to Nyege Nyege in Uganda and Rock The Mountain festival in Rio de Janeiro, the DJ sets are compromised of hand-picked, infectious dance tunes on vinyl from a vast collection representing Brazilian sounds from the past. Batukizer also records themed mixes for NTS Radio and Al Hara Radio.  The two DJs have made a significant contribution to the rediscoveries of amazing and forgotten Brazilian dance tunes through many series of mixtapes - a obsession to find grooves and rare dance records - musical treasures often not available on the streaming services.
On their quest of tracking down the forgotten rhythms and rarities, they highlight the incredible Brazilian musical heritage layered with emotions, percussion and regional culture. This research has brought BTKZR on extensive digging trips through 15 Brazilian states including the Amazon, presenting killer grooves and big tunes to audiences worldwide.

The mixtapes and setlist are shared on musical channels such as The Vinyl Factory, NTS Radio, My Analog Journal, Discogs, Le Mellotron, Gouranga, Brazils Mareh Music and Tropicals, The Dream Chimney and Music for Dreams. An example is the ABOM mixtape series on Soundcloud that draws on spirituality and powerful Brazilian rhythms (batuque means percussion and hence the name Batukizer). In 2025 the total number of Youtube plays is well beyond 6 million plays.  With their DJ sets Batukizer brings the tunes and energy to match any electronic or groove based music lineup and has  performed in electronic festivals, clubs and jazz festivals in France, Italy, India, Brazil, Germany, Spain, UK, Sweden, Romania, Norway, Slovenia, Switzerland, Uganda, Finland, Portugal, Tunisia, Belgium, Albani, Ukraine and the US. They’ve shared the stage with and supported Brazilian legends such as Jorge Ben, Azymuth, Marcos Valle, Mari Froes, Gilsons, Banda Black Rio, Céu, Majur, Jards Macalé and Latin Grammy winners Emicida and Liniker.

events.title: Posh Isolation: Loke Rahbek & Frederik Valentin + Vanity Productions + oqbqbo // RUST
events.description:
POSH ISOLATION: LOKE RAHBEK & FREDERIK VALENTIN + VANITY PRODUCTIONS + OQBQBO
Find billetter: https://www.ticketmaster.dk/event/539828917
--------------------------------------
• Døre: 19.00 • koncertstart: 20.00
• Billetter: • Forsalg: 250 kr • Dørsalg: 260 kr
--------------------------------------
Loke Rahbek & Frederik Valentin
“Together” er det tredje kollaborative album fra Frederik Valentin og Loke Rahbek, efter “Elephant” fra 2020 og "Buy Corals Online" fra 2017. Lo-fi-vignetter af guitar og feltoptagelser præsenteres side om side med elektroakustiske eksperimenter som fortryllende invitationer til rytmiske, syntetiske verdener, hvor hver især finder balance i Markers meditation over menneskets hukommelse. Med akustiske instrumenter behandlet digitalt og instrumentale optrædener fortolket på ny bevæger "Together" sig ad den frodige retning fra deres tidligere værker mod nye destinationer.
Valentins lange række af soloarbejde og samarbejder omfatter blandt andet hans produktioner med Yung Lean (som Jonatan Leandoer127) på albummet "Nectar", samt deres fælles bestillingsværk for Sveriges Cullberg Ballet. I mere end et årti har Rahbek skabt elektronisk musik som Croatian Amor og under en række andre aliaser. Han har siden 2009 drevet Posh Isolation sammen med Christian Stadsgaard.
--------------------------------------
Vanity Productions
Posh Isolations anden skaber, Christian Stadsgaard, laver musik under solo-aliasset Vanity Productions - en afgørende figur på den nordiske elektroniske musikscene.
Stadsgaard er kendt for sin innovative og udtryksfulde stil, og med Vanity Productions mixer han larmende elementer med introverte melodier. Med et eksistentialistisk touch og sløret sensibilitet, maler Stadsgaard soniske billeder af moderne melankoli.
Udover sine anmelderroste solo-udgivelser, har Vanity Productions også samarbejdet med Merzbow, Loke Rahbek, Jonas Rönnberg og Isak Hansen.
--------------------------------------
oqbqbo
oqbqbo er aliaset for den russiskfødte, København-baserede kunstner Nastya Sipulina. oqbqbo er tilknyttet pladeselskabet Posh Isolation, hvor hun repræsenterer den mere melodiske del af deres roster.
Hendes seneste udgivelse “Tired Sun” er hendes andet værk på Posh Isolation, og det seneste år har oqbqbo samarbejdet med kunstnere som Scandinavian Star og Vallmo – mest markant på singlerne ‘Airdrops’, ‘Open Like A Flash’ og bidraget til “Rift One” YEAR0001-kompilationen med ‘Wakening’.
Derudover laver oqbqbo jævnligt explorative mixes på NTS Radio og lignende.

SØS Gunver Ryberg:
SØS Gunver Ryberg er en prisvindende elektronisk komponist og lydkunstner, kendt for sin innovative musik, der bryder med traditionelle genredefinitioner. Hun har optrådt på nogle af verdens mest prestigefyldte scener og festivaler, herunder Atonal Festival, Venedig Biennalen, Berlin Philharmonie, Flow Festival, Berghain og Roskilde Festival.
Med en kompromisløs intensitet transformerer hun lytterens oplevelse og åbner bevidstheden for nye dimensioner. Hendes musik er kendetegnet ved kraftfulde og komplekse klangfarver, teksturer og rytmer, der væver sig sammen i et futuristisk og tidløst udtryk, der frygtløst omfavner nutiden og samtidig skaber perspektiver ind i den ukendte fremtid.

In the first chapter of this year’s electronic Wednesday concerts, we welcome SØS Gunver Ryberg — an award-winning electronic composer and sound artist who creates music without genre boundaries and with full intensity. She has performed at venues such as Berghain, Roskilde Festival, and the Venice Biennale, and this evening the chapter opens and closes with support from local friendly man Mikael Frykman.
SØS Gunver Ryberg:
SØS Gunver Ryberg is an award-winning electronic composer and sound artist, known for her innovative music that breaks traditional genre boundaries. She has performed on some of the world’s most prestigious stages and festivals, including Atonal Festival, the Venice Biennale, Berlin Philharmonie, Flow Festival, Berghain, and Roskilde Festival.
With uncompromising intensity, she transforms the listener’s experience and opens the mind to new dimensions. Her music is characterized by powerful and complex tones, textures, and rhythms, woven together into a futuristic and timeless expression that fearlessly embraces the present while creating new perspectives into the unknown future.

events.title: Mad Professor (UK) - SOLD OUT
events.description:
Med et helt særligt greb om mixerpulten og en urokkelig nysgerrighed for lydens grænser har Mad Professor gennem årtier formet dubmusikken, som vi kender den i dag. Vi er beærede over at kunne præsentere den legendariske, visionære guyanesisk-britiske producer, når han inviterer publikum ind i sit kosmos af dyb, hypnotisk og tidløs dub på ALICE til februar.

I mere end fire årtier har den legendariske Guyana-fødte britiske producer Neil Joseph Stephen Fraser aka Mad Professor været en kompromisløs drivkraft i dubuniverset. Hans ikoniske Ariwa-studie i London har dannet ramme om nogle af genrens mest skelsættende produktioner og remix, og han står som en central figur i dubmusikkens anden generation. Her har han arbejdet med ikoner som Lee “Scratch” Perry, Jah Shaka, Pato Banton og Horace Andy, og samtidig sat sit præg på kunstnere langt uden for reggaeens univers. Navne som Massive Attack, Sade, Grace Jones og Perry Farrell har alle lagt deres musik i hænderne på hans transformerende produktioner.
Mad Professors lydunivers er kendetegnet ved dybe basspor, hypersensitiv rumklang og en legende tilgang til studieteknik, der konstant udvider dubbens horisont og på én gang lyder oldschool og futuristisk. Når Mad Professor går på scenen, bliver mixerpulten et instrument i sig selv og publikum inviteres ind i en levende proces, hvor beats, ekkoer og bassens pulserende varme konstant genfødes i nye former. Glæd dig til en aften, hvor en af verdens mest visionære lydalkymister sender vibrationer gennem ALICE og åbner døren til sit kosmos af dyb, hypnotisk og tidløs dub. Det bliver en fest for både dedikerede dubhoveder og nysgerrige lyttere, når Mad Professor indtager ALICE under Vinterjazz.
Koncerten er en del af Vinterjazz 2026 – en landsdækkende festival som finder sted fra 30. januar-28. februar. Mere info via www.jazz.dk

ENGLISH:
With a singular command of the mixing desk and an unshakeable curiosity for the outer edges of sound, Mad Professor has shaped dub music as we know it today. We are honoured to present the legendary, visionary Guyanese-British producer as he invites the audience into his cosmos of deep, hypnotic, and timeless dub at ALICE this February.
For more than four decades, the Guyana-born British producer Neil Joseph Stephen Fraser – better known as Mad Professor – has been a relentless driving force in the world of dub. His iconic Ariwa Studio in London has hosted some of the genre’s most defining productions and remixes, and he stands as a central figure in dub’s second generation. Here, he has worked with icons such as Lee “Scratch” Perry, Jah Shaka, Pato Banto, and Horace Andy, while also leaving his mark on artists far beyond the reggae sphere. Names like Massive Attack, Sade, Grace Jones, and Perry Farrell have all entrusted their music to his transformative touch.
Mad Professor’s sonic universe is defined by deep basslines, hyper-sensitive reverbs, and a playful approach to studio technique that continuously expands the horizons of dub, sounding at once old-school and futuristic. When he performs live, the mixing desk becomes an instrument in its own right, and the audience is invited into a living process where beats, echoes, and bass warmth are constantly reborn in new forms. Expect an evening where one of the world’s most visionary sound alchemists sends vibrations through ALICE and opens the door to his cosmos of deep, hypnotic, and timeless dub. It will be a celebration for devoted dub heads and curious listeners alike when Mad Professor takes over ALICE during Vinterjazz.
The concert is part of Vinterjazz 2026 – a nationwide festival taking place from January 30 to February 28. More info at www.jazz.dk

events.title: Soleima (DK)
events.description:
Soleima fylder VEGA med kompromisløs rock
______________________________________________________________
Døre: 19.00
Koncertstart: 20.00
Billetpris: 315 kr inkl. gebyr.
______________________________________________________________
Soleima er på ingen måde et ubeskrevet blad i dansk musik. Fra P3-hits og stærke liveoptrædener til det anmelderroste album Nationens Skrammer, der for alvor fremhævede Soleimas lyriske talent på dansk, har hun sunget sig ind i danskernes musikhjerter.
Med den aktuelle udgivelse – Hærværk/Mesterværk - Side A tager hun et nyt skridt i sin musikalske udvikling. Med en mere rocket lyd i centrum, er ambitionen klar: Soleima vil være det næste store danske rocknavn. Første halvdel af Hærværk/Mesterværk - Side A viser en rocket, kompromisløs og modig side af Soleima – en lyd som kendetegner de aktuelle koncerter, såvel som den kommende i Store VEGA. Lyden er skabt i samarbejde med Bjarke Niemann (Spleen United). Om samarbejdet fortæller Soleima:
"Det var centralt for pladen, at alt blev indspillet live – så det var et af dogmerne, der lå fast, inden vi vidste, hvem der skulle producere pladen. En fælles ven foreslog Bjarke. For mig repræsenterer Bjarke og Spleen United uforudsigelighed og ud-af-kroppen musikalske oplevelser, der tangerer trance og uigennemtrængelig usårlighed. En tilsidesættelse af alt det, der gør os bekymrede og dødelige væsner.”
De to indledende singler, "Den Udødelige Historie" og "Sidste År" vakte bred opmærksomhed, og førte Soleima til ugens udvalgte udgivelser hos Soundvenue og Politiken, og hos GAFFA med en 6-stjernet anmeldelse til det nye album:
”Det kan lyde på grænsen til storhedsvanvid, men sangerens frygtløse tilgang til det grandiose skaber i stedet originale numre, der både bider fra sig og bider sig fast. (…)
På kun 33 minutter leverer Soleima en rå og vital digtsamling på niveau med tidens allerstørste poeter. Hærværk/Mesterværk - Side A er et oprørsk og næsten fejlfrit (mester)værk om selvudvikling og -forståelse.”
Hærværk/Mesterværk - Side A og Soleimas markante kunstneriske vision vidner om en artist, der ikke er bange for at udforske nye territorier på udgivelses- såvel som live-siden.

Friday, February 6, 2200! returns to Sigurd CPH with another night where Nørrebro’s pulse takes control of the dance floor. 2200! is built on the sounds that shape our streets, our nights, and our city, with hiphop leading the way and genres like RnB, House, Funk, Disco, Dance, and Afrobeat moving in and out of focus. This is a club night rooted in energy, attitude, and community. No trends to chase, no formulas to follow, just music that feels right when the lights go low. events.description:
Inferno presents:
Istedgade Lokalradio 004 - The Pata Pata Edition
Here we go. Once again. And this time we’re turning up the Radiator and cranking the humidifier to 11. It’s World o’clock!
Introducing the powerhouse that is Pata Pata, who will have a layover at this edition of Istedgade Lokalradio, by way of their legendary parties at Søhesten. Flanked by the ever-menacing presence of the fabled morning radio shock jocks, Shocking Jockeys, on warm-up, the temperature will be raised ever-so-slowly, like putting a frog in a pot.
Kicking off, and for one night only, Shocking Jockeys skip the hungover morning shifts on air at the station, take a break from the lewd rudeness, and get their primetime spot at this month’s Istedgade Lokalradio. From 18.00 - 20.00 they will dish up a concoction of music from far away lands and tall tales from tall ships. Having appalled and astonished the good listeners of Istedgade Lokalradio every weekday morning on their eponymous radio show for almost two decades, the duo has been let out of the studio for a few hours of frivolity leading in to the main spectacle of the night.
But grown-ups will take over the waves from 20.00, when two-man army Pata Pata commandeers the sound desk, bringing with them the fury of a million burning record bags. Pata Pata is a globally inspired Copenhagen club concept rooted in World music, vinyl culture, and inclusive dance‑floor energy — curated by the multinational duo Mobumfe ¿ Bravo.
Having DJ’ed together for over a decade, the duo currently holds a residency at Søhesten, where they blend Afro, Brazil, Latin, Arab, Cumbia, Caribbean, Thai, Kuduro, and all kinds of eclectic rhythms into a signature Copenhagen dance experience. Their events emphasise community, warmth, and vibrant global grooves — occasionally expanding into special happenings like floating harbour boat parties. And now, with Istedgade Lokalradio, they turn up the electronic edge of their deep‑rooted back catalogue, opening yet another chapter in the evolving Pata Pata Dancefloor Fire Sound.
So, the night will progress thusly:
18.00 - 20.00:
Shock o’Clock w/ Shocking Jockeys
Host: Shocking Jockeys (Morgenværter, Istedgade Lokalradio)

20.00 - 02.00:
Pata Pata
Host: Mobumfe ¿ Bravo
https://www.instagram.com/patapata_dk/

The long and the short of it:
Eight long hours of music from exotic countries, to warm up your winter-depressed heart. Countless excursions into all sort of Worldy weirdness, quite carefully curated for your feet an to put your soul back in to place!

Den dansk-baserede tunesiske producer AMMAR 808 vender tilbage med en kraftudladning af et nyt kapitel. Med sit seneste album “Club Tounsi” (Glitterbeat Records) dykker han ned i Tunisiens vibrerende Mezoued-tradition og sender den direkte ind i fremtiden med buldrende bas, forvrænget elektronik og rituelle rytmer. ⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
AMMAR 808:
I løbet af de seneste år har Sofyann Ben Youssef aka AMMAR 808 gang på gang bevist, at han mestrer kunsten at bygge hele nye universer af lyd. Først med “Maghreb United”, hvor han transformerede nordafrikanske traditioner til en futuristisk klubdrøm, og sidenhen med “Global Control / Invisible Invasion”, hvor han kastede sig frygtløst over sydindiske musiktraditioner og de mytiske fortællinger fra Mahabharata.
Med sit seneste album vender AMMAR 808 blikket hjemad. “Club Tounsi” er en eksplosiv og bastung hyldest til Mezoued – en rå, folkelig og historisk udskældt genre, båret af sækkepiber af gedeskind, håndtrommer og tekster om kærlighedens smerte og hverdagens pres. Det er musikken fra Tunisiens gader, fra arbejderklassen, fra de utæmmede bryllupsnætter hvor fezzani-rytmen sætter skub i dansegulvet. AMMAR 808 tager denne tradition og lader den kollidere med synths, mekaniske beats og dystopisk klubæstetik, så traditionens puls bliver både fremmed og forførende velkendt. Og under Vinterjazz transformerer AMMAR 808 koncertsalen på ALICE til en tunesisk natklub i fuldt kog, når han giver koncert. Er man fan af navne som Nuri, Deena Abdelwahed og Tootard, er denne aften en kæmpe anbefaling.
Mbizo:
Mbizo er et etableret navn på den danske elektroniske undergrundsscene og medlem af event-kollektiverne Lokal, Vesterbro- og Nørrebro Bas Klub. Hans seneste mixtape for Strøm blev udvalgt af Resident Advisor som ‘’Mix Of The Day’’ med titlen ‘’An impeccable production mix’’. Han medvirker også på de danske compilation-LP’er ‘’Danish Dub’’ part 1 og 2 sammen med 2000F, og er senest aktiv med officielle remixes for store danske artister som Bikstok, Raske Penge & Klumben og AV AV AV. Med et bevidst udgangspunkt i dubmusik, bliver elementer fra genrer som grime, dubstep, breaks og UK funky også inkorporeret – Mbizo repræsenterer bas- og soundsystem-kulturen. Mbizo spillede på ALICE under åbningsugen sidste år og vi glæder os til at præsentere ham igen, når han denne gang spiller et liveset.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
ENGLISH:
Denmark-based Tunisian producer AMMAR 808 returns with an electrifying new chapter. With his latest album “Club Tounsi” (Glitterbeat Records), he dives into Tunisia’s vibrant Mezoued tradition and propels it straight into the future with thunderous bass, distorted electronics and ritualistic rhythms. We’re excited to present this visionary sonic storm during Vinterjazz, when AMMAR 808 returns to ALICE. Mbizo opens the night with a live set.
AMMAR 808:
Over the past years, Sofyann Ben Youssef aka AMMAR 808 has repeatedly proven his mastery of building entirely new sound worlds. First with “Maghreb United”, where he transformed North African traditions into a futuristic club dream, and later with “Global Control / Invisible Invasion”, where he fearlessly explored South Indian musical traditions and the mythical tales of the Mahabharata.
With his latest album, AMMAR 808 turns his gaze homeward. “Club Tounsi” is an explosive, bass-heavy tribute to Mezoued – a raw, popular and historically stigmatized genre driven by goatskin bagpipes, hand drums and lyrics about heartbreak and the pressures of everyday life. This is the music of Tunisia’s streets, of the working class, of untamed wedding nights where the fezzani rhythm lights up the dance floor. AMMAR 808 takes this tradition and lets it collide with synths, mechanical beats and dystopian club aesthetics, making its pulse feel both alien and irresistibly familiar. And during Vinterjazz, AMMAR 808 will transform the concert hall at ALICE into a Tunisian nightclub in full boil.
If you’re a fan of artists like Nuri, Deena Abdelwahed or Tootard, this night comes highly recommended.
Mbizo:
Mbizo is an established name in the Danish underground scene of electronic music and he is a member of the event collectives Lokal, Vesterbro- and Nørrebro Bas Klub. His latest work for Strøm (Strøm Mixx 044) got featured at Resident Advisor’s series ‘’Mix Of The Day’’ with the title ‘’An impeccable production mix’’. He also appears on the Danish compilation LP’s ‘’Danish Dub’’ part 1 and 2 together with 2000F, and has recently been active with official remixes for big Danish artists like Bikstok, Raske Penge & Klumben and AV AV AV. With a conscious foundation in dub music, elements of grime, dubstep, UK funky, and breaks are also mixed in - Mbizo represents bass and soundsystem culture. We're looking forward to presenting Mbizo again, this time playing a live set

Komponist Elori Saxl og saxofonist Henry Solomon forener analoge synths og baritonsaxofon og basklarinet i projektet Seeing Is Forgetting. Deres fælles lyd trækker både på jazzens abstraktioner og popmusikkens hooks – en ambient omfavnelse til alle os, der kunne få brug for den.

Elori Saxl komponerer eksperimenterende, elektronisk musik, og Henry Solomon er kunstner, producer og saxofonist. I projektet Seeing Is Forgetting har de forenet kræfterne: Analoge synths møder baritonsaxofon og basklarinet i en lyd, der føles både håbefuld og skrøbelig. Seeing Is Forgetting trækker på abstrakt jazz og minimalisme, såvel som popmusikkens sans for harmonier, form og hooks. Forenet åbner Elori Saxl og Henry Solomon op for en ambient krammer, som leder tankerne hen på andre tider og fjerne verdener. Gå derfor ikke glip af deres koncert under Vinterjazz 2026!
Elori Saxl har modtaget roser for sin evne til at forene digital lyd og analog synthesizere og klassiske instrumenter i alt fra The Washington Post, The Guardian, Pitchfork og The New Yorker. Desuden har hun optrådt, både solo og som en del af en kvartet, på Rewire, Dripping, WOD, National Sawdust, Public Records og som åbner til Colin Stetsons nordamerikanske tour. Ud over egne projektet har Henry Solomon spillet for Paramore, Vampire Weekend, Louis Cole, Miley Cyrus og er med på HAIM’s album Women In Music Pt. 3. Henry Slomon har spillet i Madison Square Garden, Hollywood Bowl og Sofi Stadium, og på utallige festivaler rundt omkring i verden. Det er altså to yderst rutinerede musikere, vi får besøg af til Vinterjazz 2026. Men det gør ikke oplevelsen mindre intim. Se frem til at blive svøbt ind i Elori Saxl og Henry Solomons på én gang futuristiske og jazzede udtryk!
Sagt om Elori Saxl
“Elori Saxl blurs the distinctions between laptop-based 21st-century explorations and the more tactile, playful avant gardism of previous generations.” – THE GUARDIAN
“Building a hypnotic counterpoint between a bright chamber-music ensemble and groaning analog synthesizers, composer Elori Saxl’s debut is an investigation of emotion and seasonal change.” – PITCHFORK
Koncerten er en del af Vinterjazz 2026 – en landsdækkende festival, som finder sted fra 30. januar-28. februar. Læs mere på www.jazz.dk
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
In English:
Composer Elori Saxl and saxophonist Henry Solomon unite analog synths with baritone saxophone and bass clarinet in their project ‘Seeing Is Forgetting’. Their shared sound draws from both the abstractions of jazz and the hooks of pop music – an ambient embrace for all of us who might need one.
Elori Saxl creates experimental electronic music, andHenry Solomon is an artist, producer, and saxophonist. In the project Seeing Is Forgetting, they’ve joined forces. In their sound, analog synths meet baritone saxophone and bass clarinet in a way that feels both hopeful and fragile. The project blends abstract jazz and minimalism with pop music’s ear for harmony, form, and hooks. Together, Elori Saxl and Henry Solomon open up an ambient, enveloping soundscape that evokes other times and distant worlds. Don’t miss their concert at Vinterjazz 2026!
Elori Saxl has received praise from The Washington Post, The Guardian, Pitchfork, and The New Yorker for her ability to merge digital sound, analog synthesizers, and classical instruments. She has performed both solo and as part of a quartet at places such as Rewire, Dripping, WOD, National Sawdust, and Public Records, and opened for Colin Stetson’s North American tour. Beyond his solo projects, Henry Solomon has played with Paramore, Vampire Weekend, Louis Cole, Miley Cyrus, and appears on HAIM’s grammy nominated album Women in Music Pt. 3. He has performed at Madison Square Garden, Hollywood Bowl, Sofi Stadium, and countless festivals worldwide. So, when these two accomplished musicians visit Vinterjazz 2026, it’s bound to be a special occasion – intimate despite their respective impressive résumés. Get ready to be wrapped in Elori Saxl and Henry Solomon’s sound – at once futuristic and steeped in jazz.
Said about Elori Saxl:
“Elori Saxl blurs the distinctions between laptop-based 21st-century explorations and the more tactile, playful avant gardism of previous generations.” – THE GUARDIAN
“Building a hypnotic counterpoint between a bright chamber-music ensemble and groaning analog synthesizers, composer Elori Saxl’s debut is an investigation of emotion and seasonal change.” – PITCHFORK
The concert is part of Vinterjazz 2026, a nationwide festival taking place from January 30 to February 28. Learn more at www.jazz.dk

events.title: Æsset + Eva Rystok
events.description:
Eva Rystok træder frem med en lyd bygget på ærlig sangskrivning og intens nærhed. Hendes musik folder sig ud i intime, følelsesladede kompositioner, hvor hver tone bærer både sårbarhed og styrke, en rolig, men gennemtrængende intensitet. Hun har skabt en klar kunstnerisk identitet med et stærkt nærvær, der inviterer publikum til at mærke musikken tæt på. Gennem sneak peeks, studie­besøg og direkte kontakt med lyttere trækker hun os med ind i den kreative proces, tættere på lyden, tættere på mennesket bag.

ÆSSET, poet, oprører, kunstner. Med EP’en Synd & Skam bevæger han sig i feltet mellem det morbide og det smukke, det sårbare og det kontroversielle. Det er mørkt, ærligt og kompromisløst, en genre nogle betegner som “Anti-Pop”, båret af hiphop, R&B og alternative elementer. ÆSSET skærper blikket, provokerer og reflekterer, og åbner et univers, der tør røre ved det rå, det nære og det ufiltrerede.

events.title: TWO LANES
events.description:
Symbiotisk søskende magi fra TWO LANES i VEGA
___________________________________________________________________
Døre: 19.00
Koncertstart: 20.00
Billetpris: 280 kr.
___________________________________________________________________
Brødrene fra Berlin, Leo og Rafael Schmid, excellerer i stemningsfulde, musikalske tableauer, hvor akustiske klaverstykker, analoge synthesizere og minimalistiske beats smelter sammen i deres genrevridende, elektroniske lydunivers.
På deres seneste EP, No Feeling Is Final (2025), fortsætter søskendeparret ufortrødent med at udforske forskellige hjørner af deres musikalitet – fra neoklassisk og ambient til melodisk, techno.
De to brødre er vokset op med musikken tæt inde på livet. Leo har med udgangspunkt i klassiske værker fra J.S. Bach, Schumann og Debussy oparbejdet et virtuost forhold til klaverets sorte og hvide tangenter, mens Rafael er draget mod elektroniske eksperimenter med bl.a. lyddesign.
I projektet TWO LANES har duoen således fundet et fælles musikalsk sprog, hvor deres færdigheder for dels det akustiske og det elektroniske passer som hånd i handske.
TWO LANES har med flere udgivelser bag sig opnået mere end 300 millioner streams på tværs af forskellige platforme, og radiostationer som BBC1, Sirius XM og Triple J har dedikeret sendetid til deres kompositioner.
Den 12. februar kan publikum træde ind i Leo og Rafaels besnærende og genreudfordrende verden, når de virtuost leverer akustisk og elektronisk vellyd i Lille VEGA.
Koncerten er støttet af Liveurope. Liveurope er det første pan-europæiske initiativ, der støtter koncertvenues i deres bestræbelser på at promovere opkommende europæiske kunstnere. Liveurope er medfinansieret af EUs Creative Europe-program.

Den 12. februar byder på hårdtslående industriel hip hop med ho99o9 og special guest N8NOFACE!
Billetsalget starter den 4. november kl. 11.00.
▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄
Entré: 215 kr. (inkl. gebyr)
Forsalg: https://tinyurl.com/ho99o9-loppen
Døre: 20.30 // Koncertstart: 21.30
https://loppen.dk/kalender/ho99o9
▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄
Manifestation af overmenneskelig kraft gennem nærmest magisk lydalkymi – Ho99o9 bryder konstant fri af alle kreative begrænsninger. Duoen theOGM og Yeti Bones smelter genrer sammen som kemikalier i et eksperiment: infernalsk hiphop, rå hardcore, fremtidsorienteret punk, skærende metal, industriel støj og forvrænget elektronika. Resultatet? En eksplosiv lyd, der tænder i samme sekund, du trykker “play” – eller når de rammer scenen.
Med anmelderroste udgivelser, samarbejder på højeste niveau og udsolgte turnéer har Ho99o9 længe huseret i kulturens mørkeste kroge. I 2025 vender de tilbage med deres tredje album, 'Tomorrow We Escape', udgivet på 999 Deathkult / Last Gang Records / MNRK – en sonisk eksplosion og en følelsesmæssig flugt fra alt, der holder dig fanget.
"Du kan flygte fra mentale problemer, stoffer eller dårlige situationer – det er op til lytteren,” fortæller Yeti Bones. theOGM tilføjer: “Alle kæmper med noget. Målet er at finde motivationen til at overleve. Denne gang gik vi mere personligt til værks.”
Fra deres gennembrud med 'United States of Horror' i 2017 – kaldt “usammenlignelig med alt andet lige nu” af DIY – til legendariske liveoptrædener med Slipknot, Korn, Alice In Chains, Rob Zombie, Ministry, Dillinger Escape Plan, Denzel Curry og Ghostface Killah, har Ho99o9 opnået kultstatus.
På scenen er det en oplevelse uden sidestykke: En kaotisk, kompromisløs og rensende udladning, der bevæger sig mellem himmel og helvede – alt sammen på Loppen den 12. februar.

events.title: Shouse + Support: Ora The Molecule
events.description:
SHOUSE
12. FEBRUAR 2026 – PUMPEHUSET, KØBENHAVN
BILLETSALGET STARTER: 17. OKTOBER KL. 10
BILLETPRIS: 230,- PLUS GEBYR
BILLETSALG VIA: ALLTHINGSLIVE.DK / TICKETMASTER.DK
Melbourne-duoen Shouse, der er kendt for deres globale anthems og fællesskabsgivende dance hits, indtager Pumpehuset torsdag 12. februar 2026. Duoen, der står bag megahittet ”Love Tonight” og det nye album Collective Ecstasy, lover en aften med dance, sang og kollektiv ekstase.
Shouse består af Ed Service og Jack Madin, to bedste venner fra Melbourne/Naarm i Australien, som eksperimenterer med trommemaskiner og synths i skabelsen af deres unikke lyd under betegnelsen ”weirdo” house. De kombinerer elektroniske beats med livevokal, kor og fællesskab, og skaber oplevelser, der samler publikum i fælles energi og glæde.
Siden gennembruddet med ”Love Tonight” har Shouse forsat med at udgive bangers, der rækker langt ud over dansegulvet. Fra samarbejder med Vance Joy og Cub Sport til hits som ”Won’t Forget You” og ”Call My Name”, formår duoen konsekvent at skabe musik der forener mennesker på tværs af lande og kulturer.
Deres debutalbum Collective Ecstasy har været næsten et årti undervejs, og med liveshows og DJ-optrædener over hele verden fortsætter Shouse med at invitere publikum ind i deres univers af fælles ekstase. Koncerten i Pumpehuset bliver en unik chance for danske fans at opleve duoens karismatiske liveshow, hvor de leder publikum gennem musikalske ritualer fyldt med glæde, dans og sang.

events.title: SPECTRA w / Kilopatrah Jones (US) & Robin Flux (DE)
events.description:
✧✵ Welcome to 𝐒𝐏𝐄𝐂𝐓𝐑𝐀 ✵✧

A queer- and dance-centered club space that celebrates esteemed and emerging underground artists from the Queer, Trans and BIPOC spectrum around the globe.

Expect a wide spectrum of visionary dance and club music while honoring its rich history and culture anchored in NYC and the Midwest US.

Let’s create a respectful and liberating club experience together and keep phones and conversations away from the dance floor.


𝗟𝗜𝗡𝗘-𝗨𝗣:

✧✵ 𝗞𝗶𝗹𝗼𝗽𝗮𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗵 𝗝𝗼𝗻𝗲𝘀 (𝗡𝗬𝗖) [they/them] ✵✧

Born and raised in Queens, Kilopatrah Jones is a house dancer first—a city dweller and club kid with a rare gift for transferring energy from the booth to the dance floor. Kilo’s world runs straight through New York’s ’80s/’90s house and ballroom lineages: reinvention, transgression, glamour, and joy—carried with a particular clarity that echoes Junior Vasquez and his peers. Their sets can feel like walking into Sound Factory at peak time: full-body, sweaty, euphoric, and unapologetically alive. A resident on The Lot Radio, Kilo channels New York’s queer house vocabulary with intent. They are a regular at iconic NYC nightlife institutions such as Nowadays, Basement, and Public Records, and have shared lineups with pioneers such as Todd Terry and Underground Resistance. Recent highlights include appearances at Detroit’s Movement weekend, and Berlin’s legendary Berghain/Panorama Bar. Kilo’s momentum is driven by their undeniable authenticity.

✧✵ 𝗥𝗼𝗯𝗶𝗻 𝗙𝗹𝘂𝘅 (𝗗𝗘) [he/they] ✵✧

𝐒𝐏𝐄𝐂𝐓𝐑𝐀 is a club concept curated by Robin Flux, a Berlin-based DJ/producer, dancer and curator moving between club and dance scenes across Europe, the US, and Asia. Shaped by years of going to the source—from NYC, Chicago, and Detroit to Tokyo and other cities across Japan, Korea, and Southeast Asia—he approaches DJing as movement-led storytelling: playful, daring, and grounded in the queer lineages of dance music. As an active member of the ballroom, whacking and house dance scenes, he draws on years of shared practice to give dancers’ movements and stories space at the center of the night, where they are lived rather than referenced.

✧✵ artwork by 𝗝𝗼𝗿𝗱𝗮𝗻 𝗠𝗼𝘀𝘀 @__jinx ✵✧

events.description:
Gør dig klar til rendyrket danseeufori, når den legendariske keyboard-mester Rizan Said lader sine lynhurtige synth-fraser ramme København. Med sin eksplosive dabke-lyd og flere år på scenen med Omar Souleyman har han løftet traditionen til globale højder – og nu kan du opleve hans grænseløse dansemagi helt tæt på, når han indtager ALICE.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛

NB: Koncerten er stående
SCROLL DOWN FOR ENGLISH
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
Når Rizan Said indtager ALICE til februar, bliver det med en energi, der kan få selv det mest vintertrætte publikum i omdrejninger. I hjertet af Saids lydunivers finder man nemlig den eksplosive blanding af traditionelle dabke-rytmer, hypnotiske melodier og hans karakteristiske, virtuose synth-spil. Said er oprindeligt fra Ras Al-Ain i Syriens nordøstlige Jazeera-region og udviklede sig tidligt som musikalsk vidunderbarn – først på slagtøj og blæseinstrumenter, siden som pioner i den syriske synth-æra i slut 80’erne og start 90’erne. Rizan Saids arbejde på den spirende kassettebånd-scene gjorde ham hurtigt til et navn uden for Syriens grænser, især gennem hans mangeårige samarbejde med produceren Zuhir Maksi.
Rizan Said har komponeret og produceret for en række markante stemmer, bl.a. Sarya Al Suwas og Asi El Hellani, og har stået bag musik til både film og tv-serier. Internationalt er han også kendt for sine år på scenen med legendariske Omar Souleyman, hvor hans lynhurtige synth-fraser blev et globalt fænomen. Saids egne albums “The King of Keyboard” (2015) og opfølgeren på Akuphone Records (2019) cementerede hans status som en kunstner, der både bærer traditionen og sprænger den. Live skaber Rizan Said også ren eufori med sin pulserende, festlige og fuldstændig uimodståelige lyd. Hans shows på europæiske festivaler som Le Guess Who, Down the Rabbit Hole og Iceland Airwaves er blevet kult – og nu kan du opleve hans grænseløse dansemagi helt tæt på, når han fyrer op under ALICE til februar.
Koncerten er en del af Vinterjazz 2026 – en landsdækkende festival som finder sted fra 30. januar-28. februar. Mere info via www.jazz.dk

In English:
Get ready for pure dance euphoria as legendary keyboard master Rizan Said unleashes his lightning-fast synth phrases in Copenhagen. With his explosive dabke sound and years on stage with Omar Souleyman, he has lifted the tradition to global heights – and now you can experience his boundless dance magic up close when he takes over ALICE.
When Rizan Said steps onto the ALICE stage this February, he arrives with an energy capable of shaking even the most winter-weary audience awake. At the heart of Said’s sonic universe lies the electrifying fusion of traditional dabke rhythms, hypnotic melodies, and his signature, virtuosic synth work. Originally from Ras Al-Ain in Syria’s northeastern Jazeera region, Said emerged early as a musical prodigy – first on percussion and reed instruments, later as a pioneer of Syria’s synth era in the late ’80s and early ’90s. His work on the burgeoning cassette scene quickly earned him a reputation beyond Syria’s borders, not least through his long-running collaboration with producer Zuhir Maksi.
Rizan Said has composed and produced for a number of major voices, including Sarya Al Suwas and Asi El Hellani, and has created music for both film and television. Internationally, he is also known for his many years on stage with the legendary Omar Souleyman, where his rapid-fire synth lines became a global phenomenon. His solo albums The King of Keyboard (2015) and its follow-up on Akuphone Records (2019) cemented his status as an artist who both carries and transforms tradition. Live, Rizan Said conjures pure euphoria with a pulsating, festive, and utterly irresistible sound. His performances at European festivals such as Le Guess Who, Down the Rabbit Hole, and Iceland Airwaves have gained cult status – and now you can experience his boundary-breaking dance magic up close when he ignites ALICE this February.
The concert is part of Vinterjazz 2026 – a nationwide festival taking place from January 30 to February 28. More info at www.jazz.dk
