events.title: GLØD pres: Peter Pain + Vincent Ryder
events.description:
GLØD er klar med årets første koncert, og det bliver intet mindre end genialt! Vi glæder os utroligt meget til at præsentere dygtige Peter Pain og Vincent Ryder fredag d. 13. februar på Lygten Station<33

20.00 Døre

21.00 Peter Pain
22.00 Vincent Ryder

Forsalg 80 kr. ekskl. gebyr
Dørsalg 100 kr


//PETER PAIN
Peter Bruhn, hjernen bag Peter Pain, er ikke nogen nybegynder på musikscenen. Kendt for sit arbejde med anerkendte projekter som First Flush, Melodi Ghazal og Aperly High træder han nu frem i rampelyset med en lyd, der både er nostalgisk og frisk.

Med inspiration fra den rå energi i 90’ernes grunge, de slagkraftige hooks fra 00’ernes punkrock og den ufiltrerede charme ved 80’ernes produktion skaber Peter Pain et sonisk moodboard, der er både følelsesladet og gennemført. Den melankolske kant i musikken balanceres af polerede, intime vokaler, hvilket resulterer i en lyd, der føles dybt personlig og samtidig har en universel genklang.

//VINCENT RYDER
Vincent Ryder inviterer os ind i en verden af mareridt og længsel, fortabt kærlighed og skrøbeligt håb. Hans cinematiske post-apokalyptiske univers blander art-rockens og indiepoppens intimitet med en moderne singer-songwriter-energi.

Hans sange udstråler autenticitet og følelsesmæssig dybde, og hans live-shows har fanget publikum, både på intime spillesteder og på større scener. Gaffa har kaldt ham et ”talent af Guds nåde” og med sin unikke stemme samt et talent for historiefortælling, leverer Vincent Ryder musik, der efterlader et varigt indtryk.


Vi glæder os til at se jer!

Koncerten er støttet af Statens Kunstfond og Københavns Musikudvalg og er et samarbejde med Lygten Station.


<3------ENGLISH------<3

GLØD is ready with the first concert of the year, and we can't wait! We’re incredibly excited to present the talented Peter Pain and Vincent Ryder on Friday, February 13th at Lygten Station <33

20.00 Doors
21.00 Peter Pain
22.00 Vincent Ryder

Presale: 80 DKK (excluding fees)
At the door: 100 DKK

//PETER PAIN
Peter Bruhn, the mind behind Peter Pain, is no stranger to the music scene. Known for his work with acclaimed projects like First Flush, Melodi Ghazal, and Aperly High, he now steps into the spotlight with a sound that's both nostalgic and fresh.

Drawing inspiration from the raw energy of 90s grunge, the punchy hooks of 00s punk-rock, and the scrappy charm of 80s production, Peter Pain creates a sonic moodboard that's both emotionally charged and expertly curated. The melancholic edge of his music is balanced by polished, intimate vocals, crafting a sound that feels deeply personal yet universally resonant.

//VINCENT RYDER
Vincent Ryder invites us into a world of nightmares and longing, lost love and fragile hope. His cinematic post-apocalyptic universe blends the intimacy of art rock and indie pop with a modern singer-songwriter energy.

His songs radiate authenticity and emotional depth, and his live shows have captivated audiences, both in intimate venues and on larger stages. Gaffa has called him a ‘talent of God's grace’ and with his unique voice and talent for storytelling, Vincent Ryder delivers music that leaves a lasting impression.

We hope to see you there.The event is supported by Statens Kunstfond and Københavns Musikudvalg and is presented in collaboration with Lygten Station

events.description:
Two forces collide for one explosive night on the dancefloor.
Operator and Entrance Traxxx join hands to deliver a global, high-energy club experience. To mark this special collaboration, we welcome Skatebård: a true club innovator known for blending house, techno, disco, and rave energy into unpredictable, high-impact sets.
Expect raw dancefloor energy, genre-crossing selections, and nonstop grooves from open to close. 

OPERATORS OF THE NIGHT: 

SKATEBÅRD (NO) 
Throughout his impressive career of releasing five albums and more than twenty 12-inches, he has steadily carved out his own corner of dance music with a unique flair. Traversing a range of seemingly disparate genres and emotions comes incredibly naturally to the Norwegian artist, whose music oscillates between Italo disco and raw Detroit-infused house and techno. With an enviably eclectic collection of the mastery to navigate it seamlessly, Skatebård’s DJ sets offer exploratory excursions through the unknown and unexpected. From festival mainstages to intimate club nights, Boiler Rooms and radio shows, Skatebård has captivated audiences across the globe, performing at many of electronic music’s most revered institutions. 

The dynamic scope of Skatebård’s artistry extends to his work in the studio. Spanning over two decades, his impressive discography is dispersed across labels including his own Digitalo Enterprises, Sex Tags Mania and Bordello A Parigi.
With a knack for balancing kitsch with elegance, Skatebård creates music that exudes an air of nonchalant fun.

events.title: SACRED SINERGY Valentine's Edition
events.description:
At Klubben, Valentine’s Day 2026 is about intimacy and power. It’s about celebrating sensuality on your own terms, whether single, taken, or somewhere in between, and less about heterosexual love rituals and rings hidden in chocolate lava cakes. 

This Saturday, February 14th, we’re excited to welcome back Sacred Sinergy for a special Valentine’s event. This Copenhagen-based, all-female pole-dance group is known for their thoughtful performances that balance strength with softness and control with vulnerability. They turn pole dancing into an art form focused on self-expression, not just show.

Sacred Sinergy’s performances aren’t for the male gaze—they move beyond it.
Every movement is intentional. Each routine is built on trust, skill, and a shared sense of the body as both strong and poetic.

For this Valentine’s event, Kitty Spiral and Trap Goddess will be joined by guest performer Anja Provocateur, who is filling in while Velvet Valentina recovers. Anja brings a slow, grounded, and emotional energy, guided by breath, heart, and intention instead of excess.

The performances will take place throughout the night on a podium in the club, not as interruptions, but as rituals.

To hold the space, we’ve invited three DJs who understand timing, tension, and atmosphere.
Kaddi Sawaneh, DJ Alipapa, and John Vincent will set the vibe with a balanced mix of hip-hop, afrobeats, R&B, and pop. The music is there to support the performances, not compete with them.

There are a few important things to remember: this is a space where respect comes first.

NO touching the performers.
NO climbing the podium.
Aggressive, disruptive, or overly drunk behavior is not allowed.
And NO requests for the DJs.

If you’re here, your role is to witness, listen, and move—not just to consume.

Come alone, with a partner, or with friends.
Come open-minded, curious, and present.
Happy Valentine’s!

events.description:
Skandinavisk eskapisme med Sassy 009 i VEGA
_______________________________________________________________
Døre: 19.00
Koncertstart: 20.00
Billetpris 205 kr. inkl. gebyr
_______________________________________________________________
Bag det kække kunstnernavn Sassy 009 gemmer sig norske Sunniva Lindgård. Oprindeligt flankeret af gymnasieveninderne Teodora Georgijević og Johanna Scheie Orellana skabte trioen i slut 10’erne blikfang hos internationale medier som The Guardian, Pitchfork og The Fader med udgivelserne Do You Mind og Kill Sassy 009.
Med omtalen skrev Sassy 009 sig ind i en række af fremadstormende norske kunstnere, der i slægtskab med navne som Smerz og Okay Kaya gjorde sig bemærkede for deres synthtunge elektropop omkring slutningen af 2010’erne.
Siden har Sassy 009 manifesteret sig som et soloprojekt, men det betyder ingenlunde, at musikken er blevet mindre spændende. I krydsfeltet mellem de kaotiske og fragmenterede hjørner af hyperpop og bedroom poppens DIY-æstetik finder Sassy 009 sit musikalske udtryk. Det har banet vejen for et samarbejde med amerikanske Clairo, ligesom hun også har remixet for kunstnere som Mø, Empress Of og Agar Agar.
I september fik vi for første gang i knap fire år ny musik ved Sassy 009s hånd. ‘Butterflies’ er navnet på førstesinglen fra det kommende album Dreamer+, der lander til januar.
Som barn af to klassisk uddannede musikere kan man roligt sige, at Sunniva Lindgård har fået musikken ind med modermælken. Forvent en kunstner med styr på sit håndværk og seriøs skandinavisk eskapisme, når Sassy 009 tager os med ind i sit pulserende popunivers i Ideal bar 18. februar.

events.title: Saint Abdullah (IR/CA) + Tehran (IR/SE) at ALICE
events.description:
Saint Abdullah er alias for de iransk-canadiske brødre Mohammad og Mehdi Mehrabani, hvis musik bevæger sig i krydsfeltet mellem eksperimenterende elektronik, improvisation og dybt personlige fortællinger. Med rødder i både Teheran og London skaber duoen soniske universer, hvor geopolitik, religion og social adfærd flettes sammen i et råt og sanseligt udtryk. Når Saint Abdullah giver koncert på ALICE, bliver det i soloformat med Mohammad Mehrabani. Svensk-iranske Tehran åbner aftenen.

⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
I deres studiepraksis arbejder Saint Abdullah som lydarkæologer, der graver i personlige og kollektive historier – både de hørbare og de tabte. Resultatet er musik, der ulmer af tekstur, åndelighed og en følelse af uafsluttede ritualer. Gennem de seneste otte år har duoen – bestående af de iransk-canadiske brødre Mohammad og Mehdi Mehrabani – markeret sig som en af de mest fascinerende kræfter inden for eksperimenterende elektronisk musik med udgivelser på labels som Planet Mu, Room40, Other People, Disciples og Psychic Liberation. Deres seneste album Of No Fixed Abode udkom på det visionære London-label The Trilogy Tapes.
Saint Abdullah har samarbejdet med en lang række markante kunstnere – fra Nicolas Jaar, Moor Mother og Armand Hammer til Sofia Jernberg, John Butcher og Lawrence English – og hver alliance fremhæver deres evne til at skabe relationer mellem vidt forskellige musikalske sprog. Live skaber Saint Abdullah et råt og nærværende rum, hvor elektronik og improvisation smelter sammen i en intens tilstedeværelse. Kom med på en lydrejse, hvor fragmenter af kultur, tro og migration spejles i dyb bas, skarpe samples og uforudsigelige improvisationer, når Saint Abdullah spiller soloshow med Mohammad Mehrabani på ALICE under Vinterjazz.
Tehran:
Svensk-iranske Tehran (fka Nadia Tehran) strøg for alvor ind på den skandinaviske scene for et par år siden med deres hårdtslående, konfronterende og sårbare udtryk og svært indtagende koncerter. I 2024 fejrede den iransk-svenske kunstner release på deres nye album “Husqvarna” på ALICE – en doomy, støjende og vred plade, der gnistrende tager opgør med fødestedet Jönköking. Når Tehran åbner for Saint Abdullah denne aften, bliver det med en udvidet audiovisuel udgave af “Husqvarna”.
Koncerten er en del af Vinterjazz 2026. Vinterjazz er en landsdækkende musikfestival, som strækker sig over tre uger og rummer omkring 600 koncerter fordelt på flere end 150 spillesteder og arrangører fra Skagen til Svaneke. Vinterjazz 2026 finder sted fra 30. januar til 28. februar. Se mere på www.jazz.dk
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
ENGLISH:
Saint Abdullah is the alias of Iranian-Canadian brothers Mohammad and Mehdi Mehrabani, whose music moves at the intersection of experimental electronics, improvisation, and deeply personal narratives. With roots in both Tehran and London, the duo creates sonic worlds where geopolitics, religion, and social behavior are interwoven into a raw and visceral expression. When Saint Abdullah performs at ALICE, it will be presented as a solo show with Mohammad Mehrabani. The evening will be opened by Swedish-Iranian artist Tehran.
In their studio practice, Saint Abdullah work like sonic archaeologists, digging into personal and collective histories – both the audible and the lost. The result is music that smolders with texture, spirituality, and a sense of unfinished rituals. Over the past eight years, the duo – comprised of Iranian-Canadian brothers Mohammad and Mehdi Mehrabani – has established itself as one of the most compelling forces in experimental electronic music, with releases on labels such as Planet Mu, Room40, Other People, Disciples, and Psychic Liberation. Their latest album, Of No Fixed Abode, was released on the visionary London-based label The Trilogy Tapes.
Saint Abdullah has collaborated with a wide range of influential artists – from Nicolas Jaar, Moor Mother, and Armand Hammer to Sofia Jernberg, John Butcher, and Lawrence English – and each collaboration highlights their ability to create connections between vastly different musical languages. Live, Saint Abdullah creates a raw and immediate space where electronics and improvisation merge into an intense presence. Join a sonic journey in which fragments of culture, belief, and migration are reflected in deep bass, sharp samples, and unpredictable improvisations, when Saint Abdullah performs a solo show with Mohammad Mehrabani at ALICE during Vinterjazz.
Tehran:
Swedish-Iranian Tehran (formerly known as Nadia Tehran) broke through on the Scandinavian scene a few years ago with their hard-hitting, confrontational, and vulnerable expression, as well as their intensely captivating live performances. In 2024, the Iranian-Swedish artist celebrated the release of their new album Husqvarna at ALICE—a doomy, noisy, and furious record that fiercely takes on their hometown of Jönköping. When Tehran opens for Saint Abdullah this evening, it will be with an expanded audiovisual version of Husqvarna.
The concert is part of Vinterjazz 2026. Vinterjazz is a nationwide music festival that spans three weeks and includes around 600 concerts spread across more than 150 venues and organizers from Skagen to Svaneke. Vinterjazz 2026 takes place from January 30 to February 28. See more at www.jazz.dk

events.title: Alinka / Soft Bites / Téa / steamboi / DJ 2LATE
events.description:
Ukraine’s Alinka headlines with her signature house sound, bridging Chicago roots and Berlin club culture.

Alinka is a DJ’s DJ, known for her deep connection to house music and an instinctive, dancefloor-driven approach. Raised on Chicago’s house legacy with toes dipped into Detroit techno, Europe’s more robust approaches to bass music and the myriad of genre’s coming from cities like Berlin, London and Paris. For nearly a decade GLIA, has made waves in the electronic music scene with her sets. GLIA is Berlin-based and originally from Slovenia - She crafts layered, high-energy sets that fuse tribal pulse, hypnotic groove, and dark rhythmic drive. events.title: Vinterjazz: Søren Skov Orbit + Jiyu + Afterparty: Dingotracks + Den Stenede Rille
events.description:
Kom og vær med til en aften med lokal undergroundjazz på Stengade, hvor Søren Skov Orbit og Jiyu byder på spirituel jazz med elementer af afro og 60'er-eksperimentel amerikansk jazz. Før koncerterne vil der være dj's i loungen ovenpå som varmer jer op. Bagefter koncerterne står DJ Dingotracks og DJ Den Stenede Rille for afterparty.
Koncerten er en del af Vinterjazz Festivalen.
Søren Skov Orbit:
With a shared love for modal jazz's opportunities to delve into and cultivate the evocative, Orbit was formed in 2016 in a collaboration between saxophonist Søren Lyhne Skov and pianist Peder Vind.
The band debuted in 2019 on Jazzman Records' sublabel Jazz45 and in the fall of 2024 the album Adrift was released, where the band was expanded with Ayi Solomon on Percussion. The LP received great acclaim, including in Mojo Magazine, where it was the jazz album of the month in August 2024.
Musically, we find ourselves in the tension between Afro-inspired modal jazz and free improvisation.
The drumming is dynamic and playful, the bass solidly grooving, the piano playing minimalist and insistent, and the saxophone playing both noisy and beautiful, and it is all meaningfully tied together by Solomon's superior rhythmic sense.
https://frederiksbergrecords.bandcamp.com/album/adrift
+ Jiyu:
Jiyu, hailing from Copenhagen, fearlessly pushing boundaries across genres, dubbed as "modern late night nu cosmic space jazz" their latest album, "Totem of Quiet Mystic," has garnered international acclaim from jazz magazines like Jazzwise (UK), tastemakers, a slew of iconic radio DJs, and in DK, the prestigious spot as the album of the week on P8 Jazz.
Their rich arrangements, featuring analog synths, electric piano, guitar, flute, sax, and quirky bass-drum-percussion grooves, is streamlined to six musicians on stage: Thomas Dietl (Drums), Emil Jonathan (Guitar & Synth), Phong Le (Electric Piano and Synths), Rasmus Kjærsgaard (Flute and Sax), Jacob Vikkelsø (Percussion), and Nicolai Land (Bass).
Emil Jonathan, the visionary behind Jiyu, boasts a rich musical pedigree, with previous ventures including the tango-dub project von Daler & Low Pressure and the soulful beats of EMO. Collaborating with luminaries like English hip-hop pioneer DJ Vadim, Dancehall Queen Natasja, and trailblazers of downbeat, nu-jazz, and broken-beat such as Boozoo Bajou, Nu Spirrit Helsinki, and Les Gammas, Emil's sonic tapestry is woven with diverse threads of influence. His recent collaboration with Canadian house producer Fred Everything on "All is Well" (Compost Records, 2024) further underscores his versatility and artistic prowess.
“If you are in the mood for chill-out music, this is your destination” – “There’s a distant spiritual jazz feel that lends a bit of depth and also a touch of 1970s CTI-like calmness in the instrumental passages that coalesce into a series of trancelike moods that largely pass by free from incident, a sort of 21st century version of Eric Satie’s ‘Furniture Music’ with synths” - Jazzwise - Stuart Nicholson (UK)

events.title: FELT PRESENTS: Rafael Toral (PT) + Treen (INT) at ALICE
events.description:
Rafael Toral skaber vidtstrakte klanglandskaber på guitar og elektronik. Sammen med musikere som Jim O’Rourke, Otomo Yoshihide og Oren Ambarchi genopfandt han i 1990’erne elektronisk musik ved at lade rock, jazz, ambient og minimalisme flyde sammen i nye, åbne former. Siden har Toral været en uundgåelig skikkelse på den elektroniske scene, og nu, 40 år efter, er han klar til at indtage ALICE med sit projekt Guitar Concert. Den København-baserede improv-trio Treen åbner aftenen.
Koncerten er præsenteret i samarbejde med FELT.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
Køb billet i forsalg: 150 dkk eksl. gebyr / ungebillet: 130 ung dkk eksl. gebyr
Køb billet: https://alicecph.com/event/rafael-toral-pt-treen-int/
Lyt: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eoJ3vPqkz-w
NB: Koncerten er stående
SCROLL DOWN FOR ENGLISH
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
Rafael Toral har i mere end fire årtier været en helt central skikkelse inden for eksperimenterende musik – en kunstner, der igen og igen har været foran sin tid. Med base i Lissabon trådte Toral i 1990’erne frem som en del af den generation, der sammen med navne som Jim O’Rourke, Otomo Yoshihide og Oren Ambarchi genopfandt elektronisk musik ved at lade rock, jazz, ambient og minimalisme flyde sammen i nye, åbne former. Med banebrydende værker som “Sound Mind Sound Body”, “Wave Field” og “Space Program” har Rafael Toral skabt vidtstrakte klangflader, langstrakte toner og musikalske praksisser, der kom til at definere en ny fase i minimalmusikken og inspirere utallige kunstnere i årene efter.
Over de seneste år har Rafael Torals arbejde bevæget sig ind i en ny, hybrid fase, hvor guitaren spiller en central rolle side om side med de teksturer og klangverdener, der har præget hele hans virke. Når han præsenterer Guitar Concert på ALICE, maler Rafael Toral således et koncentreret øjebliksbillede af denne udvikling. Koncerten trækker tråde gennem hele hans diskografi – fra tidlige milepæle til det anmelderroste “Spectral Evolution” – og åbner samtidig for spontane øjeblikke og nye værker. Det er en hyldest til guitaren som instrument og til skønheden i det åbne rum mellem toner.
Treen:
Treen er et nyt, men allerede stærkt sammenspillet navn på den københavnske improv-scene. Trioen opstod i efteråret 2023, da trommeslager Jan Philipp, pianist Gintė Preisaitė og altsaxofonist Amalie Dahl mødtes i København. De tre markante musikalske stemmer skaber tilsammen et åbent og dragende rum af akustisk fri improvisation. Musikken opstår i et varmt, legende rum, hvor intet er fastlagt på forhånd, men alt lytter intenst til hinanden. Trioen bevæger sig som én samlet organisme, der konstant responderer på øjeblikkets impulser og energi. Resultatet er langsomt udviklende, dronende forløb, som er umuligt ikke at læne sig ind i. I september 2025 udgav Treen deres andet studiealbum “Kaikō” på det norske label Sauajazz.
Koncerten er en del af Vinterjazz 2026. Vinterjazz er en landsdækkende musikfestival, som strækker sig over tre uger og rummer omkring 600 koncerter fordelt på flere end 150 spillesteder og arrangører fra Skagen til Svaneke. Vinterjazz 2026 finder sted fra 30. januar til 28. februar. Se mere på www.jazz.dk
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
In English:
Rafael Toral creates expansive soundscapes with guitar and electronics. Alongside musicians such as Jim O’Rourke, Otomo Yoshihide, and Oren Ambarchi, he helped reinvent electronic music in the 1990s by allowing rock, jazz, ambient, and minimalism to flow together in new, open forms. Since then, Toral has remained an indispensable figure on the electronic music scene, and now, 40 years on, he is ready to take over ALICE with his project Guitar Concert. The Copenhagen-based improv trio Treen opens the evening.
For more than four decades, Rafael Toral has been a central figure in experimental music – an artist who has repeatedly been ahead of his time. Based in Lisbon, Toral emerged in the 1990s as part of a generation that, together with names such as Jim O’Rourke, Otomo Yoshihide, and Oren Ambarchi, reinvented electronic music by blending rock, jazz, ambient, and minimalism into new, open forms. With groundbreaking works such as Sound Mind Sound Body, Wave Field, and Space Program, Rafael Toral has created vast sonic surfaces, long-form tones, and musical practices that defined a new phase of minimal music and inspired countless artists in the years that followed.
In recent years, Rafael Toral’s work has entered a new, hybrid phase, in which the guitar plays a central role alongside the textures and sound worlds that have shaped his entire oeuvre. When he presents Guitar Concert at ALICE, Rafael Toral offers a concentrated snapshot of this development. The concert draws threads through his entire discography – from early milestones to the critically acclaimed Spectral Evolution – while also opening up space for spontaneous moments and new works. It is a celebration of the guitar as an instrument and of the beauty found in the open space between tones.
Treen:
Treen is a new, yet already tightly knit name on the Copenhagen improv scene. The trio was formed in the autumn of 2023, when drummer Jan Philipp, pianist Gintė Preisaitė, and alto saxophonist Amalie Dahl met in Copenhagen. Together, the three distinct musical voices create an open and compelling space for acoustic free improvisation. The music emerges from a warm, playful state of mind, where nothing is predetermined and everything listens intently to each other. The trio moves as a single organism, constantly responding to the impulses and energy of the moment. The result is slowly evolving, droning passages that are impossible not to lean into. In September 2025, Treen released their second studio album Kaikō on the Norwegian label Sauajazz.
The concert is part of Vinterjazz 2026. Vinterjazz is a nationwide music festival spanning three weeks and featuring around 600 concerts across more than 150 venues and presenters, from Skagen to Svaneke. Vinterjazz 2026 takes place from January 30 to February 28. Read more at www.jazz.dk

den 26. februar går Laura4evigt sammen med eventgruppen Carrie’s Going Out, for at skabe en unik og omsorgsfuld aften fyldt med kærlighed, kunst, koncert og klub på Jolene i Kødbyen.
fælles for de to projekter er et værdigrundlag baseret på fri kreativitet, inklusion, fællesskab, gennemsigtighed og anti-gatekeeping. at inddrage deltagerne, for sammen at skabe et nærværende og kærligt rum, hvor der er plads til kontraster – det sårbare og det svære med det festlige og klubbede, hvor der er plads til at grine og græde, danse og kramme.
med Carrie’s Going 444 vil vi skabe et rum for en aften, hvor nysgerrighed, leg og fællesskab mødes på tværs af samtaler, kunst og musik – og hvor vi skal danse, lytte, dele og bogstaveligt talt spejle os i hinanden, fordi vi har brug for hinanden. gennem et open call inviterer vi folk ind til at dele ud af deres kunst og erfaringer, samtidig med at der er plads til at sætte sit eget præg på rummet vi skal dele.
vi håber I vil være med<3
𝟒𝟒𝟒
444 er skabt af artisten Laura4evigt. Laura laver musik, hvor der både er plads til det følsomme og til eskapismen. hendes musik er inspireret af 00’ernes pop og eurodance, hvor temaer som kærlighed, længsel og det at være menneske i en digital tid bliver kombineret med høj energi og tempo.
444 er skabt som et univers og et fællesskab, der bliver til gennem fysiske events. i en tid, hvor vi i stigende grad lever vores liv på sociale medier og alene, er 444 et ønske om at være en del af en modbevægelse med fokus på nærvær, kreativitet og følelser. navnet 444 refererer til engletal, der symboliserer at være på rette vej – og aspejler projektets fokus på fællesskab og emotionel forbundethed. gennem koncerter, kunstneriske indslag og samarbejder med andre kreative initiativer bliver formålet at samle os og samskabe.
𝓬𝓪𝓻𝓻𝓲𝓮'𝓼 𝓰𝓸𝓲𝓷𝓰 𝓸𝓾𝓽
Carrie’s Going Out er en selvorganiseret, aktivistisk event- og kulturplatform, der arbejder tværæstetisk og antikapitalistisk for en mere inkluderende, omsorgsfuld og bæredygtig fremtid for musik - og kulturbranchen. Vores arbejde er interdisciplinært med afsæt i samarbejde og fællesskab. Vi vil sætte et præg på kulturen og samfundet omkring os og inspirere til endnu flere unge initiativer og samarbejder. Vi tror på at kunst og kultur skaber forandring! En forandring som vi kan bruge til at udligne hierarkiske strukturer og isolerende, ekskluderende og undertrykkende systemer i samfundet.
Til et Carrie’s Going Out event er der plads til det tunge og det svære, men også til drømmene og håbet for en lysere fremtid. Vores events vil som oftest søge at bringe nogle problemstillinger i spil, der kan have med identitetsskabelse, klimakrise, fællesskab, sorg, diverse kærlighedsrelationer og meget andet at gøre. Det er ikke altid, eventet skal være løsningsorienteret. Forhåbningen for Carrie’s Going Out er, at gæsterne går derfra med ny energi og et gåpåmod, der kan være indadvendt, udadvendt eller noget helt tredje.
𝓮𝓷𝓰𝓵𝓲𝓼𝓱
On February 26, Laura4evigt joins forces with the event collective Carrie’s Going Out to create a unique and caring evening filled with love, art, live music, and club culture at Jolene in Kødbyen.
What unites the two projects is a shared set of values rooted in free creativity, inclusion, community, transparency, and anti-gatekeeping. By actively involving the participants, we want to co-create a present, loving space that welcomes contrasts - the vulnerable and the difficult alongside the celebratory and club-oriented. A space where there is room to laugh and cry, dance and hug.
With Carrie’s Going 444, we aim to create a space for one evening where curiosity, playfulness, and community meet through conversations, art, and music - where we dance, listen, share, and quite literally mirror ourselves in one another, because we need each other. Through an open call we invite people to share their art and experiences, while also leaving room for everyone to leave their own mark on the shared space.
We hope you’ll join us ❤
𝟒𝟒𝟒
444 was created by the artist Laura4evigt. Laura makes music that holds space for both sensitivity and escapism. Her sound is inspired by 2000s pop and eurodance, combining themes of love, longing, and what it means to be human in a digital age with high energy and tempo.
444 is conceived as a universe and a community that comes into being through physical events. In a time when we increasingly live our lives on social media and in isolation, 444 is a desire to be part of a counter-movement focused on presence, creativity, and emotion. The name 444 refers to angel numbers symbolizing being on the right path - and reflects the project’s focus on community and emotional connection. Through concerts, artistic contributions, and collaborations with other creative initiatives, the goal is to bring us together and co-create.
𝓬𝓪𝓻𝓻𝓲𝓮'𝓼 𝓰𝓸𝓲𝓷𝓰 𝓸𝓾𝓽
Carrie’s Going Out is a self-organized, activist event and cultural platform that works across artistic disciplines and from an anti-capitalist perspective toward a more inclusive, caring, and sustainable future for the music and culture industry. Our work is interdisciplinary and grounded in collaboration and community. We want to leave a mark on the culture and society around us and inspire even more young initiatives and collaborations. We believe that art and culture create change - change we can use to challenge hierarchical structures and isolating, exclusionary, and oppressive systems in society.
At a Carrie’s Going Out event, there is room for the heavy and the difficult, but also for dreams and hope for a brighter future. Our events often seek to engage with themes such as identity formation, the climate crisis, community, grief, different forms of love, and much more. An event does not always have to be solution-oriented. The hope behind Carrie’s Going Out is that guests leave with renewed energy and momentum - whether directed inward, outward, or somewhere in between.

events.title: HYPNO QLUB IV: Pauline & Nicole Hogstrand + Ola Sandberg (SE) + Erik Klinga (SE)
events.description:
VINTERJAZZ @ KONCERTKIRKEN 2026
HYPNO QLUB IV: Pauline & Nicole Hogstrand + Ola Sandberg (SE) + Erik Klinga (SE)
Line up #1
Pauline Hogstrand, bratsch og elektronik
Nicole Hogstrand, cello
Line up #2
Ola Sandberg, elektronik
Line up #3
Erik Klinga – elektronik
_________________________________________________________
Tvillingsøstrene Pauline og Nicole Hogstrand samler deres individuelle kunstneriske praksisser i en fælles udforskning af lyd, hvor akustiske strengeinstrumenter møder elektronik. Med baggrund i samtidsklassisk musik, improvisation og elektroakustisk praksis arbejder de med mikrotonalitet, resonans og lydens rumlige bevægelse gennem langsomt udviklende lag af klangfarver, droner og intim noise. Deres tætte musikalske forbindelse skaber en stemme, der både er samlet og kontrasterende — musik, hvor lyd bliver til bevægelse, båret af en legende balance mellem styrke, skrøbelighed og fintfølende samspil.
Pauline og Nicole Hogstrand kommer fra Piteå i det nordlige Sverige og bor nu i København. Sammen trækker de på omfattende erfaring fra ensembler som Damkapellet, Crush String Collective, Halvcirkel og Blue Lake, samt samarbejder med kunstnere som Terry Riley, Valgeir Sigurðsson og Ellen Fullman. Deres arbejde er udgivet på pladeselskaber som Warm Winters Ltd., FatCat/130701 og Solen. Søstrene udvikler sammen en praksis, der er rodfæstet i eksperimenterende lytning og en vedvarende nysgerrighed på lydens udfoldelsesmuligheder.
_________________________________________________________
Ola Sandberg (f. 1988) er en Malmö-baseret musiker, komponist og lydkunstner, der fokuserer på lyd som fænomen snarere end symbol. Han arbejder med improvisation, langvarighed, intonation og tonale klynger som redskaber til at øve sig i at lytte og udforske lydens iboende egenskaber. Sandberg arbejder også med arkitektoniske rum som lytteapparater, musikinstrumenter og kompositoriske elementer. Han bruger ambisonisk optagelse som en måde at indfange og dokumentere hørbare aspekter af bygninger og skaber dermed et voksende lydarkiv. Han er også medlem af duoen Den Osynliga Mantel.
_________________________________________________________
Erik Klinga, født i 1991 i Sandviken, Sverige, er komponist og musiker. Klinga er kendt fra bandene Simian Ghost, Light Vibes og Horse Show og har spillet i flere projekter som trommeslager, herunder Solen, Dolce og Mi von Ahn.
Han har et studiebaseret værksted og skaber elektronisk musik med interesse for at udvikle værker, der fokuserer på klangfarve, melodi og harmoni i repetitionsbaserede formstrukturer. Drevet af nysgerrigheden efter at finde nye lydrelationer arbejder han hovedsageligt med syntetiske og akustiske kilder sammen med feltoptagelser. En væsentlig del af hans arbejde involverer modulær syntese i Buchla-formatet, som han komponerer og optræder live på. Hans musik bevæger sig inden for og mellem genrer som dark ambient, drone, minimalisme og electronica.
Klinga har optrådt live med sin musik på festivaler og spillesteder i ind- og udland, bl.a. på Norbergfestival, Malmö Konstmuseum, Organ Sound Art Festival (København), Mengi (Reykjavik), Ekko festival (Bergen), KET (Athen), Inkonst (Malmö) og Thanatosis festival
(Stockholm).
Erik har en bachelorgrad i elektroakustisk komposition fra Det Kongelige Musikhøjskole i Stockholm og en kandidatgrad i musikskabelse fra Rhythmic Music Conservatory i København….
_________________________________________________________
Billetter: 150 DKK / Stud: 100 DKK
_________________________________________________________
Vinterjazz @ KoncertKirken 2026 støttes af Statens Kunstfond, Københavns Kommune m.fl.

events.title: Inspector Spacetime - VEGA
events.description:
Intergalaktisk danseeufori med Inspector Spacetime i VEGA
____________________________________________________________
Døre: 20.00
Koncertstart: 21.00
Billetpris: 215 kr. inkl. gebyr.
_____________________________________________________________
For Inspector Spacetime er endemålet simpelt: at få folk til at bevæge sig, slippe deres hæmninger; at forlade hovedet, komme ned i kroppen og lade dansen tage over.
Den islandske poptrio er kommet fra land i 2025 med udgivelsen af singlerne “Party at My House” i begyndelsen af januar, efterfulgt af “Catch Planes”.
Inspector Spacetime har siden udgivelsen af deres selvbetitlede debutalbum i 2021 modtaget rosende ord fra anmeldere og publikum, dels for deres indspilninger, men er især blevet lovprist for deres energiske koncerter. Bandet, der besøgte dette års SPOT Festival, fik følgende ord med på vejen af GAFFA:
“Inspector Spacetime er et ekstremt nørdet arkæologiprojekt, der har drukket sig fuld i alkoholisk geyservand og har Islands anarkistiske æstetik, charme og tilgang til vestlig kultur med sig – og det fungerer pokkers godt! Jeg vil gerne rejse rundt i multiverset i en TARDIS, hvis de leverer en dundrende technopop-fest til det."
I de sidste par år har Inspector Spacetime spillet på flere islandske musikfestivaler, herunder Iceland Airwaves, og de har optrådt som support til landsmandens Daði Freyrs koncerter på den europæiske del af hans seneste turné.
Det er derfor med nye pulserende toner og en fuldstændig elektrisk og ubekymret attitude, at Inspector Spacetime tilsmiler dansen og euforien i Lille VEGA den 27. februar

events.title: Whipped #2 with Olivia Mendez
events.description:
Whipped #2 w/ Olivia Mendez @ Den Anden Side

Saturday, February 28 │ Soft Selection │ Techno, Hypnotic Techno
————

After the first sharp slash in the beginning of the year, we are back with the second round of whipping. For the February edition of Whipped, we are proud to present the Berlin-based vinyl equilibrist Olivia Mendez. She is supported by three promising local newcomers: DRAHO, Shaan and PAVI.

Whipped is a hypnotic techno party where detail, texture, quality, and skill is at the center of attention. This is techno in its most intoxicating form: stripped back, relentless, and finely tuned to keep you hypnotized from the first kick to the final echo. 

Within the Whipped concept, we will present an international sound bringing both newer names and old legends to DAS, combined with a strong and emerging local scene, which we have experienced blossoming in the past year.

This is Whipped #2
Come’ get whipped.

𝗟𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘂𝗽
Olivia Mendez [she/her]
DRAHO [he/him]
PAVI [she/her]
Shaan [he/him]

OLIVIA MENDEZ
Olivia Mendez is a vinyl-only DJ, selector, and curator whose sets weave deep, minimalistic techno. Her sound is rooted in rhythm – shaped by her early years as a percussionist and dancer, and refined through a deep immersion in London’s underground scene between 2006 and 2011.
A passionate digger with a background in music journalism and event curation, Olivia approaches her sets as narrative journeys – sonorous, layered, and emotionally resonant. From Brooklyn to Kiev, she’s queered consciousness through sound, creating dancefloors that pulse with tension, release, and intent.

DRAHO
Based in Copenhagen, DRAHO is a resident DJ at GAG (Den Anden Side) and the founder of UNIT ZERO, a collective techno space dedicated to ritual sound and loop-driven immersion.
His sound fuses rolling grooves, crisp percussion, and machine-like synth textures, unfolding through tension, release, and evolution. Each set is a focused journey — functionally immersive and deeply physical — designed to draw dancers into a shared threshold where repetition becomes transformation and sound becomes architecture.


PAVI
Growing up in a home full of creatives, PAVI is no stranger to expressing herself through art and sound. In recent years she’s been drawn to DJ’ing and has explored a wide variety of genres and moods.
Since 2023 her sound has evolved into a tasty blend of faster paced techno, driven by percussive beats, jazzy vibes and hypnotic grooves. 
PAVI is based in Copenhagen and can often be seen handing out ear candy in local clubs - be ready to get your groove on when you catch her behind the decks.

DJ ODEI is a Galician DJ resident of the Copenhaguen-based collective amigxs.bailar. His musical selection spans multiple genres, namely trance (the dark, swampy kind), dub techno and house, always mixed with more experimental sounds. His approach to DJing aims to induce a hypnotic state on the listener  using reptile-like sound textures and more emotional content, creating a psychedelic journey to explore your own subconscious.

01:00 - 02:00 Furkay @furkann.akayy
Furkan, known on decks as Furkay, is a Copenhagen-based DJ navigating the space between melodic techno, house, and tech house. His sound blends groovy depth with club-focused precision—where melodies meet rolling grooves and crisp.
Inspired by the atmospheric pull of melodic techno and the infectious energy of house culture, Furkay
builds sets that feel like a controlled evolution. His mixing leans into tension, release, and momentum — melancholic synth lines, hypnotic bass patterns, and sharp rhythm programming that echo Copenhagen’s underground spirit

From MDQ Argentina to Copenhagen, lover of progressive house and melodic techno.

mrjs.ddk is a Malmö/Berlin-based newcomer who has played at private events and open decks so far. She appreciates a driving rhythm that leads you through the night and leaves a smile on your face. Playing hypnotic, deep, and groovy techno, mrjs.ddk consistently manifests her style while always leaving room for surprise. You can expect little twists and turns, a steady bass, and a comforting atmosphere where everyone is invited to lose themselves for a little while.

DJ Filter Coffee brings the same rush as a strong cup of his favorite brew—fast, flavorful, and impossible to forget. Friends often joke that his sets feel like having way too much caffeine in a short amount of time, and honestly… they’re not wrong.
With around four years of on‑and‑off DJ’ing under his belt, Filter Coffee has carved out a niche by diving deep into sub‑genres and uncovering sounds that sit just left of the mainstream. His selections are driven by curiosity, rhythm, and a love for the unexpected—always keeping the dancefloor guessing and moving.

A technical force behind the decks, Marcus B. Goode treats the mixer like an instrument. Relentless four-to-the-floor pressure collides with fractured breakbeats as B. Goode will drive the room to a peak. Expect zero mercy.

06:00 - 07:00 AVI.avi @aviajamaria
AVI.avi comes from a small island, but is now based in Copenhagen. Growing up around folk music, living in Peru as an exchange student as a teen and later exploring the danish club scene, she has a great love for the ritualistic ecstacy and solidarity that comes with dance music in all its forms. Through smooth techno, tech house, and latin tek she curates sets that are groovy, eclectic, feminine and FUN!☆

events.title: NEW GAME+ // Chemtrailz (US)
events.description:
New Game+ is a gaming themed club night curated and hosted by Kardinal Bertram. In Gaming terminology, a "New Game+" is a game mode that allows the player to replay a game, while keeping items and or experience gained in the first playthrough. All that is left to do now is for you to equip your favorite gear and get ready to level up with us once again! 
Main floor is a showcase of the harder shades of techno: Industrial techno, Schranz and Hard Techno. The Kiosk floor will be taking you on a powerful Hypnotic techno / Hardgroove Side Quest. 

For our first edition of 2026 we are bringing you two DK debuts to the main floor: CHEMTRAILZ from America and ARANEA from Sweden. 

Your host Kardinal Bertram will be setting the tone on the main floor with his signature blend of industrial techno and schranz, followed by a 3 hour high energy journey with trance inducing techno, Schranz, industrial techno and everything in-between from CHEMTRAILZ & a banger Schranz / Industrial techno / Hard techno closing from ARANEA.
The Kiosk Floor Side Quest is a true masterclass in hardgroove and hypnotic techno, provided by Enna from Dirty Fika and Arvy from Pure Echo

BONUS XP for gaming themed outfits, but this is not mandatory.
Let’s kick this year off in proper New Game+ style <3

CHEMTRAILZ (US)
Cutting his teeth on California’s legendary thumping warehouses and desert raves chemtrailz has worked hard to become the underground sensation he is today. A master horticulturist for well over 15 years, the American artist has cultivated a deep, hard, high energy sound to create a vibrant voyage that sets dancefloors aflame. Starting in 2018, the Chemtrailz project began, blooming with a number of successful EPs and singles on top labels such as EXHALE, VERKNIPT, Voxnox, CLTX’s TX Records, The Finest Techno, Suara, ODD, Autektone Dark, and Fatima Hajji’s Silver M. and his own imprint, Terra Novae. 
Having relocated to Europe, there is no ceiling for the chemtrailz project. As one of the most exciting exports the US has to offer, Chemtrailz has become a trance Inducing techno hybrid that’s taken on a life of its own. He’s no stranger to the top of the charts, and certainly not to the upper echelon of touring techno artists’ playlists.

ARANEA (SE)
Based in Gothenburg with roots in the Middle East, Aranea has become one of Sweden’s most distinctive voices in the underground techno scene. As co-founder of CXVII and resident at both Equus and Abstrakt, she is a key force in the city’s harder techno landscape. With performances across Europe and releases on labels such as Techno Wereld, she delivers uncompromising schranz, industrial grit, and emotional drive – always with storytelling at the core.

events.title: THE REMIX X THIS IS INANC (TR)
events.description:
On Saturday, February 28, we’re back with THE REMIX, a club night built around celebrating the art and culture of remixing. The Remix looks beyond genres and into the creative act itself. Remixing isn’t just about reworking tracks; it’s about keeping music alive, relevant, and constantly evolving. It’s where hip-hop can meet UK garage, where R&B can flip into something unexpected, and where the DJ’s perspective is the main event. At Sigurd CPH, we celebrate the remix as a cultural force that keeps club music moving forward. This time, we’re bringing in a selector who lives and breathes that philosophy.

THIS IS INANC is an Istanbul-based DJ and producer who grew up deep in the city’s hip-hop scene. Inspired early on by watching the DMC World Championships, he developed a sharp, technical approach to DJing with a strong sense of storytelling. Over the years, he has shared stages with legends like Mobb Deep, Mos Def, Lil’ Cease, and many others, shaping a sound rooted in hip-hop culture but always looking ahead, and he’s earned international recognition for his high-energy sets that seamlessly blend Hip-Hop and R&B with UK Garage. 

On support, we have Delanamnam, a Ghanaian DJ whose name means “the one who arrives before others,” and it shows. Known for always staying ahead of the curve, he delivers seamless mixes of Afrobeats, hip-hop, Amapiano, and R&B. His sets are all about transformation, turning slow jams into dancefloor moments and building vibes that feel effortless but hit hard. A familiar name to Copenhagen’s music lovers, Delanamnam brings warmth, rhythm, and serious energy to the room.

PSA: No requests, OK?! Trust the DJs, let them cook, and let the music and remixes take you where they need to go.

events.title: Lost2Reality: Christian Vogel (Live) + Support: Alfredo92
events.description:
I årets andet kapitel af elektroniske onsdagskoncerter byder vi velkommen til Cristian Vogel: En legendarisk komponist og pioner inden for elektronisk musik. Denne aften præsenterer han et unikt live-set med højdepunkter fra sit omfattende bagkatalog – fra de tidlige udgivelser på Tresor i 90’erne til nutidens eksperimenterende lydunivers.
●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○
Venue: Musikcaféen, 3. etage
Døre: 20:00
Show: 21:00
Entré: 70kr.
●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○
Cristian Vogel:
Cristián Vogel er en særdeles anerkendt komponist, lyddesigner og kreativ teknolog. Han er grundlægger af studiet NeverEngineLabs i København.
Hans produktive karriere inden for musik og lyddesign har skaffet ham internationale fans, priser og anerkendelser og har siden begyndelsen af 90’erne etableret ham som en markant skikkelse inden for innovativ musik. Han har udgivet en række banebrydende og indflydelsesrige albums inden for elektronisk musik, IDM og techno på labels som Mille Plateaux, Tresor og Mute Records.
Han er desuden en dygtig programmør, der arbejder i krydsfeltet mellem musik og teknologi på højeste niveau. Med hundredvis af koncerter, studiesamarbejder og ambitiøse projekter inden for elektronisk musik leverer han konsekvent en dyb og uforudsigelig lytteoplevelse – både i studiet og på scenen.
Alfredo92:
Alfredo92, også kendt som TAXA, er DJ og producer med base i København. Alfredo92 driver pladeselskabet Axces Recordings, hvor hans debutalbum Transient blev udgivet i 2021. Som DJ og producer er Alfredo92s stil forankret i dance-musik, men den indeholder også leftfield-elementer og går aldrig på kompromis med at udforske nye lydverdener.
Som TAXA har han desuden udgivet på Mirror Zone-labelen, drevet af Spekki Webu. Udgivelsen presser tempoet ud over al logik og resulterer i det, der bedst kan beskrives som kalejdoskopisk braindance med en følelse af presserende energi.
ENG.
In the second chapter of this year’s electronic Wednesday concert series, we welcome Cristian Vogel: a legendary composer and pioneer in electronic music. This evening, he will present a unique live set featuring highlights from his extensive back catalogue – from his early 90s releases on Tresor to his present-day experimental sound universe.
Cristian Vogel:
Cristián Vogel is a highly acclaimed composer, sound designer, and creative technologist. He is the founder of the studio NeverEngineLabs in Copenhagen.
His prolific career in music and sound design has earned him international fans, awards, and recognition, establishing him since the early 90s as a prominent figure in innovative music. He has released a series of groundbreaking and influential albums in electronic music, IDM, and techno on labels such as Mille Plateaux, Tresor, and Mute Records.
He is also a skilled programmer working at the intersection of music and technology at the highest level. With hundreds of performances, studio collaborations, and ambitious electronic music projects, he consistently delivers a deep and unpredictable listening experience—both in the studio and on stage.
Alfredo92:
Alfredo92, also known as TAXA, is a DJ and producer based in Copenhagen. He runs the record label Axces Recordings, which released his debut album Transient in 2021. As a DJ and producer, Alfredo92’s style is rooted in dance music but also incorporates leftfield elements, never compromising in exploring new sonic territories.
As TAXA, he has also released on the Mirror Zone label, run by Spekki Webu. The release pushes tempo beyond all logic, resulting in what can best be described as kaleidoscopic braindance with a sense of urgent energy.

events.title: Some Traces Of House at Jolene
events.description:
Some Traces Of House represents an artistic platform focused on underground house music where different sound perceptions are highlighted according to each artist. This concept was founded by Ivan Dallmann in 2020. STOH allows international artists to express themselves in music podcasts and it also works as an independent record label and musical events promoter, aiming to diversify channels and boost up different ways of expression.   

In this opportunity we are hosting Andrej Lasić also known as Laseech, one of the most talented House producers and vinyl DJs from Croatia at Jolene in the mythical meat packing district of Copenhagen. 

He will take care of the decks for the most part of the night, setting up the finest sound atmosphere, spinning his best selection of soulful and houssy records for which he is so well known. Alongside of our special guest, Ivan Dallmann and DJ HNRKSN will be in charge of warming of the venue with the deepest house tunes.  

Laseech is a DJ, producer, remixer, and Cosada label owner with an impressive catalog featuring releases on esteemed labels like BBE Music, Forbidden Dance Records, and Lumberjacks In Hell, which have quickly carved out a reputation for him in the eclectic, soulful corners of the house music scene. His collaborations and connections with influential artists like Ron Trent, Patrice Scott, Javonntte, and Dego (2000Black) highlight his deep roots and commitment to the sound. A constant drive to dig deeper and explore new sonic territories fuels his creativity, reflected in both his productions and his dancefloor-ready, yet uncompromising selections. 

Over the past 15 years, Andrej has graced the stages of major festivals and venues across the former Yugoslavia, including Love International in Tisno, and Dimensions and Outlook festivals, as well as reputable clubs like Klub K4 in Slovenia and Peti Kupe in Zagreb. He has also played international venues like DJOON Club in Paris and many more in the UK, Spain and Italy. 
Laseech has earned support for his music from industry heavyweights like Theo Parrish, Ron Trent, Joe Claussel, Louie Vega, Osunlade... As a passionate vinyl collector and audiophile with a degree in audio engineering, Laseech’s dedication to his craft continues to resonate, making him one of the finest Croatian artists.

This won't be regular night! You can expect a warm vibes winter evening filled with quality music, good drinks and that special house music crowd atmosphere you don’t wanna miss at the most iconic club in Denmarks capital.  

Event Info.

* Free Entrance  
* 20+ 

 See you on the dance floor ;)

⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
ayas musik bevæger sig frit mellem techno, hardcore, støj, club deconstruction og emotionelt overload. Det er elektronisk musik, der ikke forsøger at være pæn eller behagelig, men som i stedet presser kroppen, tempoet og sanserne ud i yderpositionerne. Hendes lydunivers er fragmenteret, aggressivt og sårbart på samme tid – som et konstant spændingsfelt mellem kontrol og kollaps.
Med debutalbummet im hole slog aya sit navn fast internationalt, og med hexed! på det toneangivende Hyperdub-label har hun for alvor manifesteret sig som en af de mest relevante elektroniske kunstnere lige nu. Albummet er en hæsblæsende, højenergisk udladning, der har placeret hende centralt i både klubkulturen og den eksperimenterende elektroniske undergrund. Det er musik, der trækker på internettets kaos, soundsystem-kulturens tyngde og hardcore-æstetikkens rå direktehed. Live er aya kendt for at levere ekstremt nærværende og fysisk krævende performances, hvor beats, distortion og vokale fragmenter smelter sammen i ét massivt tryk. Det er musik, der inviterer til bevægelse og fælles ekstase – men også til at miste fodfæstet et øjeblik. Vi glæder os til at præsentere aya til en aften med kompromisløs, fremadskuende klubmusik.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
ENGLISH:
When aya takes the stage with her breathless, high-energy outbursts, the intensity constantly teeters between euphoria and collapse. The British electronic artist operates at the heart of today’s most vital club and experimental scenes, and her shows are intense, uncompromising, and designed to go directly to the bones.
aya’s music moves freely between techno, hardcore, noise, club deconstruction, and emotional overload. This is electronic music that refuses to be polite or comfortable, instead pushing the body, tempo, and senses to their outer limits. Her sound world is fragmented, aggressive, and vulnerable all at once – a perpetual tension between control and breakdown.
With her debut album im hole, aya established herself internationally, and with hexed! on the influential Hyperdub label she has fully cemented her position as one of the most relevant electronic artists working today. The album is a breathless, high-energy release that has placed her at the centre of both club culture and the experimental electronic underground. It draws on the chaos of the internet, the physical weight of soundsystem culture, and the raw directness of hardcore aesthetics. Live, aya is known for delivering intensely present and physically demanding performances, where beats, distortion, and vocal fragments fuse into one massive surge. It’s music that invites movement and collective ecstasy – but also the feeling of losing your footing, if only for a moment. We look forward to presenting aya for a night of uncompromising, forward-thinking club music.

events.title: Zoumer Releasekoncert: 'e.a.l' (euro arab lovergirl)
events.description:
Kom og fejr udgivelsen af Zoumers nye album ‘e.a.l.’ - livekoncert + venner der DJ’er før og efter.
Zoumer er projektet af den københavnsbaserede sanger, producer, sangskriver og kunstner Yasmina Derradj. I 2024 udgav hun debutmixtapet ‘Green World’, som blev varmt modtaget i både musikundergrunden og kunstscenen for sin blanding af eksperimenterende pop, algeriske raï-metoder og lo-fi sensibilitet - med refleksioner over myte, historie og introspektion. Udgivelsen blev anmeldt/omtalt af Passive/Aggressive, GAFFA og Undertoner og kom på Soundvenues Breaking Sound-liste (2024).
Den 6. marts udkommer ‘e.a.l.’ - et collage-agtigt projekt af omarbejdede vokalfreestyles og field recordings, der bliver til samples, vævet sammen med strejf af algerisk percussion og intuitive elektroniske lag. ‘e.a.l.’ er en forkortelse for “euro arab lovergirl” - en karakter, der bevæger sig gennem albummets univers. Musikken samler stemninger og impulser i sange, hvor historier driver mellem det private rum og verden udenfor.
Albummet bevæger sig mellem isolation og forbindelse, dagbog og fiktion - med et diaspora-blik gennem lydlandskaber: fra steder i Algier som den botaniske have Hamma Jardin d’Essai og byens gader, videre ind i europæiske storbyer, hvor optagelser af stemmer, gadeoptagelser og instrumenter smelter sammen i musikken, mens man bevæger sig gennem forskellige rum. Et projekt der følger en stille tilbagevenden til sig selv.
Navnet Zoumer er en reference til den 1800-tals algeriske frihedskæmper Lalla Fatma N’Soumer - en stille reference gennem projektet og en undersøgelse af den styrke, der kan eksistere gennem sårbarhed.
Live bæres den samme undersøgelse videre - hvor det sårbare, modstanden og selvstændigheden står side om side.
Til release-showet kommer Zoumer med et udvidet live-setup - flere akustiske instrumenter vævet ind i elektroniske teksturer - efterfulgt af DJ-sets fra venner og community.
DJ-sets af:
Zahna Siham Benamor
A Good Year
Shelly Expose

Deki Alem samarbejder med producerne Richard Zastenker og Johannes Klahr, og udgav for nyligt deres debutalbum Forget In Mass, som blandt andet har fået roser af musikanmelderen Anthony Fantano, BBC Radio 6 og i Clash Magazine. Når Deki Alem drager ud på deres 25/26-tour her i efteråret, er det blandt andet med et udsolgt show på klubben Berghain i Berlin. Længe var Deki Alem Sveriges bedst bevarede hiphop-hemmelighed, men de dage lader til at være forbi. Vent derfor ikke for længe, hvis du vil opleve Deki Alem sende strøm til koncertsalen!

In English:
For years, Deki Alem were Sweden’s best-kept hip-hop secret. But with their unmatched live energy and explosive fusion of drum and bass, rap, and trip-hop, Swedish duo Deki Alem have become more than just a whispered name in the underground – they’re now headlining posters at some of Europe’s biggest festivals. Come join us and experience decades of club culture colliding in a dancefloor frenzy with Deki Alem!
With a raw and daring sound that blends drum and bass, trip-hop, and rap, Deki Alem offers a glimpse into Stockholm’s musical underground. The project is driven by twin brothers Sammy and Johnny Boakye Bennett, who channel relentless energy straight to the dancefloor. Working with producers Richard Zastenker and Johannes Klahr, they recently released their debut album Forget In Mass, which has drawn praise from music critic Anthony Fantano, BBC Radio 6, and Clash Magazine. Known for explosive live shows, punk energy, and a guerrilla-style approach, Deki Alem are more than just a music act – they’re forming a movement.
They’ve already played some of Europe’s biggest festivals, including Roskilde Festival in 2023, as well as Glastonbury and Electric Castle in 2025. As part of their 25/26 tour this fall, they’ll hit stages across Europe, including a sold-out show at Berlin’s legendary Berghain. For years, Deki Alem were Sweden’s best-kept hip-hop secret – but those days might be over. Don’t wait too long if you want to feel the surge when Deki Alem electrify the stage!

Jolene Invites welcomes Decoder and Grammar Of Movement, two artists working across deeper and more hypnotic shades of techno.

Dallas based producer and DJ, Decoder moves through sci-fi and deep techno, building retrofuturistic soundscapes shaped by experimental electronics and his cultural roots. With releases across Antiterra, Float Records, Subsist and Jeff Mills’ legendary Axis label, his productions have found support from artists like Richie Hawtin, Jeff Mills and Ben Sims, while his DJ sets have taken him through clubs such as De School, Fold and Cialo.

Through releases like Azadi and Plastic Games, as well as work on Copenhagen’s Escho label, he maps out rhythmic structures that feel both personal and expansive.

events.title: Rival Consoles / DR Koncerthuset - Studie 2
events.description:
Rival Consoles, der er en af Englands mest indflydelsesrige elektroniske musikere i dette årtusinde, giver koncert i Studie 2 med sit seneste album ”Landscape of Memory” og et spektakulært visuelt show.
“Impossible to ignore, and hard to forget” — Pitchfork
“Ambient leaning, mind expanding electronics” — DJ Mag
Det har ikke skortet på ros, siden Ryan Lee West i 2009 udsendte sit debutalbum under pseudonymet Rival Consoles. 16 år senere er han anerkendt som en af Englands mest kompromisløse og stilskabende elektroniske musikere i dette årtusinde for sin unikke blanding af billedskabende ambient, sfærisk shoegazede lydflader, artsy kompositionsmusik og minimal techno.
Rival Consoles’ musik kan vække minder om navne som John Hopkins, Aphex Twin og Nils Frahm, hvilket siger noget om hans talent og musikalske spændvidde. Udover at have udgivet ni studiealbum via det respekterede elektroniske/avantgarde-label Erased Tapes har han bl.a. remixet Jon Hopkins, Vessels, Ólafur Arnalds og Nils Frahm, lavet musik til en moderne danseforestilling og et afsnit af Netflix-hitserien ”Black Mirror”.
Tidligere i år udkom hans seneste album ”Landscape From Memory”, som bl.a. blev rost af DJ Mag, mens Uncut skrev, at albummet ”surges and pulses with emotionally charged, meticulously detailed, luminescent electronica”. MusicOHM kvitterede med 4 ud af 5 stjerner og kaldte det ”an album full of positive energy, showcasing electronic music at its most instinctive”.
Nu indtager Rival Consoles Studie 2 med et spektakulært audiovisuelt show, specialdesignet til at akkompagnere de nye numre live.

events.title: Jolene Invites: Tarik Hensen (Martinou & Ben Kaczor)
events.description:
Tarik Hensen is the joint project of Swedish producer Martinou and Swiss deep techno craftsman Ben Kaczor. The two first connected through SoundCloud nearly a decade ago and have since reunited in the studio for a series of deeply textured releases blending dub-leaning house, hypnotic techno and introspective club music.

Martinou, known for his emotionally rich productions and releases on labels like Nous’klaer Audio, Mule Musiq and Turbo Recordings, brings lush atmospheres and deep rhythmic storytelling shaped by years in the Scandinavian scene.

Ben Kaczor, the Basel-born producer behind the KCZ imprint and releases on Dial and Orion, is known for meticulous sound design and hypnotic deep techno that rewards patient listeners and proper sound systems.

Together as Tarik Hensen, they dive into the deeper end of the dancefloor: dubby textures, slow-burn grooves and music for the heads.

Quality music all night.

events.title: La Valentina (CO) + Suziethecockroach (BR)
events.description:
La Valentina er et friskt og kompromisløst navn på den nye europæiske klubscene. Med rødder i Colombia og base i Paris mixer hun rap, trap, eksperimenterende rock og salsa til et råt, legesygt og hyper nutidigt udtryk. Forvent en aften med ubønhørlig energi, sved og kæmpe bangers, når La Valentina indtager scenen på ALICE med sine dansere. Den brasilianske DJ suziethecockroach åbner med elektrificerende femme-frekvenser.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
Køb billet i forsalg: 160 dkk eksl. gebyr / ungebillet: 140 ung dkk eksl. gebyr
Køb billet: https://alicecph.com/.../la-valentina-co.../
Lyt: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BBzTeE1pTrQ&authuser=0
NB: Koncerten er stående
SCROLL DOWN FOR ENGLISH
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
En koncert med La Valentina er en oplevelse, der ikke efterlader nogen uberørt. Den colombianske Paris-baserede sanger mixer drill rap, trap, boom bap, eksperimenterende rock og salsa til et råt, legesygt og hyper nutidigt udtryk, der rammer kroppen som en sexet, sjov og frigørende energibombe. Samtidig repræsenterer hun med sit eklektiske udtryk en ny, kompromisløs latinamerikansk diaspora, der er i gang med at erobre Europas klub- og livescener med pondus og attitude.
Siden sit gennembrud i 2022 har La Valentina markeret sig stærkt på den franske scene med optrædener ved Les Inouïs du Printemps de Bourges og Buzz Booster samt medvirken i Netflix-serien “Nouvelle École”. I 2024 udgav hun sin debut-EP og solgte sin første solokoncert på La Boule Noire ud. Med “Crimen y Castigo Vol. 1” tog hun næste skridt og drog på sin første europæiske turné, mens Vol. 2 udkommer i februar og samler sig til et album i fuld længde.
La Valentina synger på spansk og fransk og trækker på inspiration fra både latinamerikanske rødder og fransk rap. Fans af navne som Baby Volcano, Isabella Lovestory og Rosalía kan godt allerede sætte kryds i kalenderen 13. marts, når La Valentina indtager ALICEs scene med sine dansere.
Suziethecockroach:
suziethecockroach er en brasilianskfødt kunstner og DJ med base i København. Hun har markeret sig både lokalt og internationalt, bl.a. med sine mixes på Drift Radio og live som et af de mest spændende navne på klubscenen. Hun er kendt for sine intense, kropslige og frygtløst eklektiske sets, hvor pulserende trommer, elektrificerende femme-energi og rytmer fra det globale syd flyder sammen i ren klubeufori og tænder ild under ethvert dansegulv. Med et åbent blik mod verden og dansegulvet som samlingspunkt åbner suziethecockroach for La Valentina denne aften.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
In English:
La Valentina is a fresh and uncompromising name on the new European club scene. With roots in Colombia and a base in Paris, she blends rap, trap, experimental rock and salsa into a raw, playful and hyper-contemporary sound. Expect a night of relentless energy, sweat and huge bangers when La Valentina takes over the stage at ALICE with her dancers. Brazilian DJ suziethecockroach opens the night with electrifying femme frequencies.
A concert with La Valentina is an experience that leaves no one untouched. The Colombian, Paris-based singer mixes drill rap, trap, boom bap, experimental rock and salsa into a raw, playful and ultra-modern expression that hits the body like a sexy, fun and liberating energy bomb. At the same time, her eclectic style represents a new, uncompromising Latin American diaspora that is currently conquering Europe’s club and live scenes with power and attitude.
Since her breakthrough in 2022, La Valentina has made a strong mark on the French scene with performances at Les Inouïs du Printemps de Bourges and Buzz Booster, as well as an appearance in the Netflix series Nouvelle École. In 2024, she released her debut EP and sold out her first solo concert at La Boule Noire. With Crimen y Castigo Vol. 1, she took the next step and embarked on her first European tour, while Vol. 2 will be released in February and come together as a full-length album. La Valentina sings in Spanish and French and draws inspiration from both her Latin American roots and French rap. Fans of artists like Baby Volcano, Isabella Lovestory and Rosalía can already mark their calendars for March 13, when La Valentina takes the stage at ALICE with her dancers.
Suziethecockroach:
suziethecockroach is a Brazilian-born artist and DJ based in Copenhagen. She has made her mark both locally and internationally, including with her mixes on Drift Radio and live as one of the most exciting names on the club scene. She is known for her intense, physical and fearlessly eclectic sets, where pulsating drums, electrifying femme energy and rhythms from the global south merge into pure club euphoria and set any dance floor on fire. With an open view toward the world and the dance floor as a gathering point, suziethecockroach opens the night for La Valentina.

events.title: Rashad Becker (DE/SY) + Anton Friisgaard (DK)
events.description:
For lydnørder er Rashad Becker kendt for sit mangeårige virke som et sandt mastering-geni med mere end 1200 udgivelser i bagagen. Men i sine egne værker udforsker den Berlin-baserede komponist, lydkunstner og producer lydens strukturelle og psykoakustiske egenskaber med kirurgisk præcision og en næsten uhyggelig fantasi. Kom og bliv opslugt af hans dragende univers, når han spiller koncert på ALICE til marts. Anton Friisgaard åbner aftenen.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
Køb billet i forsalg: 180 dkk eksl. gebyr / ungebillet: 160 ung dkk eksl. gebyr
Køb billet: https://alicecph.com/event/rashad-becker-de…anton-friisgaard/
Rashad Becker: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nwd3xlGVSpw
Anton Friisgaard: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iCZWyyCOv3Q
NB: Koncerten er stående
SCROLL DOWN FOR ENGLISH
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
For lydnørder verden over er Rashad Becker en legende. Siden 1997 har den Berlin-baserede komponist, lydkunstner og producer været en central skikkelse i Dubplates & Mastering i Berlin – studiet bag Basic Channel – og har sat sit præg på mere end 1200 udgivelser som master- og mix-ingeniør. Her har han været med til at forme lyden af kompromisløs, eksperimenterende elektronisk musik, ofte i kulissen, men med enorm indflydelse. Hans eget kunstneriske virke er mindre kendt, men til gengæld radikalt, kompromisløst og dybt originalt. Becker er især kendt for den anmelderroste serie “Traditional Music of Notional Species” på PAN – et særegent univers af komplekse, fremmedartede kompositioner, hvor lydene opfører sig som levende organismer, der ånder, vrider sig og muterer i konstant bevægelse.
Og det er netop dette univers, man kan glæde sig til at træde ind i, når Rashad Becker giver koncert på ALICE. Live åbner han nemlig et mørkt og indadvendt lytterum, hvor grænserne mellem musik, lydkunst og spirituel erfaring opløses. Publikum inviteres ind i et apokalyptisk, meditativt og nærmest rituelt sonisk landskab, hvor detaljerigdom og intensitet kræver fuld overgivelse. For fans af Drew McDowall, Alessandro Cortini og Jan Jelinek – og for alle med appetit på udfordrende og transformerende lytteoplevelser – er dette en sjælden mulighed for at opleve en sand mester i sit rette element.
Anton Friisgaard:
Anton Friisgaard er en mangfoldig musiker og lydskaber med rødder i elektronisk musikproduktion og komposition, men med et virke, der rækker langt ud over genrer og formater. Hans kunstneriske nysgerrighed, og hans dybfølte kærlighed til mangfoldigheden af udtryk inden for musik, har ført til samarbejder med klassiske ensembler, live-performances med den danske elektroniske pioner Gunner Møller Pedersen og dybdegående undersøgelser af tapeloops og analoge processer. Senest har han arbejdet tæt sammen med lokale balinesiske gamelan-musikere på Stroom-udgivelsen “Teratai Åkande”.
Anton Friisgaard har udgivet musik på labels som Flau, Janushoved, Vaagner og Stroom og har præsenteret sit arbejde på festivaler og scener som Roskilde Festival, Strøm, Intonal, VinterJazz og CPH Jazz – samt på spillesteder og kunstinstitutioner som ALICE, Koncertkirken, Gl. Strand og Mayhem. Med sit sanselige og fordybende soniske udtryk åbner Anton Friisgaard aftenen for Rashad Becker.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
In English:
For sound nerds, Rashad Becker is known for his long-standing work as a true mastering genius, with more than 1200 releases under his belt. But in his own compositions, the Berlin-based composer, sound artist and producer explores the structural and psychoacoustic properties of sound with surgical precision and an almost uncanny imagination. Come and be absorbed by his compelling universe when he performs at ALICE in March. Anton Friisgaard opens the evening.
For sound enthusiasts around the world, Rashad Becker is a legend. Since 1997, the Berlin-based composer, sound artist and producer has been a central figure at Dubplates & Mastering in Berlin — the studio behind Basic Channel — and has left his mark on more than 1,200 releases as a mastering and mixing engineer. Here, he has helped shape the sound of uncompromising, experimental electronic music, often behind the scenes, but with enormous influence. His own artistic output is less widely known, yet radically uncompromising and deeply original. Becker is especially renowned for the critically acclaimed series Traditional Music of Notional Species on PAN — a distinctive universe of complex, otherworldly compositions in which sounds behave like living organisms that breathe, contort and mutate in constant motion.
And it is precisely this universe that audiences can look forward to entering when Rashad Becker performs at ALICE. Live, he opens a dark and inward-looking listening space where the boundaries between music, sound art and spiritual experience dissolve. The audience is invited into an apocalyptic, meditative and almost ritualistic sonic landscape, where richness of detail and intensity demand complete surrender. For fans of Drew McDowall, Alessandro Cortini and Jan Jelinek — and for anyone with an appetite for challenging and transformative listening experiences — this is a rare opportunity to experience a true master in his natural element.
Anton Friisgaard:
Anton Friisgaard is a multifaceted musician and soundmaker with roots in electronic music production and composition, yet with a practice that extends far beyond genres and formats. His artistic curiosity — and his deep-felt love for the multiplicity of musical expression — has led to collaborations with classical ensembles, live performances with Danish electronic pioneer Gunner Møller Pedersen, and in-depth explorations of tapeloops and analogue processes. Most recently, he has worked closely with local Balinese gamelan musicians on the Stroom release Teratai Åkande.
Anton Friisgaard has released music on labels such as Flau, Janushoved, Vaagner and Stroom, and has presented his work at festivals and stages including Roskilde Festival, Strøm, Intonal, VinterJazz and CPH Jazz — as well as at venues and art institutions such as ALICE, Koncertkirken, Gl. Strand and Mayhem. With his sensuous and immersive sonic expression, Anton Friisgaard opens the evening for Rashad Becker.

events.title: Carpenter Brut
events.description:
Carpenter Brut bringer mørk synthwave og filmisk kaos til Store VEGA
Siden 2012 har franske Carpenter Brut været en af de mest markante og toneangivende navne på den internationale synthwave-scene. 

Med en unik fusion af elektronisk musik, rock og 80’er-inspirerede lydbilleder har han skabt et dystopisk og filmisk univers, der både hylder VHS-æraens æstetik og sprænger rammerne for moderne liveproduktion. 

Carpenter Brut er kendt for sine intense og visuelt stærke koncerter, hvor lyd og lys går op i en højere enhed. Han har spillet udsolgte shows på ikoniske spillesteder som La Cigale og L’Olympia i Paris, gæstet Coachella og stået på hovedscenerne på Hellfest og Poland Rock Festival. 

Med albumtrilogien Trilogy, Leather Teeth og Leather Terror har han cementeret sin status som en kompromisløs kunstner, der kombinerer synthwave med metallisk aggression og cineastisk atmosfære. Det visuelle er en integreret del af Carpenter Bruts udtryk. Gennem stiliserede musikvideoer og et gennemført grafisk univers forlænger han koncertoplevelsen og skaber en helhedsæstetik, der fanger både hardcore fans og nye lyttere. 

I dag er Carpenter Brut anerkendt som en kunstner i særklasse – både for den kompromisløse lyd, de spektakulære liveshows og evnen til at samle et bredt og dedikeret publikum på tværs af genrer og generationer.

events.title: Leftfield (UK)
events.description:
smash!bang!pow! & VEGA præsenterer:
▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄
Leftfield (UK) i Store VEGA
Torsdag d. 19. marts 2026 kl. 20:00
Billetter: 385 kr + gebyr
Billetsalget starter fredag d. 16. januar kl. 10.
Billetlink: https://www.billetlugen.dk/event/21165817/?affiliate=SXV
▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄
Legendariske Leftfield lufter deres stilskabende progressive house-bagkatalog live den 19. marts i Store VEGA.
Leftfield er stilskabende i ordets egentlige betydning. Den britiske elektroniske producergruppes udtryk, der trippende blander house med triphop, techno, breakbeat, dub og reggae er således grunden til, at progressive house opstod som subgenre – simpelthen for at beskrive deres unikke lyd!
Gruppen blev dannet i London i 1989 og var sammen med navne som Underworld, The Chemical Brothers og The Prodigy en central del af den elektroniske musikrevolution, som skyllede ind over England og resten af verden op igennem 90’erne.
Leftfields gennembrud kom med singlen ”Open Up” med gæstevokal fra Sex Pistol-legenden John Lydon, som opnåede en 13. plads på den engelske singlehitliste. Den succes fulgte gruppen effektivt op på med den mesterlige debut-milepæl ”Leftism” (1995), der gik nummer 3 i hjemlandet. Her sætter Leftfield nye standarder for eksperimenterende og meditativt medrivende elektronisk musik. Samme år blev albummet nomineret til en Mercury Prize, mens Mix Mag beskrev Leftfield som "the single most influential production team working in British dance music".
I 1999 udkom den fremragende efterfølger ”Rhythm and Stealth”, som strøg til tops på den engelske albumhitliste, og efterfølgende blev Leftfield endnu en gang nomineret til årets Mercury Prize. I 2002 valgte medlemmerne dog at trække stikket.
Lykkeligvis blev Leftfield gendannet i 2010, hvor de begyndte at optræde live igen. I 2015 udkom deres tredje album ”Alternative Light Source” til ros fra bl.a. The Line of Best Fit, Clash, Mojo og Uncut, og i 2022 fulgte den fjerde langspiller ”This Is What We Do”, som Mojo kaldte ”a timely blast of healing positivity, all but impossible to resist”, mens The Guardian kvitterede med 4 ud af 5 stjerner.
At Leftfield fortsat også er et vitalt bekendtskab live, kan gruppens danske fans bevidne, når de elektroniske legender lægger vejen forbi Store VEGA den 19. marts 2026.

events.title: FJAAK (Extended set), Milo Makua, Johannes Astrup
events.description:
German electronic Duo FJAAK continue to push boundaries in 2025 with their distinctive  blend of driving, energetic dance tracks. From storming warehouse techno to reflective  power house, their sound seamlessly incorporates influences from U.K. garage, dub,  breakbeat hardcore, and beyond. Known for their gritty yet sensual productions, FJAAK  create most of their music entirely on analog equipment, staying true to their raw and  authentic sound. 

Based in Berlin, Felix Wagner and Aaron Röbig have been making music together since  childhood and started producing techno as FJAAK in the late 2000s. Over the years, they’ve  built a reputation for their rebellious attitude, electrifying live performances, and  commitment to revitalizing the club scene with hardware-only live shows and high-energy DJ  sets. 
After launching their labels “FJAAK,” “SPANDAU20,” and the 2023-established “CROWD,” the  duo made waves in 2024 with their most ambitious project yet: the genre-defying album  FJAAK THE SYSTEM. A love letter to club music in all its forms, the album merges UK  breakbeat, techno, 2-step, d’n’b, jungle, trip-hop, and ambient. Featuring collaborations  with Modeselektor, Skee Mask, Red Eye, and J.Manuel, it has been widely celebrated as a  groundbreaking release. 

Now, in 2025, FJAAK are building on this momentum with new music, global tours, and a  growing roster on their labels. By continuing to challenge the norms of the club scene, they  remain at the forefront of electronic music, injecting playfulness, intensity, and innovation  into every project.

ALICE tager Newroz ind i nutiden med blikket rettet direkte mod dansegulvet og inviterer til en aften, hvor klubkultur og kulturelle rødder mødes. DJ Nah Care åbner ballet med sveddryppende klubmusik rodfæstet i Københavns progressive queer-scene, Istanbul Ghetto Club leverer eksplosiv eastern rave punk og PAYDAR fuldender natten med et energisk, inkluderende set.
