Istanbul Ghetto Club:
Istanbul Ghetto Club er opstået i Berlins legendariske undergrund som et anonymt kunstinitiativ, der lige så meget er performancekunst og visuel fortælling, som det er klubmusik. Deres liveshows har opnået over en million organiske visninger online, og deres Instagram-univers fremstår nærmest som et digitalt galleri, hvor lyd, billede og identitet flyder sammen. Her opstår et spændingsfelt mellem øst og vest, tradition og samtid, underground og mainstream. Musikalsk arbejder Istanbul Ghetto Club med improviseret klubkomposition, hvor rave møder performance, film, teater og litteratur. Hver koncert er en ny transformation – uforudsigelig, intens og dybt fysisk. Det er ikke uden grund, at deres mantra lyder: “A Rave With Istanbul Ghetto Club Will Be Unforgettable.”
Publikum verden over har allerede oplevet deres vilde og sanselige shows på scener og festivaler som Nuits Sonores, Berlin Atonal, Fusion Festival, Lente Kabinet, Maxim Gorki Theater og VENT Tokyo. Nu er turen kommet til København, og vi kan ikke komme i tanke om en bedre måde at fejre Newroz på!
PAYDAR:
“PAYDAR delivered an unforgettable and inclusive dance party when they unfolded their musical universe at Roskilde Festival.”– Bands Of Tomorrow
PAYDAR fuldender festen efter Istanbul Ghetto Club med et DJ-set, der er lige så energisk, uforudsigeligt og inkluderende, som det er personligt. Med rødder i Sydøstasien, en opvækst i Norden og en identitet, der svæver frit mellem kulturer, inviterer PAYDAR publikum med ind i et svimlende sonisk rum. Musikken bevæger sig ubesværet mellem amapiano, hiphop, baile funk, afro- og arabic house, flettet sammen til et pulserende klubunivers, hvor modsætninger sameksisterer. PAYDARs lyd udspringer blandt andet af iransk 90’er-musik fra barndomshjemmet og mødet med house og hiphop, som siden er blevet forenet på debut-EP’en “Middlebeatz” (2024). Live skaber PAYDAR et rum, hvor individualitet, fællesskab og mangfoldige identiteter fejres – en energi, der allerede har ramt alt fra intime klubber til Roskilde Festivals Apollo-scene.
DJ Nah Care:
DJ Nah Care åbner aftenen med et energisk og kompromisløst DJ-set, der trækker tråde direkte ind i Københavns progressive og queer natteliv. Som en central skikkelse på byens klubscene har han gennem det seneste årti udviklet en kinetisk og kropslig lyd, hvor hard groove, trance, sexet house og frække klub-edits forenes med tydelige referencer til hans kurdiske rødder. Som stifter af MISS THING og resident på Endurance CPH arbejder DJ Nah Care målrettet for inklusion og queer repræsentation, både på og uden for dansegulvet. Hans intense og højenergiske sets har bragt ham rundt på klubber i hele Europa – fra Berlin til Lissabon – og skabt et solidt internationalt aftryk.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
In English:
Newroz marks the arrival of spring and a new beginning for many Kurdish and Persian cultures – a celebration of light, renewal, and togetherness. At ALICE, we bring Newroz into the present with our focus firmly on the dancefloor, inviting you to a night where club culture meets cultural roots. DJ Nah Care opens the night with sweat-drenched club music rooted in Copenhagen’s progressive queer scene, Istanbul Ghetto Club delivers explosive eastern rave punk, and PAYDAR rounds off the night with an energetic and inclusive set.
Istanbul Ghetto Club:
Istanbul Ghetto Club emerged from Berlin’s legendary underground as an anonymous art initiative that is as much about performance art and visual storytelling as it is about club music. Their live shows have amassed over one million organic views online, while their Instagram universe resembles a digital gallery where sound, image, and identity merge. Here, a charged interface emerges between East and West, tradition and contemporaneity, underground and mainstream. Musically, Istanbul Ghetto Club works with improvised club compositions where rave collides with performance, film, theatre, and literature. Each concert is a new transformation – unpredictable, intense, and deeply physical. It’s no coincidence that their mantra is: “A Rave With Istanbul Ghetto Club Will Be Unforgettable.”
Audiences around the world have already experienced their wild and sensorial shows at venues and festivals such as Nuits Sonores, Berlin Atonal, Fusion Festival, Lente Kabinet, Maxim Gorki Theater, and VENT Tokyo. Now it’s Copenhagen’s turn – and we can’t think of a better way to celebrate Newroz.
PAYDAR:
“PAYDAR delivered an unforgettable and inclusive dance party when they unfolded their musical universe at Roskilde Festival.” – Bands Of Tomorrow
PAYDAR rounds off the night after Istanbul Ghetto Club with a DJ set that is as energetic, unpredictable, and inclusive as it is personal. With roots in Southeast Asia, an upbringing in the Nordics, and an identity floating freely between cultures, PAYDAR invites the audience into a dizzying sonic space. The music moves effortlessly between amapiano, hip-hop, baile funk, afro, and Arabic house, woven into a pulsating club universe where contrasts coexist. PAYDAR’s sound draws in part from Iranian 90s music from their childhood home, alongside encounters with house and hip-hop, later united on the debut EP Middlebeatz (2024). Live, PAYDAR creates a space where individuality, community, and diverse identities are celebrated – an energy already felt everywhere from intimate clubs to Roskilde Festival’s Apollo stage.
DJ Nah Care:
DJ Nah Care opens the night with an energetic and uncompromising DJ set that connects directly to Copenhagen’s progressive and queer nightlife. As a central figure on the city’s club scene, he has spent the past decade developing a kinetic and physical sound where hard groove, trance, sexy house, and cheeky club edits merge with clear references to his Kurdish roots. As founder of MISS THING and resident at Endurance CPH, DJ Nah Care works actively to promote inclusion and queer representation both on and off the dancefloor. His intense, high-energy sets have taken him to clubs across Europe – from Berlin to Lisbon – leaving a strong international imprint

Container er det kompromisløse elektroniske soloprojekt fra den amerikanskfødte og London‑baserede musiker Ren Schofield. Han voksede op i Providence, Rhode Island, hvor byens DIY‑ og noise‑scene i 00’erne satte et afgørende præg på hans tilgang til lyd: rå, intens og uden hensyn til konventioner. Efter år som del af støjbaserede bands og eksperimentelle projekter begyndte Schofield i 2009 at udforske, hvordan han kunne omsætte denne energi til et mere rytmisk format. Resultatet blev Container – et projekt, der kombinerer støj, båndmanipulation, forvrængede beats og technoens repetition i et udtryk, der føles både punket og funktionelt.
Siden debuten har Container opbygget en kultstatus i den internationale undergrund med udgivelser på anerkendte labels og hyppige, højintense liveoptrædener. Hans musik er fysisk, skarp og utilregnelig; skabt med simple maskiner, men leveret med en aggressiv præcision, der både tiltaler klubpublikummet og fans af eksperimentel støjkunst.
I 2024 udkom albummet Yacker, hvor Schofield tilføjede en mere rockinspireret styrke og rytmisk tyngde til sit univers, uden at miste projektets grundlæggende kaos, humor og kant. Med Container fortsætter han med at udfordre grænserne for, hvad elektronisk musik kan være – og hvordan det kan føles.

Old-school rhythm meets new-school attitude, and her sets feel personal without being precious. It’s sexy, it’s raw, and it’s meant to be felt in your hips.

Highgraid
Highgraid operates on drums first. UK funky, afrobeats, hard drum, and UK bass weave together through tight, rolling percussion. Influenced by pirate radio culture and underground club scenes in London and Copenhagen, he knows how to make unfamiliar tracks feel instantly necessary. Expect layered rhythms, quick blends, and a dance floor that moves as one unit.

events.title: Portal Pets Release
events.description:
Portal Pets, the first self-titled and self-released album from the Copenhagen-based group Portal Pets in March. We celebrate the release on the 21st of March in Christianshavnsbeboerhus together. The album consists of nine riveting songs, ranging from statements of compelling connectivity to heartfelt soliloquy, from vast scapes as seen from the perspective of a flying dragon, to the nearness, the introspection and the raw realism of the everyday. Wordless vocal hooks are placed as central figures, rather than as mere ornaments. Auditory residue and bleed from early versions of songs kept in the finals. Enchanting, mischievous and invigorating vocal lines bend as refracted light, reverberates over brisk and rosy-cheeked riffs and beats. Spirited, as a pleasant spook.
Portal Pets are Xenia Xamanek, Emil Palme & Oliver Laumann, on vocals, bass, guitar and drums.
On this night, we’ve invited the great 100 (live), Dawda Jobarteh (live) and Tjiquita (DJ) to perform alongside Portal Pets.
Looking forward to see you

Oplev de københavnske producere Deb Foam og Dragongirl den 25. marts 2026!
Den københavnsbaserede producer Deb Foam er kendt for sin evne til at blande rå energi og selvrefleksion i sin musik, hvilket afspejler autenticitet og fanger essensen af hendes oplevelser. Med inspiration fra en blanding af EDM, punk og breakbeat skaber Deb Foam en rebelsk og fascinerende lydoplevelse med kraftige, forvrængede beats og aggressive synths. Gennem denne intense og dynamiske lyd udforsker hun temaer som oprør og udholdenhed, og hun tager lytterne med på en ærlig rejse af selvopdagelse og følelsesmæssig frigørelse.
Den københavnsbaserede komponist, producer og DJ Dragongirl arbejder i krydsfeltet mellem klubmusik og scenekunst. Hun er interesseret i, hvordan musik kan skabe verdener, rum og sin egen form for taktilitet og krop. Hun udforsker dette på sit debutalbum, lydrejse og klubeventyr “Hot Blue.”
Selvom hendes musik ofte beskrives som apokalyptisk, er den ikke af dystopisk natur, men fremmaner både håb og lys. Med nedtonede og atmosfæriske noter arbejder hun sig imod en fremtid, hvor drager og maskiner lever side om side.

events.description:
ALICE lancerer 360° Evening – en ny serie af aftener, der udfordrer det klassiske koncertformat. Med et firedelt quadrofonisk højttaler-setup og scenen i midten af rummet, inviteres publikum ind til intenst omsluttende koncertoplevelser. Første aften finder sted til marts, hvor tre kompromisløse kunstnere med stærke kunstneriske personligheder kolliderer i en uforglemmelig triple-bill. Vi glæder os til at præsentere den radikale rapper og producer Skt. DeLarge, den færøske AGGRASOPPAR-frontfigur med sit soloprojekt Silvurdrongur og den hypede norske elektroniske duo Fochs Koshka.

Skt. DeLarge:
Rapper og producer Skt. DeLarge har siden 2020 markeret sig som en af de mest originale stemmer i den danske undergrund. Hans ekspressive og eftertænksomme univers bevæger sig frit mellem alternativ rap, noise og digital hardcore – med satirisk bid, forvrængede beats og tekster gennemsyret af både raseri og skrøbelighed. Med debutalbummet “Ritualer Er Det Eneste Vi Har At Holde Om…” leverer Skt. DeLarge en horrorlignende meditation over gentagelser på det personlige, samfundsmæssige og verdenshistoriske plan. Det er kompromisløst, aggressivt og dybt reflekterende. Skt. DeLarge har allerede blæst publikum bagover på Roskilde Festival, så vi glæder os til at opleve hans intense liveenergi på ALICE denne aften.
Silvurdrongur:
Færøske Silvurdrongur bringer en shamanistisk og kaotisk kraft til scenen med sin egenartede blanding af club, hiphop, punk og noise rock – en lyd, han selv betegner som “extinction punk”. Hans seneste album “nú æt eg eftir ánni” er en mørk, hypnotisk rejse mod undergang og genfødsel, akkompagneret af en kortfilm og rost af medier som The Fader. Silvurdrongurs koncerter er vilde, uforudsigelige og dybt forløsende. Han spillede en helt pakket koncert på ALICE i efteråret med sit band AGGRASOPPAR, og nu glæder vi os til at præsentere ham med sit soloprojekt denne aften.
Fochs Koshka:
Lineup fuldendes af norske Fochs Koshka, et af de mest fremadskuende navne på den skandinaviske elektroniske scene. Duoens hyperintense liveshows er et bombardement af punket techno, dekonstrueret klubmusik og brutal energi. Med debutalbummet Cluttercore (2025) skubber de deres lyd endnu længere ud i spændet mellem teknologisk acceleration og samfundsmæssigt kollaps. Fochs Koshka lagde Roskilde Festival ned i 2024, og nu er turen heldigvis kommet til ALICE!
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
In English:
ALICE launches 360° Evening – a new series of nights that challenge the classic concert format. With a four-speaker quadraphonic sound setup and the stage placed in the middle of the room, audiences are invited into intensely immersive concert experiences. The first evening takes place in March, where three uncompromising artists with strong artistic identities collide in an unforgettable triple bill. We are excited to present the radical rapper and producer Skt. DeLarge, the Faroese AGGRASOPPAR front figure with his solo project Silvurdrongur, and the hyped Norwegian electronic duo Fochs Koshka.
Skt. DeLarge:
Rapper and producer Skt. DeLarge has, since 2020, established himself as one of the most original voices in the Danish underground. His expressive yet reflective universe moves freely between alternative rap, noise and digital hardcore – marked by satirical bite, distorted beats and lyrics infused with both rage and vulnerability. With his debut album Ritualer Er Det Eneste Vi Har At Holde Om…, Skt. DeLarge delivers a horror-like meditation on repetition on personal, societal and world-historical levels. It is uncompromising, aggressive and deeply reflective. Having already blown audiences away at Roskilde Festival, we are excited to experience his intense live energy at ALICE this evening.
Silvurdrongur:
Faroese artist Silvurdrongur brings a shamanistic and chaotic force to the stage with his distinctive blend of club, hip hop, punk and noise rock – a sound he himself describes as “extinction punk.” His latest album nú æt eg eftir ánni is a dark, hypnotic journey toward apocalypse and rebirth, accompanied by a short film and praised by outlets such as The Fader. Silvurdrongur’s concerts are wild, unpredictable and deeply cathartic. He played a completely packed show at ALICE last autumn with his band AGGRASOPPAR, and we are now excited to present him with his solo project this evening.
Fochs Koshka:
The lineup is completed by Norway’s Fochs Koshka, one of the most forward-thinking acts on the Scandinavian electronic scene. The duo’s hyper-intense live shows are a barrage of punk-infused techno, deconstructed club music and brutal energy. With their debut album Cluttercore (2025), they push their sound even further into the tension between technological acceleration and societal collapse. Fochs Koshka tore Roskilde Festival apart in 2024 – and now, luckily, it’s ALICE’s turn.

events.title: Some Traces Of House at Jolene
events.description:
Some Traces Of House represents an artistic platform focused on underground house music where different sound perceptions are highlighted according to each artist. This concept was founded by Ivan Dallmann in 2020. STOH allows international artists to express themselves in music podcasts and it also works as an independent record label and musical events promoter, aiming to diversify channels and boost up different ways of expression. 

This time we are hosting Chiri & Gonz Lijtenberg booth among the most influential vinyl DJs in Argentina at Jolene in the mythical meat packing district of Copenhagen. This two will take care of the decks  for the most part of the night, being responsible of setting up the finest sound atmosphere, spinning their best selection of  house and Detroit techno records alongside Ivan Dallmann who's in charge of warming of the venue with the deepest house tunes. 

Juan Ignacio Chiri is a DJ, producer and co-founder of the Detroit Classic Gallery (DCG) label. Since 2014, he has been part of the duo E110101, standing out for his mastery of vinyl. He has taken his music to iconic clubs such as Tresor, Rex Club and the HOR platform.

His sound proposal fuses house and techno in DJ set formats with vinyl and also Live. In addition to producing events and training new talents through DCG Academy, he is the co-founder of Fusión, a production company focused on the house scene, establishing himself as a key figure in the Buenos Aires underground scene. In addition, he is the founder of Buenos Aires Wax (BAWAX), a store specialized in DJ equipment and electronic music vinyl.

Gonzalo Lijtenberg is an Argentine DJ and filmmaker whose path bridges music, visual work, and electronic culture through multiple disciplines. His early years were rooted in Buenos Aires underground techno scene, here he held a residency at the legendary club Cocoliche, developing a style defined by raw, mental techno and a deep focus on dance-floor narrative and groove.

Years later he co-founded Buenos Aires Wax with his friend and fellow DJ Chiri, a vinyl store dedicated to fostering record culture in Argentina through curated imports, rare finds, and hard-to-source editions. Upon returning to DJing, Gonz embraced a warmer, more organic palette influenced by Detroit deepness, classic house grooves, and a carefully curated selection guided by years of critical listening and technical craft. His sets today are marked by measured groove, emotional depth, and an obsessive dedication to narrative. 

Nowadays he has been consolidating a strong presence within the local scene, with recurrent appearances at Avant Garten, one of the most relevant spaces in the current circuit, as well as performances at venues such as Artlab, Dunepark, and Crobar Jardin, among others.

You can’t dear to miss this one! It will be a warm vibes spring night with quality music, good drinks and that special argentine crowd atmosphere you don’t wanna miss at the most iconic club in Denmarks capital. 
 
Event Info. 

* Jolene Bar - Flæsketorvet 81, Copenhagen 
* Free Entrance 
* 20+ 

 See you on the dance floor ;)

Med udstillingens foranderlige univers som omdrejningspunkt folder aftenen sig ud i et program, hvor kunst, litteratur og klubkultur spejler og udfordrer hinanden.

ARKEN Later? inviterer Lone Aburas til en samtale om hendes bog Den frie verden – et dystopisk high school-drama om hykleri, wellnesskultur og global ulighed. Hvordan kan forestillinger om fremtiden hjælpe os med at forstå nutidens kriser og samfundsdynamikker? I dialog med Luka Holmegaard perspektiveres bogen til Chameleon og Al Qadiris kunstneriske undersøgelse af magt, begær og globale strukturer.
🍽Sulten kan stilles ved ARKENs vegetariske langbordsmiddag, hvor caféen serverer et udvalg af tærter, frisk grøn salat, hjemmebagt focaccia og pisket smør – perfekt som optakt til dansegulvet.

Oplev også en alternativ omvisning med ARKENs kunstvogn og slip din indre popstjerne løs i en omgang karaoke i boldbassinet.
Alt sammen kun for en almindelig entrébillet til ARKEN – få studierabat mod fremvisning af gyldigt studiekort.

events.title: Lord Spikeheart (KE) + Emil Palme (DK)
events.description:
Kenyanske Lord Spikeheart leverer et kompromisløst og fysisk liveshow, hvor death metal-growls, rap og klubmusik mødes i et højenergisk frontalsammenstød. Som den ene del af dennu hedengangne ekstremmetal-duo Duma leverede han en af de heftigste koncerter i ALICEs historie i 2022. Nu indtager Lord Spikeheart vores koncertsal til marts med en koncert, der rammer lige dele moshpit og dansegulv.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
Køb billet i forsalg: 160 dkk eksl. gebyr / ungebillet: 140 ung dkk eksl. gebyr
Køb billet: https://alicecph.com/event/lord-spikeheart-ke/
Lord Spikeheart: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oT8PpmqfiYc
NB: Koncerten er stående
SCROLL DOWN FOR ENGLISH
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
I det seneste årti har den kenyanske vokalist, sangskriver og producer Martin Kanja – bedre kendt som Lord Spikeheart – markeret sig som en af de mest markante stemmer i afrikansk ekstremmusik. Mange vil kende ham som den ene halvdel af de Nairobi-baserede metalhoveder i nu hedengangne Duma, men under eget navn har Lord Spikeheart skabt et endnu mere radikalt og personligt udtryk. Hans musik forener death metal-growls, skærende skrig og rap i en højenergisk hybrid, der rammer lige dele moshpit og dansegulv. Lord Spikeheart sprænger med andre ord rammerne for, hvad metal, rap og klubmusik kan være i 2026.
Debutalbummet “The Adept”, udgivet på hans eget label HAEKALU, blev mødt af massiv international anerkendelse og blev af The Guardian udnævnt til et af Top 10 Global Albums i 2024. Albummet blev rost for sin frygtløse, grænsebrydende vision af medier som Pitchfork, BBC Radio, The Quietus og Resident Advisor og cementerede Lord Spikeheart som en kunstner, der åbner nye veje for ekstrem og eksperimenterende musik – fra Østafrika til verdens scener. I 2025 fulgte EP’en “REIGN”, hvor industrielle teksturer, death metal, grindcore, afrikanske rytmetraditioner og klubenergi smelter sammen i et intenst og sammenhængende udtryk. Vi kan ikke vente til Lord Spikeheart indtager ALICE til marts!
Emil Palme:
Den eksperimenterende guitarist Emil Palme åbner aftenen for Lord Spikeheart. Med guitaren som ritualredskab – spillet med hjemmelavede buer af sten – fremkalder Palme hypnotiske mønstre i grænselandet mellem komposition og improvisation. Hans musik trækker på skandinavisk folklore, doom og neoklassiske klange og føles både urgammel og nutidig på samme tid. Det aktuelle album “Death by angel” er et mørkt requiem inspireret af mytologiske forestillinger om dødsenglen som ledsager mellem verdener. Her mødes dissonans og skønhed i langsomme bevægelser, der peger mod både undergang og forløsning. En melankolsk, andenverdslig åbning, der sætter scenen for en aften, hvor intensitet og transformation er i centrum!
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
In English:
Kenyan artist Lord Spikeheart delivers a relentless and physical live show where death metal growls, rap and club music collide in a high-energy frontal impact. As one half of the now-defunct extreme metal duo Duma, he delivered one of the most ferocious concerts in ALICE’s history back in 2022. This March, Lord Spikeheart returns to take over our concert hall with a show that hits the moshpit and the dancefloor in equal measure.
Over the past decade, Kenyan vocalist, songwriter and producer Martin Kanja – better known as Lord Spikeheart – has emerged as one of the most striking voices in African extreme music. Many will recognize him as one half of the Nairobi-based metal force Duma, now disbanded, but under his solo moniker Lord Spikeheart has developed an even more radical and personal expression. His music fuses death metal growls, piercing screams and rap into a high-energy hybrid that speaks equally to the moshpit and the dancefloor. In other words, Lord Spikeheart pushes the boundaries of what metal, rap and club music can be in 2026.
His debut album “The Adept”, released on his own label HAEKALU, was met with widespread international acclaim and was named one of The Guardian’s Top 10 Global Albums of 2024. The album was praised for its fearless, boundary-pushing vision by outlets such as Pitchfork, BBC Radio, The Quietus and Resident Advisor, cementing Lord Spikeheart as an artist opening new pathways for extreme and experimental music – from East Africa to stages around the world. In 2025, he followed up with the EP “REIGN”, where industrial textures, death metal, grindcore, African rhythmic traditions and club energy merge into an intense and cohesive sound. We can’t wait for Lord Spikeheart to take over ALICE this March!
Emil Palme:
The experimental guitarist Emil Palme opens the evening for Lord Spikeheart. Using the guitar as a ritual instrument – played with self-made bows of stone – Palme conjures hypnotic patterns in the hazy borderland between composition and improvisation. His music draws on Scandinavian folklore, doom and neo-classical textures, feeling both ancient and strikingly contemporary at the same time. His latest album Death by angel is a dark requiem inspired by mythological ideas of the angel of death as a guide between worlds. Here, dissonance and beauty meet in slow-moving passages that gesture toward both collapse and redemption. A melancholic, otherworldly opening that sets the stage for an evening centered on intensity and transformation.

Born and raised in Buenos Aires, Sol has recently been one of the few names to emerge from Latin America to make a name for themselves around the whole world. Thanks to her unique sets located somewhere along the border of House and Techno she quickly gained traction in her native Argentina. Tasked with playing alongside international headline artists in Buenos Aires, she gained wide-spread recognition far beyond her own countries borders. Since then, various tours throughout Europe saw her play some of the most reputed venues on the continent. events.description:
✧✵ Welcome to 𝐒𝐏𝐄𝐂𝐓𝐑𝐀 ✵✧

A queer- and dance-centered club space that celebrates esteemed and emerging underground artists from the Queer, Trans and BIPOC spectrum around the globe.

Expect a wide spectrum of visionary dance and club music while honoring its rich history and culture anchored in NYC and the Midwest US.

Let’s create a respectful and liberating club experience together and keep phones and conversations away from the dance floor.


𝗟𝗜𝗡𝗘-𝗨𝗣:

✧✵ 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗼𝗿𝗲𝘁𝗶𝗰 (𝗡𝗬𝗖) [they/she] ✵✧

theoretic is a Jersey-raised, Brooklyn-based DJ, producer, educator, and curator entrenched in the heart of Brooklyn’s underground music scene. Their sonic craft fuses House, Techno, Disco, NY Garage, Soul, and Black club music—without limits, across borders. Whether spinning digitally or from their vast record collection, their style is a symphonic medley that compels even the most restrained feet to move.
They hold a residency at New York’s iconic queer venue ANIMAL, and are one-third of QVC (Queer Vinyl Collective), a monthly DIY party and cultural preservation series honoring the queer, Black and Brown roots of dance music and nightlife. They have played at acclaimed NYC nightlife institutions including Elsewhere, Good Room, Nowadays, Le Bain, and internationally from London to Toronto, sharing decks with legends such as A Guy Called Gerald and Stacey “Hotwaxx” Hale. Their sonic odyssey breaks norms and melds genres—a timeless approach to dance music.

✧✵ 𝗥𝗼𝗯𝗶𝗻 𝗙𝗹𝘂𝘅 (𝗗𝗘) [he/they] ✵✧

𝐒𝐏𝐄𝐂𝐓𝐑𝐀 is a club concept curated by Robin Flux, a Berlin-based DJ/producer, dancer, educator and curator moving between club and dance scenes across Europe, the US, and Asia. Shaped by years of going to the source—from NYC, Chicago, and Detroit to Tokyo and other cities across Japan, Korea, and Southeast Asia—he approaches DJing as movement-led storytelling: playful, daring, and deeply rooted in the queer lineages of dance music. As an active member of the ballroom, whacking and house dance scenes, he draws on years of shared practice to give dancers’ movements and stories space at the center of the night, where they are lived rather than referenced.

events.title: Night Journey pres: Ultra Caro - VEGA [Support: miaw]
events.description:
Mærk hjertet banke i takt til ultra caros hyperpop i Ideal Bar
_____________________________________________________________
Døre: 19.00
Koncertstart: 20.00
Billetpris: 190 kr inkl. gebyr.
______________________________________________________________
I et æterisk, eksperimenterende lydunivers blander ultra caro tempoet fra hyperpop, shoegazens drømmende udtryk og synthpoppens melankoli.
Den franskfødte musiker udgav i slutningen af 2025 albummet moonlight diaries og er efterhånden et velkendt navn på den alternative popscene.
På moonlight diaries introducerer ultra caro sange af mørke og elektronisk-båret produktioner, der sammen med nænsomme, blide melodi- og vokallinjer tager lytteren med ud i den krystalklare nat, hvor måneskinnet dominerer og drømmene får frit løb. Sangene står som tydelige eksempler på musikerens evne til netop at gå på opdagelse i alsidige lyddesign, genreeksperimenter og innovative produktionsteknikker.
ultra caro har arbejdet sammen med navne som A. G. Cook, Charli XCX, Hannah Diamond, Erika de Casier og daine og har en tæt forbindelse til det toneangivende, pladselskab, PC Music, som førstnævnte A. G. Cook har grundlagt.
Publikum kan se frem til en aften i Ideal Bar, hvor hyperpoppens hurtigt pulserende energi danser kinddans med indadvendte, melankolske toner fra ultra caros eksperimenterende pop.

Support: miaw
miaw er en cross-pop-duo, der leverer UK bass-inspireret, dekonstrueret clubmusik, som leder tankerne hen på Sega Bodega, Body Meat og james K, samtidig med at den blander sig med elementer fra shoegaze og 90’ernes trip-hop.Duoen består af Frederik Fog og Liza Dries fra Danmark og Holland. De to producere bruger hurtige breakbeats, arpeggierede synthesizere og utraditionelle sampling-teknikker til at skabe en lyd i krydsfeltet mellem et remix og en popsang. miaw har spillet VEGAs Udvalgte 2026, samt festivaler så som ESNS, MIL Lisbon, O Salgado Faz Anos, by:larm og Spot, så vel som turneret rundt i Europa og delt scene med Acopia, Lyra Valenza, 100%WET og Jack J.

events.title: Releasekoncert: Melodi Ghazal -  Idol Melodies
events.description:
Melodi Ghazal er sanger, sangskriver og producer med iransk baggrund fra København. Hun skaber left-field pop med elementer af r’n’b og folk, kendetegnet ved et særegent tonesprog og en stærk melodisk sensibilitet. I sine produktioner forener hun elektroniske og akustiske lag, hvor midi-strygere, daf-trommerytmer gemt i groovet, og guitarteksturer flettes sammen. Melodi arbejder med at skabe en særlig balance mellem melankoli og håb, vævet sammen af hendes dragende vokal og lyrik, som bevæger sig ubesværet mellem engelsk og persisk.
Melodi har på kort tid markeret sig som en af Danmarks mest interessante nye stemmer. Hun er uddannet fra det anerkendte Rytmisk Musikkonservatorium(RMC) i København. Hendes debut EP, udgivet i 2023, blev rost som en modig kunstnerisk erklæring og udnævnt af Soundvenue til en af årets 15 bedste udgivelser.
Siden da har Melodi optrådt på nogle af Danmarks mest markante scener og festivaler, her iblandt Roskilde Festival, Heartland Festival og det internationale showcase ‘VerdenVenter’ på VEGA. Når Melodi performer live, folder musikkens filmiske og drømmende univers sig yderligere ud. Akkompagneret af sit band, skaber hun en stemning af subtil dramatik og følelsesmæssigt nærvær. Det er fornemmelsen af, at noget skrøbeligt møder noget modstandsdygtigt, det stille møder det kraftfulde, og at publikum trækkes ind i en verden af længsel, søgen og mulighed. Melodis fuldlængde debutalbum Idol Melodies udkommer den 6.marts 2026 via Anyines, hvoraf den første smagsprøve, 'Destinies and Melodies’ udkom i slutningen af 2025. Med referencer til spirituel symbolik og en længsel efter at opløse sig selv er musikken melankolsk med downtempo grooves, mellemøstlig percussion, filmiske strygere og ørehængende melodier. Albummet er inspireret af sufi-dervisher, Britney Spears’ dansevideoer, digteren Hafez og Madonnas konvertering til kabbalah.

BASH IS BACK - Transgender Day of Visibility @ Den Anden Side

Saturday, March 28 │ Normal Selection │ House, Progressive

————
Come celebrate with us Saturday, March 28, ahead of March 31, for International Transgender Day of Visibility (TDOV) – a global day dedicated to celebrating trans lives. Observed worldwide, TDOV honors the achievements and contributions of transgender and gender-nonconforming people while drawing attention to the ongoing fight for trans justice.
Expect a night built on sound, presence, and collective energy: intention circle, queer tarot, tombola fundraiser, ambient session, and a full lineup of trans DJs, featuring special guest Julie Desire all the way from Paris.

Trans and gender-diverse people, allies, and communities are invited onto the floor – together, present, and unapologetic – honoring those who came before us and those shaping what comes next.

Trans joy, resistance, and increased, unapologetic visibility.
Visibility as Resistance: Following a trend of increased legislative restrictions, 2026 events emphasize that visibility is a crucial act of survival.

Activities 

Intention Circle by Aimé [he/him] 
Ambient session by WHO SHE [she/her]
Tombola Fundraising
Tarot Reading By Roserne [they/them]

𝗟𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘂𝗽

Julie Desire B2B DGERAL [she/her/they | they/he]
Britney Speed B2B Peachlyfe [she/her | she/her]

DEN ANDEN ENDE
YAQUB [they/he]
SUZIE THE COCKROACH [she/her]

Julie Desire (with us/Paris)
Julie Desire, embodies a new queer wave on the European electronic scene. She sets clubs
and festivals across the continent ablaze with raw energy, percussive rhythms, and
unapologetic sensuality. Blending progressive house, tribal house, and anything that could spark an orgy, her sound is an ode to desire, trans bodies, and sweat. Always high NRG, often sexy, her music is a visceral celebration of identity. A versatile producer, she’s released tracks on Maricas, BDE, Correspondant, and more. She’s also the co-founder of With Us, a queer party collective spotlighting trans and non-binary artists.
Julie Desire is raw energy, a queer vision, and an unstoppable urge to make bodies move.

She’ll be going B2B w/ BASH’s co-founder DGERAL.


DGERAL (SWEAT/BASH IS BACK) 
From Caracas to Berlin to Copenhagen, they’ve  been shaking dance floors with a groove that hits like a slap on the ass—and yes, you’ll beg for another.
A core member of Berlin’s SWEAT collective and co-daddy of Copenhagen’s Bash is Back, DGERAL is building spaces that are unapologetically trans-forward, deeply queer, and always hot. DGERAL’s sound is a steamy blend of old-school house, techno, and Latin percussion—equal parts sex, sweat, and soul. 

They’ll be going B2B w/ Julie Desire at the main floor! 


Baltza (BASH IS BACK)
BASH IS BACKS’S proud co-daddy, Baltza (they/them) crafts dance floor moments of energizing aura, joy and togetherness. Their sound lays with propulsive basslines, rolling and punchy kicks, proggy textures, heartfelt vocal samples, and an abundance of cheeky hi-hats. With a deep appreciation for the early club culture, 90s rave nostalgia, and all things soulful, their sets predominantly delve into groovy house, with occasional ventures into breaks, electro, bass, UK garage, hard groove, and playful, percussive soundscapes. The result? A journey that's uplifting, irresistibly fun, sassy, and at times, tinged with melancholy. 

Baltza will be on opening duties on the main floor! 


Peachlyfe (Fast Forward/Endurance)
peachlyfe is an artist of playful provocation. Blending psychoactive techno, swampy psy-trance, and alien acid, their DJ sets intentionally induce a state of sonic mindfuck, while their holistic live performances target transcendence. Transitioning through jazz music, composition, and the electric bass, peachlyfe rejected the rigidity of their formal conservatory training after finding freedom and empowerment in the culture and queer community of electronic music. Since then, the Fast Forward member and Endurance resident has become a mainstay within Copenhagen's fast-growing techno scene, and earned an international following that's seen them booked across 4 continents. Whether in the studio or behind the booth-Basement or Bassiani-Berlin to Beijing-peachlyfe's sonic nectar is always freshly squeezed. 

They’ll be closing the party in a B2B w/ Britney Speed


BRITNEY SPEED 
Britney speed is a Copenhagen based dj, part of the porn collective Bedside productions. After going to raves in Copenhagen since 2017, she quickly became a consistent part of the sweaty dancefloors. Finding herself mostly influenced by the rave scene from the 90s, she easily builded her selection consisting of various different genres and subgenres of techno, trance, house and breaks.
La Sosi
La Sosi, is Malmö's most scandalous travesti, and Madrid's most wanted fugitive. She brings gender mess and main character energy on the dancefloor. She is ready to cross the bridge to celebrate queer joy, sweaty bodies and trans power. Catch her firing up the main floor, besitos! 


Suziethecockroach
Suziethecockroach is a Brazilian artist, author, and DJ based in Copenhagen. For the past few years, suzie has played countless iconic sets at prominent venues and music festivals in Denmark and beyond, becoming known for her fearlessly eclectic style. Her sound consists of a blend of evocative drums, hot femme frequencies, and energetic rhythms from the global south.
Catch her turn it up on the second floor!  


Yaqub
Yaqub moves between continents and club cultures. From Somali roots to Copenhagen’s underground, they blend house, afro-house, jersey club, and techno into forward-thinking, high-energy sets that command the dancefloor.


Aimé (SWEAT)
Aimé is a seasoned raver and SWEAT Collective's vibe fairy. They have been hosting raving intention circles at the beginning of queer parties for the past three years. Aimé believes each party is an organism, and each raver is a big part of making the vibe what it is. The intention circle is a great way to connect with new cuties, learn from each other, and get a sense of collective grounding right from the start. 
You can sign up for the intention circle via our link, it’ll be hosted at Den Anden Side, before the night starts. 


Who She
Who she is a Copenhagen based non-binary DJ, artist and anarchist, who does not believe in genre supremacy; you’ll find her playing trance, house, disco, electro, pop, ambient and minimal.  She’ll be returning DAS, this time bringing a healing ambient session to shake off the transphobia and binary hell that surrounds us on a daily. Leave the linear thinking by the door, breathe in and open your mind. Expect gentle soundscapes, poetry and a beautiful journey towards queer utopia.


Roserne
Roserne gives tarot readings that help you uncover insights, bridge the gap between conscious and subconscious and earn clarity. With a decade of experience as the backbone of their practice, their intuitive and psychic approach allows for the cards to serve as portals into transformative experiences and grant access to guidance from loving, helpful sources around you. As a reader, their intention is to bring healing.
Roserne will be giving tarot readings between 22:45 and midnight.


ABOUT BASH IS BACK
BASH IS BACK is a trans-led, non-profit collective amplifying marginalized voices in nightlife. Rooted in the spirit of queer anarchist movements, the collective is committed to disrupting oppressive systems and carving out space for liberated expression on and off the dance floor.
Their residents deliver groove-heavy sets that move fluidly across the electronic spectrum — weaving in Latin influences, emotive vocals, and UK-inspired rhythms. Expect a blend of sass, sweetness, and euphoric energy, all crafted to remind you why community-built nightlife hits differently.

events.title: Axel Boman, Kawun, TINDRA
events.description:
Stockholm, early 90s. 13-year old Axel has just graduated from the notorious Fryshuset Deejay  Academy – the teacher had all students visit Pitch Control, the local record store, to buy techno records to practice mixing with, rather than the hiphop 12-inches they all brought themselves.  The discovery of this new energetic music sparks something in Axel, setting him off on his life’s journey. 

Soon enough Axel was carrying crates of vinyl around town, to any party that would have him,  if he wasn't throwing one himself. It would still be a while until he started producing his own music, but when that moment arrived, a volcano of songs erupted and by chance one of the demos caught the ear of DJ Koze. The release of ”Purple Drank” on Koze’s Pampa Records in  2010 couldn’t have been better timed: The same year Axel graduated with a Master of Fine Arts from Gothenburg University, with empty pockets and big dj dreams. Around that time he also moved his studio equipment into a basement on Barnhusgatan (“Orphanage Street”) in  Stockholm, together with Petter Nordqvist and Kornél Kovács – the beginning of Studio  Barnhus. 

Today Studio Barnhus is arguably the most important label for independent dance music in  Scandinavia, with over 100 releases from a broad spectrum of artists like Bella Boo, Sofia  Kourtesis, Jimi Tenor and of course the trio themselves. Axel does A&R and creative direction  work for the label – he also released his celebrated debut album ”Family Vacation” through Studio Barnhus in 2013. Since then, he’s kept a steady flow of releases on other lauded labels like the aforementioned Pampa and Tokyo powerhouse  Mule Musiq, garnering nominations for Grammis and P3 Guld (the two most prestigious  Swedish pop awards), as well as being named composer of the year by the Swedish songwriters  guild. 2022 will see Axel returning to Studio Barnhus and the album format with ”LUZ” and  ”Quest for fire”, by far Axel’s most ambitious project to date with guests like Off The Meds  vocalist Kamohelo, saxophonist Kristian Harborg and Baba Stiltz. Axel’s collaborative work has  always been a part of his success. He’s one third of Man Tear - a project with Petter Nordqvist  and Johan Jan Jonasson released by James Murphy’s DFA. He’s half of Talaboman with John  Talabot, adding releases on techno institutions R&S and Cocoon to his catalog. Their 2017  album, The Night Land, came with much fanfare – the duo has two EPs scheduled for 2022, to  be released on their newly formed Night Land Records imprint.

events.title: Studio Archive: RADIO PANINI x Carharrt WIP with tactual, Katla to Records, Healing Potions
events.description:
Radio Panini welcomes Carhartt WIP’s Audio Archives into its home at Jolene for their Copenhagen edition moving from afternoon broadcast into late-night club music. 

Audio Archives is part of Carhartt WIP’s wider project marking over 15 years of Carhartt WIP Radio through a publication, capsule collection and a global series of radio broadcasts and events, with Radio Panini listed as the Copenhagen chapter on Saturday 28 March 2026.

For this local edition, Radio Panini brings together three emerging Copenhagen labels — Healing Potions, tactual and Katla To Records — each hosting a section of the daytime program. The result is a full arc moving through reading, radio, live performance and club music, rooted in the more exploratory edges of contemporary electronic sound. The event opens with an Audio Archives book reading, before shifting into a sequence of label-hosted sessions and one-off performances.

Healing Potions begins the broadcast section with Asmus Odsat, a longtime Copenhagen favorite whose sets regularly lean into bass-forward experimentation and adventurous club textures. He is followed by A.Dixen (live), the project of Copenhagen’s Anders Dixen, whose work has been described as fusing the city’s experimental undercurrent with a more club-oriented sensibility; recent live material has shown a stripped, minimalist approach with a strong sense of tension and detail - for this one, he will bring one hour of improvised material. 

Next, tactual takes over with Jerey Stevenson, opening the hour before Mata Disk (live) brings in a different type of pressure. The Rotterdam artist Julian Determan, aka Mata Disk, has been active across both DJ and live formats, with recent listings and festival appearances pointing toward a sound world that stretches from swirling pads and propulsive rhythmic movement into more forceful club abstraction. For Radio Panini, this section also marks an important step: the first time live electronic performance is being woven this deeply into the program’s structure.

The final broadcast hour is hosted by Katla To Records, starting with Deb Foam and closing the daytime program with Poly Chain (live). Born in Ukraine and now based in Denmark, Poly Chain has built an international reputation through releases and sets moving fluidly between electro, IDM, acid, ambient and more marginal electronic forms. Her presence gives the day’s closing stretch a particularly strong sense of scope: intimate in format, but with a reach well beyond the local scene.

From 23:00, the room shifts fully into club mode. Vika b2b ymse opens the night; as a key figure behind Kune festival and most recently supporting the Healing Potions label operations, as a DJ Vika has appeared across Copenhagen lineups associated with bass-minded, percussive and low-end-focused programming, making this pairing a fitting bridge from the live section into the dancefloor. Freshly returned behind the decks after a long hiatus, norwegian ymse represents tactual wiht her dub infused techno and house. 

Mata Disk then returns in DJ mode, extending the thread between live performance and club functionality, before local super star DJ JM meets Simon Tyv from Kora wrapping up the night with deep and funky selection weaving through house, techno and bass. 

Across both day and night, the event traces a path through left-field electronic music in multiple forms: spoken word, broadcast, live hardware performance and club-focused DJ sets. A local chapter inside a wider international project, shaped by labels and artists working close to the edges of radio and dance music alike.

events.title: ØVSA Live w. Ektoplast, Judith van Waterkant & eski
events.description:
ØVSA Live is inviting you for a night of deep, cell shaking, mind bending and body rolling tunes brought to you by 
Ektoplast, Judith van Waterkant and eski.

As always you'll emerge into a soft, warm setting, close to the artists and their music with supreme sound quality.

We kindly ask you to arrive in the same hour between 7-8 pm. This ensures a wonderful atmosphere once the music starts and we can dance together undistrurbed by people coming in randomly from the streets.

Doors close - 8 pm

____________________________________________________________

ABOUT THE ARTISTS

***** EKTOPLAST *****
Live act.
We are extremely excited to have Ektoplast performing with with us in our intimate ØVSA set up. 
We have invited Ektoplast because he can create an unmatchable, cribbeling experience of electronic sounds, which make your whole body tingle and tickle. You will only really understand what it feels like when you have heard it. He performs live sets that combine original productions with improvisation, making each show a unique and evolving experience — perfect for creating both intimate atmospheres and energetic club vibes.

With a background in contemporary music composition and sound art, Clément Demonsant (Ektoplast) holds a Master’s degree in electroacoustic composition from the National Conservatory of Music and Dance (France). His work bridges electronic music, performance, and sound installation, often creating links between sound, architecture, and the visual arts.

Ektoplast is based in Berlin and known for weaving slow, hypnotic rhythms with deep, emotional textures. He has released on; Crépite, Talpa rec, Down, Underyourskin, Afterhour, Magician on duty, Rithmocode and performed at: Fusion Festival (GER), Kater Blau (GER), Boom Festival (PT), Noisily Festival (UK), LaNature (BG) and is a resident DJ at Beate Uwe.


*****JUDITH VAN WATERKANT*******
Dj set.
It's a huge pleasure to be able to share with you, that Judith van Waterkant will be joining us on this night! Besides her phenomenal sound, she also has done a lot of important work in the club scene, which has insipred us and others in many ways.

Judith van Waterkant is a DJ, producer, and psychologist whose hypnotic sound has become a staple in the electronic music scene. Hailing from Northern Germany, she has developed a unique style within "Slowrave" – a blend of driving techno and decelerated, melodic elements that create immersive, hypnotic dance floor experiences.

In the late 90s, Judith found her way into the left-leaning techno scene in Rostock. In the early 2000s, she attended the Fusion Festival for the first time, laying the foundation for a lifelong passion. While studying psychology she tirelessly organized events and built networks since then – a commitment that still drives her today.

The dream of standing behind the decks herself has been fraught with hurdles as a woman in a patriarchal music industry. 
Her experiences with sexism and the slow process of overcoming these barriers later became a topic she has openly addressed. Through her apperances on podcasts, in documentaries and lots of work within the scene she has offered deep insights into the fight against sexism and for visibility and respect in the business.

Judith van Waterkant continues to push boundaries. She is not only an artist but also an important voice for more equality and awareness in the club scene.

With releases on Acker Records / 3000 Grad, Heimlich, Meeronaouten and performances around prominent clubs, events and festivals like Fusion, arte concert, Laut & Luise, Karrusel Festival, Kater Blau, Südpol, Institut fuer Zukunft, Ved Siden Af and many, many, many more you will surely be spoiled by her solid exprience and mix of own productions and carefully selected tracks. 


*********eski********
DJ set.
eski is a Copenhagen based DJ, bringing bounce and ease to every dancefloor with a sound that she playfully calls "Schnekno con queso." It's deep, dry, rolling bass laced with hip-hop flair, electric guitar riffs, and always with a hint of riot. Operating in the 100-120 BPM range, she moves fluidly between down-midtempo, indie dance, and reimagined elements of acid and psy techno – creating a quirky, boundary-seeking sonic signature sound scape.

Across clubs, raves, and festivals in Denmark, Sweden, and Germany, eski delivers sets that seduce the fast-paced electronic music scene with technical finesse and musical charm. Never a dull moment, always a surprise here and there.

eski's impact extends beyond the decks. As a founding member of ØVSA, she has spent years crafting exceptional parties at Distortion Festival and beyond. She launched ØVSA Live because she was needing a concept bringing low-BPM live performances in intimate settings, focusing on heartfelt, high-quality sound experiences in Copenhagen. She's also a resident and co-creator at For Haus Sake, a Copenhagen-based collective presenting down-midtempo artists from across Europe.

This will be the first time that eski is performing herself at ØVSA Live. Prepare for a musical journey that pushes boundaries, challenges expectations, and makes you smile and groove.

events.title: AFSKUM - VEGA
events.description:
AFSKUM smelter eksplosiv energi og følsom nerve sammen i VEGA
____________________________________________________________
Døre: 20.00
Koncertstart: 21.00
Billetpris: 225 kr. inkl. gebyr.
_____________________________________________________________
I en malstrøm af insisterende takter og toner fra genrer som elektrorock, pop og hiphop skaber danske AFSKUM sit helt eget univers, hvor fremdrift møder sårbarhed, og lyset kæmper om pladsen med mørket.
AFSKUM tog første gang livtag med publikums opmærksomhed med det umådeligt stærke selvbetitlede debutalbum, AFSKUM, i 2023. Her havde flere anmeldere armene placeret langt over hovedet med flotte reaktioner og rosende ord.
Soundvenue kvitterede bl.a. med fem stjerner og overskriften: “Hypen var god nok: Afskums debutalbum er fødslen af et unikum på den danske musikscene”.
Nu er AFSKUM igen tilbage i spotlyset med to spritnye singler: “JEG VIL HØRE ALTING / GLEMMER ALDRIG”, der begge varsler musikerens kommende album, HJERTET / KNIVEN. Albummet er lavet i samarbejde med produceren August Kulmann (Statisk, Spleen United m.fl.).
På de to nye singler dyrker AFSKUM sit gehør for at få kontraster til at mødes. I en pressemeddelelse stiller han spørgsmålet: Kan man leve i vreden og sorgen og stadig blive elsket – men endnu vigtigere stadig elske?
Live er AFSKUM en flammende kugle af energi, der med stor indlevelse indtager scenens rampelys og på overbevisende vis folder sit brede musikalske vingefang ud.
GAFFA kastede seks stjerner efter hans optræden på SPOT Festival i 2022 med ordene: “Som en tiger i et bur råber, danser, hopper og smadrer han rundt på scenen på en måde, hvor det virker livsnødvendigt for ham.”

events.description:
ROSA ANSCHÜTZ (DE)

--------------------------------------
• Døre: 19.30 • Koncertstart: 20.30
• Billetter • Forsalg: 225kr • Dørsalg: 235 kr
--------------------------------------

Rosa Anschütz bevæger sig i krydsfeltet mellem mørk elektronisk musik, post-punket intensitet og atmosfæriske klangflader. Som både musiker og lydkunstner arbejder hun med komposition, installation og performance, og hendes værker åbner rum, hvor polyfone vokaler møder kølige synthstrukturer.

Med udgivelserne Votive, Goldener Strom og Interior har Anschütz markeret sig som en kunstner med et stærkt visuelt og konceptuelt aftryk. Hun har optrådt og udstillet på alt fra Goethe-Institut Tokyo og Mayhem i København til Deutsche Oper og internationale festivaler som Audioriver, Grauzone og Donaufestival.

Senest har hun komponeret filmens score til How to Be Normal and The Oddness of the Other World, der fik premiere på Berlinalen i 2025. Rosa Anschütz er signet på Heartworm Press, hvor hendes kommende album Sabbtical udkommer den 26. september 2025.

----

In Atlas væver ubesværet elektronisk drevet synthpop og darkwave sammen med elektropunk. I foråret 2024 udkom hendes soloalbum 'Where The Wildflowers Grow' på det italienske pladeselskab She Lost Kontrol. Albummet kredser om følelsesmæssig frigørelse og fungerer som et vidnesbyrd om følelsers styrke og rejsen mod at omfavne sin egen højsensitive natur. In Atlas er en eksplosiv performer med en punket energi, og hun indbyder både til fest og introspektion, når hun spiller live.

Hun er desuden en del af den græsk/danske elektroniske synthpop duo V.V.I.A., som i de seneste år har tiltrukket opmærksomhed på den athenske undergrundsscene og har udgivet musik på labels som Women of V.V.I.A., Meta Moto, Phormix, Vinylopgraph og Inner Ear Records.

events.description:

Find billetter: https://www.ticketmaster.dk/event/539828917
--------------------------------------
• Døre: 19.00 • koncertstart: 20.00
• Billetter: • Forsalg: 250 kr • Dørsalg: 260 kr
--------------------------------------
Loke Rahbek & Frederik Valentin
“Together” er det tredje kollaborative album fra Frederik Valentin og Loke Rahbek, efter “Elephant” fra 2020 og "Buy Corals Online" fra 2017. Lo-fi-vignetter af guitar og feltoptagelser præsenteres side om side med elektroakustiske eksperimenter som fortryllende invitationer til rytmiske, syntetiske verdener, hvor hver især finder balance i Markers meditation over menneskets hukommelse. Med akustiske instrumenter behandlet digitalt og instrumentale optrædener fortolket på ny bevæger "Together" sig ad den frodige retning fra deres tidligere værker mod nye destinationer.
Valentins lange række af soloarbejde og samarbejder omfatter blandt andet hans produktioner med Yung Lean (som Jonatan Leandoer127) på albummet "Nectar", samt deres fælles bestillingsværk for Sveriges Cullberg Ballet. I mere end et årti har Rahbek skabt elektronisk musik som Croatian Amor og under en række andre aliaser. Han har siden 2009 drevet Posh Isolation sammen med Christian Stadsgaard.
--------------------------------------
Vanity Productions
Posh Isolations anden skaber, Christian Stadsgaard, laver musik under solo-aliasset Vanity Productions - en afgørende figur på den nordiske elektroniske musikscene.
Stadsgaard er kendt for sin innovative og udtryksfulde stil, og med Vanity Productions mixer han larmende elementer med introverte melodier. Med et eksistentialistisk touch og sløret sensibilitet, maler Stadsgaard soniske billeder af moderne melankoli.
Udover sine anmelderroste solo-udgivelser, har Vanity Productions også samarbejdet med Merzbow, Loke Rahbek, Jonas Rönnberg og Isak Hansen.
--------------------------------------
oqbqbo
oqbqbo er aliaset for den russiskfødte, København-baserede kunstner Nastya Sipulina. oqbqbo er tilknyttet pladeselskabet Posh Isolation, hvor hun repræsenterer den mere melodiske del af deres roster.
Hendes seneste udgivelse “Tired Sun” er hendes andet værk på Posh Isolation, og det seneste år har oqbqbo samarbejdet med kunstnere som Scandinavian Star og Vallmo – mest markant på singlerne ‘Airdrops’, ‘Open Like A Flash’ og bidraget til “Rift One” YEAR0001-kompilationen med ‘Wakening’.
Derudover laver oqbqbo jævnligt explorative mixes på NTS Radio og lignende

events.title: Silva Bumpa, parashoot, Vincent's older sister
events.description:
If you’re tapped into the heart of the UK music underground, Silva Bumpa will already be on your radar. On Saturday, April 4, Sigurd CPH launches the very first edition of Countdown - Mix It UP!, a new recurring club concept built for a dancefloor that does not believe in staying in one lane. Three DJs from different genres and communities share the booth in 30-minute rounds, keeping the room in constant motion as sounds clash, shift, and reset all night long. Jungle Julia draws from baile funk, afrohouse, batida, and Afro-Portuguese club music with a sound that feels textured, percussive, and emotionally charged. Her sets carry a sense of movement and cultural memory, shaped by openness, curiosity, and a refusal to stay in one lane.

MABINTI brings a warm, magnetic energy to the booth, guided by afrobeats, amapiano, hip hop, R&B, and dancehall. Her sound is sensual, groove-led, and deeply attuned to the feeling of the room, creating moments that feel both intimate and expansive.

events.description:
Seaworld 10 Year Anniversary : 14 Hour Daytime Party @ Pumpehuset

Sunday, April 5 │ Soft Selection | Techno, Trance

————
Seaworld is celebrating its 10-year anniversary with another tsunami-sized, 14-hour Sunday daytime marine madness marathon at Pumpehuset!

Back in February 2016, we threw the very first Seaworld event at the now permanently closed rock bar Drone in Nørrebro. What was originally meant to be a one-off event turned out to be such a scubalicious success that we decided to do it again. Who would have thought that, 10 years later, we’d still be orchestrating aquatic techno spectacles for a new generation of young Laguna ravers?

To celebrate a full decade below the surface, Seaworld is preparing an overwhelmingly large Easter brunch together with Den Anden Side at our sister venue Pumpehuset. We’ll be boarding Sort Sal from 12:00 noon for a 14-hour menu featuring the Parisian hypnotic groove virtuoso Mac Declos, Copenhagen’s venomous electronic godmother Mama Snake, Stockholm-based Spice99 member & techno/electro selector Nina Michelle, the unavoidable master of dark rhythms Milo Makua, and our very own Seaworld resident salsa instructor Johannes Astrup. To further stir the waters, we’ve invited the Salty Sirens for an alluring burlesque dance performance.

Meanwhile, the legendary Smokers Floor will offer a true haven for seaweed-smoking sailors, with a nicotine-sprinkled banquet of locally curated prog and trance. Expect driving hypnotic progressive sounds from Macid, rolling basslines from quake-member FILTH.y, a rare b2b from Seaworld resident pioneers Anders Horse and DJ Taco, and finally Signe Alarcon and frølår in a thrilling b2b closing set.

events.title: Lost2Reality: XURI (Live) // Support: Kristian Andersen & Osvald Lund Rønne
events.description:
Xuri fører os gennem tågede, hallucinatoriske lydlandskaber og nutidig ambient i en helt særlig liveoplevelse. Kristian Andersen og Osvald Lund Rønne sætter scenen som support.
●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○
Venue: Musikcaféen, 3. etage
Døre: 20:00
Show: 21:00
Entré: 70kr
●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○
Xuri, aka Susanne Cleworth, er en København-baseret elektronisk musiker, der dedikerer sig til at udforske organiske lydlandskaber. Hun indfanger essensen af naturen og dens særheder, samtidig med at hun fremhæver virkelighedens uperfektheder frem for den kunstige perfektion i det digitale.
Med en baggrund i grafisk design tilgår Xuri musikken, som var det arbejde med farver, og skaber sine lydlandskaber med en unik og stemningsfuld palette. Hendes brug af tågede, hallucinatoriske lyduniverser inden for eksperimenterende ambient og organiske klangflader tager lytteren med på en rejse præget af pulserende beats og en nutidig klassisk sensibilitet.
Denne lydlige udforskning bygger videre på hendes tidligere soloalbum Bedlam Of Salt, udgivet på Janushoved. På hendes kommende EP Serene Trails bevæger Xuri sig endnu længere ind i det organiske ambient og tilbyder en dragende og multidimensionel lytteoplevelse.
Ved siden af sit soloprojekt bringer Xuri sin eksperimenterende tilgang ud på dansegulvet i duoen Atikka, hvor ekstraterrestriske lyde og moderne lyddesign smelter sammen med drivende rytmer.
Kristian Andersen
Den ene halvdel af holdet bag Lost to Reality-arrangementerne. Spiller numre fra kunstnere, der tidligere har spillet til L2R events.
Osvald Lund Rønne (DJ Dogwalker)
Osvald Lund Rønne, bedre kendt som DJ Dogwalker, har i mange år været en del af Københavns techno- og trance-scene gennem BunkerBauer-kollektivet og sit label V.A.L.I.S. Records.
Han optræder normalt sammen med sin bror som Lund & Rønne, men DJ Dogwalker er hans soloprojekt. Forvent skæv, groovy “heist”-musik.
Han vil spille udvalgte tracks fra kunstnere, der tidligere har optrådt til Lost to Reality-arrangementer.
-------------------------------
ENG:
Xuri guides us through hazy, hallucinatory soundscapes and contemporary ambient in a truly special live experience. Kristian Andersen and Osvald Lund Rønne set the stage as support.
XURI
Xuri, aka Susanne Cleworth, is a Copenhagen-based electronic musician dedicated to exploring organic soundscapes, capturing the essence of nature and its peculiarities while emphasizing the imperfections of reality over the artificial perfection of computing.
With a background in graphic design, Xuri approaches music much like working with colors, crafting her sonic landscapes with a unique and evocative palette. Her use of hazy, hallucinatory sound imagery within experimental ambient and organic soundscapes takes the listener on a journey shaped by pulsating beats and a contemporary classical sensibility.
This sonic exploration continues from her previous solo album Bedlam Of Salt, released on Janushoved. On her upcoming EP Serene Trails, Xuri moves further into organic ambient, offering a captivating and multidimensional listening experience.
Alongside her solo work, Xuri brings her experimental approach to the dance floor in the duo Atikka, where extraterrestrial sounds and contemporary sound design merge with driving rhythms.
Kristian Andersen
One half of the team behind the Lost to Reality events. Will play some hits from the artist at L2R events so far.
Osvald Lund Rønne (DJ Dogwalker)
Osvald Lund Rønne, better known as DJ Dogwalker, has been part of the Copenhagen techno and trance scene for many years through the BunkerBauer crew and his label V.A.L.I.S. Records.
While he usually performs with his brother as Lund & Rønne, DJ Dogwalker is his solo project. Expect quirky, groovy heist music.
He will play selections from artists previously featured at Lost to Reality events.

events.title: Vanessa Amara & Soli City
events.description:
Vanessa Amara er en dansk duo bestående af Birk Gjerlufsen og Sebastián Santillana. Deres lydunivers er et rige, hvor grænser opløses, et sted, hvor legende absurditet møder elegancen i moderne klassisk musik. Gennem deres distinkte blanding af analoge instrumenter - lige fra den hjemsøgende resonans fra pibeorglet til den indviklede varme fra strygere - skaber de et indviklet lydtæppe, ofte sammenvævet med eksperimentel elektronik. Udgivet på det københavnske pladeselskab Posh Isolation og med en særegen stil, invitereres lytterne ind i et univers, der både er flygtigt og fængslende, et rum, hvor fortid og fremtid samtaler i en stadigt udviklende dialog.
Deres seneste album "Café LIFE" (2025) er kulminationen på den danske duos udforskning af kammerpopsensibilitet og moderne teksturel likvidation. Altid rørende og uhyre unik, leverer Vanessa Amara en uforlignelig fordybelse i moderne musikproduktioner.
Duoen som har også sat deres aftryk på Rosalias populære og anmelderroste album Lux. De har stået for arrangementerne på hele tre numre på albummet:
"Sexo, Violencia y Llantas", "La Perla" og "Magnolias."
-:-:-.-:-:-
Soli City:
"Soli City opererer i krydsfeltet mellem klassiske musiktraditioner, elektroniske strukturer og et mediekritisk blik på det moderne liv. Med rødder i en post-digital sensibilitet udfolder Soli City sig gennem komposition, performance og installation - hvor lyd, lys og rum smelter sammen i fordybende situationer, der undersøger forbindelse, forbrug og transformation.
Soli Citys musik kredser om syntetiske stemmer, polerede strygere og radikale collageteknikker og former en skinnende auditiv overflade, hvor glæde og sorg, acceleration og opløsning kan sameksistere. Med en tydelig følelsesmæssig klarhed under sine HD-teksturer undersøger værket de kontraster, der definerer vores forhold til mediekultur og verden omkring os - og inviterer lytterne ind i en oplevelse, der er både intim og skarpt nutidig."
Koncerten er et samarbejde mellem SHOCK og Christianshavns Beboerhus, med støtte fra Københavns Kommune.

Europa (DE)
Is an artist working at the intersection of sound, video, and spatial design. Treating music as a multidisciplinary medium, he operates across a wide creative spectrum - blending pop, ambient, trap, indie, and beyond into emotionally charged, genre-fluid compositions.
His work straddles the edges of art and music, forging collaborations that extend into performance, visual design, and installation. With releases like Nobedience on Berlin’s boundary-pushing label Transatlantic, Europa continues to dissolve the lines between concert and experience. Whether behind the decks or engulfed in flames and visuals, his performances transcend the traditional, becoming sculptural, immersive environments. Pyrotechnic-infused audiovisual shows or bass-heavy DJ sets - each is a full-spectrum sensory journey, engineered with surgical precision. By extracting and reshaping the essence of genres, Europa crafts hyperkinetic soundscapes that mesh visceral intensity with emotional nuance. His music pulses with life, distorting the familiar into something radically new-blissful and blistering, immersive and unrelenting.
________________________________
buildupbreakdown
His universe moves between light and darkness, between explosive energy and fragile calm. The music is raw, personal, and uncompromising, carried by an honesty that hits the audience straight on.
buildupbreakdown exists in the extremes — either soaring high in near euphoria or crashing down where everything falls apart. This tension is present not only in the lyrics and sound, but also in his stage presence. He is intense and fully present, creating a raw and direct connection with the audience. The experience is unpredictable, authentic, and powerful.

events.title: Juana Molina (AR)
events.description:
BILLETSALGET STARTER ONSDAG DEN 14. JANUAR KLOKKEN 10:00 // TICKET SALE STARTS WEDNESDAY JANUARY 14 AT 10 AM.
Juana Molina er en sand mester i eksperimenterende pop og en af de mest originale stemmer i sin generation. Med rødder i Argentinas kulturliv og en livshistorie, der spænder fra eksil i Paris til international anerkendelse med fans som David Byrne, har Molina skabt et helt særligt musikalsk univers, hvor folk, elektronik og drømmende minimalisme flyder sammen. Til foråret drager hun på tour for første gang i otte år, og vi er beærede over at præsentere hende, når hun gæster ALICE med sit nye album “DOGA” (2025).
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛

NB: Koncerten er stående
SCROLL DOWN FOR ENGLISH
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
Juana Molina voksede op omgivet af musik som datter af tangosangeren Horacio Molina og skuespilleren Chunchuna Villafañe, og allerede som femårig begyndte hun at spille guitar. Efter familiens flugt fra militærdiktaturet i Argentina blev hun i Paris eksponeret for et væld af globale musikalske udtryk, der siden har præget hendes nysgerrige og grænseløse tilgang til lyd. Tilbage i Argentina blev hun i 90’erne et landskendt navn som komiker og tv-stjerne, før hun tog det modige skridt at forlade rampelyset for at hellige sig musikken fuldt ud. Siden debuten “Rara” (1996) har Molina konstant forfinet sin lyd, blandt andet gennem banebrydende brug af loops, effekter og elektronik. Samtidig har hun skabt sit helt eget syrede visuelle univers, som sammen med lyden udgør et udtryk, der umiskendeligt er hendes.
Albummene på Domino Records, herunder det anmelderroste “Tres Cosas”, sikrede Juana Molina international hæder, og hendes arbejde er blevet beundret af kunstnere som David Byrne og Will Oldham. Senere udgivelser som “Wed 21” og “Halo” cementerede hendes status som en kunstner i konstant bevægelse. I 2025 udkom “DOGA” – hendes første album med nyt materiale i otte år – et koncentreret og dybt personligt værk, der destillerer alt det, der kendetegner Juana Molinas musik: uventede melodier, organiske klange, drømmende vokaler, gentagelsen som æstetik og en følelse af stille forundring. Live forvandler hun gennem guitar og loop-pedaler disse elementer til en dragende, audiovisuel oplevelse, hvor lag på lag af lyd opstår i nuet. Glæd jer til en sjælden og fortryllende koncertoplevelse med uovertruffent musikalsk overskud, når den argentinske stjerne gæster ALICE.
Sagt om Juana Molina:
“Like Brian Wilson or Kevin Shields, she pulls off the most out-there material with melodies nearly as accessible as conventional pop” – Rolling Stone
“Dips deep into the unknown and brings back unexpected brilliance” – MOJO
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
In English:
Juana Molina is a true original in contemporary music – a master of experimental pop and one of the most distinctive voices of her generation. Rooted in Argentina’s cultural scene and shaped by a life that spans exile in Paris to international acclaim with admirers such as David Byrne, Molina has created a singular musical universe where folk, electronics and dreamlike minimalism flow together. This spring she goes on her first tour in eight years, and we are honoured to present her at ALICE with her new album “DOGA” (2025).
Juana Molina grew up surrounded by music as the daughter of tango singer Horacio Molina and actress Chunchuna Villafañe, and she began playing guitar at the age of five. After her family fled Argentina’s military dictatorship, she was exposed in Paris to a wide range of global musical expressions, which would later shape her curious and boundary-pushing approach to sound. Back in Argentina, she became a household name in the 1990s as a comedian and TV star before making the bold decision to step away from the spotlight and devote herself fully to music. Since her debut “Rara” (1996), Molina has continually refined her sound through pioneering use of loops, effects and electronics. Alongside this, she has developed a distinctly warped visual universe which, together with the music, forms an expression that is unmistakably her own.
Her albums on Domino Records, including the critically acclaimed “Tres Cosas”, earned Juana Molina international recognition, and her work has been admired by artists such as David Byrne and Will Oldham. Later releases like “Wed 21” and “Halo” cemented her status as an artist in constant motion. In 2025 she released “DOGA” – her first album of new material in eight years – a concentrated and deeply personal work that distils everything that defines Juana Molina’s music: unexpected melodies, organic sounds, dreamlike vocals, repetition as an aesthetic and a sense of quiet wonder. Live, through guitar and loop pedals, she transforms these elements into a captivating audiovisual experience where layers of sound emerge in real time. Look forward to a rare and enchanting concert experience when the Argentine star visits ALICE.
Said about Juana Molina:
“Like Brian Wilson or Kevin Shields, she pulls off the most out-there material with melodies nearly as accessible as conventional pop” – Rolling Stone
“Dips deep into the unknown and brings back unexpected brilliance” – MOJO

ABOUT THE WHEEL 
The Wheel is a new force on Copenhagen’s electronic scene: An innovative fusion of sound, community, and ambitious lighting design reimagining the rave experience. It offers dancers more than just a night out.

Music is at the heart of what we do, and we believe electronic music truly comes alive when sound, light, and energy from the dancers interact. Few artists embody the soul of Amsterdam's techno scene like Joris Voorn. A globally celebrated Dutch DJ and producer, Voorn stands at the forefront of electronic music, seamlessly blending high-quality techno with forward-thinking house music. With a career spanning decades, he remains a visionary artist known for his precision and artistry, both in the studio and behind the decks. 

Joris has built a reputation as one of the most reliable and influential figures in the scene, producing a vast number of iconic tracks and performances across the globe for more than 20 years. As a DJ, he is known for versatile sets that span the entire underground spectrum, always driven by rich synth work and intricate drum programming.

As Joris himself puts it: “When playing a live mix, it’s all about catching the moment, feeling the room and taking your audience to another level. The outcome is defined by so many elements like the crowd’s response, the sound in the room, the space you’re playing in”. 

On April 10th, expect a night of sonic exploration - celebrating both the future of electronic music and its timeless roots.
