events.title: PUNCH!
events.description:
We’re beyond excited to present you for Beboerhuset's two-day music festival, Punch! 6 acts based in Copenhagen representing the local experimental and noisy underground scene. This festival might be intimate in size, but it’s bursting with big personalities and even bigger sound, punching above it's weight. Expect the unexpected — an unconventional, experimental vibe driven by a bold ambition to reach across borders, blend genres, and move both shores and souls.

Line up 10/4: Tehran / abji_hypersun / DJ CUNT
Behind TEHRAN stands the unruly Irani–Swedish artist formerly known as Nadia Tehran — a figure who, over the past years, has slipped from the glamorous scene of the Scandinavian music industry and into the shadow-zones of Nordic mythmaking. TEHRAN has become less a name than a presence: a rumor, invoked, glimpsed in passing. What was once a straightforward follow-up to their groundbreaking 2019 debut DOZAKH: All lovers hell has, in the span of two years, transformed into something stranger — an artifact that disappeared before ever released.
In early 2024 TEHRAN announced the visual album HUSQVARNA, to be released on their own label, Inherited Void. The first single DELAM GEREFTEH dropped, but the album never arrived. Instead, it dissolved into speculation and ritual, becoming a kind of a tale — the lost tapes. Some speak of it echoing across the ocean waves from the ruins of the S/S Castor shipwreck in Sjællands Odde last summer, others recall a gloomy night in Den Grå Hal when TEHRAN performed in near darkness, as if summoning the album from another plane. Wherever these songs emerge, they take on the weight of apparition: fleeting, feral, intangible. HUSQVARNA — like the shortened moniker itself — channels the multitudes that they have always carried: raw grief, rage, serrated joy and the will to break through structures designed to contain. Amid dissonant nu-metal guitars, industrial atmospheres and programmed blast-beats, their voice shifts between Swedish, English and Farsi — screaming, growling and softening into melodic confession. The lyrics trace depression, addiction and loss, but from these depths rises an uncompromising insistence on transcendence. What survives from this vanished work is the essence of TEHRAN’s rebirth. And rumor has it, that there is a new chapter being written.
---
abji_hypersun is the moniker of Simin Stine Ramezanali (DK/IR/DE) – drummer, vocalist, and visual artist. They are known as a member of the experimental doom/art-rock trio SLIM0, electronic duo abolish i and operarolepay band spellchestra .Their sound is extracting and distorting cultural clichés, weaving together the operatic, the tragic, and the comical. abji's world moves fluidly between beauty and humor, the unsettling and the loud – inhabiting a space suspended between nightmare and dream.
---
DJ CUNT
Their DJ sets seem to be an endless non-binary melting pot of genres, with a deep passion for and solid roots in underground music. In their own compositions and collaborations, they create worlds that invite stories focused on unlimited chaos, love and pain.

Line up 11/4: Soap Horse / Music by Idiot / Mary Ane's Polar Rig
Soap Horse
The band Soap Horse is a unique amalgamation of country and experimental rock from the Copenhagen underground. With Hans Gustav Björklund Moulvad as singer, guitarist and songwriter, Soap Horse moves undisturbed between grandiose orchestral arrangements and minimalist country-flavored spaces. In an eclectic and intense universe, pedal steel, violins and saxophones swirl around lyrics that are at once surreal and sensitive. Soap Horse's music feels like a continuously expanding and collapsing pulse outside of time and place. Soap Horse is based between London and Copenhagen, where Hans Gustav has collaborated with John Parish (PJ Harvey, Aldous Harding) and Mikko Gordon (The Smile, IDLES). These collaborations have resulted in the debut EP 'Tooth Inside A Tooth' which was released in 2025.
Soap Horse opened as a solo artist for The Raveonettes on their US tour in 2024 and has since performed throughout Europe and the UK, including as support for Elias Rønnenfeldt, Baby In Van and Alan Sparhawk (Low). Soap Horse also debuted at Roskilde Festival in 2025, with a star-studded band from the Copenhagen alternative scene to a cavalcade of critical acclaim.
---
Music by Idiot (Anders Rex)
Under the name Music By Idiot, Anders Rex presents an intimate and stripped-down version of the band Music By Idiots. As a soloist, he reinterprets songs from the back catalogue, the debut album Tiden Lyver (2022) as well as brand new material from the upcoming album. It is music created in the present, carried by the realization: Yes everything is falling – and in the fall we live The shift to the Danish mother tongue has been an artistic revelation for Rex. By removing the linguistic filters, both voice and lyrics have blossomed into a deeply personal universe that moves in emotional overdrive. The songs revolve around desire, desperation and the longing to find a foothold in a world with “thin and holey skin” – a world where the fall is not the end, but the very lifeblood:
Yes everything is falling – and in the fall we kiss.
Yes everything is falling – and in the fall we love.
The solo concept is constantly evolving and has already taken Rex past everything from churches and galleries to established venues. Audiences can expect a musical space that is both contrapuntal and contradictory – a vocal experience that balances between the quiet, the bare and the dramatic.
---
Mary Anne’s Polar Rig (Duo)
Mary Annes Polar Rig...and the Sound of Speed is a cross projectional art piece displaying the world building created by the two main characters and creators:
Fast Malin Hofvander & Filthy Harald Ingvarsson.
This is a story told through both music and comics, with the two different formats representing different parts of a puzzle, complementing and enhancing the depths of each other's subliminal messaging. It’s a friend-adventure without end - an intergalactic space rock saga about fate, hope and love. A psychedelic journey exploring the vastness of space, hearts and souls through time, time and time again.
Following it is, as always and in true MAPR-fashion, a wild live show. A virtuose explosion of chaos cut up by rays of nostalgia, punchy songwriting and catchy one-liners.

Mary Anne’s Polar Rig take their name from a mining-station (now hotel) on the Arctic island of Svalbard, an identification that implies a little bit of toughness, an ability to take a few knocks and keep on rolling. You can certainly hear some of that in their sound – the guitar duo Malin Hofvander & Harald Ingvarsson serve up rough-and-tumble rock and roll that can handle anything the world has to throw at it.

After having recalibrated to a two-piece (joined by 2 more people for live concerts) Mary Anne’s Polar Rig signed with Stockholm label Rama Lama Records and swam into more experimental waters for the follow-up album 'Makes You Wonder' (March 2023). The sound was more complex, mature and heavy, with melodies and sharp refrains striking through in places like lightning bolts. Some songs skid and roll chaotically, like an out-of-control dirt bike, while others are carefully nursed and layered into something crashing and grand, like towering prog pyramids, taking Mary Anne’s Polar Rig's music onto a level beyond anything they’ve ever done before.

events.title: Close Encounters: Müller/Jonsrud (DK/CA) x Still Out (EE) x DC Social Club (US/SE)
events.description:
A night of electronic music and community vibes spanning the Baltic Sea.

We start with local live acts inviting us into the engine room, adjusting machine voltages to the dancefloor energy in real time. After midnight, Estonian dj collective Still Out take us on a journey through deep and progressive house.

Join us at H15 Studio for a night of togetherness with minimal distance between booth and floor.

// LIVE – your local machine elves

MÜLLER/JONSRUD (DK/CA) – Emerging out of a series of low-light, low-oxygen microparties, the duo challenge conventions of house and techno in improvised livesets. Come for glitchy polyrhythms and spaced-out synths over danceable beats, with a sprinkle of jazz fusion.

DC SOCIAL CLUB (US/SE/...) – An ever-evolving configuration of Copenhagen-based internationals with a simple goal: bring together good people and tweak knobs until everyone is locked in. From surgical techno to bouncy breaks and oddball vocals, anything goes.


// STILL OUT DJs – Estonian take-over, all night long

HURMET ILUS (EE) – The Still Out founder and long-time presence on Estonian Raadio 2 is known for his infectious energy behind the decks. Hurmet moves effortlessly between deep house and driving techno in a seamless crossover that is as impactful as it is sophisticated.

UKU LEGAL (EE) – Drawing on roots in psy trance and progressive house, Uku Legal brings a focused energy to the floor, always exploring depth and meaning within the music. You may find yourself part of a deep house-guided communal meditation.

ANNEMAI (EE) – A rising, radiant star on the Still Out sky whose energetic and technically impeccable house sets bring harmony to any floor, with dancers in shared, fluid motion. Comfortably blending underground and mainstream vibes, Annemai is a breath of fresh air on the scene.

// LOCATION
H15 Studio, Halmtorvet 15, Copenhagen

// TIMETABLE

00.00: Uku Legal b2b Annemai

Friday, April 10th, 2200! lands at Sigurd CPH with a line-up built on depth, experience, and a strong feel for the dance floor. 2200! is a party where people from many different backgrounds meet in one place. The Nørrebro borough is known for its young crowd and strong cultural mix, and 2200! is about bringing that feeling indoors and giving it a dance floor.

· Pato Siebenhaar
Pato Siebenhaar is one of the enduring names of Copenhagen nightlife, with decades of work across DJing, production, live performance, and scene building. His background in hip-hop, reggae, and club culture gives his sets both weight and personality, and he knows exactly how to lift a room without forcing it. There is experience in every transition, and a clear sense of timing behind everything he plays.

· Defsounds
Defsounds brings a global perspective to the booth, building sets around funky basslines, disco rhythms, and a deep love for high-energy club music. Her sound moves through dancehall, reggaeton, afrobeats, baile funk, and melodic techno while staying focused on what makes people move together. With Anatolian roots and a strong rhythmic instinct, she creates a dance floor that feels vibrant, connected, and fully alive.

Keep our policy in mind when you step onto the floor: no requests, OK?! Trust the selectors, follow the energy, and let the night unfold on its own terms.

Soap Horse's music feels like a continuously expanding and collapsing pulse outside of time and place. Soap Horse is based between London and Copenhagen, where Hans Gustav has collaborated with John Parish (PJ Harvey, Aldous Harding) and Mikko Gordon (The Smile, IDLES). These collaborations have resulted in the debut EP 'Tooth Inside A Tooth' which was released in 2025.
Soap Horse opened as a solo artist for The Raveonettes on their US tour in 2024 and has since performed throughout Europe and the UK, including as support for Elias Rønnenfeldt, Baby In Van and Alan Sparhawk (Low). Soap Horse also debuted at Roskilde Festival in 2025, with a star-studded band from the Copenhagen alternative scene to a cavalcade of critical acclaim.
---
Music by Idiot (Anders Rex)
Under the name Music By Idiot, Anders Rex presents an intimate and stripped-down version of the band Music By Idiots. As a soloist, he reinterprets songs from the back catalogue, the debut album Tiden Lyver (2022) as well as brand new material from the upcoming album. It is music created in the present, carried by the realization: Yes everything is falling – and in the fall we live The shift to the Danish mother tongue has been an artistic revelation for Rex. By removing the linguistic filters, both voice and lyrics have blossomed into a deeply personal universe that moves in emotional overdrive. The songs revolve around desire, desperation and the longing to find a foothold in a world with “thin and holey skin” – a world where the fall is not the end, but the very lifeblood:
Yes everything is falling – and in the fall we kiss.
Yes everything is falling – and in the fall we love.
The solo concept is constantly evolving and has already taken Rex past everything from churches and galleries to established venues. Audiences can expect a musical space that is both contrapuntal and contradictory – a vocal experience that balances between the quiet, the bare and the dramatic.
---
Mary Anne’s Polar Rig (Duo)
Mary Annes Polar Rig...and the Sound of Speed is a cross projectional art piece displaying the world building created by the two main characters and creators:
Fast Malin Hofvander & Filthy Harald Ingvarsson.
This is a story told through both music and comics, with the two different formats representing different parts of a puzzle, complementing and enhancing the depths of each other's subliminal messaging. It’s a friend-adventure without end - an intergalactic space rock saga about fate, hope and love. A psychedelic journey exploring the vastness of space, hearts and souls through time, time and time again.
Following it is, as always and in true MAPR-fashion, a wild live show. A virtuose explosion of chaos cut up by rays of nostalgia, punchy songwriting and catchy one-liners.

Mary Anne’s Polar Rig take their name from a mining-station (now hotel) on the Arctic island of Svalbard, an identification that implies a little bit of toughness, an ability to take a few knocks and keep on rolling. You can certainly hear some of that in their sound – the guitar duo Malin Hofvander & Harald Ingvarsson serve up rough-and-tumble rock and roll that can handle anything the world has to throw at it.

After having recalibrated to a two-piece (joined by 2 more people for live concerts) Mary Anne’s Polar Rig signed with Stockholm label Rama Lama Records and swam into more experimental waters for the follow-up album 'Makes You Wonder' (March 2023). The sound was more complex, mature and heavy, with melodies and sharp refrains striking through in places like lightning bolts. Some songs skid and roll chaotically, like an out-of-control dirt bike, while others are carefully nursed and layered into something crashing and grand, like towering prog pyramids, taking Mary Anne’s Polar Rig's music onto a level beyond anything they’ve ever done before.

☆ PHASE FATALE
Phase Fatale is the Berlin-based techno project of Hayden Payne, with residencies at Berghain and Khidi.
Emerging as Phase Fatale in 2014, Berlin-based DJ, producer and label owner, Hayden Payne is rewriting the discourse of Techno with his cross-pollination of gnarly basslines, sensual narratives and mind-control mechanics. Demonstrating his vision through an authentic, highly curated sonic-lens of techno, Payne’s rhythmic excursions draw on both his roots in the New York and Berlin underground as well as his reputable experience performing to dancefloors globally. Exemplified by long-standing tenures as a resident for esteemed institutions such as Berlin’s Berghain as well as KHIDI in Georgia's capital Tbilisi, Payne demonstrates a resolute understanding of harnessing club synergy across his productions and DJ sets.

Hailing from post-punk roots, Payne draws on his depth of musical knowledge and multitude of influences. His merging of nuanced references and high concept narratives remain geared towards the dancefloor at its core, subtleties of his multifarious sonic palette act as the foundations for his layered wall of sound.

☆ ELLIOTT TAGUCHI
Copenhagen-based DJ and co-founder of the collective Postyr, Elliott Taguchi is known for his percussive, groove-driven approach and an instinctive ability to shape the floor. Rooted in rhythm and movement, his selections balance raw physical energy with moments of subtle depth and surprise.
Raised in a family of ravers and shaped by Copenhagen’s urban soundscape, Elliott’s sets reflect a deep connection to dance floor culture, drawing equally from driving techno, textured atmospheres, and unexpected references that catch the listener off guard. His sound is direct yet layered, always attentive to flow, timing, and collective energy.

☆ HULTGREN
With a deep understanding of how to shape mood and atmosphere, the approach to DJing emphasizes subtle guidance rather than forceful transitions—creating immersive journeys through various realms of electronic music. Track selections are curated with intention, crafting vibrant dance floors through a blend of genres that bridge techno, electro, breaks, and trance. The sound leans into contemporary aesthetics while remaining rooted in the legacy of rave culture.

☆ DRAHO
DRAHO delivers hypnotic, loop-driven techno shaped by rolling pressure and tightly controlled transitions. Long-form immersion built for the floor. His sets unfold through sustained tension and gradual evolution rather than dramatic peaks. Repetition becomes propulsion. Structure becomes physical. A steady current of pressure designed to lock the floor into movement.

Originally from Struer in the norther part of Jutland, Signe Alarcón has since moved to Copenhagen and infiltrated the electronic underground with her charismatic sets in which she mixes sexy psy-grooves with elements of bass-heavy techno.

One of techno’s most commanding voices behind the decks is returning to Copenhagen! Prepare for an intense journey into the raw, hypnotic, industrial edges of modern techno when Klangkuenstler takes the reins at Poolen on Saturday, April 11.

ABOUT THE WHEEL 
The Wheel is a new force on Copenhagen’s electronic scene: An innovative fusion of sound, community, and ambitious lighting design reimagining the rave experience. It offers dancers more than just a night out.

Music is at the heart of what we do, and we believe electronic music truly comes alive when sound, light, and energy from the dancers interact. When skilled DJs, high-fidelity sound, and bold, innovative lighting meet, they create a visual and sonic world that gives dancers no choice but to lose themselves completely in the moment.

KLANGKUENSTLER
German DJ and producer Klangkuenstler has become one of the defining voices in the contemporary techno scene, revered for a relentless sound that fuses industrial intensity with both old-school and new-school sounds
 
Originally from Bavaria, Klangkuenstler’s passion for electronic music took him from his early days experimenting with deep and tech house into Berlin’s thriving underground, where he fully embraced a harder, uncompromising techno aesthetic that has come to define his sets and productions. 

Klangkuenstler’s sets are known for their high energy, pounding rhythms, and unwavering drive that takes dancers through hypnotic rises, industrial grooves, and peak-time techno power that demands full immersion. 

We’re beyond excited to have Klangkuenstler back in Copenhagen on April 11. We know his set is gonna push the sound and space at Poolen to its limits!

PEACHLYFE
Opening the night is the playful provocateur, Peachlyfe. Blending psychoactive techno, swampy psy-trance, and alien acid, their DJ sets intentionally induce a state of sonic mindfuck, while their holistic live performances aim for transcendence. Peachlyfe’s music is fast-paced and high-energy; their sonic nectar is always freshly squeezed.

MILO MAKUA
Taking over from Peachlyfe is Milo Makua: Hypnotic, heads-down, and subtly unhinged. She navigates the deeper ends of techno through entrancing rhythmic play and textured atmospheres that pull you inward before pushing you forward.
Her sets glide between wormhole minimalism and driving 4x4 pressure, tension coiling steadily across Poolen. Playful yet precise, she shapes the floor in preparation for the expert of schranz and hard techno.

HVOB have been conquering the universe of electronic music for years. They have not only  established themselves in the international music scene through their releases, but also as a  live act. The two musicians behind HVOB are Anna Müller and Paul Wallner. Together they  compose and produce the music and are therefore jointly responsible for the unique sound of HVOB. 

They play sold-out tours in North, Central and South America, Asia, Europe and South Africa and have played many of the world's renowned festivals – from a headlining show at Sonar Barcelona and Clockenflap in Hong Kong to Burning Man, Primavera and Fuji Rock in Japan. They have also recorded a BBC Essential Mix, several Boiler Rooms and a Cercle set in Mexico. 

After five studio albums and one live album, the international electronic duo HVOB is expanding the spectrum of its means of expression with a new artistic cycle: THE SILVER CAGE. Central to this phase is a light show created and programmed by HVOB themselves – a visual counterpart to their music that forms an immersive live experience. 

Following the singles "What They Gave Me" and "Void", HVOB now release "Abyss", the third  track within this ongoing cycle. events.title: DJ Travella (TZ)
events.description:
Med en legesyg, sprængfarlig og futuristisk tilgang til singeli har DJ Travella på rekordtid markeret sig som en af de mest spændende stemmer på den globale elektroniske scene. Den unge producer fra Dar es Salaam puster nyt liv i den tanzanianske high-BPM-genre fra 00’erne med glitchy rytmer, cybernetiske melodier og en energi, der føles både kaotisk og kontrolleret på samme tid. Om lidt performer DJ Travella på de største scener, så skynd dig ned på ALICE, når den unge rave-profet spiller til april.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
Køb billet i forsalg: 200 dkk eksl. gebyr / Ung under 25 (eller studerende): 170 dkk eksl. gebyr
Billetter: https://alicecph.com/event/dj-travella-tz/
Lyt: https://youtu.be/cC3SC28AAM8?si=l49T8cFb7OyODr6m
NB: Koncerten er stående
SCROLL DOWN FOR ENGLISH
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
DJ Travella doesn’t just perform – he launches you into a new dimension!
DJ Travella aka Hamadi Hassani begyndte at lave musik som teenager og har siden været med til at skubbe singeli fra lokale gadefester i Dar es Salaam ud på internationale klub- og festivalscener. Hans gennembrud kom med det hæsblæsende track “Crazy Beat Music Umeme 2”, som hurtigt blev et undergrundshit og vakte opmærksomhed hos stjerner som Arca og Björk. Med debutalbummet “Mr Mixondo” på det toneangivende Nyege Nyege Tapes cementerede den kun 24-årige DJ Travella sin position som frontfigur for en ny, radikal bølge i elektronisk musik.
Live er DJ Travella en oplevelse i sig selv. Bevæbnet med sit karakteristiske Bluetooth-keyboard fremstår han som en slags rave-profet, der kanaliserer Dar es Salaams pulserende gadeliv direkte ud på dansegulvet. Hans sets er intense, uforudsigelige og euforiske – en sonisk overbelastning, hvor warped beats, forvrængede baslinjer og abstrakte lydfragmenter smelter sammen. I de seneste år har han sat sit præg på platforme som BBC Radio 6 Music og Resident Advisor og fortsætter med at udvide singeli-universet med nye udgivelser, senest i 2025, hvor genren foldes ud i endnu mere eksperimenterende retninger. DJ Travella spiller ikke bare musik – han åbner en portal til fremtidens rave. Oplev det selv, når han giver koncert på ALICE i april.
Sagt om DJ Travella:
“DJ Travella’s hyperactive Singeli is the sound of a digital future spiraling out of control – in the best possible way.” – Resident Advisor
“A genius-level producer channeling chaos into beauty at 180 BPM.” – The Guardian
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
In English:
With a playful, explosive and forward-thinking approach to singeli, DJ Travella has in record time established himself as one of the most exciting voices on the global electronic music scene. The young producer from Dar es Salaam breathes new life into the Tanzanian high-BPM genre of the 2000s with glitchy rhythms, cybernetic melodies and an energy that feels both chaotic and tightly controlled at the same time. Before long, DJ Travella will be performing on the world’s biggest stages – so make sure to catch the young rave prophet at ALICE this April.
DJ Travella doesn’t just perform – he launches you into a new dimension!
DJ Travella, aka Hamadi Hassani, began making music as a teenager and has since helped push singeli from local street parties in Dar es Salaam onto international club and festival stages. His breakthrough came with the breathless track “Crazy Beat Music Umeme 2”, which quickly became an underground hit and caught the attention of artists such as Arca and Björk. With his debut album Mr Mixondo on the influential label Nyege Nyege Tapes, he cemented his position as a leading figure in a new, radical wave of electronic music.
Live, DJ Travella is an experience unto himself. Armed with his signature Bluetooth keyboard, he appears as a kind of rave prophet, channeling the pulsing street life of Dar es Salaam straight onto the dancefloor. His sets are intense, unpredictable and euphoric – a sonic overload where warped beats, blown-out basslines and abstract sound fragments melt together. In recent years, he has left his mark on platforms such as BBC Radio 6 Music and Resident Advisor, and he continues to expand the singeli universe with new releases, most recently in 2025, where the genre is unfolded in even more experimental directions. DJ Travella doesn’t just play music – he opens a portal to the rave of the future. Experience it yourself when he performs at ALICE in April.
What they say about DJ Travella:
“DJ Travella’s hyperactive Singeli is the sound of a digital future spiraling out of control – in the best possible way.” – Resident Advisor
“A genius-level producer channeling chaos into beauty at 180 BPM.” – The Guardian

Crack Cloud has become notorious for their electrifying live shows and uncompromising break with traditional musical dogmas, where raw punk energy meets vibrant orchestral elements and a sense of playful instrumental experimentation. This spring, the Canadian alternative collective takes over ALICE with a new album.
Crack Cloud is a music collective unafraid to push back against traditional dogmas. With founder, vocalist, and drummer Zach Choy at the helm, the group has, through their first two acclaimed releases Pain Olympics (2019) and Tough Baby (2022), carved out a radical sonic universe where punk’s tight rhythms, staccato-cut guitars, and political edge merge with the playful eccentricity and instrumental curiosity reminiscent of Talking Heads. On their vital album Red Mile (2024), the collective pushes even further into the borderlands between genre, tonality, and experimentation. Here, raw punk energy is amplified by vibrant orchestral elements, sweeping string sections, and dramatic buildups. Red Mile received high praise from outlets like The Guardian and The Alternative, which both described the album as phenomenal. Since their debut, Crack Cloud has made a powerful impact on stages worldwide — including Mayhem, Hotel Cecil, and Roskilde Festival, where they delivered one of the standout concerts of 2019.
The Canadian alternative group was originally formed as a rehabilitation project in Vancouver, where members lived together in a large music and media collective. Crack Cloud consists of more than 20 members, whose shifting lineups have contributed to the band’s reputation for intensely charged live performances. When Crack Cloud hits ALICE with their new album, the lineup will include Zach Choy, Aleem Khan, Bryce Cloghesy, Will Choy, Danish artist Emma Acs, Eve Adams, and Nathaniel Philips.
We can’t wait for April!

events.title: Omar Souleyman - VEGA
events.description:
Elektrificerende kædedans med synth-magikeren Omar Souleyman i VEGA
___________________________________________________________________
Døre: 19.00
Koncertstart: 20.00
Billetpris: 340 kr. inkl. gebyr
___________________________________________________________________
I en perfekt eliksir af dabke, dybe, pulserende elektroniske beats og forførende synthesizer tør syriske Omar Souleyman resterne af frost fra publikums vinterhjerter. Foråret er her til lyden af smittende, dansabel techno.
Souleyman udsendte sidste år hans seneste album, Erbil, der med sine tempofyldte og hypnotisk klingende sange tager livtag med lytteren og inducerer dansefeber i selv den mest generte skikkelse.
Flere medier anmeldte udgivelsen, og særligt mediet Resident Advisor fremhævede, hvordan Erbil er et album, der med Souleymans velkendte takter sætter danseglæden i centrum.
“On Erbil, he continues to do what he's always done best: getting the party started and whipping the crowd into a frenzy.”
Symptomatisk for Souleymans musikalske univers – både på Erbil, men også tidligere udgivelser som debuten Wenu Wenu fra 2013 er – at sangene er i tæt dialog med mellemøstlige tonale-skaler og et nærvær og en musikalsk nerve så stor, at Souleyman gennem tiden har fanget opmærksomhed fra navne som Four Tet, Modeselektor og Diplo.
Wenu Wenu blev produceret af førnævnte Four Tet og i 2017 skrev Souleyman kontrakt med Diplos pladeselskab og udgav albummet, To Syria, With Love, samme år.
Omar Souleymans særegne lyd har bragt ham vidt og bredt rundt i verden. Han har spillet festivaler som Roskilde Festival, Bonnaroo og Glastonbury. I 2024 slog han vejen forbi VEGA, og den 17. april kalder han igen Store VEGA til endnu en runde elektrificerende kædedans.

events.description:
Med det radikale og sonisk grænsebrydende audiovisuelle værk “Kitbashing” kritiserer og dissekerer den egyptiske elektroniske producer ABADIR og den italienske billedkunstner Nicoló Cervello det digitale feed og de allestedsnærværende algoritmer, der former vores blik og begær. Til april præsenterer de værket live på ALICE, og publikum kan forvente et frygtløst og sansemættet bombardement af fragmenterede cuts, digitale lydkollager og svimlende visuals.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛

⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
Vi bruger timevis på at scrolle, dele og fodre sociale medier med vores data. Platformene kan være underholdende og oplysende – men også drænende, mørke og fremmedgørende. Jo mere vi scroller, desto mere kurateres vores virkelighed. Med “Kitbashing” forsøger ABADIR og Nicoló Cervello at bryde algoritmens greb. Lydklip fra reels, suggested posts og sponsorerede annoncer klippes og mikroredigeres til dristige, abstrakte kompositioner, der konstant bevæger sig mod nye soniske klimakser. Rytmerne udvider og sammentrækker sig som et digitalt åndedrag og spejler tempoet i den endeløse doomscrolling – lige så dragende og lige så foruroligende.
ABADIR er en egyptisk musikproducer, lyddesigner, DJ og musikkritiker, født i Cairo og bosat i Berlin. Han arbejder i krydsfeltet mellem det filmiske, det kluborienterede og det ambiente og hans praksis kredser ofte om fiktion, erindring og kulturelle artefakter. ABADIR har optrådt på festivaler som Roskilde, CTM, Rewire, Primavera Sound og Unsound og han er en del af det toneangivende label SVBKVLT. Nicoló Cervello arbejder med 3D-grafik, motion design og interaktionsdesign og undersøger spændingsfeltet mellem realisme og replika. Sammen skaber de et værk, der ikke blot kommenterer på den digitale samtid, men kropsliggør den. Kom og oplev det selv, når de opfører “Kitbashing” på ALICE til april.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
In English:
With the radical and sonically boundary-pushing audiovisual work Kitbashing, Egyptian electronic producer ABADIR and Italian visual artist Nicoló Cervello critique and dissect the digital feed and the omnipresent algorithms that shape our gaze and desires. This April, they present the work live at ALICE, where audiences can expect a fearless, sensory-saturated bombardment of fragmented cuts, digital sound collages, and dizzying visuals.
We spend hours scrolling, sharing, and feeding social media platforms with our data. These platforms can be entertaining and informative—but also draining, dark, and alienating. The more we scroll, the more our reality is curated. With Kitbashing, ABADIR and Nicoló Cervello attempt to break the algorithm’s grip. Audio snippets from reels, suggested posts, and sponsored ads are cut and micro-edited into bold, abstract compositions that constantly build toward new sonic climaxes. Rhythms expand and contract like a digital breath, mirroring the tempo of endless doomscrolling—equally seductive and unsettling.
ABADIR is an Egyptian music producer, sound designer, DJ, and critic, born in Cairo and based in Berlin. His work moves between the cinematic, the club-oriented, and the ambient, often revolving around fiction, memory, and cultural artefacts. He has performed at festivals such as Roskilde, CTM, Rewire, Primavera Sound, and Unsound, and is part of the influential SVBKVLT label roster. Nicoló Cervello works with 3D graphics, motion design, and interaction design, exploring the tension between realism and replica. Together, they create a work that not only comments on the digital condition—but embodies it. Experience Kitbashing live at ALICE this April.

events.title: Ross From Friends (DJ set), NAT, DRABER666
events.description:
Ross From Friends, AKA British producer Felix Clary Weatherall, is an esteemed electronic artist and the owner of the Scarlet Tiger label. His approach focuses on continuing to build his craftsmanship and enabling emotive storytelling through his releases. Since his breakout success on Distant Hawaii in 2016, he has forged a notable career for himself, encompassing two albums released via the revered label Brainfeeder. 

A cornerstone of Ross From Friends’ music has always been the blistering 3-man live show—comprising Felix, Jed Hampson & John Dunk—that delivers a killer blend of live musicianship (guitar, keys and sax) and electronics and has graced stages at the likes of Coachella, Glastonbury, Primavera and Sonar to name a few. The trio have had multiple sold-out dates across tours throughout the UK, EU, Australia and North America, including festival performances at Glastonbury, Laneway AU & NZ, AVA, Portola and Parklife. 

2024 see’s the introduction of his new moniker Bubble Love, under which he plans to release more club focussed tracks. In an attempt to separate the developing sound of “Ross From Friends” from the frenetic dancefloor tracks he simply enjoys making, he felt like now was the time to make the distinction. “I came up with an experiment one day when I was making music on the train.” - he explains. “I told myself, let me try making a tune as if there was a digital character instructed to carry out the very first idea that came into my head.” This epiphany and experimentation birthed not only a fresh way to approach writing music, but the beginnings of a character which he plans to develop into his artistic project.

events.title: Purelink
events.description:
Synk ned i flydende beats og sfæriske lydlandskaber med Purelink
Døre: 19.00
Koncertstart: 20.00
Billetpris: 205kr. inkl. gebyr.
Den Chicago-fødte, og nu New York-baserede trio
Purelink, har på et halvt årti sat sit aftryk som et af de mest spændende navne i den eksperimenterende elektroniske undergrund.
Med et udtryk, der bevæger sig mellem sfæriske ambient lyde, techno, sprøde 90’er referencer og varm, organisk improvisation, skaber Purelink en lyd, som er drømmende, men også dybt forankret i klubbens pulserende energi.
På deres nye album, Faith, åbner gruppen, bestående af Tommy Paslaski, Ben Paulson og Akeem Asani, nu døren til et mere levende og taktilt univers.
De elektroniske teksturer flettes sammen med guitarstrøg, bastoner og gæstevokaler, der tilfører musikken en ny, menneskelig porøsitet. Resultatet er en samling af numre, der både pulserer, fordamper og folder sig ud i bare ét åndedrag.
Purelink formår at skabe musik, der føles som et sted lige mellem byens natlige klubgulv og en tåget vandkant ved solopgang. Det er reflekteret, men på intet tidspunkt nostalgisk - og altid med en intuitiv fornemmelse for rytme og tekstur.
Glæd dig til en aften i Ideal Bar, hvor Purelink inviterer publikum helt tæt på deres flydende, forførende univers med en koncert, der både løfter, fordyber og vibrerer længe efter sidste tone

events.title: Maria Arnal @ ALICE
events.description:
Den prisvindende, spanske komponist, sanger og eksperimenterende kunstner Maria Arnal laver musik i krydsfeltet mellem menneske og maskine – med hjælp fra et kor af AI-genererede stemmer, et transportabelt organ og sin overjordisk smukke sangstemme.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
Køb billet i forsalg: 200 dkk eksl. gebyr / ungebillet: 180 ung dkk eksl. gebyr
Køb billet: https://alicecph.com/event/maria-arnal-es/
NB: Koncerten er stående
SCROLL DOWN FOR ENGLISH
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
En melodi fra middelalderen, et beat du kan danse til og et skvæt kunstig intelligens. Det er tre ingredienser i spanske Maria Arnals musikalske univers. Til april gæster hun ALICE med AMA – titlen på hendes seneste album og en performance, hvor Maria Arnal undersøger stemmens suverænitet i en AI-tid, såvel som intimitet og femininitet. Og leverer fængslende elektropopmelodier, der trækker på musikalske traditioner samtidigt med, at de ikke havde været mulige at skabe uden moderne teknologi. De lyder som om de kommer fra et gammelt kloster – og fra en computer – på én og samme tid.
Maria Arnal har modtaget adskillige priser, og optrådt på alt fra Sónar Festival i Barcelona, et TED Talk-event i Vancouver og Romaeuropa Festival i Rom. Som komponist har hun blandt andet skabt et lydværk til arkitekturbiennalen i Venedig, ‘AIR’ og et generativt korværk, der interagerer med Barcelonas big data i realtid, ‘SIRENA’. Dette var et samarbejde med produceren John Talabot og og skabt til Torré Glòries, der er et udsigtstårn i Barcelona. Maria Arnal udforsker de steder, hvor lyd, teknologi og kunst smelter sammen. Derfor optræder hun ofte med både et kor af AI-genererede stemmer og et transportabelt orgel, som hun kan kontrollere via sin computer. Tag med på ALICE til april, og vær med til at opleve menneske og maskine smelte sammen i Maria Arnals polyfoniske eksperimentel pop.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
In English:
The award-winning Spanish composer, singer, and experimental artist Maria Arnal creates music in the intersection between human and machine – with the help of a choir of AI-generated voices, a portable organ, and her otherworldly beautiful singing voice.
A melody from the Middle Ages, a beat you can dance to, and a splash of artificial intelligence – these are the three ingredients in Maria Arnal’s musical universe. In April, she visits ALICE with ‘AMA’, which is the title of her latest album and a performance in which Maria Arnal explores the sovereignty of the voice in an age of AI, as well as intimacy and femininity. The result is captivating electropop melodies that draw on musical traditions while simultaneously being impossible to create without modern technology. They sound as if they were coming out of an old monastery – as well as a computer.
Maria Arnal has received numerous awards and has performed everywhere from Sónar Festival in Barcelona and a TED Talk event in Vancouver to the Romaeuropa Festival in Rome. As a composer, she has also created a sound work for the Venice Architecture Biennale, ‘AIR’, and a generative choral piece that interacts with Barcelona’s big data in real time, ‘SIRENA’. This project was a collaboration with producer John Talabot and was created for Torre Glòries, an observation tower in Barcelona. Maria Arnal explores the spaces where sound, technology, and art merge. She often performs with both a choir of AI-generated voices and a portable organ she controls from her computer. Join us at ALICEthis April and experience human and machine blending together in Maria Arnal’s polyphonic experimental pop!

events.title: DJ Haram (US) // Loppen
events.description:
Producer, multidisciplinær propagandist og selvudnævnt anti-format DJ, DJ Haram, kommer til Loppen den 22. april! Med det anmelderroste album ‘Beside Myself’ i bagagen står den på bass- og klubmusik, noise, rap og et strejf af mellemøstlige instrumenter og samples i et vredt, rebelsk og fandenivolsk lydunivers!
▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄
Entré: 160 kr. (inkl. gebyr)
Forsalg: https://bit.ly/40NvKgA
Døre: 21.00 // Koncertstart: 22.00
https://loppen.dk/kalender/dj-haram
▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄
DJ Haram er en elektronisk musikproducer, multidisciplinær propagandist og selvudnævnt anti-format DJ, oprindeligt fra New Jersey og i øjeblikket bosiddende i Brooklyn, New York. Stilistisk alsidig er Haram kendt for sin eklektiske produktion og DJ-stil – eksperimenterende bass- og clubmusik; analoge synthesizere og percussion; abrasive, noise-beslægtede rap-samarbejder; samt inkorporering af mellemøstlige instrumenter og samples.
Hun udgør også halvdelen af 700 Bliss, et hiphop/noise-projekt sammen med Moor Mother; duoen udgav det kritikerroste album ‘Nothing to Declare’ i 2022. DJ Haram driver i øjeblikket det månedlige arrangement “Monday Night Raw” hos Brooklyn-institutionen The Lot Radio, hvor hun kuraterer open-format DJ b2b-sets samt live rap- og eksperimentelle performances. Tidligere havde hun et femårigt residency på Rinse FM i London med programmet “Rage Radio.” Hun har også udgivet en række samarbejder og remixes, blandt andet med Billy Woods, Armand Hammer feat. Pink Siifu, Ghias Guevara, Debby Friday og Fever Ray.
Haram begyndte at bruge sin egen stemme i produktionerne på ‘Nothing to Declare’, men på EP’en, ‘Handplay’, viser hende i en ny, mere intim form, hvor hun deler sider af sig selv som “elsker, datter og kammerat.”
Hendes seneste album ‘Beside Myself’ udkom på Hyperdub i juli 2025. Her står hendes stemme i centrum, mens hun samarbejder med venner — rappere, co-producere og solo-instrumentalister — for at sætte ord og lyd på det, hun kalder “åndens overlevelse.” Pladen har modtaget stor ros internationalt og endte endda på Pitchforks liste over 2025’s bedste elektroniske udgivelser med ordene: “Beside Myself is dramatic and daring, the agreeably messy sound of the kind of radical freedom that might not change our sinking world but can liberate the willing mind.”
Internationalt har hun spillet på markante scener som Dekmantel, Unsound, Roskilde, Le Guess Who?, Pitchfork Festival, Tashweesh og Bonnaroo og har turneret fra Tokyo til Istanbul. Derudover har DJ Haram udgivet fire solo-EP’er, herunder ‘Grace’ (Hyperdub, 2019) samt de selvudgivne ‘Mixed Berries’ (2019) og ‘Era’ (2021). Vi glæder os til en oprørsk og antikonform aften med DJ Haram på scenen den 22. april!

events.title: FELT presents: Milan W. (BE) + Support: Jonas Torstensen
events.description:
Den flamske musiker Milan W. bevæger sig frit mellem elektronisk minimalisme, synthpop og skæve popreferencer. Oplev en kunstner, der forener intimitet og ekspansion i et lydunivers, hvor guitarer, saxofon og croonende vokal smelter sammen i et personligt og grænsesøgende udtryk.
●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○
Venue: Musikcaféen, 3. etage
Døre: 19:00
Show: 20:00
Entré: 100kr.
●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○
I de brostensbelagte gader i Antwerpen, hvor skyggerne leger og vinden suser gennem gamle mure, er Milan W. (alias Milan Warmoeskerken) blevet en hjørnesten i den flamske eksperimentelle scene. Hvad enten det er som medlem af semi-kultbands som Flying Horseman og Condor Gruppe, som elektronisk komponist på de nu hedengangne pladeselskaber Ekster og JJ Funhouse, som synthpop-musiker med Mittland och Leo eller som legesyge Schlager-musiker med Gerard Herman.
Under navnet Milan W. skaber han musik, der er intim, men samtidig ekspansiv. Hans seneste værk er traditionelt elektronisk orienteret og snor sig gennem guitarer, saxofoner og hjerteskærende crooning. Milan W. er et vidnesbyrd om en kunstner, der uophørligt vover sig ud over horisonten og skubber til de musikalske grænser med et blink, et nik og det ukendtes stille latter.
Support: Jonas Torstensen:
Jonas Torstensen er en københavnsk kunstner, der arbejder med båndmusik og driver pladeselskabet Afvikling. Han er lejlighedsvis radiovært, en stjerne i gør-det-selv-kassettemiljøet og en allround-legende. Til dette arrangement vil han spille bånd og måske også nogle andre små instrumenter.
------------------------------------------------
ENG.
Flemish artist Milan W. moves effortlessly between electronic minimalism, synth pop and off-kilter pop sensibilities. Experience a performance where intimacy meets expansiveness, and guitars, saxophone and aching croon merge into a deeply personal, boundary-pushing soundscape.
In the cobbled streets of Antwerp, where shadows play and the wind whistles through ancient walls, Milan W. (aka Milan Warmoeskerken) has become a cornerstone of the Flemish experimental scene. Whether as a member of semi-cult bands like Flying Horseman and Condor Gruppe, as an electronic composer on the late Ekster and JJ Funhouse labels, making synthpop with Mittland och Leo, and wading through playful Schlager with Gerard Herman.
Under the Milan W. moniker, he crafts music that is intimate yet expansive. Traditionally electronic-oriented, his latest work meanders through guitars, saxophones, and heartbroken crooning. Milan W. is a testament to an artist who ceaselessly ventures beyond the horizon, pushing musical boundaries with a wink, a nod, and the quiet laughter of the uncharted.
Support: Jonas Torstensen
Jonas Torstensen is a Copenhagen-based artist working with tape music and running the Afvikling label. Occasional radio host, stalwart of the DIY cassette community, and all-round legend. For this event he will play tapes and maybe some other small instruments as well.

events.description:
Vi er stolte af at kunne præsentere den skotske avantgardepioner Maggie Nicols, når hun giver en sjælden solokoncert på ALICE i april. Med stemme og klaver – og med plads til både improvisation, tapdance og uforudsigelige øjeblikke – inviterer Nicols os ind i sit helt særlige, ekspressive univers. For fans af ikoner som Spacy Lady og Meredith Monk er dette en kæmpe anbefaling. Saltmother åbner aftenen for Maggie Nicols med eklektiske musikalske greb og vokale eksperimenter.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
Døre kl 19:00 / Show kl 20:00

Køb billet: https://alicecph.com/event/maggie-nicols-sct-saltmother-dk/
Lyt: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XkY1GIdGP9E
NB: Koncerten er stående
SCROLL DOWN FOR ENGLISH
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
Maggie Nicols blev født i Edinburgh i 1948 og har i årtier været en central skikkelse på den europæiske improvisationsscene. Hun droppede ud af skolen som 15-årig og begyndte som danser, bevægede sig ind i jazzen og blev i 1968 en del af Londons legendariske Spontaneous Music Ensemble. Siden har hun sat et uudsletteligt aftryk på den fuldstændigt frie, non-idiomatiske improvisation med sin legende, politiske og dybt personlige tilgang til musik. I 1970’erne grundlagde Nicols således både vokalgruppen Voice og det feministiske performancekollektiv Feminist Improvising Group, og hun har gennem hele sit virke insisteret på musikkens frihed – som kunstnerisk praksis og som aktivistisk handling. Hendes koncerter balancerer det sårbare og det kraftfulde, det humoristiske og det dybt bevægende. Altid med kroppen og stemmen som bærende redskaber.
Når Maggie Nicols giver koncert på ALICE tager aftenens repertoire primært afsæt i hendes to anmelderroste soloalbumudgivelser på Café OTO’s OTOROKU-label, hvor sangformatet foldes ud i al sin elastiske og eksperimenterende skønhed. Her møder vi Nicols i koncentreret form: spontan, fysisk, poetisk og fuldstændig nærværende. For fans af Spacy Lady og Meredith Monk er dette en enestående mulighed for at opleve en sand legende i intimt soloformat.
Saltmother:
Saltmother åbner aftenen for Maggie Nicols. En Saltmother-koncert er en intens, følsom, storladen, stille, støjende og grinern koncertoplevelse, med eklektiske musikalske og vokale greb fra middelalderviser, grungerock og synthpop. Her er både mordballader fra Jomfru Marias synspunkt og sange om at være lidt for gammel til at tisse på gaden i en brandert. På scenen veksler Saltmother mellem et akustisk og et syntetisk udtryk, som enten indeholder klaver eller synthesizer. Bag Saltmother står komponist og sanger Amanda Appel, som siden 2020 har slået sine folder på den danske eksperimenterende scene, som del af vokalgruppen ilinx. I 2022 udgav hun solo EP’en “Heavy In Baby Blue”, og arbejder nu på sit debutalbum som forventes i 2026.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
In English:
We are proud to present the Scottish avant-garde pioneer Maggie Nicols for a rare solo performance at ALICE this April. With voice and piano – and with room for improvisation, tap dance, and unpredictable moments – Nicols invites us into her singular, deeply expressive universe. For fans of icons such as Spacy Lady and Meredith Monk, this comes highly recommended. Saltmother opens the evening with eclectic musical approaches and vocal experiments.
Born in Edinburgh in 1948, Maggie Nicols has been a central figure on the European improvisation scene for decades. She left school at 15 and began her career as a dancer before moving into jazz, joining London’s legendary Spontaneous Music Ensemble in 1968. Since then, she has left an indelible mark on fully free, non-idiomatic improvisation with her playful, political, and profoundly personal approach to music. In the 1970s, Nicols founded both the vocal group Voice and the feminist performance collective Feminist Improvising Group, insisting throughout her career on music as a space of freedom – both as artistic practice and activist action. Her concerts balance the vulnerable and the powerful, the humorous and the deeply moving. Always with the body and the voice as her primary instruments.
When Maggie Nicols performs at ALICE, the evening’s repertoire will primarily draw from her two critically acclaimed solo albums released on Café OTO’s OTOROKU label, where the song format unfolds in all its elastic and experimental beauty. Here we encounter Nicols in concentrated form: spontaneous, physical, poetic, and fully present. For fans of Spacy Lady and Meredith Monk, this is a rare opportunity to experience a true legend in an intimate solo setting.
Saltmother:
Saltmother opens the evening for Maggie Nicols. A Saltmother concert is an intense, sensitive, grand, quiet, noisy, and delightful experience, drawing on eclectic musical and vocal approaches from medieval ballads, grunge rock, and synth pop. Expect everything from murder ballads told from the perspective of the Virgin Mary to songs about being slightly too old to pee in the street while drunk. On stage, Saltmother shifts between acoustic and synthetic expressions, built around either piano or synthesizer. Behind Saltmother is composer and singer Amanda Appel, who has been active on the Danish experimental scene since 2020 as part of the vocal group ilinx. In 2022, she released her solo EP “Heavy In Baby Blue” and is currently working on her debut album, expected in 2026.

events.title: Byhavens Åbningsfest 2026: Arto + Jungle Julia w. Friends
events.description:
Byhaven åbner sæsonen den 24. april
Den 24. april åbner vi Byhaven med en ordentlig slasker af en åbningsfest - selvfølgelig med fri entré. Hitmagere Arto og DJ'en Jungle Julia er de første på scenen i 2026. Vi åbner kl. 15.00 og musikken starter 17.30. Yeerro serverer igen i år lækre gyros fra kl. 17.00 og baren bugner naturligvis af lækre Brooklyn-øl, naturvin og cocktails.
Kom og dans sommeren og foråret i gang med os.
Arto
Arto er en af Danmarks største hitmagere og står bag sange med Tobias Rahim, Drew Sycamore, Andreas Odbjerg og under sit alias YoJohnny, men nu dykker han ned i sine egne musikalske rødder med en dragende blanding af samba, bossa nova og calypso. De første singler er ude, og de er fremragende.
Jungle Julia w. friends
Københavnske DJ Jungle Julia serverer en all-you-can-dance buffet af baile funk og globale clubrytmer. Hun er en af de centrale kræfter bag at introducere lyden fra den brasilianske undergrund til de københavnske dansegulve, hvor hun ubesværet blander dembow, dancehall og R&B. Til vores åbningsfest tager hun en flok venner med for at skrue helt op for stemningen.

Friday, April 24th, 2200! closes the month at Sigurd CPH with a night built on contrast, groove, and connection, and a line-up of international DJs that perfectly represent the multi-cultural borough of Nørrebro. Different sounds meet naturally here, and the crowd is just as important to the atmosphere as the DJs behind the booth. Expect a room that starts loose, builds steadily, and stays locked in until late.

¡HARTY!
¡HARTY!’s musical palette is shaped by Latin American roots, UK Garage, DnB, and afrobeats. Her sets move easily between classics, hidden gems, and her own material, creating a flow that feels vibrant, dynamic, and full of momentum. She has a strong sense of how to make different genres coexist in a single shared mood on the floor.

Qwenty
Qwenty brings a deeper current to the night, working with rolling basslines, hypnotic loops, and house textures inspired by the late 90s and early 2000s. His sets are subtle but powerful, built on warm grooves and timeless selections that slowly pull the room closer. It is a sound made for late hours, steady movement, and people who want to stay in it.

Before the night gets going, remember the rule: no requests, OK?! Leave the direction to the DJs, stay present in the mix, and dance with what comes.

events.title: Electronic Equinox Gathering: Aux Animaux (SE) og Gamma Vortex (SE) // RUST
events.description:
ELECTRONIC EQUINOX GATHERING er tilbage! Efter første arrangement i september 2025, er dette samarbejde mellem klubberne The Black Cat, Club Braincorp og Nebula Events nu tilbage med et nyt arrangement på Rust, der byder på koncerter med de to svenske bands AUX ANIMAUX og GAMMA VORTEX. Efter koncerterne er der synth/industrial/goth/darkwave natklub med tre DJ’s.

AUX ANIMAUX (S)

aux animaux er en darkwave-kunstner fra Stockholm, Sverige. Hendes sange er inspireret af 80’ernes dark wave- og gothic-bands, samt okkultisme og gyserfilm. Når hun  besøger RUST med solo projektet aux animaux, kommer hun direkte fra en længere tour som bandmedlem i IAMX. 

aux animaux er født og opvokset i Istanbul. Hun er selvlært musiker, og arbejdede som professionel bassist i flere år, før hun flyttede til Sverige. På scenen giver hun et medrivende live show, hvor hun synger og skifter mellem at spille basguitar og fremtrylle gyserfilmsoundtrack-vibes på sin theremin.

Efter en række meget velmodtagne EPer “Black Holes”, “Stockholm Synthrome” og “The Hydesville Episode”, kom debutalbummet “Body Horror” endelig i 2023 på Manic Depression Records. Albummet blev skrevet, produceret og mixet af aux animaux. Masteringen blev udført af Doruk Öztürkcan fra She Past Away, som aux animaux også har turnerede med.

I de senere år har hun turneret med bands som She Past Away, The Soft Moon, Then Comes Silence, Kontravoid, Buzz Kull, Traitrs, Patriarchy og DAF.

**

GAMMA VORTEX (S) 

Endelig er Gamma Vortex tilbage i København efter 1½ års fravær. Seneste gang Gamma Vortex var her, spillede de support for det legendariske Industrial/EBM band fra Mildreda fra Belgien. Gamma Vortex består af Martin, som også er er kendt for bandet Cryo hvor han er forsanger.

Denne gang åbner Gamma Vortex for Aux Animaux. Gamma Vortex har sluppet 2 EP´er på deres eget label, som lige er blevet genudgivet digitalt på det tyske pladeselskab Dark Dimensions som også er kendt for bands som Noisuf-X, Centhron, Absurd Minds, Phosgore, Autodafeh og mange flere. 

Gamma Vortex arbejder på deres debut album som udkommer senere i år på Dark Dimensions. Gamma Vortex er kendte for deres sceneshows, som er ret Horror / Sci-Fi agtigt, så her er tale om etact, der udover at levere god musik, også byder på et fantastisk show. Gamma Vortex musik kan bedst beskrives som en blanding af noget mørkt EBM og hård industrial i stil med bands som Front 242, Dive, The Klinik, Suicide Commando, Front Line Assembly.

**

Når koncerterne er slut, kan man give den gas til synth/industrial/goth/darkwave natklub hele natten DJ Brain, DJ Lady Sara Noir og DJ Malware. Nærmere introduktion til de tre DJ’s følger.

events.title: Whipped #3 with Talismann
events.description:
Whipped #3 w/ Talismann @ Den Anden Side

Saturday, April 25 │ Normal Selection │ Techno, Hypnotic Techno

————
We are still buzzing from the previous Whipped event, but already now we are ready to draw the curtains for the next round of lashing. For the April whipping, we are excited to give to you dutch pioneering techno DJ and producer Talismann. He is supported by the local veteran Ctrls, and the promising Norwegian newcomer PIPPA.

Whipped is a hypnotic techno party where detail, texture, quality, and skill is at the center of attention. This is techno in its most intoxicating form: stripped back, relentless, and finely tuned to keep you hypnotized from the first kick to the final echo. 

Within the Whipped concept, we will present an international sound bringing both newer names and old legends to DAS, combined with a strong and blossoming local scene.

This is Whipped #3
Come’ get whipped.

𝗟𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘂𝗽
Talismann [he/him]
Ctrls [he/him]
PIPPA [she/her]

————

TALISMANN
Talismann is meticulously refining an unparalleled vision forged from over two decades of club expertise. For Talismann a.k.a. Guy Blanken, music is a matter of the heart, and a boundless playing field for sonic explorations. His compulsive curiosity has led him to unusual corners of the electronic music realm while always probing ever deeper into the abyss of sinister soundscapes and industrial drum patterns.

When Guy hasn’t locked himself in the studio, or isn’t tending to one of his labels, he loves engaging with the dance floor during one of his tireless DJ or live sets. Finding a home at Amsterdam institutions like Trouw, De School, and Dekmantel has given him the opportunity and freedom to connect with fellow travellers, and continue on his fascinating musical journey.

CTRLS
The Ctrls project was founded in 2012. From the first release the presence of a highly individual sonic style was apparent and his fast paced and futuristic techno based sound has now been well established with a stream of respected music on labels such as Token Records, Earwiggle, Micron Audio, Mechatronica and Key Vinyl. A lifelong devotee of electronic dance music, DJ’ing and live performance are central for the project. This has resulted in many involved sets at globally notable venues such as Tresor, Berghain, Khidi, Fabric, Kit Kat, Fold, Basement NY, and Club Drugstore as well a residency at Copenhagen's purest electronic venue: Den Anden Side. The future holds a wider scope as electro, breakbeats, noise and audio visual components are folded into the distinctive Ctrls sound palette.

PIPPA
is a Norwegian DJ based in Oslo, deeply rooted in the city’s close-knit electronic music community. Since her debut in 2023, she’s made a name for herself, playing at some of Oslo’s most well-known clubs and bringing her unique energy to the scene.

Her sets are all about playful experimentation—she loves weaving together unconventional sounds (or as she calls them, “plipp plopp sounds”) with bouncy basslines and a solid groove. PIPPA doesn’t stick to just one genre; she moves fluidly between techno, house, and everything in between, always curating tracks that match her mood and energy in the moment.

events.title: A.S.S.M.R. V8: Mohajer // Saroor // babsko // sisifoss // Carla Viola Thurøe (performance)
events.description:
Bbrrr time is finally over and after a little pause we’re finally back and loud bbsz!!

We’ve been putting together a strong FLINTA lineup of local and international artists to carry the night from start to end, front to back!

This time we’re stepping into a new iconic playground at BASEMENT CPH: high ceilings, darker corners, heavy sound, always the ASSMR energy.

___________________________


V8 ARTISITS:

MOHAJER

Mohajer doesn’t just read the room, she galvanizes it. Playful, yet potent, freaky and flirtatious, her eclectic sound is bound by flavour, not genre - powered by trippy grooves, punchy vocals, and the percussive pulse of her Persian roots.

Born and raised in Gothenburg, Mohajer cut her teeth as a punk bassist before flipping the script as a DJ and promoter in Sweden’s underground scene. Since relocating to Berlin in
2013, she’s carved out her place in the city’s sonic ecosystem - fusing livewire energy with sapphic euphoria as co-founder and resident of intimate party, mp3.

As a producer, Mohajer picks no lane - she careens between slick, slippery trance rhythms, bouncy percussive basslines, and jagged industrial elements with instinct and intent. Her
forthcoming EP on Spray’s Punctuality Records twists that palette into something bold and elastic: a confident cascade of mystique, mayhem and sensuality.

With multiple appearances at Panorama Bar, Berghain, RSO, and Tresor - plus international sets at Bassiani, FOLD, and Basement - Mohajer continues to hold space for rave’s queer
roots and future possibilities.

/////////////////////////////////////////////

SAROOR

Revered for her exploration of the dark, percussive and groovy, Saroor is a Sudanese-British DJ whose sound is shaped on the realms of techno and psytrance.

From a classically trained music background playing the cello in her formative years, and being an avid multi-genre enthusiast, her music journey began with an appreciation for complex rhythms and tonalities, delivering her to exploring London’s Psytrance scene, with a particular affinity to the sounds of dark and progressive psy, forest and psy-techno. This led to her securing her first residency at the illustrious psy/ techno party SLIVER.

She holds notable performances at Fold, Unfold, Riposte, SLIVER, Pinhole as well as esteemed venues such as Colour Factory, and Corsica Studios. Saroor has also showcased her sound on Rinse FM, Voices radio and many others.

/////////////////////////////////////////////

BABSKO

babsko is a Polish artist who builds her sets as stories - not planned in advance, but written in the moment. Using breaks, deep and hypnotic techno, trance and bass as tools, these stories grow from thoughts and feelings she is moving through, shaped by the push and pull between herself and the energy of the people around her.

The layers drift, collide, and slowly lock into place. Alongside playing, she is currently part of the Copenhagen-based ASSMR, and previously co-ran the trance/techno collective MUDDER.

She is particularly interested in music as a language - a way of communicating without words. This is something she explores through her deep listening sessions, Echoes, where participants meet monthly to choose individual tracks around a shared theme and reflect on the thoughts, sensations and emotions they bring up.

/////////////////////////////////////////////

SISIFOSS

sisifoss (she/her) is a Copenhagen-based DJ, emerging from years on the dancefloor.
From front-left speaker devotion to stepping into the booth, she carries a deep connection to movement, energy and collective release. Her sound leans into fast, seductive rhythms — built to pull you in, soften your edges and keep you there.

Approaching DJing with a playful and exploratory mindset, sisifoss is still in the process of defining her own way. Her sets unfold intuitively, guided by the room as much as by her own instincts, creating a space where curiosity, tension and release can coexist.

Rooted in queer and FLINTA spaces, and as part of ASSMR, she sees the dancefloor as shared ground giving way to connection, expression and becoming. For sisifoss, music has always been a way to move closer to herself, and now, to others.

/////////////////////////////////////////////
 
PERFORMANCE:
CARLA VIOLA THURØE

To expand beyond the booth we invite Carla Viola Thurøe for ASSMR VOL 08 on 25.04.2026

Carla Viola Thurøe is a Danish actress and performing artist. She works with song, melody, body, and text intuitively, physically, and playfully within the tension field between theatre and performance art.

Carla’s practice revolves around existential themes such as nature, love, pain, lust and identity. She explores and challenge all the strange man-made systems that distance us from ourselves and from one another. “We are in the midst of a collapse that has disconnected us from nature and the body”, says Carla about what motivates her artistically. 

Carla Viola Thurøe has graduated from the Danish National School of Performing Arts in 2022 and since completing her education, she has worked on numerous large and small theatre stages across the country and in film, and television series.

___________________________________________


***ASSMR COMMUNITY GUIDELINES***

- ASSMR has zero tolerance for discrimination of any kind.
- Do not assume gender or pronouns.
- The dancefloor is for dancing. Put your phone down.
- Consent is key! Do not touch or engage with someone unless you get their approval.
- Know your limits.
- You must understand these rules to enter. By entering, you become part of a community that takes care of each other.
- If you feel uncomfortable or unwell at any point during the event, please reach out to our team.

ASSMR is a Copenhagen-based queer-focused collective aiming to bring electronic music, immersive art, and high-energy dance to the forefront of our parties and events. We curate transformative spaces for meditative release through sound, light, and motion, with a deep commitment to inclusivity and creativity.

events.title: Sigurd presents: CHAMOS (NL)
events.description:
!! PRESALE TICKETS ARE SOLD OUT - AN ADDITIONAL 500 TICKETS WILL BE SOLD AT THE DOOR ON THE NIGHT !!

On Saturday, April 25, Sigurd CPH welcomes back CHAMOS (NL), one of the most distinctive DJ duos to emerge from the European club underground in recent years. An annual April homecoming, this event marks only their second show in Copenhagen and their second appearance at Sigurd in two years, following a high-impact night in April 2025. Be part of this once-a-year ritual that’s fast becoming a legend in the making.

For this occasion, we’re doing something we rarely do. A very limited presale will be available.

CHAMOS (NL)
Friends since their first day of high school, CHAMOS is built on more than just DJ chemistry. It’s a shared musical language shaped by Kurdish heritage, Dutch club culture, and years spent moving between worlds. Their sets blend traditional West Asian melodies and vocals with heavy basslines, percussion-driven club rhythms, and raw, physical energy.

What started as edits shared between friends has grown into a global movement. From packed European clubs to tours across Asia, their music creates a rare feeling of belonging on the dancefloor. CHAMOS’ sets aren’t about genres. They’re about moments, memory, and movement. Expect emotional highs, deep lows, and a crowd that moves as one.

PAYDAR
Copenhagen-based and deeply rooted in the city’s diasporic club culture, Paydar moves effortlessly between hypnotic club rhythms, percussive grooves, and sounds drawn from lived experience. Her sets are intuitive, warm, and powerful, always led by feeling rather than formula.

SANJARI
Known to many as Artigeardit and Phlake’s longtime tour DJ, Sanjari steps forward with a solo project rooted in Iranian musical heritage and contemporary club sounds. Dubby house, dancefloor energy, and melodies from his upbringing collide in a set that’s as personal as it is explosive.

events.title: 𝒜𝓁𝓁 𝒩𝒾𝑔𝒽𝓉 𝐿𝑜𝓃𝑔 with Steen Kong
events.description:
DJ Steen Kong is one of the original architects of Copenhagen’s club culture. A vinyl purist, master selector and long-distance storyteller, he has spent more than four decades behind the decks refining a rare instinct for time, space and the room in front of him. His sets move with ease between warmth and tension, sensuality and surprise, the timeless and the unexpected.

At Jolene, where Steen has his own history and legacy, this all-nighter is more than a set.
It is a dancefloor journey shaped by memory, craft and an open heart. Drawing from a record collection built over 40 years, he builds narratives that unfold patiently and hit exactly when they need to.

No prefab performance, no shortcuts. Just six hours of intuition, elegance, sweat and emotional depth from one of the city’s true OGs.

events.title: Zevra
events.description:
Zevra is an international quartet uniting artists from Taiwan, Iran, Germany, and the United States dedicated to the evolution of improvised experimental music. Formed at the Art Omi: Music 2025 residency in New York, the ensemble combines a distinctive sonic palette of pipa, kamancheh, saxophone, and modular synthesizer, augmented by tape machines and 3D-printed instruments. Each member brings a distinct musical voice shaped by experimentation, cultural heritage, and a shared commitment to expanding the sonic possibilities of their instruments.

Blending acoustic timbres with electronics and extended techniques, Zevra experiments with proximity, silence, and density, allowing the music to unfold through sustained listening and real-time negotiation. The result is an ephemeral terrain of sound that drifts between quiet detail and immersive intensity, drawing listeners into an experience of the unexpected. The quartet is currently embarking on their first tour across the UK and EU.

Line Up:
Niloufar Shiri – kamancheh, cassette machine
Fan-Qi Wu – pipa
Jonas Engel – saxophone, 3D-printed instruments
Matthew Ryals – modular synthesizer

events.title: Rebe (ES) + Osy Cotton (DK)
events.description:
Til april indtager Rebe scenen med teatralske kærlighedsmyter og forførende, luftige dream pop i en ekstravagant ballon-scenografi, der forvandler rummet til et parallelt fantasilanskab. Den hypede, Madrid-baserede DIY-kunstners univers er kitsch, sensuelt og radikalt bizart – og samtidig uimodståeligt fængende. Med den seneste single “Brilla el sol” og en stort anlagt Europa-tour styrer hun direkte mod stjernerne, og heldigvis rammer hun ALICE på vejen. Danske Osy Cotton åbner aftenen med sart nu-emo-bedroom-pop og intime bekendelser.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
Køb billet i forsalg: 160 dkk eksl. gebyr / ungebillet: 140 ung dkk eksl. gebyr
Køb billet: https://alicecph.com/event/rebe-es-osy-cotton/
Rebe: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zvYylb-hOYk
Osy Cotton: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nyT1U4eh1Ds
NB: Koncerten er stående
SCROLL DOWN FOR ENGLISH
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
At træde ind i Rebes verden er ikke blot at lytte til hendes luftige, analoge og legende bedroom pop. Det er at blive opslugt af en helhed: den drømmeagtige atmosfære, de teatralske kærlighedsmyter og den disede vintage æstetik, der udfolder sig på tværs af musik, videoer og Instagram. Musikalsk trækker Rebe tråde fra spanske 70’er- og 80’er-ballader og ikoniske kunstnere som Jeanette og Lola Flores over i nutidig dream pop. Her bor feer, blomster og glitrende melankoli side om side med en uskyldig erotikkens nerve og en drillende energi.
Rebe begyndte sin musikalske rejse i trioen LULI REBE & SUS XOCOLATINAS, men hendes særegne, ustyrlige kunstnerpersonlighed kaldte hurtigt på sit eget rum. Solodebuten “Recuerdos de cuando me aplastó una roca y me morí” (2019) udkom på kassette via Snap! Clap! Club og Jeanne D’Arc – håndsyet i stofomslag lavet af Rebe selv – og blev udsolgt, før den overhovedet ramte gaden. Siden fulgte en ligeledes udsolgt vinyludgave. På albummet forener hun melodiske finurligheder og tåget, raffineret produktion med en skrivestil, der leger i bevidst kontrast til musikkens næsten parfumerede elegance. Siden har hun udgivet sange uden for gængse formater, optrådt på toneangivende festivaler og udgivet på bl.a. Elefant Records. Rebes seneste single, “Brilla el sol” (2026), har allerede sat stemningen til hendes kommende EU-tour. Vi er begejstrede for at hun også kommer forbi ALICE med sit magnetiske, sensuelle dream-pop-univers og ekstravagante ballon-scenografi.
Osy Cotton:
Aftenen åbnes af Osy Cotton, som med sit nu-emo-bedroom-pop-univers trækker publikum helt tæt på. Her finder store følelser og intime bekendelser sammen med bass heavy beats, drømmende, distortede flader og shoegazede guitartåger. Det er følelsesladet, digitalt og dagbogsagtigt – med klare tråde til den nye bølge af eksperimenterende bedroom pop, som kendes fra navne som Oklou og Bladee, men filtreret gennem Osys eget mørke, poetiske blik.
Live omformes sangene i et setup med guitar og DJ, hvor singer-songwriter-rødder og en snert af country sniger sig ind mellem de elektroniske teksturer.

⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
ENGLISH:
In April, Rebe takes the stage with theatrical love myths and seductive, airy dream pop in an extravagant balloon scenography that transforms the room into a parallel fantasy landscape. The hyped Madrid-based DIY artist’s universe is kitsch, sensual and radically bizarre – yet irresistibly catchy. With her latest single “Brilla el sol” and a large-scale European tour underway, she is heading straight for the stars – and luckily, she stops by ALICE on the way. Danish Osy Cotton opens the evening with delicate nu-emo bedroom pop and intimate confessions.
Stepping into Rebe’s world is not just about listening to her airy, analogue and playful bedroom pop. It is about being immersed in a complete universe: the dreamlike atmosphere, the theatrical love myths and the hazy vintage aesthetic unfolding across music, videos and Instagram. Musically, Rebe draws threads from Spanish 70s and 80s ballads and iconic artists such as Jeanette and Lola Flores into contemporary dream pop. Here, fairies, flowers and shimmering melancholy coexist with a pulse of innocent eroticism and a teasing rebelliousness.
Rebe began her musical journey in the trio LULI REBE & SUS XOCOLATINAS, but her singular, unruly artistic personality soon demanded its own space. Her solo debut, “Recuerdos de cuando me aplastó una roca y me morí” (2019), was released on cassette via Snap! Clap! Club and Jeanne D’Arc – wrapped in hand-sewn fabric covers made by Rebe herself – and sold out before it even hit the streets. A vinyl reissue quickly followed, also selling out. On the album, she merges melodic quirks and hazy, refined production with a writing style that deliberately clashes with the music’s almost perfumed elegance. Since then, she has released songs outside conventional formats, performed at leading festivals and released music through labels including Elefant Records. Her latest single, “Brilla el sol” (2026), has already set the tone for her upcoming EU tour. We are thrilled that she is also stopping by ALICE with her magnetic, sensual dream pop universe and extravagant balloon scenography.
Osy Cotton:
The evening opens with Osy Cotton, who draws the audience close with their nu-emo bedroom pop universe. Big emotions and intimate confessions merge with bass-heavy beats, dreamy distorted textures and shoegaze guitar haze. It is emotional, digital and diary-like – with clear ties to the new wave of experimental bedroom pop associated with artists such as Oklou and Bladee, yet filtered through Osy’s own dark, poetic lens.
Live, the songs are reshaped in a setup with guitar and DJ, where singer-songwriter roots and a hint of country slip in between the electronic textures.

events.title: Pearly Drops (FI) // RUST
events.description:
Pearly Drops er en kreativ synergi i producerduoen bestående af Sandra Tervonen og Juuso Malin, der skaber popmusik, som lyser af cinematiske teksturer og æteriske vokaler.

De har forfinet deres talent gennem prisvindende samarbejder og designprojekter og kanaliserer en følelsesladet, moderne tilgang, der fusionerer det drømmelignende og minimalistiske med det modige og storslåede.

Kendt for deres distinkte, bløde og afrundede lyd, selvproducerer Pearly Drops alle aspekter af deres arbejde for at sikre, at hver udgivelse resonerer med en rå og indlevende autenticitet – skabt på grænsen til noget helt nyt.

Med en baggrund i DR Pigekoret forbinder sophie-lou de harmonier, vi forbinder med den danske sangskat, til skraldede DIY-lyde, skæve synths og et inderligt og direkte tekstunivers. Thursday, April 30 │ Soft Selection │ House, Progressive House

On Thursday, April 30th — the day before May 1st which is a holiday for many — we are beyond excited to welcome legendary DJ and pioneer Avalon Emerson for an unforgettable set.

“Avalon Emerson’s selections reflect a deep knowledge of house, techno, new wave, EBM, and rave, as well as the experience of an adaptable selector. Her style transcends the confines of time and genre by recontextualizing dance music from previous eras alongside contemporary sounds and her own productions and edits.

In recent years, she has become a regular across all floors of Berlin’s iconic Berghain nightclub and has played major festivals like Coachella and Pitchfork. In 2019, she launched her own international event series, 9000 Dreams, featuring all-night solo marathon DJ sets and curated club lineups.

Alongside this, she has maintained a steady stream of original releases on respected electronic labels such as AD 93 (formerly Whities) and Ghostly International’s Spectral Sound. She released her contribution to the esteemed DJ-Kicks series in 2020. Her debut album, & the Charm, came out on her own Another Dove label in 2023.”

For support, we’ve booked local powerhouse Lucky Lube to open and close the night.

Closing the month on Thursday, April 30th, FLOOR returns for another night devoted to the dance floor. Sigurd CPH keeps this Thursday close to the music, with one DJ controlling the pace and giving the room a clear pulse from beginning to end. SELMA brings an energetic and deeply musical presence shaped by Copenhagen, by a life spent close to music, and by her own work as both DJ and artist.
