events.title: Anastasia Kristensen Pres. Bestiarium Sombre // RUST
events.description:
Anastasia Kristensen marks 10 years of music production with a new major work — the album Bestiarium Sombre, set to be released this May on the Dutch label Intercept Records.

For this unique evening, she will present a new live set based on the album’s nine distinctive and atmospheric tracks. For the performance, she has invited Tessa Laroche, a French independent dancer and choreographer, to present her interpretation of Bestiarium Sombre.

During the evening, Rask will also present a new live set filled with unique, experimental sounds, and Gavnlig will bless us behind the DJ decks with her fantastic and depth-searching musical taste.

“This evening in this shape may only happen once. It is dedicated to the art of music, and it is an honor to make this happen on home turf,” says Anastasia.

ABOUT THE ARTISTS:

Anastasia Kristensen (live)
Drawing from a wide range of influences, Anastasia Kristensen blends off-grid electronics through an adventurous and infectious mixing style. Her avant-garde, dance-focused performances invite audiences to fully let go on the dancefloor. Her releases on Warp’s Arcola, Turbo and Houndstooth explore a bold, sci-fi-tinged vision of electronic music, combining dub, IDM and techno into a distinctive and forward-looking sound. This is a perfect time to show a new milestone in her musical work – a new album Bestiaries Sombre out on Intercept records on May 8. In 2023 she founded the label absorb emit, dedicated to textured, experimental and playful dance music from forward-thinking artists. Alongside her prominent DJ career, she dedicates her time to community-driven projects, that reflect her collaborative approach across electronic music scene.

Tessa Laroche (dance performance)
With dance residencies in the States and France, a dancer of the renowned Alvin Ailey school – Tessa’s artistic approach is within the fusion of various dance styles; from ballet to jazz to contemporary – she finds a special way of movement. For this evening tessa prepared a choreography, performance and her own interpretation of Bestiarium Sombre.

Rask (live)
Rask, a Dane who spent part of his life in France, is a noise manipulator and sound programmer. His work can be heard on Anastasia’s label absorb emit. Rask will present a live set featuring original compositions and modular sounds.

Gavnlig (DJ)
The Danish-Icelandic producer and DJ Andrea Hildursdóttir, aka Gavnlig, has captured everyone’s hearts with her combination of technical finesse and playful music selection. An active figure in the scene with a broad technical understanding of music and a truly distinctive taste, which can be heard across several releases on both Danish and international labels.

events.title: ØVSA Live w. Flieder & Harmon
events.description:
ØVSA LIVE 1st of May minimal rave

On May 1st we fight for worker's rights internationally. We take a stand for equal rights, make a move against racism, facism and exploitation of workers. 
Nationally we will be marching in the streets of Copenhagen all day and in the evening we invite you to land in a melancholic, atmospheric, soft setting with us at ØVSA Live. 


We will have some soothing, modular synthesis, breakbeat, house tunes ready for you performed by:
Harmon & flieder


You'll be wrapped up in zealous live sets, showcasing phenomenal finesse and an ear for subtle, cosy music with maximum efficiency and lots of groove to the dancefloor. 


ABOUT THE ARTISTS

flieder *live:
What happens when you blend Kahl, Kaemena, Brigade, some modular synthesis and a city brimming with electronic music and innovation? You guessed it (or not), out comes: flieder - an outstanding Berlin trio. 
This German threesome hooked up some years ago and used their time to perfect the art of creating subtle, cosy music with maximum efficiency. 
Like true alchemists, they possess an uncanny ability to transform ordinary, everyday elements into pure gold with their artistry. 
Like no other, these three Berliners manage to create a deafening silence. Each element in their music is stripped back, yet speaks a thousand words. What they have to offer is nothing less than impressive. Sparse, slowed down, ghostly yet truly effective electronic work that's ready to fog up the dance floor.

Harmon *live:
Harmon has been active in the electronic music scene for over a decade in various projects and
has been most recently known for his former downtempo duo gázel. With his new project he
fuses abstract modular synthesis and sampling techniques with live guitar and a tendency to
melancholic atmospheres, always balancing minimalist aesthetic and maximalist feelings. 
His immersive sound exists between the fringes of downtempo, minimal, breakbeats and house and
tries to avoid the all too obvious conventions of said genres while remaining passionate, melodic
and groove oriented. His performances breathe through live instrumentation, analog effects and
the spontaneity of the moment.

We meet early, we dance early. Getting our groove on before midnight and doing all the dancing, hugging all the friends, hearing all the amazing music - all whilst still being able to enjoy the rest of our weekend. 
No sleep needs to be disturbed. Besides that, we care about really good sound and minimum traffic on the dancefloor. 
Live acts and vinyl only.

Istedgade Lokalradio 007 - The Sune & Siinus Double Birthday Lokalradio All Stars Mayday Elation Edition

This time ‘round is no joke. In fact, it’s deadly serious. Because, it’s a double birthday extravaganza. In fact, it’s The Sune & Siinus Double Birthday Lokalradio All Stars Mayday Elation Edition. And your favourite local radio station will celebrate it with noise and gratuitous palaver.

For this very special night, Sune and Siinus has upped the ante - and indeed the number of DJ’s on the roster, from the regular 2 to a boneshakingly staggering 7. SEVEN! And what seven!

Sune Kehlet, our near-resident returnee DJ, has joined the Lokalradio editorial staff for a night, to create the(!) even of the century along with Siinus, Editor in Chief of Istedgade Lokalradio. The last the those two tried to host a joint birthday, the outdoor party had to be canceled due to snow… in May. So, here they are again. This time inside. Hopefully no snow there. So, this time no helstegt pattegris, but a whole lot of experimental cocktails and a cocktail printer instead.

Also, it’s May Day. International Workers’ Day. Labour Day. Primo Maggio. So come in your drunken Fælledparken stupor, wear your finest coveralls and steel-toed boots, and sing along to International and Bandiera Rossa with the rest of us plebs!

.Friday, May 1st, 2200! opens the month at Sigurd CPH with a night shaped by rhythm, range, and a shared sense of direction on the floor. The party is rooted in Nørrebro: open, genre-fluid, and grounded in hip-hop, with sounds from across scenes folding naturally into the mix. Expect a room that builds steadily and stays locked once it finds its pace.

John Vincent
John Vincent brings a deep-rooted understanding of hip-hop to everything he plays, shaped by years in the culture and a background spanning dance, production, and live performance. His sets are sharp and intentional, moving between hip-hop, R&B, and club-ready blends with a strong sense of timing. There’s a clarity in how he builds energy, keeping the floor engaged without overcomplicating the moment.

events.title: Weska / Naiva / MISS ALBA / Datskie / GÆO / THOR CALIN
events.description:
WESKA returns on 2 May!

From early releases on Drumcode, Cocoon, and Bedrock to more recent work with Experts Only, REALM, and Armada Music, Weska has built a reputation for fusing techno, progressive house, and indie dance into a sound that’s distinctly his own. His approach has earned him recognition from leading artists like Adam Beyer, as well as a recent North American tour with Bart Skils. You may also have caught him performing alongside Eric Prydz at Hi Ibiza, at Drumcode showcases, or at major festivals such as Creamfields — and we’re excited to welcome him back to Copenhagen. Weska headlines the night with support from Hyggelit Records’ Naiva and Miss Alba who makes her Black Box debut. 

Meanwhile, we’re excited to bring Datskie from Colorize (Enhanced) all the way from Amsterdam to headline Red Box with his dreamy soundscapes, supported by GÆO, one of Copenhagen’s most talented breakthrough artists and fresh from releases on Blank Dust. Last but not least, Thor Calin makes his Culture Box debut.

First drink/beer for free the first open hour.

Saturday, May 2 │ Normal Selection │ Techno, Hardgroove

————

ᴘᴏꜱᴛʏʀ - [𝚙𝚘ˈ𝚜𝚝𝚢'𝚛 - 𝚞𝚙𝚛𝚘𝚊𝚛, 𝚝𝚞𝚖𝚞𝚕𝚝, 𝚌𝚘𝚖𝚖𝚘𝚝𝚒𝚘𝚗]

‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿

Postyr is thrilled to welcome Marcal, the Brazilian-born techno visionary merging Brazilian shamanistic traditions with futuristic soundscapes for a truly otherworldly experience.

Hailing from Goiânia, Brazil, Marcal has swiftly ascended to become one of South America's brightest techno exports, earning international acclaim for his innovative fusion of captivating rhythms and cutting-edge sound design. With releases on legendary labels including Rekids, Enemy Records, and Token, his powerful low-end, hypnotic grooves, and psychedelic atmospheres have garnered support from techno titans like Ben Klock, DVS1, Luke Slater, Marcel Dettmann, Freddy K, Radio Slave, and Dustin Zahn.

Deeply influenced by the vibrant rhythms and shamanistic traditions of his Brazilian heritage, Marcal skillfully merges tribal elements with avant-garde futurism. His signature sound evokes a primal "lost in the jungle" sensation paired with otherworldly allure. As a resident at iconic venues D-EDGE and Surreal, Marcal's storytelling prowess shines through extended marathon sets filled with deep basslines, syncopated percussion, and meticulously crafted textures.

Our residents will as always keep you locked in with their seamless blends of energetic, colorful techno, hypnotic grooves, reckless b2bs and restless layering of endless loops.
Postyr is based in Copenhagen, born from a desire to collectively explore the deep corners of sound, emotion, and connection. Together we are dedicated to craft raw, immense techno experiences, shaping a yet unknown realm, for those who seek connection on the hypnotizing edges of the dancefloor.

Come as you are. Leave as something else.

events.description:
The weather is getting better, and we’ve got everything ready to celebrate together.

We’ve put together a top-quality lineup with talented DJs based in Copenhagen so you can enjoy an unforgettable party, just like always.

We’re finally seeing each other again after so long!

Ikigai sunsets are back. See you on Sunday, May 3rd at Byhaven.


ELIOTT LITROWSKI

Schooled in the sounds of Parisian institutions like Le Pulp, Batofar, and Rex Club—first as a
fan, then behind the decks—French producer and DJ Eliott Litrowski has built a dynamic and
light-hearted body of work that mirrors his joyful character. Now based in Copenhagen, he balances his days as a designer with nights at local hotspots like Den Anden Side and Jolene while making waves far beyond France. His razor-sharp blends of House, electro, and Italo have taken him around the world, with tours across Asia and South America, as well as memorable Sunday parties at the legendary Concrete in Paris. A dedicated vinyl collector since his early DJing days, Eliott brings an analog warmth and deep musical knowledge to every set.

NAT 

Residing in Copenhagen, all the way from Bratislava, NAT is an upcoming talent with a deep passion ranging from acid-spiced vintage house, right up to future-facing techno and progressive electro rollers. With bold yet incisive style, she captivates the dancefloor by pushing the limits of electronic music. Often fast and high- energy yet always seamlessly connected, her selections weave together multifaceted sound niches. Balancing raw intensity with elegance and ease, she brings a dynamic presence to the dance floor, where every set is an unpredictable yet cohesive journey. 

LOWFEK 

Kevin Rivara, known as Lowfek, is an Argentine DJ and producer influenced by artists like Ricardo Villalobos, Rhadoo, Franco Cinelli, and Funk-E. He honed his music skills at the renowned Sonica school in Buenos Aires, delving into production in 2015. His successful releases, supported by labels like Whoyostro, Innocent Music, and Mood 24, allowed him to carve his unique DJ style blending Minimal and percussive sounds.

He has performed at prominent local venues in Buenos Aires such as Bahrein, Cocoliche, and Bloody Sound. Now based in Copenhagen, he has extended his presence to both the local and international scenes, including cities like Barcelona, Stockholm, and Gothenburg alongside artists like Sublee, Vlad Arapasu, Ida Daugaard, Leanca, Chrivu and Jorge Savoretti among others. Lowfek has also left his imprint on labels like Inwave, Saraw, The Aviary, Implimind, and Fratii, garnering support from acclaimed artists like Vid, Costin RP, and Dragutesku.


Come early and enjoy the full journey.


3rd | Byhaven | 15:00–21:00

We continue our commitment to bringing people together, crossing borders, fostering cultural exchange, and creating unforgettable moments.

events.title: Strøm x TYFC: Masterclass with Talons & Main Phase
events.description:
Renowned producers, friends and labelmates Main Phase and Talons (Adam Emil Schierbeck and Bjarke Bech) present an exclusive masterclass: going over production techniques, the industry, and everything in between. The two Copenhagen-based producers have made waves internationally with their UK-influenced take on everything from jungle and garage to bass music and dub techno.

Often described as "your favourite DJ's favourite DJ", Main Phase played an instrumental part in the speed garage revival in recent years, notably with his releases as one-half of ATW, his duo and label with Interplanetary Criminal. His latest DJ sets and productions have seen him dive deeper into techno and more leftfield productions, while still retaining his signature groove and energy.

Talons, fka Lille Høg, first made a name for himself with his unique productions for various artists in Copenhagen's underground hip-hop scene. Seeking fresh inspiration, he returned to his first love of electronic music in 2025. Now producing entirely with hardware equipment, his first EP Amar Dubs Vol. 1 spanned the gamut from ambient to steppas, with later releases exploring more dancefloor-friendly territory.

Together, their newly-started label First Touch Archives (referencing their previous moniker) serves as a home for Schierbeck & Bech's more experimental music, which has already drawn support from the likes of Ben UFO, Richie Hawtin and Batu.

events.title: Seefeel (UK) // RUST
events.description:
Seefeel opstod fra Londons undergrund i begyndelsen af 90’erne og blev hurtigt en af tidens mest fremadskuende grupper ved at udviske grænserne mellem guitarmusik og elektronisk eksperimentering.

De blev oprindeligt set som en del af shoegaze-bølgen sammen med bands som My Bloody Valentine og Slowdive, men Seefeels brug af samplere, loops og processerede lydflader pegede mod en anden fremtid — en der lå tættere på den spirende IDM-lyd.

Det var denne hybridvision og gruppens stigende tilknytning til elektronisk musik, som kulminerede i, at Seefeel i 1994 blev det første guitardrevne band, der blev signet på Warp Records — et skelsættende øjeblik for pladeselskabet, som indtil da udelukkende havde være et dance label.

Upåvirket af trends og altid med blikket rettet fremad står Seefeel i dag som ikoner inden for eksperimenterende musik og som pionerer for en lyd, der med tiden kun er blevet mere afgørende og indflydelsesrig.

events.title: Jolene Bar? with DJ Sense (GE) & Amiraku
events.description:
Jolene Bar? Thursday, where your mid week serious person committments go down the drain. Free Entrance, Cheap Drinks, and the usual uncompromising high quality dancefloor music courtesy of Dolly's house. 

This week, we hand the floor to our Georgian friend DJ Sense, joined by local selector Amiraku, for an evening that moves through dense, considered electronics and into something heavier as the night finds its footing.


DJ Sense comes out of Tbilisi's underground — a city whose club culture has built a reputation for seriousness and stamina, with Bassiani at its centre. He's a regular presence at venues like Horoom, Tes Club and The White Hotel, and runs Tears in Club, a community radio show dedicated to experimentation and subcultural space-making. His sound sits in dense, progressive territory but makes room for dub, ambient drift, and what his bio calls "collapse" — that feeling when a set consciously unravels something before rebuilding it. He's not a DJ who plays to impress quickly. He constructs, then dismantles, asking what can still be felt in rooms oversaturated with noise. At Jolene's scale, that approach lands differently. The room is small enough that nothing gets lost.

Amiraku opens the night, setting the table for what follows. Amiraku (Amir Blondeel) is a well known Moroccan-born, Copenhagen-based DJ, who's no stranger to extended sessions in Baggen and Jolene. He is a key figure in the local scene, specializing in minimal house, dub techno, and old-school Detroit sounds — somewhere where the headsy and attentive meet the fun and functional, never disappoints!

---

Doors open at eight, DJs from whenever it makes sense, floor fills slowly, and by midnight the room is exactly where it needs to be. Jolene Bar on a Thursday is never a stretch — it's just a good reason to be out. 

---

Doors: 20:00 – 03:00 (DJs after 21)

events.title: Halvcirkel // RUST Sleeps Around
events.description:
*Døre kl. 19.00*
*Koncertstart kl. 20.00*

Halvcirkel er en dansk strygertrio, grundlagt i København i 2015, bestående af bratschist Mika Persdotter, violinist Bettina Marie Ezaki og cellist Nicole Hogstrand. I 2024 kom Halvcirkel med i FatCat Records' sublabel 130701 og deres portefølje af postmoderne klassiske artister. De udgav her deres første album udelukkende bestående af originale kompositioner, med titlen Vida.

Albummet viser gruppens kreative udvikling og demonstrerer teknikker som col legno og pizzicato for at skabe klanglige portrætter af nordiske landskaber, der leder tankerne hen på Islands, Sveriges og Danmarks vilde skønhed. 

Kompositionerne på Vida bærer præg af gruppens tydelige referencer til Brian Eno, Craig Leon, Carl Nielsen, Arvo Pärt og Terry Riley. Deres filosofi er, at en gruppe aldrig står alene, men altid er en del af noget større. 

Halvcirkels arbejde er lige så åbensindet, som deres kunstneriske filosofi. De har fortolket værker af komponister som Dmitri Sjostakovitj og Philip Glass, samarbejdet med kunstnere på tværs af musikalske discipliner, herunder Henrik Lindstrand, Signe Lykke og Hania Rani, samt taget imod særlige bestillingsopgaver, såsom deres samarbejde med Statens Museum for Kunst i 2023. 

I foråret 2025 var de på releaseturné i Japan, med deres seneste udgivelse SPIRIT, som er skrevet i samarbejde med deres mangeårige samarbejdspartner, komponist og multiinstrumentalist Anders Lauge Meldgaard. Halvcirkels musik afspejler en nutidig tilgang til klassisk musik, hvor tradition balanceres med det eksperimenterende og hvor lytteren inviteres ind i en verden af rige teksturer og kunstnerisk nysgerrighed.

Since 2023, sim0ne has ascended from bedroom DJ/Producer to BBC Radio 1’s Future Star of 2024 and the face of TikTok’s #ElectronicMusic campaign 2025. Her high-energy blends of hard house, happy hardcore, techno and trance have landed her a Rinse FM residency, a BBC Radio 6 Music guest mix, as well as performances at Fabric, Glastonbury, ADE, Reading & Leeds, and more.

events.title: Simian & Dansehallerne present: Slippery Melody
events.description:
Simian and Dansehallerne present Slippery Melody, an immersive experience at the intersection of choreography, performance and music. The one-day festival invites you to move through sounding dances and spatial compositions within Simian’s distinctive, resonant spaces. The voice, a sanctuary exceeding the individual body, serves as a thematic entry point for the program. In times of global turmoil, the transgression from individual to collective voice is more important than ever: for protesting, lamenting, and gathering.

Slippery Melody introduces a carefully curated program of choreographic works and music performances, including Magdalena Forster’s vocal experiments with salvaged organ pipes, Deva Schubert’s dissonant, bodily choir, and Luísa Saraiva’s haptic interpretations of traditional folk repertoires. Simin Ramezanali weaves vocal textures with theatrical intensity, while multidisciplinary artist and ballroom dancer Maji Claire presents an uncompromising stage performance. The evening concludes with a rare DJ set by the experimental music producer John T. Gast.

When body becomes voice and voice becomes space, it provides a sounding place we can enter together.

events.description:
DJ Diaki – også kendt som ‘Le President’ – er kendt for at blande energien fra Bamakos hæsblæsende gadefester med elementer af hurtig footwork og brummende drum’n’bass i hvad der er blevet kaldt det ultimative afro rave-udtryk. Fra Berlins klubber til små landsbyer i udkanten af Bamako har han sat ild til dansegulvet. ALICE havde glæden af den maliske pioner i 2021 og nu vender han endelig tilbage til vores venue for fuld udblæsning med 180 BPM.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛

Køb billet: https://alicecph.com/event/dj-diaki-ml/

NB: Koncerten er stående
SCROLL DOWN FOR ENGLISH
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
“The music is 180 BPM. The style calls itself ‘crazy.’ Even as other club music styles accelerate, will this overtake them all?” Resident Advisor
Med rødder i den traditionelle balani-musik fra Bamakos gadefester og blikket rettet mod klubbens ekstase, leverer DJ Diaki et atomisk miks af pumpende trommemaskiner, rå vokal og elektrificerede vestafrikanske kadencer. Hans lyd trækker tråde til sydafrikansk shangaan electro og tanzaniansk singeli – og videre ud i drum’n’bass og footwork. Resultatet er intenst, insisterende og umuligt at stå stille til. Diaki har forfinet sit udtryk gennem mere end 30 år, men han fik sit internationale gennembrud efter sit legendariske Boiler Room-set fra Nyege Nyege Festival i 2019, hvor DJ Marcelle udråbte ham til “The discovery of the Century”. Siden har han indtaget scener verden over – fra Roskilde Festival og CTM til Berghain og Le Guess Who – og udgivet et anmelderrost debutalbum på Nyege Tapes, som The Guardian kårede til månedens album.
Når DJ Diaki går på scenen, kanaliserer han traditionelle rytmer og trækker publikum ind i en kollektiv trance – fra Berlins betonklubber til små landsbyer uden for Bamako. Til daglig er han desuden hovedprogrammør på Sanankoroba Radio, som han selv var med til at grundlægge, og en central figur i Malis spirende elektroniske miljø. Kom og oplev DJ Diakis magiske, grænsesprængende rave-ritual, når han gæster ALICE i maj.
Sagt om DJ Diaki:
“The discovery of the century” DJ Marcelle
“DJ Diaki’s debut is a speeding cascade of sound that skilfully re-creates the pounding atmosphere of Malian street party Balani Show.” The Guardian


⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
In English:
DJ Diaki – also known as ‘Le President’ – is renowned for fusing the high-octane energy of Bamako’s frantic street parties with fast-paced footwork and rumbling drum’n’bass in what has been hailed as the ultimate Afro rave expression. From Berlin’s concrete clubs to small villages on the outskirts of Bamako, he has set dancefloors ablaze. ALICE had the pleasure of hosting the Malian pioneer in 2021, and now he finally returns to our venue for a full-throttle 180 BPM blowout.
"The music is 180 BPM. The style calls itself 'crazy.' Even as other club music styles accelerate, will this overtake them all?" — Resident Advisor
With roots in traditional balani music from Bamako’s street parties and his sights set firmly on club ecstasy, DJ Diaki delivers an atomic blend of pounding drum machines, raw vocals and electrified West African cadences. His sound draws connections to South African shangaan electro and Tanzanian singeli – and stretches further into drum’n’bass and footwork. The result is intense, relentless and impossible to stand still to. Diaki has refined his craft for more than 30 years, but his international breakthrough came after his legendary Boiler Room set at Nyege Nyege Festival in 2019, where DJ Marcelle declared him “The discovery of the Century”. Since then, he has taken over stages worldwide – from Roskilde Festival and CTM to Berghain and Le Guess Who – and released a critically acclaimed debut on Nyege Tapes, named Album of the Month by The Guardian.
When DJ Diaki steps on stage, he channels traditional rhythms and pulls the crowd into a collective trance – from Berlin’s concrete temples to small villages outside Bamako. Alongside his performance work, he is head programmer at Sanankoroba Radio, which he co-founded, and a key figure in Mali’s emerging electronic scene. Come experience DJ Diaki’s magical, boundary-pushing rave ritual when he returns to ALICE this May

events.title: Mother Soki (US) // RUST
events.description:
Mother Soki er blandt en generation af nye artister, som smeder deres egen vej og skaber musik, som tiltrækker fans, der søger efter en sjæleforbindelse.

Mother Soki søger hen mod dream poppens drømmende teksturer og 90’ernes soniske nostalgi. Dagligt drager hun inspiration fra sine omgivelser og hun kanaliserer sin kreativitet igennem klassiske indflydelser som The Sundays, Imogen Heap og Cocteau Twins.

Hendes lyd blander moderne fortolkninger af vintage synths med tunge guitarer og luftige vokaler – en kontrast, som ikke burde fungere, men som alligevel gør. Mother Soki får det uventede til at føles flydende.

Det blev til inspirationen for hitsangen “Rivet Gun”, som udkom i 2025. Sangen resonerede med millioner af fans, hvilket gjorde “Rivet Gun” til en viral sonisk eksplosion. Sangen blev delt over 800 gange på TikTok indenfor 50 timer af dens udgivelse, hvilket resulterede i at sangen blev brugt i videoer mere end 12.000 gange på mindre end otte uger og blev streamet over 4.8 millioner gange globalt.

events.title: Koncert: Hasfeldt pres. 'Play Me Like One of the Others'
events.description:
Oplev Hasfeldt i en stemningsfuld koncert i Nedre Galleri, hvor Nikolaj Kunsthals historiske orgel og rummets højloftede, sakrale arkitektur træder frem som medspillere i en omsluttende lydoplevelse.
Den danske kunstner Martin Jon Hasfeldt bevæger sig i grænselandet mellem billedkunst, performance og musik. Under aliaset Hasfeldt skaber han atmosfæriske kompositioner forankret i ambient, breakbeats og kluborienterede rytmer – et lydunivers der balancerer mellem det nostalgiske og det hjemsøgende. I forbindelse med koncerten inkorporerer Hasfeldt Nikolaj Kunsthals Markussen & Søn-orgel fra 1931.
Efter debutalbummet “If You Ever Need Me” er Hasfeldt nu aktuel med “Play Me Like One of the Others” på det københavnske label REAL LIVE. Udgivelsen tager afsæt i en orgelindspilning fra en nordjysk kirke og er formet som et kollaborativt værk med bidrag fra blandt andre Fatshaudi, Croatian Amor, Francesca Burattelli, Anton Falck (First Hate) og Burning Pyre. Musikken bevæger sig i et mere melodisk, triphop-inspireret landskab uden at give slip på Hasfeldts karakteristiske emotionelle dybde og spøgelsesagtige klang.
Koncertbilletten giver fra 18:30 adgang til Nedre Galleri, der med sine 12 meter til loftet danner ramme om en udstilling af den amerikanske fluxus-kunstner Alison Knowles.
𝐓𝐢𝐝𝐬𝐩𝐥𝐚𝐧:
Kl. 18.30: Dørene åbner. Der er mulighed for at opleve udstillingen “Alison Knowles: Retrospektiv 1960-2022" og proviantere i baren
Kl. 19.30: Koncertstart
Kl. 20.30: Åben bar
Kl. 22.00: Tak for i aften
* In English
Concert * Hasfeldt presents “Play Me like One of the Others”
Experience Hasfeldt in an immersive concert at the Lower Gallery, where Nikolaj Kunsthal’s historic organ and the space’s soaring, sacral architecture become active collaborators in an enveloping sonic experience
Danish artist Martin Jon Hasfeldt works in the spaces between art forms, moving fluidly across visual art, performance, and music production. Under his musical alias Hasfeldt, he gravitates towards ambient atmospheres, breakbeat structures, and club-leaning rhythms, shaping them into a sound that feels both nostalgic and haunting. For this performance, Hasfeldt incorporates Nikolaj Kunsthal’s Markussen & Søn organ from 1931 as a central sonic presence.
Following his debut album “If You Ever Need Me”, Hasfeldt now presents “Play Me Like One of the Others” on the Copenhagen imprint REAL LIVE. The release originates from a Northern Danish church and is built around an extended organ recording, reshaped into a collaborative work featuring Fathsuadi, Croatian Amor, Francesca Burattelli, Anton Falck (First Hate), and Newcastle producer Burning Pyre. In contrast to his earlier work, the music moves closer to the ground, embracing a more melodic, trip-hop-inflected form while retaining Hasfeldt’s characteristic emotional intensity and ghostly atmosphere.
Your concert ticket grants access from 6.30 PM to the Lower Gallery, whose 12-metre-high ceilings currently frame an exhibition by the American Fluxus artist Alison Knowles.

On Thursday, May 14th, FLOOR leans into movement. The format stays locked: one DJ guiding the room from start to finish, giving the music space to stretch and the crowd time to fully arrive. It’s a night built on flow — where energy isn’t forced, but grows naturally.

We start things off with happy hour from 22 to 23: Vodka Dansevand/Maté drinks and Dark ’n’ Stormy for 65,-, and Classic or Pilsner beers for 30,-. Get in early and ease into it.

Behind the booth this week: Delanamnam.

Delanamnam moves with instinct and range, blending Afrobeats, hip-hop, Amapiano, and R&B into sets that feel both smooth and charged. There’s a natural lift in the way he plays: slow moments turning into something more physical, familiar sounds reshaped into something that hits harder. His reputation for creating real atmosphere isn’t accidental; it comes from knowing exactly when to push and when to hold back.

No need to say much more, apart from: No requests, OK?! Leave it to the booth, let loose, and dance. Ses på FLOOR!

events.title: Alpha Maid (UK)
events.description:
Den produktive sydøstlondonske guitarist og sangskriver Alpha Maid har i årevis forfinet sit tågede, DIY-drevne udtryk, der bevæger sig mellem skramlet produktion, dub og fragmenterede vokaler. På hendes seneste anmelderroste album “Is This a Queue” (AD 93, 2025) forener Alpha Maid sin karakteristiske lyd med en sangskrivning, der står knivskarpt i egen ret. Vi er glade for at kunne præsentere Alpha Maid, når hun indtager ALICE i maj.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
Køb billet i forsalg: 140 dkk eksl. gebyr / Ung under 25 (eller studerende): 120 dkk eksl. gebyr
Billetter: https://alicecph.com/event/alpha-maid-uk/
Lyt: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gKu3dnFnOpQ
NB: Koncerten er stående
SCROLL DOWN FOR ENGLISH
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
Siden debuten i 2019 på CURL – kollektivet grundlagt af bl.a. Mica Levi,Coby Sey og Brother May – har Alpha Maid aka Leisha Thomas været en stille, men markant stemme på Londons eksperimenterende scene. Hendes musik bærer tydelige spor af dette fællesskab med støvede teksturer, dissonante guitarklange og en underliggende følelse af uro. Samtidig trækker Alpha Maid på dubtraditioner, der peger tilbage på hendes jamaicanske rødder og Windrush-generationens kulturelle arv.
Efter mere end syv år og utallige samarbejder og EP-udgivelser på London-scenen, er Alpha Maids ude med “Is This a Queue” (AD 93, 2025). Albummet er skrevet over flere år og på tværs af steder – og det kan høres. Det føles som en samling øjeblikke, mennesker og stemninger, der langsomt folder sig ud i et råt og sanseligt lydunivers. Hendes guitar fungerer som det konstante omdrejningspunkt, mens numrene bevæger sig mellem tågede lydflader, skrøbelige melodier og emo-agtige glimt af intimitet. Albummet, der er skabt med gæsteoptræden fra bl.a. Valentina Magaletti, er blevet hyldet af medier som The Guardian og Boomkat og sikrede også Alpha Maid et spot på Le Guess Who. Nu er det heldigvis blevet ALICEs tur til at præsentere den visionære guitarist og vi kan ikke vente.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
In English:
The prolific South East London guitarist and songwriter Alpha Maid has spent years refining her hazy, DIY-driven expression, moving between lo-fi production, dub, and fragmented vocals. On her latest critically acclaimed album “Is This a Queue” (AD 93, 2025), Alpha Maid brings together her distinctive sound with songwriting that stands sharply on its own. We’re excited to present Alpha Maid as she takes over ALICE this May.
Since her debut in 2019 on CURL—the collective founded by artists including Mica Levi, Coby Sey, and Brother May—Alpha Maid, aka Leisha Thomas, has been a quiet yet striking voice on London’s experimental scene. Her music clearly reflects this community, with dusty textures, dissonant guitar tones, and an underlying sense of unease. At the same time, Alpha Maid draws on dub traditions that point back to her Jamaican roots and the cultural legacy of the Windrush generation.
After more than seven years and countless collaborations and EP releases on the London scene, Alpha Maid returns with “Is This a Queue” (AD 93, 2025). The album was written over several years and across different places—and you can hear it. It feels like a collection of moments, people, and moods that gradually unfold into a raw and sensory soundscape. Her guitar serves as the constant focal point, while the tracks move between hazy textures, fragile melodies, and emo-tinged flashes of intimacy. Created with guest appearances from artists including Valentina Magaletti, the album has been praised by outlets such as The Guardian and Boomkat, and also earned Alpha Maid a spot at Le Guess Who?. Now it’s finally ALICE’s turn to present the visionary guitarist—and we can’t wait.

events.description:
French techno artist Moteka brings his unique and improvised live set to Copenhagen, combining machines and software to create a raw, hypnotic vibe on the dancefloor.

Moteka leans towards a minimalistic and restrained approach, inspired by the classics of the English techno scene such as Surgeon and Planetary Assault Systems. Percussive and dark, his music often reveals oneiric and melancholic sonic landscapes, reflecting his passion for analog synthesizers. Moteka releases on the French label Skryptöm and is also a regular on the London-based label Children of Tomorrow, as well as appearing on Sotor Records and Mary Go Wild. We’re very excited to bring him to Copenhagen for the first time, joined by local support from Kallax and Holtz. MDK takes over Red Box with special guest Elvi from Sidequest Records, straight from Ibiza, joined by main man Geroge. Expect a night of pure underground energy.

events.description:
Join the cirkus for a night of heavy bouncy Indie Dance. CIRKUS GALORE residents Anders HP, Business Risky, CERJ, joa picaro and local icon Rexie Lex, are teaming up with legendary Daniel Neuland (44 Hertz) for one night only.
Daniel Neuland is a heavy hitter with releases on Tipping Point and his genre defining sound is regularly melting clubs like Kater Blau and Sisyphos and completely blew our minds with his last Fusion Festival performance.
This is one you don’t wanna miss!

Daniel Neuland (DE)
Daniel Neuland, born in 1988, is a German music producer and DJ from Berlin.
In 2019, Daniel Neuland fell for Berlin's techno hype and has been producing and performing under his own name ever since. His sound can be located somewhere between indie dance and tech house, whereby he always incorporates his musical roots from hip hop and dubstep into his productions. This mixture has enabled him to prove himself as an innovative creative mind within the techno scene.
As co-founder of his own label, 44 Hertz, "Neuli" has been releasing his songs by himself since 2023. In the same year, the event series of the same name found its home in the infamous Kater Blau and has radiated far beyond the capital.
"Neuli" can be heard regularly in Berlin clubs such as Kater Blau, Sisyphos, KitKat and Ritter Butzke, but he is also a regular guest outside the city and beyond the country's borders. He has released on other well-known labels such as Heinz Music, Hollystone Records and SNOE and is celebrated for his playful productions and dedicated performances. Neuland is known for his passion for music and his ability to combine different styles of electronic music and create something new on the dancefloor.

events.title: D-STRING - Prometheus (live concert & Sounds Good afterparty)
events.description:
Five songs. Five elements. One theft that changed everything. "D-STRING - Prometheus" moves through an ancient hero's journey as a live musical ritual - guided by a voice, anchored in the body, structured as a ceremony and played with old world and new world instruments. Rituals mark each threshold - gesture, movement, and symbol made flesh. Greek myth, Norse ritual, and alchemical tradition as the architecture, taking us into older layers of our collective past.

D-STRING is a multiinstrumentalist duo formed by Edgar Fortea - violinist, producer- alongside bassist and keyboardist Ian Natanael. Their sound sits at the intersection of classical roots and electronic structures, drawing from flamenco, latin, rock, funk, and contemporary production. Strings, synths, and sequencers - live electronic music that feels physical, present, and alive. Embodying the ritual is Giorgia Reitani, a Copenhagen based dancer and choreographer working across Europe. Her practice is grounded in contemporary dance and physical theatre, where the movement research is enriched by the emotional journey behind it.

In a single experience beyond genre, Prometheus, a spark in D-STRING's universe, brings a bold invitation to steal the Sacred Fire, to kindle our individual flames, and dance around our own self-made bonfires.

The concert will follow with an afterparty by Sounds Good collective until 3am.

Friday, May 15th, 2200! shifts into a more textured space, where detail and drive meet on the dance floor. The night moves between hip-hop, house, and UK-influenced club sounds, with enough room for both sharp transitions and longer stretches of groove. It’s one for those who stay curious and stay late.

Malika Mahmoud
Malika Mahmoud brings intention and perspective to the booth, with sets that balance cultural awareness and club functionality. Moving through hip-hop, R&B, and global club sounds, she creates a space that feels open, expressive, and grounded in community. There’s both purpose and play in the way she builds a room.

Slackin Beats (SE)
Slackin Beats leans into groove-heavy club music, working across house, garage, disco, and breaks with a light but precise touch. His sets are built on edits, blends, and original material, giving familiar elements a slightly off-center feel. The result is a sound that’s warm, rhythmic, and easy to stay locked into.

House rules still apply: No requests, OK?! Let go of control, trust the mix, and stay with it.

events.title: Local Circuit w/ TS Kahuna & Fergus Jones
events.description:
Local Circuit is back 💕 friday at jolene, six hours, two versatile selectors, one dark red tinted room — strictly necessary ingredients for a night to remember.  
This round: Fergus Jones and TS Kahuna. Solo sets and b2b stretches that let the music breathe and find its own logic, without pre-arranged dynamics.   Boomkat once called him “one of the underground’s key, if liminal, hyper-connectors,” which is a lot of words, yet not enough to quite track the genius running in the Scottish born, Copenhagen raised Fergus Jones.  
When not head down solo-managing his label FELT, climbing rocks, cooking masterpieces in the studio or touring some of the best clubs in the world, sometimes he finds the time and energy to delight Copenhagen dance floors of the city with his spacey, tripped out and wildly unpredictable music taste.

Our own Radio Panini mastermind, TS Kahuna is a self-described generalist who folds psychedelic polyrhythms into 4/4 tools and dubbed-out tension into emotional sucker-punches. 15k something tracks on the hard drive, a long radio life through Spazio Aperto on Noods, Radio Raheem, Operator and Threads — the man did his homework, and it shows.

The back to back should be the thing — two selectors with enough in common to lock in, enough difference to keep it from going where you expect.

events.title: Sanyu (NO)
events.description:
Sanyu (NO) skaber et intenst og genreåbent liveunivers, hvor RnB, jazz, spoken word og elektroniske teksturer flettes sammen i et sjælfuldt og energisk koncertformat.
●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○
Venue: Musikcaféen, 3. etage
Døre: 20:00
Show: 21:00
Entré: 120 kr. // Studerende 60 kr.
●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○
Sanyu har de seneste år spillet på festivaler som Øya, Trondheim Calling og jævnligt på Jazzfestivaler i både Oslo og København. Hendes debut-EP, Now You Hear It, blev beskrevet som "et bevis på ægte kunstnerskab og dedikation til håndværket" af Beehype og udvalgt til deres samling af «Best Albums of 2024». Derudover blev hendes musikvideo til "You Don't Hear It (Do You?)" udvalgt til deres samling af de bedste musikvideoer fra 2024. Alligevel giver EP'en kun en forsmag på, hvad du kan forvente at opleve live. Den udkom i oktober 2024 og blev fulgt af en turné med koncerter i Tyskland, Danmark, Sverige og Norge i vinteren 2025.
Med baggrund i old school RnB og improvisation er hendes liveoptrædener præget af et sjælfuldt udtryk med varme harmonier, men også leg med rap og groove-baserede riffs i et lydbillede, hvor akustisk og elektronisk er tæt vævet sammen. "Hendes beslutsomme og udforskende sjæl blandet med taktile spoken word og hamrende jazz leveres til publikum med en energi, der varer hele aftenen." Hendes koncert på VillVillVest blev beskrevet som "den helt klart største oplevelse under festivalen". På scenen har hun nogle af de mest markante musikere i den unge norske jazz og elektroniske musikscene med sig. Rino Sivathas på trommer, multiinstrumentalist, Kristina Fransson og Joachim Mørch Meyer på kontrabas, udviser både en ro og eksplosivitet i deres musikskabelse med hinanden.
“Absolut den største oplevelse under festivalen” -Ellisiv Sunde Myrva, Bergens Tidene
"Sikke en stemme, med masser af mørk glød, variation og noget på hjerte, og sikke et fængslende og sjælfuldt udtryk, som tydeligvis hentede energi fra alle mulige musikalske spændingsfelter." - Mads Kornum, All That DK
"Hun er umulig at kategorisere, men alt, hvad hun gør, udstråler musikalitet" -Engelsholm Events
●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○
ENG.
Sanyu (NO) delivers an intense, genre-bending live experience where RnB, jazz, spoken word and electronic textures merge into a soulful and high-energy concert.
Described by Gaffa as “an artist who gives the finger to all music journalist who wish to lock artists up in industry-formed genre-categories” Sanyus has created her very own genre-bending sound with confidence. Her debut EP “Now You Hear It” was described as “a testament to true artistry and dedication to the craft” by Beehype and chosen as their Norwegian Pick for “Best Albums of 2024”, and in october 2025 she was granted the lyric award by Norways compser & songwriters assosiation for her poem “You Don’t Hear It (Do You?)”. Already having performed at several festivals in Norway, Denmark, Sweden, Germany and Egypt, Sanyu is due to release her debut album in march 2026. The release of “Latent” will be followed by several shows throughout northern Europe.
With a background in RnB and improvisation, her music bears the stamp of a soulful expression with warm harmonies, but also plays around with rap and groove-based riffs. Her determined and exploratory soul interspersed with tactile spoken word and hammering jazz charges her listeners with an energy where her lyrics are at the core of what drives her performances. In March 2025 she was awarded the “lyspunkt” prize by the Norwegian Lyricist Fund for her lyrical works of the previous year.
On the stage she is joined by some of the most distinct sounding musicians from Norway’s jazz and electronic music scene. Drummer, Rino Sivathas, multiinstrumentalist Kristina Fransson and double bass player, Joachim Mørch Meyer all display both composure and explosiveness through their interplay with each other.
“By far the greatest experience during the festival” -Ellisiv Sunde Myrva, Bergens Tidene
"What a voice, with lots of dark glow, variation and something on her mind, and what a captivating and soulful expression, which clearly draws upon all sorts of musical fields of reference." - Mads Kornum, All That DK
“She is impossible to categorise, but everything she does exudes musicality” -Engelsholm Events

events.title: Lua De Santana (BR/ES)
events.description:
Med rødder i både Brasilien og Spanien forener Lua de Santana baile funk, soul, urban og eksperimenterende klublyde til et intenst og dragende udtryk. events.title: Lucrecia Dalt (CO)
events.description:
Lucrecia Dalt har det med at printe sig ind på publikums nethinde med sine dybt fascinerende koncerter, hvor elektronisk musik, dramatiske rytmer og sanselig tilstedeværelse går op i en højere enhed. Vi har flere gange haft fornøjelsen af Dalt solo på ALICE, men til maj indtager den colombianske sangerinde og multiinstrumentalist vores scene med fuldt band. Med sig har hun det anmelderroste og dybt personlige nye album “A Danger to Ourselves” (2025), der har navne som Juana Molina på listen over samarbejdspartnere.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛

⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
Lucrecia Dalt har en usædvanlig baggrund som geoteknisk ingeniør, og netop mødet mellem det naturvidenskabelige og det kunstneriske er en grundpille i hendes musik. Hendes kompositioner bevæger sig i et ambient og futuristisk lydunivers, hvor abstrakte, dragende rytmer, teksturer og elektroniske detaljer flettes sammen med et intenst lag af vokaler og spoken word. Teksterne har især på tidligere udgivelser trukket på begreber fra geoscience og kvantefysik og forvandler dem til poetiske refleksioner over eksistens, relationer og verdens skrøbelighed.
Siden de tidlige udgivelser har Lucrecia Dalt markeret sig som en af de mest originale stemmer på den internationale eksperimenterende musikscene. Med albumtrilogien “Anticlines”, “No era sólida” og det prisbelønnede “¡Ay!” på RVNG Intl. har hun for alvor cementeret sin position, ligesom hendes arbejde med film- og tv-scores har udvidet hendes lydlige univers. Senest har hun udgivet “A Danger to Ourselves” – et mere indadvendt og personligt værk, hvor stemmen står klarere, og musikken kredser om kærlighed, sårbarhed og menneskets indre landskaber. Albummet er skabt med bidrag fra bl.a. David Sylvian, Camille Mandoki og ALICE-aktuelle Juana Molina. På scenen er Lucrecia Dalt kendt for at skabe en intens og nærværende koncertoplevelse, hvor publikum inviteres ind i et lydligt rum, der både føles intimt og kosmisk. Lucrecia Dalt har spillet både på Roskilde Festival og ALICE, og vi glæder os til at byde hende velkommen tilbage til maj, når hun indtager vores scene med fuldt band.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
In English:
Lucrecia Dalt has a way of imprinting herself on the audience’s mind with her deeply captivating concerts, where electronic music, dramatic rhythms, and a sensual stage presence merge into a powerful whole. We have had the pleasure of hosting Dalt solo at ALICE on several occasions, but this May the Colombian singer and multi-instrumentalist returns to our stage with a full band. She brings with her the critically acclaimed and deeply personal new album A Danger to Ourselves (2025), featuring collaborators such as Juana Molina.
Lucrecia Dalt has an unusual background as a geotechnical engineer, and the meeting point between natural science and artistic expression forms a cornerstone of her music. Her compositions unfold within an ambient and futuristic sound universe, where abstract, hypnotic rhythms, textures, and electronic details intertwine with an intense layer of vocals and spoken word. Especially on earlier releases, her lyrics have drawn on concepts from geoscience and quantum physics, transforming them into poetic reflections on existence, relationships, and the fragility of the world.
Since her early releases, Lucrecia Dalt has established herself as one of the most original voices on the international experimental music scene. With the album trilogy Anticlines, No era sólida, and the award-winning ¡Ay! on RVNG Intl., she has firmly cemented her position, while her work with film and television scores has further expanded her sonic universe. Most recently, she released A Danger to Ourselves—a more introspective and personal work in which the voice stands clearer and the music revolves around love, vulnerability, and the inner landscapes of the human mind. The album features contributions from, among others, David Sylvian, Camille Mandoki, and ALICE-regular Juana Molina. On stage, Lucrecia Dalt is known for creating an intense and immersive concert experience, inviting the audience into a sonic space that feels both intimate and cosmic. Having performed at both Roskilde Festival and ALICE, we look forward to welcoming her back this May, when she takes over our stage with a full band.

events.title: Zé Ibarra (DR)
events.description:
Med velourblød vokal, episke blæsere og en forførende rytmesektion, udforsker brasilianske Zé Ibarra lydlandskaber, der forener bossa nova og samba med jazz og pop. Efter en uforglemmelig Roskilde Festival-koncert med sin gruppe Bala Desejo, vender den grammyvindende sanger, sangskriver og multiinstrumentalist nu tilbage til Danmark med sit soloprojekt og fylder ALICEs sal med vellyd ud over det sædvanlige.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛

Køb billet: https://alicecph.com/event/ze-ibarra-br/

NB: Koncerten er stående
SCROLL DOWN FOR ENGLISH
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
Zé Ibarra er en af de mest fremtrædende skikkelser fra den nye bølge af brasilianske kunstnere. I tråd med navne som Bruno Berle og Nyron Higor, og som medstifter af den prisvindende gruppe Bala Desejo, skubber han til grænserne for Música Popular Brasileira – arven fra 1960’ernes Brasilien, hvor traditionelle genrer som samba og bossa nova mødte pop, jazz og rock. Ibarras lyd er groovy, nostalgisk og mættet af varme blæsere, akustisk guitar og en levende rytmesektion. Hans vokal er sensuel og elegant med kærlige ekkoer af João Gilberto, og live besidder han en sjælden evne til at tryllebinde sit publikum.
Med rødder i bandet Dônica og som en del af den Grammy-vindende gruppe Bala Desejo – der begejstrede publikum på Roskilde i 2023 – har Zé Ibarra desuden optrådt med ikoner som Milton Nascimento. Og hans imponerende arbejde som soloartist har kun oversteget forventningerne hos publikum og kritikere. På sit seneste udspil “AFIM” (Coala Records) bevæger Ibarra sig fra det intime, akustiske guitarbaserede udtryk og over i en mørkere og mere visuelt slående lyd, hvor hver tone udfolder sig som et levende maleri. Kom selv og oplev det, når han indtager ALICEs scene med sit band til maj.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
In English:
With velvet-soft vocals, sweeping horns, and a seductive rhythm section, Brazilian artist Zé Ibarra explores sonic landscapes that unite bossa nova and samba with jazz and pop. Following an unforgettable Roskilde Festival performance with his group Bala Desejo, the Grammy-winning singer, songwriter, and multi-instrumentalist now returns to Denmark with his solo project, filling ALICE’s concert hall with extraordinarily soothing sounds.
Zé Ibarra is one of the most prominent figures in the new wave of Brazilian artists. Alongside names such as Bruno Berle and Nyron Higor, and as co-founder of the award-winning group Bala Desejo, he pushes the boundaries of Música Popular Brasileira—the legacy of 1960s Brazil, where traditional genres like samba and bossa nova met pop, jazz, and rock. Ibarra’s sound is groovy and nostalgic, saturated with warm horns, acoustic guitar, and a vibrant rhythm section. His vocals are sensual and elegant, carrying affectionate echoes of João Gilberto, and live he possesses a rare ability to captivate audiences completely.
With roots in the band Dônica and as a member of the Grammy-winning Bala Desejo—who enchanted audiences at Roskilde in 2023—Zé Ibarra has also performed alongside icons such as Milton Nascimento. As a solo artist, he has continued to surpass expectations from both audiences and critics. On his latest release, AFIM (Coala Records), Ibarra moves from an intimate, acoustic guitar-based expression toward a darker and more visually striking sound, where each note unfolds like a living painting. Experience it for yourself when he takes the stage at ALICE with his band this May.

events.title: Melodi Ghazal + Tiffi M (SE) // Byhaven
events.description:
Den 22. maj er der fri entré til koncerterne med Melodi Ghazal og Tiffi M i Byhaven. Vi åbner kl. 15.00 og musikken starter kl. 19.00. Yeerro serverer lækre gyros fra kl. 17.00 og baren bugner naturligvis af lækre Brooklyn-øl, naturvin og cocktails.
Melodi Ghazal
Melodi Ghazal er sanger, sangskriver og producer med iransk baggrund fra København. Hun skaber left-field pop med elementer af r’n’b og folk, kendetegnet ved et særegent tonesprog og en stærk melodisk sensibilitet. I sine produktioner forener hun elektroniske og akustiske lag, hvor midi-strygere, daf-trommerytmer gemt i groovet, og guitarteksturer flettes sammen. Melodi arbejder med at skabe en særlig balance mellem melankoli og håb, vævet sammen af hendes dragende vokal og lyrik, som bevæger sig ubesværet mellem engelsk og persisk.
Tiffi M
Tiffi M er en svensk artist og spirende stemme på den alternative popscene, med en lyd der blander følelsesladet historiefortælling med dynamiske og atmosfæriske produktioner. Hun har skabt en unik lydidentitet, der kombinerer trommebreaks, legende samples og strygere med autotunede vokaler og oprigtige tekster. Hendes debutalbum "Heartstrings" udkom i efteråret 2025 og indeholder 10 numre, der udforsker personlige temaer som længsel, forbindelse og introspektion gennem rå og reflekteret sangskrivning.
Hendes musikalske samarbejder tæller bl.a. danske A Good Year, svenske Horse Vision og den amerikanske kunstner Quiet Light.

Jolene Invites with Big Leg (DE) & Tania Just
events.description:
Jolene Invites is back — and this one's got an edge to it. Essex-born, Berlin-sharpened eccentrism meets the warm, dancefloor-rooted selections of one of Copenhagen's most trusted figures. One small room, no fuss, no wasted sets.

The series does what it says on the tin: it brings people into Jolene whose relationship with music is obvious the moment they touch the decks. Never banal, never predictable. 

Big Leg arrives from Germany carrying a hard to categorise sound that lives at the more introspective, swampy end of the electronic spectrum, yet often venturing in cross-genres journeys from dub to drum and bass via house and more. The kind of selector who builds with patience — deep, textured, unhurried — and who understands that a room this size rewards a long game rather than a headline moment. Think hypnotic house and rolling, dub-tinged techno that shifts gradually rather than announces itself, dense with atmosphere and rooted in an aesthetic that owes something to the weirder corners of the UK and German club scenes.

Tania Just is one of those Copenhagen selectors who knows exactly who she's playing for — and it shows. Co-founder of the Berlin party series Fandango and the driving force behind Essence, Denmark's finest daytime gathering, she brings a warmth and fluency to her sets that's been earned over years of playing for the right reasons. Her selections move through deep house and adjacent territory with an ease that feels natural rather than calculated — dancefloor-focused, soulful, never showy. She knows this room and this room knows her.

Come early, stay late, bring someone who understands that the best dancefloor in the city doesn't need to be the loudest one.

Toolroom's MARK KNIGHT jets to Copenhagen. This is huge!

Mark Knight stands among the most respected names in global house music, with a career spanning over three decades. At the core of his universe is Toolroom Records, one of the most influential labels in house music, consistently shaping dancefloors and artists alike. As both label head and producer, Knight continues a relentless stream of releases, collaborations and club-driven records that resonate across international lineups. His enduring impact was even honoured with the EDMA Icon Award—recognising a career defined by longevity, discipline and unwavering dedication to the culture.

Mark Knight receives strong support from Sol:Luna resident Denize (of the ANEK duo and Steve Lawler’s VIVa MUSiC) and FYNUTZU, fresh off releases on Red Alert, Adesso Music, and CookEe Jar Records. ESKI from ØVSA and MURPHY from Hamburg, Germany will keep the Red Box energized all night.

Mythologen is the alias of artist, designer and musician Alexander Palmestål from Gothenburg, Sweden. His early demos began circulating in 2002 as Pistol Disco, combining his love for Acid House, Bleep, and Kraut-influenced Techno to critical acclaim. This momentum led to international tours and releases on influential indie labels.
As a dance music producer he is inspired by House, 00's Scandinavian Electro and the eternal motorik pulse that haunts the highways of Europe.
His album, Eurovision was released on June 6th, 2025 via YEAR0001.

events.description:
Den 28. maj er der fri entré til koncerterne med mikey og Minais B i Byhaven. Vi åbner kl. 15.00 og musikken starter kl. 19.00. Yeerro serverer lækre gyros fra kl. 17.00 og baren bugner naturligvis af lækre Brooklyn-øl, naturvin og cocktails.
mikey
Den alternative popduo mikey, bestående af Maiken Kock Rask og Henrik Koefod Petersen, laver nærværende musik om livets eksistentielle spørgsmål på den anden side af de 30 år. Rejsen begyndte med debutsinglen "don’t wait" i marts 2025, som først introducerede mikeys ærlige, rå og autentiske musikunivers, der ifølge duoen er guidet mere af intuition end af en fastlåst samarbejdsform. For mikey handler musikken om at give plads til det uforudsigelige, hvilket gennemsyrer EP’en “first notes”, som både trækker på ultraelektroniske elementer og akustiske instrumenter, der giver deres musik et unikt udtryk, som både udviser en sårbarhed og en styrke.
Når mikey indtager Byhaven den 28. maj, er det deres første ægte koncert, og duoen garanterer at folde deres univers ud og invitere dig helt tæt ind.
Minais B
Bag kunstnernavnet Minais B står komponist og producer Villads Klint. Hans kompositioner er præget af en legende tilgang, hvor kontrasterende musikalske idéer væves sammen til nye fortællinger. Temaer som tab og transformation udgør en rød tråd i Klints værker, som spænder over syntetiske orgelsalmer til musik udgivet som fugtighedscreme. På sin seneste udgivelse ‘And i know i can feel bad when i get in a bad mood’ træder Klints vokal for første gang i forgrunden og udfolder en ærlig og melodisk refleksion over følelser af tvivl, skam og længsel.

Køb billet via Ticketmaster fra fredag den 27. november kl. 10.
----------
Massive Attack indtager Royal Arena!
Den 1. juni 2026 kan danske fans opleve Massive Attack live i Royal Arena, når de forvandler arenaen til et mørkt, pulserende og filmisk lydunivers midt i København.
Massive Attack opstod i begyndelsen af 90’erne og markerede sig hurtigt med deres hypnotiske fusion af tunge hiphop-rytmer, soulede melodier, dybe dub-basser og elektroniske teksturer. Med klassikere som ’Blue Lines’, ’Protection’ og det skelsættende ’Mezzanine’ satte de en ny standard for, hvordan elektronisk musik kunne lyde. Med ’Mezzanine’-albummet toppede de hitlisterne i Storbritannien, som virkelig cementerede gruppens status som et af sin generations absolut mest toneangivende og kompromisløse navne.
Med rødder i Bristol har duoen Robert “3D” Del Naja og Grant “Daddy G” Marshall gennem tre årtier forenet musik, politik og banebrydende visuals i liveproduktioner, hvor lyd, lys og budskaber smelter sammen i én samlet, overvældende fortælling.
Senest begejstrede de et dansk publikum på NorthSide i 2024 – der blandt andet udløste en seksstjernet anmeldelse af Soundvenue – og når de vender tilbage til dansk jord, kan publikum endnu engang se frem til at opleve ikoniske numre som ”Teardrop”, ”Unfinished Sympathy” og ”Safe from Harm” – sange, der ikke blot har defineret en æra, men fortsat sætter spor i nye generationer af kunstnere og lyttere verden over.

events.title: PRAED in København
events.description:
02.06.26: Praed (LB)

Kaleidoscopic shaabi meets spiritual jazz and trippy techno

In connection with the duo’s new album, Al Wahem الوهم, the Swiss-Lebanese experimentalists Praed return to Copenhagen with their ecstatic fusion of Arabic party music, psychedelic jazz, and hypnotic techno.



Date: Tuesday 02.06.26

Doors: 19:30

Show: 20:00

Price: 140 dkr in presale + fee / 165 dkr at the door

Venue: Basement, Enghavevej 42, 1674 København V

Buy tickets



Praed (LB)

The Swiss-Lebanese duo Praed have just released their sixth album, Al Wahem الوهم, and are marking the occasion with a return to Copenhagen, once again inviting local audiences into their captivating blend of hypnotic shaabi and ecstatic electronic music.


For two decades, the duo have pushed the boundaries of how far Arabic party music can be stretched. When Raed Yassin’s electronic, kaleidoscopic beats meet Paed Conca’s wailing clarinet, they open up a rich sonic landscape where Lebanese wedding music effortlessly draws from spiritual jazz, krautrock’s motorik rhythms, and techno’s driving trance. The result sits somewhere between ecstatic devotional music and gritty underground energy.


Since 2020, they have explored shaabi in an orchestral format with the releases PRAED Orchestra! and its follow-up The Dictionary of Lost Meanings (2025), which was described by The Wire as “blissfully swirling and mesmeric music". Now, Praed return to their original duo format with Al Wahem الوهم, where, across four extended tracks, they once again reinvent their potent and immersive electronic fusion, still sounding both timeless and entirely their own.

events.title: Black Coffee - Copenhagen City Hall Square
events.description:
The monumental backdrop of Rådhuspladsen sets the stage for absolute summer vibes on the City Hall Square with global phenomenon Black Coffee on Wednesday 3 June 2026.

As a true cultural icon and Grammy-award winner who has collaborated with anyone from Drake to Alicia Keys, Diplo and David Guetta, he has solidified his status as one of the most influential artists of our time.

His signature style blends deep, soulful house with African percussion into an immersive musical experience that is both intimate and powerful — which he has brought to the world’s biggest stages including Burning Man, Tomorrowland, and Coachella, as well as a historic sold-out performance at Madison Square Garden.

Black Coffee will be joined by global house producer Shoba, afro house rising star Meera, and local talents Skai and Youss. The event is co-hosted by legendary producer duo party makers TMLH, ensuring a solid DJ set and the wildest opening day of Distortion.

This is a once in a lifetime — secure your ticket now before it's too late.

events.title: Nuovo Testamento (IT/US) // RUST
events.description:
Den Los Angeles-baserede trio Nuovo Testamento har i de seneste år indtaget dansegulve verden over med deres unikke blanding af mørk Italo-disco og synthmættet pop. Tænk alle dine yndlingshits fra synth-æraen tilsat en moderne pop-æstetik og sange, der borer sig ind i hjernen og bliver der.

Deres debut-EP Exposure fra 2019 viste tydeligt deres musikalske talent og gjorde dem hurtigt til favoritter på goth-klubscenen. Men det var opfølgeren New Earth fra 2021, der for alvor cementerede trioens dark-pop-evner og sikrede dem en plads blandt de hurtigst voksende stjerner på den alternative scene.

Deres seneste EP Trouble (2025) indkapsler de 80’er- og 90’er-indflydelser, som gruppen holder så meget af – en sammensmeltning af freestyle, synthpop og alternativ musik i et sammenhængende (og dansabelt) lydunivers.

Med krystalklar moderne produktion og boblende sangskrivning har Nuovo Testamento skabt en frisk og umiskendelig lyd, der helt er deres egen.

events.title: Distortion Club: Extrawelt
events.description:
Distortion Club: Extrawelt @ Den Anden Side

Thursday, June 4 │ Soft Selection│ Minimal Techno, Tech House

————

True to tradition, Den Anden Side is opening our doors for Distortion Club. This year we are proud to present a one of a kind live performance by pioneers Extrawelt, and an electrifying DJ set by Anastasia Kristensen.
The event is free for guests with a Distortion Festival Pass.

𝗟𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘂𝗽
Extrawelt (live) [he/him | he/him]
Anastasia Kristensen [she/they]

Living and breathing electronic music for over twenty years, Arne Schaffhausen and Wayan Raabe have carved out their own place in dance music history. Starting as DJs before moving into production through Hamburg’s X-Dream studio, their early projects Midimiliz and Spirallianz gained major recognition. In 2005, they launched Extrawelt, marking a new musical direction. Their debut release, “Soopertrack,” was picked up by James Holden’s Border Community label, launching a career filled with acclaimed records, remixes, and live performances at leading clubs and festivals worldwide.

Their debut album Schöne Neue Extrawelt was widely celebrated, winning “Best Album 2008” by Groove Magazine and Raveline, which also named them “Best Live Act.” Their second album In Aufruhr followed in 2011 on Cocoon Recordings to similar acclaim. Known for their hardware-driven live performances, Extrawelt have spent over a decade refining a sound defined by spontaneity, technical precision, and deep sonic exploration.

With their third album Fear of an Extra Planet arriving in 2017 and their fourth, Unknown, in 2018, Extrawelt continued pushing boundaries with bold compositions that balance techno’s roots with futuristic innovation. Their live shows remain at the core of their identity, constantly evolving while honoring the purity of electronic music’s past and future.

WHAT IS SUPECOLOR?
An homage to a time where experiences of color spectrums in music, dancefloors and people were truly aspirational!

SUPERCOLOR draws from the spirit of an era where limitations in technology sparked creativity, and innovation had a human touch. Drum machines clicked, synths shimmered, and imperfections became texture. The dancefloor wasn’t content, it was community. events.title: Gintė Preisaitė release concert / Emil Palme (support)
events.description:
A body with its skin torn off. A raw approach to songwriting, moving through beloved paths of acoustic timbres, drones, and analogue sound processing. Fragile and emotional, it is shaped by a deeply personal sense of where composition begins and ends, filled with magical realism and folky, ethereal modes.
“I wanted to open up to my sensuality and be bold in that sense, coming closer to who I truly am in sound. This time, I allowed my voice to reveal hidden melodies within my body, and I surrendered to it. The lyrics emerged through fantasy, absurdity, and relationships, mostly love for other beings and the world, taking on different forms and shapes throughout the album-making process. At times devastatingly crushing, but also purifying. Each piece holds its own world and journey, yet they weave together coherently with the help of an incredible ensemble of strings, brass, and accordion, guitar, prepared piano. I am deeply thankful to every soul who became part of it.”
Gintė Preisaitė is a Lithuanian artist based in Copenhagen, where she composes and improvises with piano and electronics. Through a variety of timbres, textures, collaged melodies, and percussive figures, she finds the thin spaces of transcendence and transformation between acoustic instrumentation and the electronic processing of contemporary compositions. She moves between ambient, drone, and experimental songwriting, exploring themes of escapism and memory through sound. Collisions pile up as ideas meet between her classical and improvisational background, and playful, sample-based material, focusing on instrumental timbres, extended techniques, and earthy vocals.
As an improvising pianist and composer, she has performed and collaborated with artists such as Toshimaru Nakamura, Sachiko M,
and Kenny Wollesen, and has opened for artists like Drew McDowall and Rafael Toral. During her time at RMC, she also
composed music for larger ensembles, including the octet
Octesonance and the quintet Stochastic Meditation.
BAND:
Thora Kidon Jæger- double bass
Rémy Goufault- drums,electronics
Jon Lipscomb- guitar
Ginte Preisaite-vocal, electronics, guitar,piano

Support: Emil Palme
Emil Palme is an experimental composer and guitarist from Copenhagen, whose practice is rooted in Scandinavian experimental music and folklore.
His second solo work, 'Death by angel' is a doomsday requiem that illuminates the path from this life to the afterlife. Death by angel is inspired by ancient mythology – the idea of ​​the angel of death guiding our souls through the unknown. The release consists of ten movements, each symbolizing nature's indisputable paths that all living beings are bound and destined to walk. Death by angel represents the dissonance and harmony that is inherent in our view of beauty and mystery. By stroking and scratching the strings of his instrument with homemade stone bows, the Danish artist conjures fascinating ceremonial patterns that unfold in the misty no-man's land between composition and improvisation. There is a kind of primal quality to the music that
seems to be the sum of all its parts. A melancholic, magnificent and otherworldly essence that calls for forgotten worlds, created through a modern, neoclassical approach.
Emil Palme is an unconventional and extremely creative artist who, in addition to his solo project, is active in, among others, Portal Pets, which is performing at this year's Roskilde Festival, and in the two bands Baujillaud and Yngel.

events.title: Jay Tripwire / Ricardo Roessel
events.description:
BAGGEN
Friday, 5 June 
Doors 11PM

// Jay Tripwire //

Always sitting slightly off-center, Jay Tripwire is an artist that walks the line as an industry staple and ever changing innovator, releasing one standout release after another.

A career spanning two decades, with over 200 vinyl releases, 2 commercial mixed cd compilations, and four full length albums. He remains one of the most prolific artists around, with an average of 15 releases per year.

Jay has made appearances in over 200 cities worldwide, and some of his most memorable gigs have been a decade of bookings at Fabric London- a venue that has changed his approach to Djing, and production sound. Jay’s work has been featured on numerous compilations, notably from Cocoon, Fabric , Renaissance, Journeys by DJ, Ultra & Bedrock, and is supported by a diverse spectrum of dance culture from house luminaries such as Doc Martin and Kerri Chandler to legends Steve Bug and Laurent Garnier and John Digweed. With anticipated releases and remixes imminent, the Tripwire production wheel is still very much in motion, and on its way to a turntable near you. 

// Ricardo Roessel //

A true record digger and purveyor of the dance floor experience, Ricardo Roessel is a visionary DJ and event curator raised through the culturally thick lens of Chicago's underground."

The Chicago native has made waves playing in well renown clubs and venues across the world from BRET Amsterdam, Detroit's TV Lounge to YuYu in México City. Continuously re-arranging a unique record bag collected from the depths of Human Head and Academy records New York, Berlin's Spacehall to Syncrophone and A-1 in Paris. 

Known best for playing extended vinyl sets, showcasing a vast influence of rare 90's US & UK house, breaks, minimal, electro, experimental, IDM, Y2K era progressive, trance and tech house. Consistently blurring the lines between genres old and new, finding the common thread within the lost and forgotten yet timeless records mixed with a new age sound. All sewn effortlessly into the right context with technical skills and precision, presented to the dance floor in a symbiotic and loose natured feeling. 

Born and raised in the evolving mecca of house music, quickly adapting and becoming a key contributor within the local dance community as a creative mind behind some of Chicago's most elusive underground parties and events. Co-producing and booking events under the success of Body Response, a party series running since 2017. To now working with south side based Sound-Systems such as The Post and Durty Truth, gaining recognition and playing among some of the foundational heads and pioneers such as Chez Damier, Boo Williams, Darryn Jones, Mike Dunn, Gene Hunt and the Chosen Few Dj's. All while taking cues playing on lineups alongside modern tastemakers like Nicolas Lutz, Malika, The Ghost, Unai Trotti and Evan Baggs.

events.title: Peach Gxrls x Hexercise with Mademoiselle (DE), Matas (US), Soft Pxrn, djGEM
events.description:
This Saturday 06.06, something trance-adjacent and gloriously unruly is taking over Jolene, as Peach Gxrls and Hexercise bring their combined sensibility to Kødbyen. Two of our favourite curators and DJs in town, djGEM & Soft Pxrn, inviting two respected artists from NYC and Berlin for a night of genre fluid mayhem. 

Both Peach Gxrls and Hexercise have built their respective followings around a refusal to be pinned down — their arsenal drawing just as much from progressive house, euphoric and deep trance, percussive techno and a lot more. 

Setting the room in motion is Soft Pxrn, Peach Gxrls founder and a known face to Jolene regulars under the  slower-burning alias of peachlyfe, a name familiar to the global techno and trance scene. Where peachlyfe runs fast and loud, Soft Pxrn goes inward — progressive house structures, melodic trance pressure, hypnotic rave euphoria. The 2024 album Permission to Roam on UMAY is the clearest statement of where this project lives.

Matas comes from deep inside New York's underground — a regular at Nowadays, Bossa Nova Civic Club, and Basement, the kind of career built through years on floors as much as behind decks. His sets move between atmospheric ease and sharp, rolling percussion, and he's shared bills with DVS1 and Roza Terenzi. That context tells you what you need to know.  London-born, Berlin-based, and founder of the increasingly popular Iterations event and mix series, she's a dedicated digger whose sets braid trance, techno, and house into something genre-fluid and kinetic. The reference points are rooted in the 90s and early 00s — old-school architecture, new-school interpretation — and the results are playful, tripped-out, and relentlessly driving. Her recent Unfold live recording is a good place to get acquainted.
 
djGem brings her radio concept Hexercise for the first time to Jolene. Finally, we may add!  The Copenhagen-based, South African-born artist works in what she calls dancefloor psychedelia — inter-genre, trance-threaded, and atmospheric. Expect a gradual pull toward something deeper.

21 years old + with valid ID.

events.description:

at Musikcaféen
doors at 20:00

...
Jacob Staib...
The music begins before it is decided.
Jacob Staib builds their own software and sets it in motion,
what happens next is unknown. Sound monoliths rise in real time,
driven by systems that follow their own inner logic.
Architectural structures tower impossibly high and fall impossibly deep.
It is an investigation of sound and development,
and the result is as much a surprise for the artist as it is for the listener.
Jacob Staib's debut album "UDEN KROP" will be released on June 5th,
just one day before this first ever solo performance at Xenon

Gertrude...
Some people say Gertrude was an old, mysterious woman no one had ever truly seen - a quiet presence drifting between places, gathering forgotten melodies, though no one knows where she lives, or if she ever existed at all.
Gertrude is a dream pop band whose music grows out of subtle gestures and small, song-like ideas. They move between ambient soundscapes and intimate songwriting, blending electronics, acoustic instruments, and voice into a single, breathing texture.
Nina Karpińska – vox
Franek Wicke – bass
Malina Midera – keys
Liam Amner – drums

Claire Dickson, Marius Wankel & Halfdan Magnus Stefansson...
Claire Dickson, Marius Wankel & Halfdan Magnus Stefansson is a new constellation and collaboration between the three musicians. All three being songwriters and improvisers - all three with very different meanings attached to those labels.
After a concert and first meeting at the Berlin concert series Future Bash in December 2025, they all felt the music they could make together had a lot of potential, and they decided to keep making more.
In June 2025 they are playing three more concerts, now as a band, in Berlin, Copenhagen and Århus, and will also be going into the studio to record this.
The dreamy and poetic vocals and electronics of Claire Dickson (based in Berlin, and Brooklyn before that), will be put in context by the autodidact, atmospheric noise-guitar of Halfdan Magnus Stefansson (in Copenhagen), all kept in momentum by the grounded, yet impalpable drumming of Marius Wankel (of the Berlin avantgarde scene) - all to make music that is based in fragile, intimate, and thoughtful songs.
The music is new and special to them, and they wish to share it with you.

A SUNRAVE SPECIAL!! We go a little out of what you've heard before and turn the BPM up a notch. 

We are very excited to welcome you into our 3rd SUNRAVE SESSION where we are joining forces with our friends from Berlin, RESONANZ - the movement of sound led by Das Techno Team. We've asked them to do a full takeover. 
This sunday is a collision of rhythm, sweat, and sound and a chance to drop out of your mind and into your body, unlocking rhythm, release control, and let yourself be moved.

12:00 - 15:30 // THE DANCE WORKSHOP (afterparty included in the ticket)
Das Techno Team facilitate their popular and very unique Rave Dance Workshop experience — where your body becomes the dancefloor, and the music moves through you. The workshop blends rhythmic improvisation with precise technique, inviting participants to explore body awareness and freedom of movement in a powerful musical and visual environment.

The workshop is open to all levels, from beginners to experienced dancers and requires no specific background knowledge or skills. It is structured in short, focused segments that alternate between guided exercises and open movement sessions, accompanied by live sets with shifting dynamics and tempo.

Designed as a space for both creative expression and collective learning, the experience concludes with an afterparty included in the ticket.
