The dancefloor will already be steamy, groovy and moving as you arrive to H15 and we leave it to the DJs of Das Techno Team: 

DJ // Mollen Lollen 

DJ // EITAN

DJ // John Fick 


Come sweat your prayers.
Come lose the edges.
Come back to your body.

events.title: Swordes (US) // RUST
events.description:
I sommeren 2021, da det endelig blev lovligt at gå ud igen, debuterede Swordes med at spille til de mange warehouse-raves og fester i Brooklyns undergrundsscene i New York. Frygtløs, poppet og melodidrevet består hendes live-set af hardware-synths, trommemaskiner og en følelsesladet, operatisk vokal. Der er ikke en computer i sigte.

I en verden mættet af hyperproduceret computermusik, autotunede vokaler og major label-æstetik repræsenterer hun i stedet et ærligt, poetisk og dybt personligt kunstnerisk udtryk. Med sin eneste vokaltræning fra brusebadet og uden nogen egentlig musikalsk uddannelse er Swordes’ stil eklektisk, eksperimenterende og frem for alt legende. Swordes skriver, producerer, indspiller og mixer stadig al sin musik selv og har integreret sin baggrund som billedkunstner i sit coverartwork og visuelle udtryk.

Swordes finder stor tilfredshed i at udforske de mange subgenrer inden for elektronisk musik, og når hun bliver spurgt, hvilken genre hendes musik tilhører, svarer hun: “Det er menneskemusik for mennesker.” Hendes næste projekt er en samling sange, der blander popvokaler med klubinspirerede lyde fra slutningen af 90’ernes dansemusik.

events.title: Alto Aria + Francesca Burattelli // RUST
events.description:
ALTO ARIA
Alto Aria er kunstnernavnet for sanger og komponist Aria Leth Schütze. Projektet undersøger relationen mellem akustisk og elektronisk lyd med transformation som omdrejningspunkt. Klassiske elementer flettes sammen med moderne elektroniske beats og bindes af en luftig, nærværende vokal.

Aria Leth Schütze er desuden grundlægger af det københavnske pladeselskab Rhizome, der har fokus på eksperimenterende musik og alternative udgivelsesformater. Alto Aria har delt scene med navne som Meuko Meuko, Mabe Fratti og Okkyung Lee og har leveret mixes til blandt andre NTS, Refuge Worldwide og Retreat Radio. Senest har Alto Aria udgivet en serie dobbeltsingler på Posh Isolation samt fuldlængdealbummet Ephemeral.

FRANCESCA BURATTELLI
Multidiciplinære kunstner Francesca Burattelli har de seneste år været aktiv på den danske eksperimenterende musikscene med sin særegne avantgarde-pop og performances.

I musikken mødes elementer fra orkestralmusik, experimental, til art-pop, i et elektronisk univers med stor udtryksmæssig spændevidde. Hun trækker den syditalienske lyd og sangtradition ind i sine kompositioner, og skaber et surrealistisk, nostalgisk og uncanny univers, som ofte akkompagneres af et stærkt visuelt performativt element.

Hendes udgivelser “Conditon” (VISAGE) og “Battle Fatigue” (Anyines) fra henholdsvis 2020 og 2022 har markeret hende som en vigtig producer i dansk eksperimenterenede musik.

On Friday 12th of June, Den Anden Side welcomes longtime collaborators WEEEIRDOS — the boundary-pushing party concept hosted by Lolsnake and known for their Thursday nights at Säule / Berghain, presenting an array of S-tier artists from around the globe alongside exciting upcoming talents.

Headlining the night is the undeniable party-starter Chippy Nonstop, bringing her explosive blend of club chaos, bass and high-energy rave pressure. A true force within the global queer underground, her sets are intense, fast and impossible to stand still to.

Lolsnake, founder and host of WEEEIRDOS, delivers hypnotic rave energy shaped by acid, techno and trance-driven sounds straight from Berlin’s underground.

CHIPPY NONSTOP
Chippy Nonstop is a versatile DJ, rapper, and producer whose high-energy sets seamlessly blend global club, rap, and bass-driven sounds. She thrives across contexts from queer-focused underground nights to fashion events and more commercial stages bringing her unique energy to every floor. Key shows include Berghain, Live From Earth, DGTL, Ultra, the Mugler Fashion Show and has shared lineups with VTSS, LSDXOXO, Honey Dijon and many more. Chippy also runs her own party series and upcoming label Pep Rally, centering FLINTA, BIPOC, and queer representation.

Leaning into several layers of dance music—from techno and trance to acid and cosmic bleep—Lolsnake moves through sound the way her namesake moves through a forest: curious, playful, and quietly disarming. Born in California to Iraqi parents and based in Berlin, the DJ and producer has become a regular presence at Berghain, where her sets feel less like performances and more like guided trips through feeling, texture, and movement.

NERI J
Neri J doesn’t just move bodies - she lifts spirits. Blending the emotional rush of trance with the raw pulse of techno, her sound is a sensual journey through hypnotic grooves, euphoric peaks, and atmospheric textures. Lithuanian born but with roots in Copenhagen, Neri J has spent years refining a signature style: high-energy, smooth, and cinematic music that lingers long after the last hours. events.title: 20 Years of Permanent Vacation with Benjamin Frolich (DE), Kasper Bjorke, Prom Night
events.description:
Twenty years is a long time to keep a label honest. Permanent Vacation lands at Jolene to mark two decades of Munich's most sun-drenched imprint — and they're bringing the right people to do it justice.

Since 2006, Permanent Vacation has built a catalogue that moves between cosmic disco, deep house, and everything that lives in the warm, unhurried space between the two. The label's fingerprints are on some of the most lasting records of the past two decades — releases from Todd Terje, John Talabot, Mano Le Tough, Red Axes, Fort Romeau, Perel, and a roster that reads like a map of where European electronic music found its most joyful, exploratory instincts. Tonight at Jolene, that legacy gets a proper dancefloor celebration — three selectors, one tight room, and a shared understanding of what makes a night move.

Benjamin Fröhlich is the man who co-built that catalogue. Munich-raised and deeply schooled, he came up running a record shop before helping found Permanent Vacation, and the breadth of that background shows in how he plays. His sets draw a fluid line through house, disco, and cosmic — not as genres to tick off, but as a single sensibility. Warm and hypnotic, he holds a room with patience, building momentum without ever announcing it. On a night like this, with his own label's story as the backdrop, expect something generous and close to the bone.

Kasper Bjørke brings two decades of his own to the table. The Copenhagen producer has moved through club anthems, ambient opuses, neo-classical terrain, and back again — releasing via Kompakt, Mule Musiq, Live At Robert Johnson, and his own Sensitive Records imprint, with five Panorama Bar sets and a back catalogue that stretches from disco-laced dancefloor work to Guardian-praised ambient. His 2024 album Puzzles drew praise for how naturally it crossed between intimate listening and open dancefloors, and that duality tracks in his DJ sets — literate, warm, and built for late-night rooms exactly this size.

Our resident DJ Prom Night holds things down on home turf. Shaq grew up in Aarhus, raised on the South African record collection his parents brought with them when they fled apartheid — soul, funk, jazz, disco, hip hop — and that inheritance runs through everything he plays. His sets span Italo house, afro-house, sleazy disco cuts, acid, and techno, held together by a sensibility he describes as nostalgic, groovy, and sparkly. He's a Jolene regular, and it shows — he knows how this room breathes, how it opens up late, when to push. Streams for HÖR Berlin, radio on Rinse FM and Refuge Worldwide, and a run of Danish festival appearances at Roskilde, Distortion, and Northside have sharpened what was already a distinctive voice. Tonight he holds the anchor.

events.title: Sydhavns Salonen - Stofskifte
events.description:
Velkommen til Sydhavns Salonen - Stofskifte
Med den store danske digter Mette Moestrup, koncert med dreamfolkstjernen Fine Glindvad og band, performance med danser og kropskunstner Ar Utke Ács. Vidensdeling med professor i økologi Hans Henrik Bruun.
Salonen beskæftiger sig med stofskiftets livsnødvendige muligheder i kroppen og på planeten.
Lys, energi, varme, protein, vækst, transformationen fra det ene til det andet stof.
Mette Moestrup udkom sidste år med digtsamlingen Butterfly Nebula, der med udgangspunkt i egen krop anlægger et kosmisk og poetisk perspektiv på stofskifte, stofskiftesygdom, stofskifteubalance i kroppen og på planeten. “En vild og videnskabelig hyldest til stofskiftet” (Information)
Mette Moestrup er med Butterfly Nebula indstillet til Nordisk Råds Pris.
Fine Glindvad er en fantastisk vokalist med en meget smuk og dragende sangstemme, og bliver med god grund sammenlignet med Mazzy Star og Elisabeth Fraser fra Cocteau Twins.
Hun skriver æteriske dreamfolksange med inderlige tekster, og har siden debuten i 2024 turneret med sit band i ind og udland.
Ar Utke Ács har som danser, koreograf og kropskunstner i en årrække skabt forestillinger med udgangspunkt i den sårede krop. I april spillede hendes forestilling Trembl på Det Kgl. Teater.
Professor Hans Henrik Bruun holder et oplæg om biodiversitet – om biodiversitetskrisen og hvordan vi som mennesker kan løse den (!!)
Døre kl. 18:30
Show kl. 19:00
Entré: 175 kr. inklusiv gebyr
Salonen foregår i Dansepavillonen
Det er et siddende arrangement.
METTE MOESTRUP◁◁◁
er digter og forfatter. Hendes praksis inkluderer oversættelse, performance, multimedia, kollektive samarbejder og essayistik.
Hun har bl.a. udgivet seks digtsamlinger, senest Butterfly Nebula (2025).
Hendes kritikerroste værker er oversat til flere sprog, og hun har modtaget en lang række priser, bl.a. Montana-prisen, Aarestrup Medaljen, Beatriceprisen og Statens Kunstfonds Livsvarige Hædersydelse. Hun er desuden medlem af Det Danske Akademi. Bor i København.
“Butterfly Nebula” er en stor, sanselig og tænkende digtsamling om stofskifte, syner og sygdom. I syv sammenvævede dele skriver Mette Moestrup rødglitrende, rituelle og hymniske digte om den sommerfugleformede kirtel, som styrer metabolismen. Hun har gennem syv år haft en autoimmun stofskiftelidelse. Ud fra dén kropslige erfaring besynger hun stofskiftet, der forbinder alle arter. Og begræder det ødelagte stofskifte mellem mennesket og jorden. Her er vilde og virtuose spring fra de små sten på stranden til den sommerfugleformede stjernetåge, som har givet bogen sit navn. Her er forvandlingsfællesskaber og helende seancer. Søvnløshedssange, blodspådomme. Og en rød ufo! Her blandes eufori med ond latter og dyb sorg. Her blandes ømhed med mysterier. Gæt gåder, følg spor, far vild – i Butterfly Nebula kan alt ske.
Butterfly Nebula blev nomineret til Kritikerprisen, Politikens Litteraturpris.
Buttterfly Nebula er indstillet til NORDISK RÅDS LITTERATURPRIS 2026.

Fine ◁◁◁
Fine Glindvad er en vildt dygtig vokalist fra København med en vidunderlig sangstemme, og bliver sammenlignet med Mazzy Star og Elisabeth Fraser.
Med sin æteriske crossover-lyd forener den københavnske sanger, sangskriver og producer samples, akustiske og elektriske instrumenter til noget, der føles både velkendt og som fra en drøm.
Nogen vil kende Fine fra trioen Chinah, som hun var sanger og producer i. Som soloartist bevæger Fine sig væk fra trioens elektroniske univers, og ind en alternativ guitarpop, der refererer til både folk, bluegrass, shoegaze – og lyden af MTV.
I 2024 udgav Fine sit debutalbum, ‘Rocky Top Ballads’, på pladeselskabet Escho. ‘Rocky Top Ballads’ er et lydunivers skabt af groovy trommer, et væld af guitarlyde, basriffs, rumklangsmættede atmosfærer og reallydsoptagelser. I 2025 fulgte 4 singleudgivelser og turné i ind og udland.
Hun er i den grad en del af den Københavnske bølge af nye cool artister, som er at finde på Cph+ spillelisten.
I Sydhavns Salonen optræder hun i et særligt duo set up.
AR UTKE ÁCS ◁◁◁
danser, koreograf og kropskunstner som senest har skabt forestillingerne Shivr og Trembl, som udforsker ikke-binære positioner og oplevelser relateret til kønsnonkonformitet, kronisk sygdom og performance.
Hvordan ser tiden ud, hvis vi strækker den i takt med en krop uden for normen? Danseforestillingen “trembl” ophæver tiden, som vi kender den. De raskes tid er ovre. Forestillingen skildrer en dansende, kronisk syg avatar og dens omgivende verden. Publikum inviteres til at overvære et selvlindrende ritual og strække fantasien til en verden, der møder kronikeres behov.
“Trembl” spiller på Det Kgl. Teater / KSelekt i april.
“En kønsløs larve svøbt i gazelignende klædninger, der får den til at ligne en dyrisk patient på vej mod forpuppelse. Den uhyggelige animalske udvikling gennemføres af Ar Utke Ács med skræmmende kropskontrol…” (fra anmeldelse af forestillingen“Shivr”, CPH culture)
Hans Henrik Bruun ◁◁◁
Professor ved Københavns Universitet. Forsker og underviser i økologi og biologisk mangfoldighed, med særligt fokus på samspil mellem arter i samfund af planter, dyr og svampe. Desuden forskning i evidensbaseret naturbevaring.


Illustration ◁◁◁
Giant Peacock Moth (sketch)
Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam (Vincent van Gogh Foundation)

SYDHAVNS SALONERNE ◁◁◁
er et tværæstetisk projekt kurateret af Cecilie Brask, støttet af Statens Kunstfond, Karens Minde Kulturfond, Københavns Musikudvalg og Kgs.Enghave Lokaludvalg arrangeret af Copenhagen Concert Community.
Salonerne bevæger sig mellem gøgl og videnskab, pop og kunst. Formen bevæger sig mellem koncert, performance, foredrag, samtale og højskolesang.
Salonerne foregår i Sydhavnen og afvikles i samarbejde med Karens Minde Kulturhus og Klein - Sydhavnens spillested.
Copenhagen Concert Community, der har base i Sydhavnen, København, ønsker at skabe koncertoplevelser, der går på tværs af genrer og generationer.

Friday, June 12th. The floor opens late and stays open later. Three artists, three entry points into the same night — bass that settles into your chest, hip-hop that moves like a conversation, rhythms that don't sit still.

Téa Kenithia works in the space where liquid drum&bass meets deep jungle and atmospheric bass. Dense, layered, unhurried. Her sets build slowly and hold their weight. The kind of music that changes how the room feels without announcing itself.

Rooted in rap, hip-hop, and R&B, VIK 3.0 carries the ease of someone who has spent years reading rooms across Copenhagen, Los Angeles, Paris, and London. His sets move with confidence and a sense of place.

Naima
Naima pulls from rhythms across cultures, blending with a genuine curiosity that keeps his sets warm and in motion. There's a generosity to how he plays. Music that invites you in and keeps you moving.

No requests, OK?! Stay with the flow and let the night unfold on its own terms.

events.title: Jolene Invites with ATEQ (DE), Amiraku
events.description:
Two artists, one dancefloor, a shared language built on patience and pressure. This is Jolene Invites — a format that trusts the music to do the talking and the room to do the rest.

The thread running through this night is restraint as a tool. Not sparse for the sake of it, but music that builds slowly, holds tension in the loop, and releases it through the groove rather than the drop. 

ATEQ brings that sensibility from Berlin and Weimar via one of electronic music's most distinctive collectives. Amiraku brings it from a different route — Casablanca to Denmark, through the dusty shelves of record stores and the archive of 90s rave culture — arriving at his own synthesis that moves between acid, minimal, and the harder edges of techno.

Florian Lepa has been releasing music as ATEQ on Giegling since the collective's early Weimar years, and those releases remain the clearest map of his sound: rolling, melancholic, deeply functional. His loops don't announce themselves — they accumulate, fold back on themselves, and quietly take hold of the room. His work spans DJ sets and live performance, including a recent collaboration with percussionist Samuel Rohrer that pushed into avant-garde jazz and ambient territory, suggesting a musical curiosity that runs well beyond the obvious. At home in Berlin, he holds a residency with Heideglühen; internationally, he has developed a close bond with Tbilisi's Bassiani. What he brings to Jolene is a set rooted in that Giegling minimalism — house and techno held together by mood and movement, never in a hurry.

Amiraku is a Copenhagen-based DJ whose ear was shaped by two things that rarely get to meet: the percussive, rhythmically complex music culture of Morocco where he grew up, and the UK, Detroit, and Berlin lineage he discovered after arriving in Europe. His sets move across acid, minimal, and tech-house, drawing from 90s rave archives as readily as from the Martinez-school minimal universe he cites as a core influence. There's an inherent eclecticism in how he approaches a set — not genre-hopping, but genuinely genre-fluent — and it makes for a warm-up that doesn't feel like a warm-up.

Together, these two trace a path from the considered to the insistent. Early hours carry depth and a certain inwardness — the kind of music you lean into before your body catches up. By the time the night finds its stride, the dancefloor has been given something to hold onto. Jolene's room, close and unhurried, is exactly where that joruney makes sense.

---

A rogue collective of sonic alchemists, operating on dancefloors with a singular mission: to heal through rhythm, by any means necessary. Formed in the underground labs of Copenhagen’s elec-tronic scene, (Con)Doctors are specialists each wielding their own strain of musical medicine. The sound is a precision fusion of Electro’s pulse, hardgroove’s depth, techno’s surgical strike, and trance’s euphoric contagion. We don’t just play tracks; we orchestrate outbreaks. The approach is all about maintaining momentum, seamless transitions that keep energy flowing, smart BPM progression that builds intensity naturally, unexpected genre combinations that surprise dancers, and crowd-responsive programming that adapts to the room. For this date we have planned something special for the test tubes.
Welcome to The Playground LAB, where the (Con)Doctors are conducting a highly unorthodox ex-periment. Upon admission, you’ll receive your initial dose to calibrate your system for sound ab-sorption. From there, the BPM escalates like a controlled toxin, pushing your limits in phases: se-dation (grooves), stimulation (pulsing rhythms), and finally, system overload (meltdown). Side effects include loss of time and involuntary movement. How much rhythm can a body withstand? From controlled beats to reckless abandon, this is live research and the dancer is the test subject!

events.title: Hasfeldt + Alto Aria
events.description:
Den 16. juni er der fri entré til koncerterne med Hasfeldt og Alto Aria i Byhaven. Vi åbner kl. 15.00 og musikken starter kl. 19.00. Yeerro serverer lækre gyros fra kl. 17.00 og baren bugner naturligvis af lækre Brooklyn-øl, naturvin og cocktails.
Hasfeldt
Martin Jon Hasfeldt arbejder i krydsfeltet af forskellige kunstformer og bevæger sig på tværs af billedkunst, performance og musikproduktion. Under sit musikalske alias Hasfeldt drages han mod ambiente atmosfærer, breakbeats og kluborienterede rytmer, som han former til et lydunivers, der føles både nostalgisk og lidt fouroligende.
Som opfølger til debutalbummet “If You Ever Need Me” har han netop udgivet EP’en “Play Me Like One of the Others”, hvor han omfavner en mere melodisk, triphop-inspireret form, men hvor den karakteristiske nerve og spøgelsesagtige atmosfære fortsat bevares.
Alto Aria
Alto Aria er kunstnernavnet for sanger og komponist Aria Leth Schütze. Projektet undersøger relationen mellem akustisk og elektronisk lyd med transformation som omdrejningspunkt. Klassiske elementer flettes sammen med moderne elektroniske beats og bindes af en luftig, nærværende vokal. Aria Leth Schütze er desuden grundlægger af det københavnske pladeselskab Rhizome, der har fokus på eksperimenterende musik og alternative udgivelsesformater. Alto Aria har delt scene med navne som Meuko Meuko, Mabe Fratti og Okkyung Lee og har leveret mixes til blandt andre NTS, Refuge Worldwide og Retreat Radio. Senest har Alto Aria udgivet en serie dobbeltsingler på Posh Isolation samt fuldlængdealbummet Ephemeral.

events.title: Dame Area (ES) // RUST
events.description:
Dame Area har efterladt publikum mundlamme på tværs af Europa og Amerika hvor de har spillet over 300 live shows og skabt en tydelig konsensus – de er et af de bedste live acts man kan opleve lige nu! 

De har spillet på festivaler som Atonal, CTM, Nuits Sonores, Grauzone, Dour, Fusion og Eurosonic samt på legendariske klubber som Berghain, Tresor og Apolo, og for nylig en session hos det ikoniske KEXP i Seattle, hvilket har efterladt det indtryk, at få elektroniske acts er så direkte og kompromisløse som denne katalansk/italienske duo.

Først med deres seneste album “Toda la verdad sobre Dame Area”, udgivet på Mannequin Records, har de formået at indfange energien fra deres liveoptrædener. Albummet blev kåret som det næstbedste rockalbum i 2024 af Pitchfork, udvalgt som “record of the week” af The Quietus og sat i rotation på BBC6 Radio. Det er et industrielt værk, der forener Einstürzende Neubautens percussion, flamencoens polyrytmer og elektroniske elementer i stil med Esplendor Geométrico og Suicide.

Men det er deres sans for dynamik, der adskiller dem fra resten af den industrielle scene, da de har mere tilfælles med Sonic Youths eksperimenterende rock end med et klassisk elektronisk projekt, mens strukturerne peger mod Coils avantgarde innovationer.

De repræsenterer en eklektisk og kræsen form for nutidig industriel musik, der forener hypnotiske minimal synth-mønstre og rå polyrytmer med unikt fortolkede elementer af post-punk og EBM.

SCROLL DOWN FOR ENGLISH
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
For første gang indtager SPOILR scenen på ALICE til en omgang demos, works in progress og uudgivet materiale. Denne gang slår de sig sammen med den herboende norske trommeslager, sanger og rapper Øyunn som medvært. Sammen med pixel.daddy guider hun publikum gennem en aften med 10+ artister, der deler det, de arbejder på lige nu.
Spænd sikkerhedsselen, læn dig tilbage, og nyd kaosset, når artister fra hele det musikalske spektrum mødes for at spille ufærdige tracks og afprøve nye idéer.
Om Øyunn:
Siden sit indtog på den danske musikscene har den herboende norske trommeslager, sanger og rapper Siv Øyunn aka Øyunn brændt sig fast hos publikum med sin helt særlige lyd, der favner breakbeats, dynamiske grooves, ekspressiv vokal, rap og personlige tekster om relationer, håb, indre uro, tilhørighed og identitet. Hendes seneste album “I Know U Can Do It” (2025) blev modtaget med stor begejstring af publikum såvel som medier. Øyunn har de seneste år bragt sit betagende liveshow til festivaler som Roskilde Festival, SPOT, Musik i Lejet, Festspillene i Nord Norge og Vossajazz.
I 2022 debuterede Øyunn som filmskaber med det audiovisuelle værk Aspects, som senere udkom som livealbum og indbragte hende både DMA Jazz-prisen som Årets Nye Jazznavn og Tivolis pris Årets Nybrud. Som trommeslager har hun samarbejdet med navne som Nils Frahm, Efterklang og Guldimund.
⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛⊛
In English:
Over the past few years, the music collective SPOILR has energized Copenhagen’s music scene with free-spirited live experiences where musicians test out new material in front of an audience. Now it’s finally ALICE’s turn, as host pixel.daddy joins forces with Norwegian drummer Øyunn to present 10+ artists unveiling unfinished tracks and fresh ideas.
For the first time, SPOILR takes over the stage at ALICE for an evening of demos, works in progress, and unreleased material. This time, they team up with the Norway-born, Copenhagen-based drummer, singer, and rapper Øyunn as co-host. Together with pixel.daddy, she will guide the audience through an evening featuring 10+ artists sharing what they are currently working on.
Fasten your seatbelt, sit back, and embrace the chaos as artists from across the musical spectrum come together to perform unfinished tracks and experiment with new ideas.
About Øyunn:
Since emerging on the Danish music scene, the Norway-born, Copenhagen-based drummer, singer, and rapper Siv Øyunn, aka Øyunn, has captivated audiences with her distinctive sound, blending breakbeats, dynamic grooves, expressive vocals, rap, and deeply personal lyrics about relationships, hope, inner turmoil, belonging, and identity. Her latest album, I Know U Can Do It (2025), was met with great enthusiasm from both audiences and critics alike. In recent years, Øyunn has brought her mesmerizing live show to festivals such as Roskilde Festival, SPOT, Musik i Lejet, Festspillene i Nord Norge, and Vossajazz.
In 2022, Øyunn made her debut as a filmmaker with the audiovisual work Aspects, which was later released as a live album and earned her both the Danish Music Award Jazz for New Jazz Artist of the Year and Tivoli’s Breakthrough of the Year award. As a drummer, she has collaborated with artists such as Nils Frahm, Efterklang, and Guldimund.

events.description:
170 kr. i forsalg / 185 kr. i døren
Døre kl. 19 / show kl. 20
Electronic Body Music - For fans af Front 242, DAF (Deutsch Amerikanische Freundschaft), Author & Punisher
▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄
Da Youth Code i 2025 vendte tilbage med 'Yours, With Malice,' markerede det afslutningen på en længere pause og begyndelsen på et nyt kapitel for den Los Angeles-baserede EBM-duo. Sara Taylor og Ryan George havde i årene op til udgivelsen bevidst trukket sig tilbage fra rampelyset, ikke som følge af stilstand, men for at gentænke både deres arbejdsproces og deres identitet som band. Resultatet blev ikke en dramatisk kursændring, men snarere en skærpelse af det udtryk, de har forfinet siden begyndelsen i 2012.
Youth Code har altid befundet sig i spændingsfeltet mellem industriel elektronik og hardcore-punkens kompromisløshed, og netop den position har sikret dem en særstatus i den moderne EBM-scene. I en periode, hvor mange beslægtede acts dukkede op, valgte duoen at fokusere på detaljer, håndværk og langsigtet udvikling frem for hurtige udgivelser. Samarbejdet med Sumerian Records blev et naturligt næste skridt og gav dem den struktur, der skulle til for at samle trådene.
'With Malice' mindre som et comeback og mere som en konsolidering: et bevis på, at Youth Code fortsat er relevante, uden at gå på kompromis med den rå nerve, der altid har defineret dem. Det kan du opleve live i BETA.
For fans af Front 242, DAF (Deutsch Amerikanische Freundschaft), Nitzer Ebb og The Klinik

events.title: Mads Kinnerup
events.description:
***OBS***
Det er gratis at komme med til koncerten, men book en billet hvis du vil sikre dig en plads.
Oplev Mads Kinnerups hypnotiske univers af gentagelser, klanglige forskydninger og modulære systemer, når han præsenterer sit nye album Invented Mythology live.
●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○
Venue: Musikcaféen, 3. etage
Døre: 19:00
Show: 20:00
Entré: Gratis
●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●○
Mads Kinnerup er en kunstner og musikproducer, der arbejder i krydsfeltet mellem elektronisk eksperimenterende musik, IDM og ambient. Hans praksis er forankret i en fascination af systemer: hvordan simple strukturer, når de får lov at udfolde sig over tid, kan skabe komplekse og resonante resultater. På tværs af sit arbejde udforsker Kinnerup gentagelse, minimalt melodisk materiale og udviklende klangfarver som en måde at stille spørgsmål ved, hvordan elektronisk musik kan komponeres, fremføres og opfattes.
På sit fjerde album, Invented Mythology, retter Kinnerup blikket mod fundamentet for tidlig elektronisk musik. Med inspiration fra pionerarbejde i studier og teknikker fra 1960’erne og 70’erne er albummet opbygget ved hjælp af elementære værktøjer såsom arpeggiatorer og step-sequencere.
Frem for at basere sig på harmoniske progressioner eller dramatiske strukturelle skift undersøger musikken, hvordan en enkelt melodi kan forblive engagerende over længere tid gennem gradvise ændringer i lyd, tekstur og rumlig bevægelse. Resultatet er musik, der føles både statisk og levende; fastlåst i gentagende mønstre, men konstant foranderlig på klangligt niveau.
Albummet er indspillet i Elektron Musik Studion (EMS) i Stockholm. Ved at arbejde med studiets sjældne og historiske Buchla-synthesizere omfavnede Kinnerup begrænsningerne og uforudsigeligheden i tidlige modulære systemer. Den håndgribelige tilgang til Buchlainstrumenterne, hvor spænding, ustabilitet og fysisk interaktion former lyden, spiller en central rolle i albummets karakter. Subtile forskydninger i tone, envelope og modulation bliver de primære narrative drivkræfter og fremhæver selve lyden som det centrale kompositoriske element.
Kinnerups tidligere udgivelser har etableret ham som en kunstner med en dyb interesse for elektronisk form og hukommelse. Hans selvudgivne debutalbum Parademons (2019) udforskede ambient-landskaber inspireret af en Warp-æsteti. Hans andet album, Heart 1993 (2022), udgivet på det danske label Janushoved, præsenterede et atmosfærisk og introspektivt værk baseret på fragmenterede barndomsminder og dekonstruktion af lydlige artefakter. Med sit tredje album, Interpolation, reducerede Kinnerup musikken yderligere og nåede frem til et koncentreret studie i gentagelse, tid og lydlig udvikling med kun én enkelt stemme.
Mads Kinnerup er desuden ansat som studieadjunkt på musikproduktion ved Rytmisk Musikkonservatorium i København. Udgivelsen er støttet af Statens Kunstfond, DAF og KODA.
Albummet udgives på det Københavnske label No Technique den 18. juni og markeres med en releasekoncert på Musikcaféen i HUSET i København samme dag. Albummet vil tilgængeligt på alle streamingplatforme.
---------------------------
ENG.
Mads Kinnerup is an artist and music producer working within experimental electronic music, at the intersection of IDM and ambient. His practice explores how simple systems and repetitions can unfold over time into complex and immersive sonic experiences.
With his fourth album, Invented Mythology, Kinnerup turns his attention to the foundations of early electronic music. Inspired by studio techniques from the 1960s and 70s, the album is built using elemental tools such as arpeggiators and step sequencers. Rather than relying on harmonic progression, the music evolves through subtle shifts in sound, texture and spatial movement.
The result is a sonic landscape that feels both static and alive. Repetition creates a stable framework, while gradual changes in tone and modulation generate movement and depth.
The album was recorded at Elektron Musik Studion in Stockholm using rare Buchla synthesizers. Embracing the limitations and unpredictability of these early modular systems plays a central role, where physical interaction and slight variations in sound shape the musical narrative.
Kinnerup’s previous releases have established him as an artist deeply engaged with sound, time and memory. From the ambient-inspired debut Parademons to the introspective Heart 1993 and the minimalist exploration of repetition on Interpolation.
The release of Invented Mythology is marked by a live performance where the audience can experience the work unfold in real time.

Bubbling Inside returns with a special guest from Kyiv's underground: Vera Logdanidi.

A DJ, producer, and co-founder of Rhythm Büro, Vera has spent nearly two decades refining a sound that moves effortlessly between groovy and hypnotic techno, house-leaning excursions, ambient experimentation, and the occasional jungle detour. Her productions have appeared on labels including Dial Records, Semantica, Rhythm Büro, and Corridor Audio, while her DJ sets have taken her to institutions such as Panorama Bar, Bassiani, Tresor, and Closer.

Joining her is Bubbling Inside founder HAKEEM, whose genre-fluid approach draws from deep techno, tech house, UK-influenced club sounds, and overlooked dancefloor gems. Together, they navigate the space between groove, depth, and exploration.

events.description:
Argentinian artist Nicolas Rada returns to What Happens following a standout set a few years back that still lingers in memory.

Based in Buenos Aires, Rada has steadily built his profile - collaborating with Nick Warren and sharing lineups with Sasha, John Digweed, Hernan Cattaneo, and Guy J. His productions reflect a refined take on progressive house, with releases across some of the genre’s most respected labels. He’s joined by What Happens resident Tim Andresen, a central figure in Copenhagen’s progressive scene, known for his carefully constructed sets and long-form storytelling behind the decks. Completing the Black Box lineup is fellow Argentinian Alejo Fochi, whose recent releases on labels such as The Soundgarden, Sudbeat, and AH Digital mark him as one to watch.

With a strong Argentinian presence across the lineup, the connection runs deep throughout the night. In Red Box, things take a sharper turn — faster, playful, and driven by techno grooves from Shansen, Lele, and Culture Box debutant AYELEN. Vamos.

First drink/beer for free the first open hour.

Seaworld - Midsommar Edition @ Den Anden Side

Saturday, June 20 │ Normal Selection │ Techno, Hardgroove, Trance, Progressive

————

Aloha! Your most trusty bademeisters are back in the pool with another colourful cocktail heavily spiked with the most intoxicating international techno and trance. To celebrate the arrival of Midsummer, we are lighting up a giant underwater bonfire in our most beloved wellness spa, Den Anden Side. So pack your electrolytes & fishnet tights and get ready for 9 hours of extended waterboarding with this very wet variety:

Once again, we have the great pleasure of inviting the Argentinian vinyl ninja Gina Demarchi to flip some discs of dirty techno and hot hardgroove. It's been a couple of years since we had her on Danish soil, and since then her reputation has only continued to grow. Her sets build patiently and steadily, alluring dancers into a pulsating and ever-evolving world of repetition and mesmerization.

To fulfill the nautical naughtiness, we have our resident bathing nymphs adorning the lineup: Johannes Astrup is on the main deck with his characteristic spicy blend of saltwater salsa and subsonic techno, while Anders Horse and Bollen (F.K.A. Legendariske Tricky vender tilbage til Store VEGA!
Den 20. juni 2026 gæster det britiske triphop-ikon Tricky Store VEGA med et helt nyt liveshow. Publikum kan se frem til en intens og atmosfærisk koncertoplevelse fra en af de mest betydningsfulde skikkelser i moderne britisk musik.

events.title: La Dolce Vita with Paty Vapor (BR), Harrison Heat and Boogie Rookie
events.description:
La Dolce Vita is back for another round of italo madness of the year. For a pumping night of italo-love and sweet living, Jolene is guested by an super sweet lineup. For one night only we're joined by a rising star in the world of drugged up retro synth music Paty Vapor from Brazil via Berlin and by the Copenhagen rave don Harrison Heat. The two guest stars will be backed up by the Dolce resident Boogie Rookie.

PATY VAPOR (BR/DE)

Brazilian born, Berlin based Paty Vapor is an integral part of the new Berlin scene for italo-rave and clubby retro-synthesizer sounds! Her parties at Sameheads and beyond and her dj-sets have become fabled all over blending the best bits from EBM, Electro(clash), minimal synth, obscure italo, new beat etc. Characterized by powerful kicks, bold basslines, ethereal synths, and enigmatic vocals. Paty Vapor's sonic tapestry is a captivating fusion of the old and the avant-garde.

She is part of the Italian label-collective Slow Motion / Wrong Era and co-founder of the event series 'Wisdom Tits & The Mad Express presents' and the party Klaash (who’s latest guest was none other than DJ Hell). Holding a residency at the Berlin club Sameheads, she regularly showcases her sound at the pinnacle of Berlin's venues, across Europe, and in Brazil. Just the last two weeks, her impeccable taste has taken her to both Panorama Bar, Sonar Festival and now La Dolce Vita at Jolene. We can’t wait to have her on!!

HARRISON HEAT

Harrison Heat is the final boss of rave in Copenhagen. A great promoter, fantastic booker, and even better DJ, he has really put his mark on the Copenhagen dance scene bringing underground rave culture to large audiences of party-goers. 
As a DJ he spans from early US disco to contemporary fast techno but somehow always keeps a red threat through it all. His sets are usually heavy on Chicago-house and he has a special love for the weird vinyl records never caving in to stupid drops or easy pop always keeping his crowd on their toes.
He will play a b2b opening set with Boogie Rookie triangulating between  italo, weird ass euro house, and chicago-acid-jacking house


BOOGIE ROOKIE

For the early b2b with Harrison Heat and for the wee hours of the early next morning, Copenhagen's busiest disco jockey will be playing a selection of italo, new beat and fun retro-housey records. He might even give a sneak peak of some homemade tunes! Rock n roll meets mechanic beats and over the top synths.

events.title: The Outer Village V: Excursions EP Release
events.description:
For our 5th edition of The Outer Village we are once again fulfilling a roster of bright talent in depthful electronica. We are proud to present our new Various Artists EP series Excursions, which is a concept similar to our previous Interlocked series, but in a more compact format to showcase new artists who bring something distinct to the electronics table.

Jakob Planch is a soundsmith who engages in musical abstractions through experimentation with synthesis in highly melodic measures. His track Visco on the Excursions EP exposes storytelling flair in highly detailed textures. For this evening, Jakob Planch is bringing his Live-set to Underwerket, so expect a thorough performance of glitch, synth and audio warp in a household lesson of electronic brilliance.
Newcomer SPNR has been revealing himself as none other than the chosen one to watch in the Copenhagen bass music scene. With his most recent release on Solumn Records, SPNR exposes his rhythmical fluency and craftsmanship in tracks that linger in strong listenability.

.:ibe & DJ VIcksy are household DJs of the collective Bass Blasted, situated in Lund, Sweden. In the last couple of years, they have pushed the deeper ends of drum and bass in Sweden through a variety of events with focus on community building, which is something we highly admire.

Emdex is a new DJ out of the Copenhagen bass scene, who develops her craft in versatility with aimed focus of call-to-arms inducing, energetic selections. Expect a darker set from Emdex on this special occasion.

Mørika is a revered drum and bass artist out of the Copenhagen scene, who aims for raw and cutting edge in-your-face breakbeats with a strong understanding of flow and development in a DJ set. Mørika will end the evening off in great manners with a set of, at its core, powerfulness at 175.

events.title: Sinewave with Martin Gilleshøj, WE.LL, Amazinggajin
events.description:
Sinewave makes its debut at Jolene — a new night rooted in the sine wave at the heart of all synthesis, and the bass-heavy UK lineage that grew from it.

The concept is simple but purposeful: most of the music that shaped a generation of producers started with a single oscillator, a clean tone moving through a synthesizer. Sinewave traces that thread forward — from the rolling breaks and skippy rhythms of 2-step and UK garage, through the weight of dubstep, into the harder, darker pressures of contemporary techno and mutant club music.

Martin Gilleshøj needs little introduction in Copenhagen. A DJ, label head, and scene architect — founder of Buttheads, co-founder of Axces Recordings and Kune Festival, former operator of Proton Records — he brings decades of dedication to building rooms and building communities. His sets resist easy categorisation: fluid, adventurous, emotionally intelligent. He might stay deep and hypnotic for an hour, then pivot somewhere warmer and more kinetic without losing the thread. That inquisitive energy is his signature, and it fits the Sinewave brief well.

Amazinggaijin is the alias of Jean-Hugues Kabuiku, French writer, theorist, and the driving force behind Sinewave. Signed to London's All Centre — the label home to some of the most uncompromising sounds at the intersection of UK bass and experimental club music — his sets occupy the space where 2-step's syncopation meets the murkier textures of post-dubstep electronics. A member of the Copenhagen Overtone Collective and co-organiser of the five-day Sonoluma Festival, Kabuiku brings an intellectual rigour to his selections that never tips into coldness. Expect mutant rhythms, heavy bass, and the kind of curation that rewards close listening on the floor.


Co-Founder, Resident, and Organizer of A.S.S.M.R. Collective in Copenhagen. Former Founder, Resident, and Organizer of SEQUENTIAL HAPTICS N.Y.C. 

His sets weave between powerful peaks and meditative moments, creating a space where connection and release are just as much about the music as the community that surrounds it.

After a decade immersed in NYC’s rich underground scene - feeding on hardcore, industrial, melodic, groove, breakbeat, and psy techno - Copenhagen-based WE.LL delivers a razor-sharp story telling, forward-driving psychedelic leaning sets that weave into hypnotic rolling grooves. You can expect intricate sound design, textured atmospheres, and rhythmic artifacts collide with peak-time percussion.

A Thursday at Jolene is its own thing: tighter, more focused, the kind of crowd that came because they wanted to be there. First edition. Worth showing up for.

---

events.title: Whipped #4 with RUIZ OSC1
events.description:
Whipped #4 w/ RUIZ OSC1 @ Den Anden Side

Friday, June 26 │ Normal Selection │ Techno, Hypnotic Techno

————

For the June slash, we are hyped to present an old friend of the club: the ferocious Colombian vinyl spinner RUIZ OSC1 is ready to take the booth for a solid lesson in her distinctive folkloric techno sound.
She is supported by Dico Nemus for the closing, and Gavnlig, who is presenting the techno end of her repertoire. Gavnlig will also open the night from 21:30 with the first edition of our new music producer listening and feedback sessions, “All Ears”.

Whipped is a hypnotic techno party where detail, texture, quality, and skill are at the center of attention. This is techno in its most intoxicating form: stripped back, relentless, and finely tuned to keep you hypnotized from the first kick to the final echo.

Within the Whipped concept, we present an international sound, bringing both newer names and old legends to DAS, combined with a strong and blossoming local scene.

This is Whipped #4.
Come get whipped.

𝗟𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘂𝗽
RUIZ OSC1 [she/her]
Gavnlig [she/her]
Dico Nemus [he/him]

————

RUIZ OSC1
Erika Andrea Murcia Ruiz, known artistically as Ruiz OSC1, is a Colombian DJ and producer from Bogotá, celebrated for her refined vinyl technique and genre-defying sound. Her performances have graced some of the world’s most respected venues, including Bassiani, Vent (Tokyo), Basement (New York), RSO, FOLD, and Tresor, alongside appearances at Intercell, Vault Sessions, and showcases for Mutual Rytm and Technics, where she currently serves as an ambassador.

Rooted in a lifelong passion for music, RUIZ OSC1 draws inspiration from her mother — a singer and music reseller — who introduced her to salsa, merengue, and Colombian folklore during her upbringing in the late ’80s and early ’90s. After relocating to Europe in 2010, she began blending these rhythmic traditions with contemporary electronic elements, creating her distinctive sound, which she defines as “folkloric techno”.

events.title: Love Party x E.P.I.Q./ Anna Cainelli, C:Mone, Savsannah & DJ LoveCatt
events.description:
LOVE PARTY is an ode to everything we love about clubbing, heavily inspired by early club and house culture. This night calls for self-expression, dancing, connecting, respect and having fun Grab (a) loved one(s) and create a beautiful, safe, non-jugdemental dancefloor together with us.
This night at Jolene is all about love!

For this edition of LOVE PARTY I’m lucky to be teaming up with E.P.I.Q.!
They’re a group of seven DJs based in Cologne whose mission is to combine their eclectic tastes for musical journeys through the night. They join forces with other DJs, artists, and creatives for wholesome events within the local scene and other cities around Germany.
Enter one of their dance floors and allow the confidence, blissful joy, and passion to embrace you – an energy one can’t explain but only experience. The moment your foot steps into their world, you become part of the symbiotic cell that melts with the multitude of dancing bodies. They aim to create a supportive space where they can share their favorite sounds, togetherness, and radiance with everyone. E.P.I.Q. is Sedaction, Savsannah, Piush, Nikity, C:Mone, Anna Cainelli, & AMSL. From soul to hip-hop, R&B to world pop, house to breakbeats, bass to UK garage, and more, they provide cute B2B2Bs, loving energy, and booty shaking all night long.

E.P.I.Q. is usually seven powerhouses but tonight we get to experience three of them.

𝗟𝗜𝗡𝗘𝗨𝗣

❥ 𝓓𝓙 𝓛𝓸𝓿𝓮𝓒𝓪𝓽𝓽
is a big sucker for house, garage, disco, chicago house, and anything groovy from the past and the future. Everything should revolve around love! The music we love, the places, surroundings we love, and the people we love.

❥ 𝓐𝓷𝓷𝓪 𝓒𝓪𝓲𝓷𝓮𝓵𝓵𝓲

is a Cologne-based DJ, radio host and part of the seven-member DJ crew E.P.I.Q. From vibrant housey to UK beats and seductive, rhythmic sounds: She sets herself no genre boundaries and plays whatever her heart desires and won't let her feet stand still.

One of Copenhagen’s best kept secrets where music feels like magic and Danish hygge meets high-fidelity hedonism. A full-on cosmic dance party all night long.

Disco, Jazz, Afro, Funk, Psychedelic, Soul, Percussive, House all on vinyl through a premium sound set up.

Magic City is a pop up artisan audiophile dance party run by music and hifi lovers with the main goal of pushing the boundaries of conventional club culture and providing a space for music that otherwise wouldn’t typically be heard.

Inspired by Japan’s culture of jazz kissa, but reimagined for the dance floor, the focus is on providing quality sound through a custom-built sound system and high-end analog hifi components to ensure the music can sound its best.

We strive to create a space where you can move your body, open your hearts and travel to the tropical forests of your mind, all the while listening to awesome music. That’s why we have an open-minded music policy and encourage our selectors to play music from the soul no matter the genre.

Butterfly Effect returns, welcoming two special guests from Ireland and Berlin’s underground: Holly Lester and Aimé You.

Holly Lester is a Belfast-based DJ, producer, and label head known for her distinctive take on house and techno. A former resident at Chibuku Shake Shake and The Warehouse Project, she’s played globally from London and Berlin to Australia and beyond. Founder of Duality Trax and co-founder of Terrazzo, she’s also active in shaping Northern Ireland’s nightlife through the Free The Night initiative.

Aimé You is a Berlin-based DJ, producer, and dedicated digger, known for weaving late ’90s and early 2000s progressive and tech house with breakbeat, tribal textures, and flashes of old-school trance. His career has taken him through key institutions such as Sisyphos, Watergate, Kater, and KitKat, as well as Berlin’s underground DIY party circuit, often playing deep into sunrise.

Joining them is Butterfly Effect founder NAT. Her sets move through acid-spiced house, forward-thinking techno, and progressive electro with a clear, driving thread. She has played venues including Culture Box, Hangaren, and Den Anden Side, and hosts Radio Panini, with appearances on HOR Berlin and Newtown Radio.

events.title: K A L E II D O + Mike Sheridan
events.description:
Glæd dig til en aften med nærværende og sanselig jazz, når K A L E II D O + Mike Sheridan spiller i Dansepavillonen ved KLEIN under Copenhagen Jazz Festival 2026. Duoen skaber musik i øjeblikket med et roligt, intuitivt samspil, hvor hver tone opstår i nuet.
▼▼▼
Entré: 120 kr. plus gebyr (140 kr. i døren)
Billetter: https://billetto.dk/.../k-a-l-e-ii-d-o-mike-sheridan...
Døre kl. 18:30
Koncert kl. 19:00
Venue: Dansepavillonen
▲▲▲
Anna Roemer og Cecilie Strange har på få år manifesteret sig på den danske musikscene med deres duo K A L E II D O og deres banebrydende tilgang til at spille øjebliksmusik. Hvert anslag, hvert åndedræt, hver enkelt tone opstår lige dér - i samspillet mellem Roemer og Strange og deres medmusikere. Det værende i studiet eller på scenen.
Hver gang afsøger de nye uafprøvet afgrunde og deres musik affødes af et roligt, langsomt talende tonesprog, hvor instrumenterne på indfølt vis smyger sig om hinanden. Der er på intet tidspunkt plads til egoer, musikalske afstikkere eller show-offs. Tvæ rtimod vidner duoens lyd om en musikalsk modenhed og kærlighed til samskabelse med deres gæstemusikere, som nærmer sig det transcenderende. K A L E II D O udgav deres anmelderroste debutalbum VOYAGE i januar 2021 og den prisvindende opfølger ELEMENTS i marts 2022. I efteråret 2023 udkom album nummer tre med navnet PLACES, som gæstes af Rumpistol på synthesizer, keyboard og sampling, Lars Vissing på trompet med diverse effekter, Rasmus Sitarz på trommer med effekter samt drum pad og Hannah Schneider på ordløs vokal.
K A L E II D O vandt Carl Prisen i kategorien “Årets Komponist Jazz” i
2023 for deres album ELEMENTS som de desuden også modtog “Jazznytprisen” for i efteråret 2022. K A L E II D O har også tidligere år været nomineret til Carl Prisen for VOYAGE, DMA JAZZ, indstillet til GAFFA-prisen i flere kategorier og høstet flotte anmeldelser for deres første tre første udgivelser VOYAGE fra 2021, ELEMENTS 2022 og PLACES fra 2023. PLACES vandt også Carl Prisen for "Årets Komponist indenfor Jazz" i 2024.
Nu har de for første gang været i studiet og indspille et duoalbum i det berømte Ocean Sound studie i Norge. Albummet forventes udgivet senere i år. I foråret 2024 indspillede Roemer og Strange en række livesessions i Pavillionen ved Karensminde Kulturhus. De er forevigt på 3 udgivelser som tilsammen er en EP ved navn: PART OF NATURE. Koncerten på KLEIN under dette års Copenhagen Jazz Festival er en duo koncert.
Sagt om K A L E II DO:
Politiken (5 hjerter)
(David A. Dyrholm Nielsen) VOYAGE
“Med duodebuten ’Voyage’ lukker guitarist Anna Roemer og saxofonist Cecilie Strange fuldstændig op for blændeåbningen, der lader lyset skinne direkte ind i kalejdoskopet, så spejlene og det farvede glas kan danne nye billeder i bevidstheden.”
Kristeligt Dagblad (5 stjerner)
(Andreo Mielczarek) ELEMENTS
“[…] musikken ligger og ulmer i ambiente flader, minimalistisk, men aldrig trivielt – aldrig overfyldt… Et flot album, som vokser for hver lytning, og som viser, at dansk jazz lever og har det godt.”

events.title: Copenhagen Jazz Festival: Katharsis pres. jjjacob + Dudde
events.description:
Byhaven er igen i år en del af Copenhagen Jazz Festival og præsenterer i samarbejde med festivalen et eventyrlystent og udfordrende program med artister, der går egne veje i jazzen og et væld af andre genrer. Der er fri entré og Byhaven åbner kl. 15.00. Under jazzfestivalen starter koncerterne kl. 17.00 og 19.00.
Yeerro serverer lækre gyros fra kl. 16.00 og baren bugner naturligvis af lækre Brooklyn-øl, naturvin og cocktails.
Dudde - kl. 17.00
Komponist og producer David Engelbrecht står bag det instrumentale soloprojekt Dudde. Med legende tilgange og undersøgende genremøder skaber Dudde et distinkt udtryk, både på sine udgivelser og live. Hans musik er forankret i et kontinuerligt arbejde med sit eget personlige lydarkiv, hvor han fragmenterer, bearbejder og resampler materialet, til nye musikalske indtryk og betydninger opstår.
jjjacob - kl. 19.00
jjjacob er en københavnsk elektronisk musiker, producer og label/event-kurator. Hans musik bevæger sig mellem meditativ ambient, eksperimenterende elektroniske kompositioner og mere højintense, kropslige strukturer, med et gennemgående fokus på følelser, stemninger og forandring. Gennem lag af melodiske synthflader, bearbejdede samples og rytmiske forskydninger undersøger han musikken som et rum for refleksion, nærvær og følelsesmæssig bearbejdning.

Emil F & Frederik Valentin - kl. 17.00
Den anerkendte eksperimentelle musiker Frederik Valentin og den fremadstormende københavnske producer Emil F blander ambient minimalisme, bøjninger af folkemusikken og elektroniske teksturer, mens de udforsker den fine balance mellem lys og mørke – deres samarbejde er en intim meditation over forgængelighed og den stille skønhed i livets kontinuerlige nedstigning.
Merely - kl. 19.00
Merely er solopseudonymet for den svenske sangerinde og producer Kristina Florell. Henover 10 års arbejde, der spænder fra solo-projekter til roller i bands som Team Rockit og Chariot, har Florell bevist sin sekulære plads i nutidens musikalske landskab gennem sin unikke stemme, poetiske sangskrivning og kompositioner dannet ud fra en problemfri blanding af dream pop, new age og guldalderklubmusik.

events.title: CPH Jazz Festival: Sara Flindt / Søren Maria Buschmann / Lena Douglas (AU) / Szymon Wójcik(PL)
events.description:
Tre projekter mødes i et fælles program den 10. juli, som udspringer af venskaber og en fælles beundring for hinandens musik.
Sara Flindt & Szymon Wójcik (PL) When you rub your eyes, you see things you can’t describe er et album af den polskfødte, Köln-baserede komponist Szymon Wójcik i samarbejde med den danske sanger og sangskriver Sara Flindt. Musikken bevæger sig i krydsfeltet mellem stramt organiseret komposition baseret på renstemning og en fri, improvisatorisk vokalpraksis, hvor teksten skabes i øjeblikket, og sproget mærkes frem for mestres.
Søren Maria Bushmann skriver, spiller og synger sange på dansk. Musik og tekst bevæger sig sammen mellem velkendte og mere abstrakte formationer. Tonesproget er båret af den akustiske guitar, frit og legende. Han udgav i 2020 albummet "BishBusch" under kunstnernavnet BishBusch, og udkommer i 2026 med ny musik.
Lena Douglas (AU) & Sara Flindt Den australske kunstner Lena Douglas og den danske vokalist Sara Flindt har udviklet et duo-projekt, hvor deres sange væves sammen i et fælles udtryk. Med to vokaler og to keyboards udforsker de teksturer, effekter og åbne improvisatoriske former mellem komposition og opløsning.

Aftenen er både en fortælling om det vedvarende savn af hjemlandet og en hyldest til den styrke, varme og livsglæde, som kendetegner latinamerikanske fællesskaber. Gennem musik bringer Latin Angel Social Club Latinamerika tættere på København og skaber et rum, hvor kultur, identitet og fællesskab kan fejres. events.title: OPERATOR with Maruwa, Kawun & Prom Night
events.description:
Celebrating music from all over the world, Operator finds inspiration in 80's and 90's dance
culture where disco & house took over the globe. Presented to you by Copenhagen DJs and party
promoters Prom Night & Kawun, Operator invites you on a worldwide journey presenting and
representing music from every corner of the world, while also being on a mission to unite cultures
and dance moves.

OPERATORS OF THE NIGHT:

MARUWA
Maruwa builds her sets around tension and deep emotional texture - blending sharp,
driving rhythms with warm atmosphere. Her sound pulls from the golden era of the 90's
and early 2000s, enriched with a modern twist.
Now based in Frankfurt, she has carved her niche with a number of multifaceted EPs on
labels like Steel City Dance Discs and X-Kalay. Her remixes for scene veterans like
Dusky, Skream, and Catz 'n' Dogz, as well as underground artists such as Azo,
Subsism, and Denham Audio - have found their way into the hearts of ravers around the
world.
One can catch her delivering a long opening at Fabric or a sunset set at Pitch Festival,
igniting early mornings at Robert Johnson, or navigating deeper nights at Nantes'
Macadam.


PROM NIGHT


KAWUN

2200! is back on Friday, July 10th. Named after the postcode, built around the neighbourhood. Every week a different sound, a different combination of DJs, and a floor that moves accordingly.

DJ Ary
A fixture in Danish nightlife and a producer who brings that same precision to the booth. Persian melodies woven into electronics that feel rooted and completely current. Ary builds slowly, hits hard, and takes the room exactly where it needs to go.

Lisa Fosmark
In just a few years Lisa Fosmark has carved out a place in the Danish club scene. Her sets move between hip-hop, house and UK garage, and the mix holds together from first track to last.

KNUS10
Part of Copenhagen's Christiania Sound collective. KNUS10 moves between Dancehall and Baile Funk with the kind of energy that's hard to stand still to. Two genres that hit differently but land in the same place.

No requests, OK?! Trust the DJs, stay with the flow.

I 2026 fejrer Bas Under Buen 15 års jubilæum og du og hele Danmark er inviteret.
Som Nordeuropas absolut største festival for basmusikken fejres Bas Under Buens jubilæum i år med kæmpe soundsystems og landets mest bastunge artister og DJs samt et udvidet BørneBas-program og et helt nyt opkvalificeringsprogram for unge kulturskabere.

Boot up. Log in. Lose control.
Absolute Bounce 2000 is your glitch in time—dialing straight back to the Y2K era where chrome dreams, pixel fever, and underground rave energy collide. Think flip phones, cybercore aesthetics, and dancefloors that feel like a corrupted hard drive on overload.
Expect high-BPM bouncy techno, elastic basslines, bouncy techno and trance-laced grooves that hit like a dial-up connection on steroids.

ALYOSHA (ARG)
An acclaimed figure in the dance community, Alyosha’s sets are a journey through sound that leaves an indelible mark on all who experience them. Known for their infectious energy and captivating stage presence, they’re a true force in the world of electronic music, sweeter than the last drop of a perfectly crafted mix.
With a heart rooted in the essence of 90s acid and trance, Alyosha’s sound is a nostalgic homage to the iconic era of electronic music, infusing each set with the euphoric highs and mesmerizing beats that defined a generation. Alyosha hits harder than the drop in Sandstorm by Darude—no doubt about it.

events.title: BASS UNDER BUEN EXTENDED
events.description:
Bas Under Buen Extended. Saturday, July 11th. The party started under the bridge. Now it continues indoors at Sigurd. Same energy, more floor, no curfew.

Gavnlig
Danish-Icelandic producer and DJ with a technical finesse and a truly distinctive taste. Usually operating in heavy breaks and techno territory but reads a room with the ease of someone who has done it long enough to know when to shift. Genre-fluid, always in service of the floor.

High Graid
Fifteen years deep with roots in East London. Producer and DJ with stripped-down, high-intensity sets built for the dancefloor. UK funky, hard drum and UK bass at the core - pulls from anywhere, always lands the element of surprise.

Sanjari
Persian melodies woven into modern house and dance music. Hypnotic rhythms, traditional textures, high-energy club grooves. Curator of the Silk Road event series at Sigurd CPH.

Califano
Dubstep, DnB and bass-heavy club sounds delivered hard. Known from Culture Box, Baggen and Module. Hits hard and keeps the floor locked.

Fergus Murphy
A trusted Copenhagen selector with a sound that spans new and old music from all around the world. Blends soul with instinct, crosses genres and dives into musical wormholes that only make sense once you're in the room. Opening the evening across Klubben and Haven.

No requests, OK?! Follow where it goes. 

Sigurdsgade 39, 2200 20:00–04:00 Free till 23 · 120 DKK after Free wardrobe · 21+

events.title: strictly strictly with Vincent Neumann & Ensure
events.description:
Berlin based label Strictly Strictly arrives in Copenhagen and presents Leipzig's finest Vincent Neumann, one of the residents of Leipzig's Distillery since 2012, and known for his energetic, driving, enthusiastic and sometimes even relentless marathon sets at Berghain or Bassiani.

ensure is a DJ and producer from Vilnius, Lithuania, currently based in Copenhagen. She focuses on rare 90s psychedelic and hypnotic sounds, drawing from years of digging and playing in different settings - from clubs to festivals. This experience has shaped her distinct style, both in the booth and in production, with a couple of releases to date.

Strictly Strictly was founded in 2016 in Berlin, started as a festival, morphed into a label and hosted a series of events across Berlin and around Europe for the past 10 years. Driven by breakbeats, trance, house and techno, it's co-founder klex will close the night. He has released music on respected labels like his second home Warning, Mana Abundance, and Electric Shapes, with his debut EP, Klextasy, which dropped on his own imprint, Strictly Strictly in 2024.

Open Decks & Ping Pong is back once again!


Right now it’s hot, humid, and slightly delirious — so what better time to cool off with cold drinks, deep cuts you’ll probably never hear again, and a few hard-fought ping pong victories?


As always, expect:

events.description:
Thursday is FLOOR. One DJ, one continuous flow, and a room that's allowed to go wherever the music takes it. No handovers. No resets. Just one person in full control of the night from start to finish.

We begin with happy hour from 22 to 23: Vodka Dansevand/Maté drinks and Dark 'n' Stormy for 65,-, and Classic or Pilsner beers for 30,-. Start early, stay late.

**Karlita's Way** takes over the booth.

A Copenhagen selector with a selection that spans Baile Funk, Batida, Dembow, UK Garage and global bass edits, brought together with the instinct of someone who genuinely loves every corner of it. Karlita's Way pulls from São Paulo, London, Kingston and everywhere in between, dropping unreleased flips and sharp edits alongside the tracks that shaped the sound. Genre lines dissolve somewhere in the middle and you stop caring where.

No requests, OK?! Follow the sound and dance. Ses på FLOOR!

IDA ENGBERG
Ida Engberg is a powerhouse in the global techno scene—DJ, producer, and visionary artist who has spent nearly two decades shaping underground dance floors with hypnotic, driving energy. Born in Sweden, she started spinning vinyl in at her local youth center at the age of 13, her raw talent and passion quickly propelling her into the heart of the electronic music world.

Her breakout track, “Disco Volante”, spread like wildfire across Europe, but Ida’s impact goes far beyond one hit. From intimate pulsating underground clubs to the most respected festivals in the world; Awakenings, Tomorrowland, Exit Festival, Ultra Miami and beyond. Her sets are journeys from deep, raw hypnotic techno fusing rolling basslines, tribal percussion, and atmospheric textures into pure sonic magic.

In 2023, she made history with MYSTIK, her full-season Ibiza residency at Club Chinois, making her the first woman to hold such a position on the island.

events.title: Ricardo Roessel / KC Wray / CCTV
events.description:
Chicago meets Berlin meets Copenhagen at Culture Box.

Three artists shaped by the pulse of Chicago’s underground, now rooted in Berlin and Copenhagen, come together for one special night, curated by Ricardo Roessel. A devoted record digger and master of the extended vinyl journey, Roessel brings his signature deep-cut selections and dancefloor intuition to the forefront.

Joining him are KC Wray, whose path runs through the legendary Warehouse lineage and global institutions like Panorama Bar and Smartbar, and CCTV, Chicago underground mainstay turned Berlin selector, known for energetic, genre-fluid sets rooted in movement, connection, and fearless exploration.

A rare Chicago lineage in Copenhagen—raw, refined, and built for the dance floor.

First drink/beer for free the first open hour.

events.title: Phat 909: Jordan George (UK), Adrian Salcedo, Harrison Heat, JohanTheFirst (UK), Thor Calin
events.description:
Phat 909 

Main Line up

Jordan George (UK)
Jordan George is a fast rising DJ and producer out of Birmingham, and if you've caught one of his sets you already know the vibe: high energy, feel good, and built on old school sounds he's twisted into something that's unmistakably his. He's been picking up support from some serious names in the scene along the way, and his catalogue of guest mixes (including a hard house session for Groove Society) shows a guy who's not just riding a sound but genuinely obsessed with it.

Adrian Salcedo
Fresh of Fête de la Musique and Distortion Festival, Adrian has cemented his signature style blending high energy Gospel, Trance, UKG, 90's and House. Drawing inspiration from the Dutch scene (ADE, Dekmantel), he will also introduce fresh, original mixes crafted alongside multi-platinum award-winning producer Daniel Mirza. As always he will be taking you to church only this time adding groves inspired by his Thailand tour and Circoloco Phuket.

Harrison Heat
Harrison Heat has been behind the decks in Copenhagen for close to ten years now, and he's the kind of DJ who'll talk your ear off about vinyl if you let him. His sound comes straight out of Chicago house, jacking and bouncy, and he's played alongside heavyweights like Eris Drew and Octo Octa at REFRACTIONS. Outside the booth he's co founder and booking manager at Pleasure Control and keeps busy as a graphic designer too, so the guy's got his hands in pretty much every corner of the scene.

Warm up

JohanTheFirst
JohanTheFirst grew up in London but he's made Copenhagen home, and he's brought a genre bending sound with him that jumps between grime, UKG and Jersey club without ever feeling forced. Since the move he's quietly built himself a name locally, playing venues, in store sessions and festivals, with a standout appearance at CPH Distortion along the way. Expect bass, energy and a proper gun fingers moment or two.

Thor Calin
An rising star, who recently won a spot at Relevance Festival warm up with a strong deep house selection. It earned him a spot at the notorious Culturebox delivering a groovy deep house set. This time giving you a house-focused Baggen spirit warm up set.

events.title: NATKAT + BIMS + DJ Whut! + B from E
events.description:
Den 23. juli er der fri entré til koncerterne med NATKAT og BIMS + DJ sets fra DJ Whut! og B FROM E i Byhaven. Vi åbner kl. 15.00 og musikken starter kl. 16.00. Yeerro serverer lækre gyros fra kl. 17.00 og baren bugner naturligvis af lækre Brooklyn-øl, naturvin og cocktails.
NATKAT
NATKAT er en hiphop-duo fra København, der har opbygget kultstatus i undergrunden med deres kompromisløse tilgang til lyrik, beats og stemning. Duoen kombinerer klassisk boom bap med en nutidig tilstedeværelse og elektronisk kant. Siden 2014 har Natkat markeret sig som et navn, man ikke bare lytter til - men oplever live.
I foråret 2026 vendte NATKAT tilbage med deres første single i syv år. Modtagelsen var massiv og kulminerede i en afspærret Bragesgade på Nørrebro.
BIMS
Støvede beats, sjælfulde hooks og rim, der sidder præcist der, de skal. BIMS henter sin inspiration fra de store ordsmede i black star-traditionen og pakker det ind i en alternativ, organisk lyd, der er hans helt egen. Forvent self-produced beats, tætte vers og en stemning, der er del undergrund, del poesi.
DJ Whut!
Fra New York til Nørrebro og siden mere end 25 år rundt om på dansegulve, klubber og festivaler. DJ Whut! (Jason Rivera) bygger sine sets på klassisk hiphop, boom bap, soul og funk, og bevæger sig gennem klassikere, deep cuts og sjældne perler med respekt for kulturen og en dyb kærlighed til musikken.
B FROM E
Siden 2007 har B FROM E formet dansegulve i København og rundt om i verden med en sikker fornemmelse for rum, stemning og det rigtige øjeblik. Hans sets glider smukt og frækt gennem house, disco og garage — altid med sving, altid med timing og en spillevende nysgerrighed over for, hvad rummet faktisk har brug for.

events.title: Order of Magnitude with Derango & Mussy Moody
events.description:
Order of Magnitude w/ Derango & Mussy Moody @ Den Anden Side

Friday, July 24 │ Normal Selection │ Forest Trance, Psytrance
————

On Friday, July 24th, we open the doors for the next installment of our Order of Magnitude trance event series. This time, we welcome legendary forest trance producer Derango, a.k.a. Ghostscent, alongside his partner, both privately and musically, Mussy Moody. Together, they are also known as Alchemist. 

The creativity of Derango is a full expression of the psychedelic experience transferred in music. Their huge sound pictures are created combining a solid-warm base with on the top waves of sounds from synths and samples in a constant change and movement. The result is a unique wrapping effect that gives to the listeners on one side the safe feeling of the belonging to mother earth womb, and on the other side, the challenge of discovering and understanding that our mind and spirit have no borders. ‘

‘Thy Trung is a female psychedelic trance music producer from Denmark, originally she has Vietnameese/Chineese roots. Mussy Moody aka Thy Trung started her education in an electronic computer school in Aarhus, where she began to get introduced to psytrance. Working now for several years on her own musical creations under a few synonyms like Magnolia or forming the Psilo Cowboys with Jahbo. And now Alchemized with Ola Eriksson from former Derango, she has substantial experience in the worldwide trance scene. However, her main focus is on her most recent project Mussy Moody where she shows her passion for madness and twisted atmospheres. Already released several tracks on international labels like Insomnia from Russia, Trishula Records in the Netherlands, Phreex Network in Japan and Mistress of Evil from the USA and played in 32 different countries around the world.
Puts her name solid as one of the leading psytrance female producer in the trance scene. Being an inherent part of the Parvati Records crew from the early times she relentless works on new sounds for the party crowd and convinces frequently with releases on her hometown label like the “Psy Stories Trilogy” or the “No strings Attached” split album.’

To host the night, we have our very own OOM resident Filen opening and closing the event. We can't wait to see you there! :)

DJ MARIA. Elevating Tokyo’s Techno Scene to New Heights 

Hailing from Osaka and currently based in Tokyo, DJ MARIA. has  been strengthening her presence as a key figure in pushing the  boundaries of the city’s techno scene, which has evolved alongside diverse cultural influences. Over the past few years, her impact on  the international DJ circuit has led to her recognition as a symbolic artist of Tokyo’s—and Japan’s—new-generation techno movement. 

Her DJ style captivates audiences with its immersive storytelling,  seamlessly transitioning between groovy techno rhythms that energize the body and trance sounds that deeply engage the mind. This sensory-driven approach leaves a lasting impression, often making her sets one of the most memorable highlights of the night. events.title: DJ Tennis, Ena Cosovic, NILU, RO, Adam Eisert
events.description:
DJ Tennis
Founder and A&R of Life and Death Records, Manfredi Romano grew up tour-managing punk bands and organizing left-field music events in Italy around the turn of the Millennium. Having completed his studies in computer science at the University of Pisa, Manfredi then formed DAZE, Italy’s first booking agency solely devoted to electronic music. 

Drawing on two decades of experience behind the scenes, Romano shifted focus to DJ Tennis, established in 2010 and quickly gained worldwide recognition in the electronic music scene.

As a performer, DJ Tennis has the unique ability to create intimate atmospheres in the vastest of gatherings, blending elements of house, techno and disco in eclectic and captivating ways. 

Manfredi is also a long-time producer; in his studio work he consistently channels his past relationships with post-rock luminaries such as Godspeed You! Black Emperor, Tortoise and Fugazi into intricately-synthesized electronic constellations. Throughout his career, DJ Tennis’ music has been released on Kompakt, Rhythm Assault, Running Back Records, !K7, Cercle Records, Aus Music, Circoloco Records, other than having frequent his own releases on Life and Death. Tennis also remixed the likes of Diplo, Boys Noize, Loco Dice, WhoMadeWho, Acid Pauli and more.

After five and a half years, countless memories, shows, collections, friendships, and moments we never thought possible, the time has come to say goodbye.

A final gathering for everyone who has been part of the journey - whether you attended a show, wore a collection, came to an event, collaborated with us, or simply followed along. 

For one last night, we celebrate everything that was.

And everything that remains.
The community.
The friendships.
The memories.

August 7th.

The Funeral.

See you for one last dance.

FC Forever.

MIAW - Pride starts underground

DEN ANDEN SIDE

SATURDAY 8TH OF AUGUST 23.59
Before Copenhagen turns rainbow-coloured for a week, we gather underground.
For this special Pride Week opening edition, MIAW returns to Den Anden Side with a lineup bringing together local favourites and international guests across house, techno, trance and everything in between.

FAFI ABDEL NOUR
Headlining the night is Fafi Abdel Nour from Amsterdam. A DJ, community builder and one of the most exciting voices in Europe's queer club culture, Fafi creates musical journeys that move seamlessly between house, breakbeats, melodic passages and moments of pure euphoria. His approach to dance music is rooted in connection, freedom and community. We are beyond excited to have him behind the dj booth. 

MAJDOLEN
If you were with us on January 3rd, you probably already know why we're excited about this. Majdolen's MIAW debut quickly became one of the most talked-about sets we've hosted.
And now she's coming back! 
Based in Berlin and a resident at Power Dance Club, Majdolen has quickly become one of the most exciting names in the city's queer underground. As founder of Substation – one of Berlin's newest queer underground parties – she is helping shape a scene built on freedom, experimentation and community. Behind the decks, she moves effortlessly between hypnotic techno, trance-soaked psychedelia, house and unexpected emotional detours, creating the kind of collective euphoria that keeps people moving until the very last track.
Joining them throughout the night are some of our favourite artists and familiar faces:

events.title: MISSIO (US) // RUST
events.description:
MISSIO bryder frygtløst reglerne, når de sammenfletter elementer af rock, elektronisk musik, indie og hiphop til en enestående og kompromisløs hybrid. Austin-duoen bestående af Matthew Brue og David Butler binder på overfladen vidt forskellige tråde sammen med ærlige og inderlige tekster, der både skal provokere og inspirere.

Efter EP-serien ‘Cinco’ (2023–2024) præsenterer duoen deres hidtil mest gennemførte og dynamiske vision med deres dobbelte fuldlængdealbum ‘I Am Cinco’. Albummet samler fem stemninger – I Am Sad, I Am High, I Am Awesome, I Am Angry og I Am Crazy – i ét samlet værk.

Siden 2015 har MISSIO tegnet dette musikalske billede med ‘Loner’ (2017), ‘The Darker the Weather // The Better the Man’ (2019), ‘Can You Feel The Sun’ (2020) og ‘VILLAIN’ (2022). Med over 1 milliard streams har deres katalog for alvor ramt publikum – særligt med den guld-certificerede single “Everybody Gets High”. Når de ikke har spillet turnéer for udsolgte sale, har de optrådt på festivaler som ACL og Lollapalooza og fået ros af medier som Atwood, Billboard, Rolling Stone, New Noise og Substream.

events.title: Vinocio Copenhagen 2026
events.description:
Some Traces Of House represents an artistic platform focused on underground house music where different sound perceptions are highlighted according to each artist. This concept was founded by Ivan Dallmann in 2020. STOH allows international artists to express themselves in music podcasts and it also works as an independent record label and musical events promoter, aiming to diversify channels and boost up different ways of expression.

In this opportunity we are glad to host Vinocio for the second time and with the full band, on their 2026 European tour at H15 in the mythical meat packing district of Copenhagen. 

Vinocio is a project that blends genres like Soul, R&B, Hip Hop and Jazz, strongly influenced by the 70 / 90's sounds but at the same time keeping loyal to its roots by their lyrics and Argentine accent. The founding members of this Funk / Soul band from Buenos Aires are Lucio Memi and Fermin Carpena, later on joined by other musicians such as Juan Duque (AKA Chiljud), Ivan Chapuis, Fer Moreno and Maxi Sayes. Their music is inspired by funk and soul from the 70's by artists like Roy Ayers and neo-soul artists like D’Angelo.

The promising band shared stage with iconic musicians such as Kamasi Washington (USA), Marcos Valle (Brazil), Kamaal Williams (UK) and Ratones Paranoicos (Argentina). They also played in international festivals like Lolapallozza, Primavera Sound and Cosquín Rock.

It will be a soulful summer evening with good music, drinks, chill vibes, DJ guests and that special argentine crowd atmosphere you don’t wanna miss.

Tickets Info.

Early Bird: 160 DKK + RA Fee
1st Release: 180 DKK + RA Fee
General Admission: 200 DKK + RA Fee
Final Release: 220 DKK + RA Fee
Door: 250 DKK + RA Fee

Drawing inspiration from trance euphoria and the raw power of driving techno, she has crafted a signature sound that balances intensity with poetic depth.

With releases on leading labels such as Factory 93, Kraftek, Respekt Recordings and mau5trap, and support from Amelie Lens, Adam Beyer, ANNA, Alan Fitzpatrick and Pleasurekraft, she continues to carve out her own lane in contemporary techno, driven by a fierce commitment to artistic authenticity.

Argentine producer, DJ, and singer Rocío Portillo returns to What Happens — Denmark's longest-running monthly club night and one of Europe's leading events for organic and progressive house music.

Rocío Portillo releases music on Mango Alley, Hoomidaas, and Sudbeat Music, and her productions have received support from renowned artists including Hernán Cattáneo, Guy J, and Nick Warren. She is joined in Black Box by Denmark's award-winning legend Tim Andresen, fresh from the release of his album on Sofa Beats, and Ayelen, who took us by storm with her debut appearance. Meanwhile, in Red Box, Marsans, Matias Oliveros, and Distracted will take the crowd on a musical journey in what promises to be a truly magical night at Culture Box.

First drink/beer for free the first open hour.
